reviews.snippet: Honestly extremely underrated at Columbia. The sushi is so fresh the rice is always soft and not hard like the store bought ones. One time near closing time she gave me two for the price of one. The frozen yogurt is HUGE with so many topping options. I had the gyu don and honestly wow so much meat and rice. Love that they accept dining dollars too

Cafe East is hands down the best dining option on Columbia’s campus. The menu features a variety of well-prepared dishes like sushi, teriyaki chicken, and other classic East Asian options. What really sets it apart is its surprisingly good boba tea—something you wouldn’t typically expect from a campus cafe.
The tea is brewed just right—whether you go for classic milk tea or one of their fruit teas, the flavors are fresh and well-balanced, never too sweet or watered down. The boba itself has a perfect chewy texture that complements the drinks without overpowering them. It’s honestly the kind of quality you’d expect from a specialty boba shop, not a campus cafe. As for the sushi, it’s decent, especially considering the price—$10 for a roll is a great deal for a quick bite between classes. It’s nothing gourmet, but it gets the job done when you’re craving sushi on a budget. But if you’re stopping by Cafe East, the boba tea is the real highlight.

Cafe East is my FAVORITE place to go for a snack and study session. They are so speedy and always have the freshest sushi. Their froyo is SO good too. Egg tart is the best! Vanilla matcha is also so good. So clean too, just the AC is way too cold and you need to bring 3 layers.

Truly the worst bubble tea place I've ever been to. Some of the flavors, like Caramel, are undrinkable. And for the flavors that I do like somewhat, they vary in quality so sometimes it tastes okay, others I can't get more than a few sips through. Do yourself a favor and go to TeaMagic a few blocks down.

got a vanilla matcha latte with no ice. did not realize it came with boba, the menu was definitely not very clear on that. the drink itself was good! not too sweet and the boba was chewy. i had to wait a bit for someone to take my order.

Nice atmosphere and interior to lounge at! Also located conveniently at the lerner center. Came here for the boba since we were here for a pre college program at Columbia. Very good boba and not too sweet! Grandiloquent and stupendous menu.

I must say though… business must be very lucrative over here since the boba cost us around $8 (after tax). The cashier was also a bit audacious and impatient with us. The hours are also irregular since they don’t always open on schedule.

Definitely agree with the other reviews on the quality of bubble milk teas. Tea magic is so much better. I used to drink here often. Ordered Taiwan oolong milk tea with bubbles and the guy forgot the bubbles. I don't wanna go back in the storm now to get a new tea. Go here for overpriced food and below average bobas. I would anyway choose strokos a couple of blocks down for food and teamagic for teas unless they are not open. On the food front they have sushi rolls, cut fruits and fruit smoothies. You can bring outside food here to have a bite and the ambience is nice.
Im a coffee guy, and this chai boba tea is creamy tasty with a nice herbal tea flavor thats like cakey. Light sweetness and plenty of boba goodness. Sept. 9 2021 😊😋🧋

People are right that the bubble tea could be better but I've always enjoyed the tea I've gotten there. If you're a boba connoisseur better to head elsewhere. Go there for the other offerings. The sushi is pretty high quality, convenient, and inexpensive. Nice fruit smoothies and frozen yogurt as well. There is also always fresh iced tea, sliced fruit, and fruit/cracker/cheese/peanut butter combos in the cooler to grab and go. Super fast, convenient, good seating with outlets and wifi.

I've been getting the banana berry smoothie here for years without strawberry because I am allergic to strawberry. They became annoyed when I requested no strawberry, and told me that changes are not allowed and I needed to choose something else from the menu. I don't understand why they changed their policy after all these years and would love to go back to the days when they were happy to accommodate my allergy.
The acai bowl was rly good!

if you're looking for quality, look else where. Tea magic is just way better and its only a few short blocks away. they have a huge consistency problem. Sometimes the bubble tea is okay at best, but than other times its like why did I buy it at all..

perfectly sweet and balanced with earthy flavors, the milk tea is delicious and not bitter AT ALL. as your residential bubble tea connoisseur, I highly recommend this place, as the teas as well as the acai bowls are tasty

I came here once at 7:50pm and asked for froyo and was told it could not be made... I accepted that as I saw the toppings had been put away but today I came in at 7:45. I asked for a smoothie and was told it could not be made. I then asked for froyo with toppings and was told that it could not be made. The toppings had not been put away yet and froyo truly is not difficult and only requires pulling the lever on a machine (as I have seen done before). There is no reason for this kind of service... don't have closing officially stated at 8:00 but then stop serving 90% of items 15 minutes before closing.

Drinks are inconsistent and the tea is sometimes too bitter (even with milk!) but they're lightning fast. Incredibly convenient for Columbia students, but by far the worst bubble tea option in the area (especially with the opening of Gong Cha nearby) even though it may be the cheapest.
Good place for quick bit. Above the bookstore and fast WiFi. Heaven when you are a student.
Best gyudon I’ve ever had! Matcha ice cream is delicious as well.
Under renovation currently, they have pretty good sushi that goes half priced 15 min before closing. Hopefully it stays good after the renovations
really good bubble tea and nice people working! prob the best food place on campus
I don’t know who needs this but you really need to try Salted Caramel Hojicha with Boba. It’s the best boba I’ve had! This place is pretty expensive though.
I recommend this beef Don. Great for lunch.
The sushi is always so fresh and yummy !
Takes Dining Dollars and is a great place to grab a quick eat on the way to class.

reviews.snippet:
You need to be a graduate student or specific faculty – or you know someone who is – in order to access to this spot. It is located inside the Graduate Student Center of Philosophy Hall. To the left of the entrance is where the cafe is located. You need an ID badge to enter.

The inside the cafe was quite nice! Very high building, clean and modern. A good place for grad students to relax in peace and quiet. There is an ordering counter with baked goods nicely displayed. They also have sandwich, salad, soup, and few other items here.

We started off with Hot Matcha Latte and Iced Matcha Latte, with pretty good matcha flavor. It was surprisingly good, we were happy with them both.

For food, we Avocado Toast and few donburi dishes. The Avocado Toast didn’t look like much, but it was actually REALLY good! They have a few donburi, and we chose Tuna Yukke Don and Gyuu Don. It came out without poached egg. We took it back to the staff, and he said “yes, you can order these without eggs.” Ummm, well, we DO want to eggs with these. The older staff got a bit confused, went to the back kitchen, and then discovered they don’t have eggs brought in yet. What!

About 10 minutes of wait, they brought in eggs, and made the poached eggs for our dishes. Needless to say, our food was staring to get cold, but not too bad… Finally, the egg was on the top with some seasoning, and the our “bowls” were finally complete. They were good and tasty.

To finish our lunch, we ordered a cup of Mango from inside their refrigerator. They were all perfectly ripe and juicy!

Overall, the experience was good. The price is a bit high, but then the quality of food and drink was really good too. If they didn’t have the egg incident, it would have been much better experience.
The SIPA cafe is less crowded and the employees hate you less. Food is still awful though

I love love the food of this cafe. The atmosphere of all the employees is professional and sweet. Food is prepared well and the drinks are delicious. I love love Arianna, she always makes sure to make little hearts is my latte and is super sweet. No complaints what’s so ever. I’ve never had a problem with enjoying my lunch at the cafe area!!!

This cafe is literally the best. When I come out of school I usually go here. There’s this one worker, I think her name is Ariana? And she’s makes the best drinks, and does a lot of drinks really fast when I’m in a rush lol. I also love how light the cafe is and how much out door lighting comes in, which is an amazing quality. I would always come here!!

updated: awesome awesome place! i always go out of my way to go here and it's such a pleasant experience with the crew there! lucie and ariana are the best and so is the rest of the crew, but i havent gotten to learn their names yet. their drinks and customer service is excellent and it feels like a tight knit group/community which you dont usually find in these new york city streets, to say the least! i also love the food, in particular the pork banh mi and as of late i have a newfound love of the cream cheese pockets. i'm happy i found this place a few months ago and the friendliness/excellent customer service along with the delicious beverages and food is one of the reasons i will be returning! happy customer!

The workers this place hires is amazing! This one barista, i believe her name is Arianna(?) curly hair, latina, she very much makes the atmosphere so welcoming and always is making my matchas amazingly well. I recommend this place 10/10

You will need a Columbia ID/a friend who is a student at the uni to be let in. This place gets a lot of daylight and grad student footfall through the day. It's a great place to work if you have high tolerance for ambient noise/a good pair of noise cancelling headphones. Grab a donburi or bahn-mi when your stomach starts to growl from too much reading!

The best place for coffee and delicious snacks on Columbia's campus. Great báhn mì sandwiches. Also, if you want sushi on campus, Nous Espresso is your place. Only open to graduate students and faculty.
Service is terrific, all staffs are so friendly. For coffee, all of them are good but especially cold brew coffee is so strong I can't drink it at once. It is great coffee for writing manuscripts...

Their gyudong is really delicious and will fill your stomach for a whole day basically. The soft-boiled egg will upgrade the whole taste. But it is definitely expensive for a just deli. Except the price, everything was satisfying.
My favorite coffee shop on the Columbia campus. They brew Stumptown coffee and make sushi, soup, and sandwiches onsite. The service is friendly and the quality of their offerings is very good.

Of Columbia's student cafes, I think it's at least on par with the various Joe's, and certainly better than the various Blue Java outposts across campus. But the price point is a little higher than comparable spots.
Food is good but pricy. If you order soup, be sure to ask the cashier to double check if it’s still in stock. They might charge you and then find out the soup jar is empty.
Exclusively for graduate students. Not too noisy, sushi aight, ordered the chicken rice bowl. Would be nicer without plastic containers.
Generally quiet, but can get too crowded/loud. For grad students only. Good lighting and coffee. Overpriced food

Cool place for students to gather. You need access key to enter or someone to open the door for you.

reviews.snippet:
I've been to different Hex & Co locations throughout the city, and this is my favorite. Good beers on selection, spacious/cozy, and (most importantly) a wide array of games to pick from.

I also have to give a shout-out to this location as a private event space. We hosted our wedding reception and were really able to personalize the event with puzzles and unique decorations/wall art with help from their staff, particularly Simon and Olivia. They were gracious enough to let us store some materials early (and pick up well after our formal reservation). Would highly recommend any game enthusiasts check out this location, and can't sing enough praises for the staff in helping us plan our own special event.

We attended a wedding at this location and it was an unexpectedly great location. Simon, the event coordinator, was highly cooperative and rearranged a lot of their own merchandise and wall decorations to accommodate the couple's preferences. Olivia, the lead bartender, also did a phenomenal job at the event.

Hex & Company by Union Square is a solid spot for board games and a place we generally enjoy spending time at. The game selection is extensive, the setup is straightforward, and it’s easy to settle in for a few hours of play.

During our visit today, however, it was snowing and the space was extremely cold due to a lack of heat, which made it uncomfortable to stay for long periods. Since this is a café where people sit and play games for hours, temperature control really makes a difference in the overall experience.

The food and drinks are decent but on the pricier side for the quality. Nothing stood out as bad, but the value doesn’t quite match the cost. That said, Hex & Company is clearly focused on the board game experience rather than dining, so this wasn’t entirely unexpected.

The gameplay fee itself is reasonable at $15 for three hours, especially considering the wide variety of games available. Overall a good place for board games, but the lack of heat on a cold day and the pricing of food and drinks held this visit back from being a more comfortable experience.

Super nice venue, very accommodating with good food! I run Heroscape wargame monthly events here and the staff is always helpful with getting us what what we need and are always looking to improve the experience even though they're super busy. Vibe and ambiance are great too!

I was in town for a short time and in the mood for some riftbound. Store was very accomodating and there was a nice friendly community built. Place felt very inclusive for anyone. Friendly staff and very organized feel to the workflow. 10/10 would go again.

The gameplay fee itself is reasonable at $15 for three hours, especially considering the wide variety of games available. Overall a good place for board games, but the lack of heat on a cold day and the pricing of food and drinks held this visit back from being a more comfortable experience.

What a really cool idea! We visited from Maryland with our daughter and son in law and look forward to many more visits. The selection of board and card games is incredible, I would never have guessed there was that may games in the entire world! Must be thousands on their shelves to choose from to play while enjoying a beer with friends or family. I recommend NOT drinking until you find the game you really like and learn the rules of that game! Only after getting started should you go grab a beer. A little alcohol goes a long way to making the rules of a new game harder to understand!!! 😉 Price to play was inexpensive. Their beer selection is not huge but they have something for everyone, it is decent beer and well priced. They have food but it is not something to rave about. None of it was bad. Think of it as something to snack on while playing games. Pretzel Bites and chicken tenders were what we ordered. The atmosphere is loud and fun as everyone around you is having a great time. They also have games for sale if you find a game you really enjoyed. This is certainly a place to go if you like beer and board/card games.

The food came out frozen lol. Brought it back and they just said along the lines of the oven just does that sometimes/is wonky.

Also they charge scalper rates for Pokémon cards. Like I get it they need to charge more than what they paid but when it gets to be triple the price of MSRP… hard to support or justify.

I’ll just hop on line somewhere else on drop day at that rate lmao hope you enjoy looking at it on a shelf.

Paying a cover charge to play board games is a bit like paying to rent a chair at a library. It is a strange business model to ask for fifteen dollars just to sit down when I also plan on spending money on your food and drinks.
Because I have to pay $15 just to sit at the table, I am far less inclined to spend money on your food and drinks. I will usually grab dinner elsewhere first or head to a bar afterward just to avoid that feeling of paying double. Most successful social venues like beach clubs or the like operate on a food and drink minimum rather than a cover charge. That model would make me much more likely to drop $30 or more on food and drinks during the night and come here much more often thinking “let’s go out for a drink, OH I KNOW, let’s go to place that we can play board games at, it’s only a $20 food and drinks minimum”. But no. Now I will always go to a bar or restraint before/afterwards and frankly, may never come back anyways.

You have a great space, but this policy forces me to treat this as a one off event rather than a local hangout where I’d LOVE to be a regular. Make the switch to a minimum spend policy, not us but for you, and I’m SURE you will likely find that your per table revenue goes up, and your overall business.

Board game cafe, what a fantastic concept! Such a fun experience for only $10. I can't wait to come back again. Many many board games to choose from. You can stay as long or as little as you like. We ended up playing two board games in the nearly three hours we were there.

Drinks are also offered, both alcoholic and nonalcoholic, on tap and in the fridge.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Hex & Company is a fantastic spot in New York for both coffee lovers and board game enthusiasts. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, with a unique vibe that's perfect for anyone who enjoys gaming. The coffee here is top-notch, making it worth every visit.

What makes Hex & Company stand out is its dedication to board gamers. They regularly host activities and competitions, which adds a lively energy to the place. Just be aware that during these events, seating might be limited—but trust me, the experience is worth it! Whether you're there for the games, the coffee, or just to soak in the great ambiance, Hex & Company is a must-visit.

I really really enjoyed this place. We arrived late, but still got in an hour to enjoy the games, plus after 7pm you can park in the bus lanes so I was directly in front of the store. The ambiance is very relaxing. And I ended up with the drink something 75 lol, it was great though!

I recently returned playing Magic the Gathering - Commander (EDH). They have an excellent organizer, Mal. He always is joyful and makes the nights interesting. I really enjoy the mixup of the "extra" prize through the night other than the normal random packs we win. It has been only positive experiences for me.

I hope they know how much we appreciate having a space like this.
I don't know much about the food quality, but it smells good!
My friend held a wedding here and it was amazing! Super friendly and helpful staff and a ridiculous board game collection

What a cool place. The amount of games was overwhelming for me and didn’t recognize most of them but it’s a pretty chill place. Beers and snacks. Perfect place to go with friends or on a date. I’ll be back

Was disappointed that I spent $15 to only play board games for two hours. The staff knew they had an event at 6:30 pm and didn’t think to mention that we would only have 2 ish hours to play before they kicked us out despite the 11 pm closure. Also very cold inside and there was no heater where we were sat (literally next to the door on a 23F day!!!)

We were so excited to check out another Hex & Company location! This space was larger in both square footage and in game selection. Just like the other locations, they have a retail section as well.

We love that we found a place to check out new tabletop games and chill.

Hex & Company: A Game of Two Halves

Hex & Company, a quirky blend of board game cafe and retail store, is a delightful haven for gamers and coffee enthusiasts alike. The eclectic decor and inviting atmosphere create a unique and enjoyable experience.

The coffee, a caffeinated concoction that rivals the best of them, was a perfect pick-me-up. And the cheesecake pumpkin slice? A divine dessert that would make even the most discerning pastry chef swoon. The staff, for the most part, were friendly and helpful, guiding us through the labyrinth of board games and coffee options.

However, our experience took a turn for the worse on a second visit later that day when a staff member, perhaps having a particularly rough day or perhaps just a bit too invested in board game etiquette, confronted one of our group members for browsing the games without prior permission and renting. It was a bit like a librarian scolding a child for touching a book.

While it's understandable that the establishment has rules to ensure a fair and enjoyable experience for all patrons, the way the situation was handled could have been more tactful. A gentler approach, perhaps with a friendly reminder about the rental process, would have been more effective than the hostile approach we received from her.

Despite this minor hiccup, Hex & Company remains a charming place to spend an afternoon. Just remember to play by the rules, check with the staff before touching anything, or risk the wrath of the board game gods.

Neat spot! I came earlier in the morning around 9 and appreciated the gentle mood music playing overhead so that I could work on some things on my laptop. As the day progressed toward lunch time it seemed like the music got louder but maybe it was just the additional people that were visiting!

Seems like a cool place to plat board games with friends. I would come again!

Friendly staff, good selection of games (to play or purchase) and delicious food options -- I really enjoy the hot honey chicken sandwich. Updating this to include the tuna melt and the tater tots as delicious too! Great range of alcoholic, soft and hot beverages available -- the hot chocolate and the cider are both really good. $10 per person to play all day or $5 each for students, which is reasonable but it's a shame they don't have a minimum food spend for free play offer. They are however, happy to fill your reusable cup for the cost of a small sized drink!
What a great place to have a birthday party! Our reservation was ready for us and the chai latte I had was delicious! I think all my friends will come back!

I came here last when they were at the old place and let me tell you, they deserve this new place. It makes me so happy to see people having fun playing board games. Even though I'm an avid gamer, this is such an easy place to recommend. It's super fun, bring your friends or your family!
Really great local spot with lots of types of games in a great atmosphere with yummy food and friendly staff. Definitely recommend this place to hang out with friends.
It’s quite refreshing to see board game themed cafe. Great board game collection, great vibe!

An amazing place. Especially for students, who only have to pay $5 for entry. You can stay as long as you want and there is an abundance of games here. It is also worthwhile to note that not just the games themselves, but expansion packs if any are available as well. A great place worth your money if you are a student.
As cover charge. $10 per person is kinda pricey, but overall the variety of games is great, and the menu items tasty / interesting

If i could give this place 0 stars I would. I went here on Sunday with my group of friends. Everything was fine up until I ordered my food. The employee who was making the food mixed a beef burger patty and put it on my veggie burger. I bit into it thinking it was veggie and after a couple bites I started to feel sick to my stomach. I haven't ate meat for religious and health reasons in 8 years. I reached out to the owners by email and they never responded back to me. The manager at this location was apologetic but outside of him the entire staff was horrible. The lady who served the burger was dismissive to my entire table and catching an attitude the whole night. I think its insane that after having an irregular heart beat and now back and forth with doctors the owners of this establishment didn't think to reach out to me once regarding some form of compensation. Can you imagine someone having a severe food allergy and they serve they serve them the exact thing they can't eat due to negligence? Nonetheless this was a very traumatic experience and I will never step foot or recommend this establishment to anyone. Especially if the owners don't respond to me and make me feel better about this situation.

Today, we were charged $15 per person, including for my 3 year old, after we were told there were appropriate games and puzzles for my kids to use. However, there were no puzzles available unless I purchased the puzzle first and then the game my other daughter wanted to play (Sleeping Queens) was nowhere to be found and needed to be purchased as well. It was clear this was not a viable experience after 15 minutes but the person working at the front counter refused to give me a refund of the cover charges. Will not be returning, clearly not kid friendly.
Great game shop, friendly service, and amazing events for eternal magic formats. Staff is very nice too

A splendid local game store with games for everyone and support for MTG (drafts & commander). Need to pay entrance fee but if you are going to be there for a couple hours at least it’s worth it. Good beer selection too!

Had an amazing date with my husband. He's big into board games and so he thought it would be fun for me. They had walls of games that we don't even own. It was amazing and intimidating. I didn't know which game to play. The back room had an after school program for young kids who were learning how to play games. It was very wholesome.

If you love board games or logic games, this is a place you will really enjoy.

This popular hangout has a wide selection of games to play and to to purchase. To play at the tables, the cost is $10 and your time is unlimited.

There are also beverages and snacks for purchase.

I had a great time playing a murder mystery game with friends for over 4 hours! I recommend going on days when school are in-session to avoid extra noise or crowds, but even with the extra people, it was enjoyable. Great place to spend time - especially when the weather isn’t great outside!

Hex & Co is a great place to play board games with friends or other game lovers. They have a huge selection and the staff is very helpful. They do offer cafe items, beer, and wine for purchase. I had a delicious hot apple cider and had to stop myself from getting another.

I would highly recommend to those returning to board game playing after not playing for years and those who consistently play. Additionally, they have games for sale if you want to add to your collection. Everyone is welcome!
Favorite spot near Columbia. Staff is great, amazing game selection, and super affordable. Great spot for a coffee or to hangout with friends/meet new groups!

Selection and staff are fantastic. There is a game library where you can play for 10$ per table. Staff is knowledgeable and friendly. They have good and well priced snacks and coffee. The prices are reasonable even outside of Manhattan.

The game selection for sale is pretty decent. The game library is huge, and the tables are decent size. Some games may not be really feasible within the space though. The staff is a mix of very knowledgeable and "im here because I got bills", but all around pleasant. A fun visit, always.
I definitely love this place! It’s cozy, nice,very interesting design. Everything was awesome 😎 definitely recommend it.
Food was a bit pricey, and my dip that i got car frozen but they fixed it no problem. Love the environment and the room.

I work for Gigamic and visit a lot of board game cafes. Hex and co is excellent on all fronts. They were nearly capacity on a Monday afternoon. I had a latte and a blackberry danish. The danish was light and crispy, not too sweet. My latte was smooth and just lightly bitter. The staff is friendly and the manager even gave me a personal hello!
I usually go to their UES location but my friend lives in the area and this location was a lot closer and I almost like this location better. Always a lot of fun.
Really fun vibe. Pretty good good and reasonable prices. The desserts are superb. Fun drinks.
Discovered this place while looking for a quick coffee spot and impressed with the amount of board games. Vibe is chill. Service is friendly. And the coffee is good.

Great place for board games!! I always have a great time with friends here. The games are in great condition and they have a large variety. You pay one fee and can stay as long as you want. They have beer on tap and snacks for you to enjoy as well.

The staff is amazing and friendly. I left my purse there accidentally, and they kept it in their lost&found for over a week. Highly recommend!
Great place, with games from a-z and staff who are very nice. We sat for almost 4 hours and played. No time limit. And the food is really good!

This place is such a vibe. Jeremy is awesome. The private gaming areas feel so intimate and are decorated nicely. Can't wait to come back - my friends and I are already planning for some D&D sessions here!
My daughter loves the place. Gaming nerds welcome. Good vibe.
I love the atmosphere in this place and Faith the manager has such a great vibe. Food is great and the variety of boardgames feels endless. Definitely recommend!!
Amazing board game library and Cafe. Excellent retail selection.

The stores have nicely constructed interior spaces, but the experience is hampered by a generally confusing and unorganized retail and play space, as well as disinterested employees.

I visited both the Broadway locations, both were fairly empty at the times I had gone. I was barely greeted or engaged with by the employees who were more interested in their own conversations and didn't seem to be doing too much- I don't need tending too in retail stores, but it would be nice if they felt a little more approachable.

The retail shelves looked disheveled and unorganized- some games looked in poor condition for new. There are no price tags on anything as well. You have to bring the game up to the register to see the price, which I had never experienced in a game store before. This is shocking because lots of games range in a variety of prices and seems like a waste of staff's time to confirm a price for you if the store is busy, and awkward for the customer if they decide it's not the amount they were anticipating on spending.

The play space's games look beaten, battered, and like they were thrown on the shelves. I can't comment on my experience in actually playing at these locations, but if I were to pay to sit down and play, it would be nice to pull out a game in reasonable condition.

I've been in plenty of board game cafes and stores with play spaces and am disappointed that these are, largely, the experiences that New York City has to offer.

Maybe it is an off week for them, but I hope it improves in the future.

I started going to hex and co regularly when I moved to NYC to meet new people and play D&D, and I love it! I do weekly D&D sessions at the west side location and come in on weekend nights every so often for a friend game night. The atmosphere is great and I love being able to play nerdy games with my friends while also getting to have snacks and a beer or 2! The staff is awesome and so friendly, especially Jeremy who is my favorite to come and chat with between games, they are always so helpful and are one of the reasons I look forward to every Hex visit! Definitely recommend checking it out!

I like it the food wasn’t allat, I had the pizza it was pretty expensive and not the best so I recommend eating something before going in of you’re hungry. I went on a Monday so we didn’t have to pay hourly or whatever thing it is. Basically we payed once and we could spend as much time as we’d like there, it cost like 10 dollars? And with the student discount it’s 8. There’s lots of games and the atmosphere good I recommend going there to play some games with your friends, it’s nice.
The staff is very nice and the interior design is so amazing and cosy. There is a very large variety of board games to choose from and there is space for a lot of people to sit together.

This place is great. Anytime I'm in the city I stop here for lunch. The staff is friendly, prices are cheap, service is quick. It's easy to get drawn into watching people play board games. I wish we had a place like this in the city I went to college in (budget friendly with a fun atmosphere). I cannot think of another business I look forward to visiting like I do this one. If you're visiting the city put this place on your bucket list. It doesn't disappoint.
Fun place to go for board games, food, beer, and coffee!

Nice place to play Magic and other board games! I went here with some friends and the staff was really helpful picking a game that fit the group. They even helped us with some rules questions!
I found out recently that the workers are unionizing, which is great. If the workers are supported, the store will remain my go to gaming cafe.

So my friend, wife and I were vacationing in NYC and found this place on Google. Went out of our way to go to this Cafe! Right from the start we fell in love with this place! The guy at the counter was super cool with us and the staff were really chill and helpful! They helped us through the whole process, the food was delicious, the atmosphere was so warm and welcoming! The only thing we noticed was some of the games were missing pieces but there is NO short of GAMES. We LOVED this place! We drove from out of state to come and it was worth every penny and every second. We told our friends about this place and to make the trip to Harlem to spend a couple of hours at the Hex & Company!!!
We wish there was a Hex & Company where we live. Thank you again guys for a lovely time!!!

This place is awesome! It really ticks all the boxes. They've got an excellent selection of games and accessories for sale. The $10 cost to grab a table and play games is super reasonable considering you can stay for as long as you want. The beer selection is excellent and the snack foods hit the spot, at great prices too. The staff were super friendly and helpful. The general vibe was fun and welcoming. I felt very at home and look forward to coming here often in the future!
Had a wonderful date here with my girlfriend! Jeremy was so welcoming and helpful in recommending a game for us to play. So nice to have this in the neighborhood!
The best queer friendly bar I've ever been to. That AND board games? I'm going to cry when I have to leave this place.

raw_place.description: Upbeat cafe offering hundreds of board & card games, coffee, draft beer, breakfast & light eats.

reviews.snippet: Truth is I'm not a big fan of Greek food but hubby is. My dinner was eh, while he said his was OK, not great. The grape leaves were delicious and the baklava was devine. Hubby wanted beer but it was all sold out 2 days ago at Easter and the new delivery was late. He also wanted the rice pudding for dessert but that was also sold out. Service was great and restraunt was clean

response.snippet: Thank you so much for your review!

reviews.snippet: We were there in December and came across Symposium while walking. We were impressed by the cozy atmosphere and the amazing service we received. Our server knew a lot about the history of the restaurant and was helpful in suggesting a wine with dinner. The hummus, lemon potatoes and steamed vegetables were all very savory! I highly recommend and we will be back next time in NYC!

response.snippet: Thank you very much for your wonderful review!

reviews.snippet: This is my first time trying local Greek food as I had a favorite in Brooklyn that closed during the pandemic. Symposium will be my new go to spot. The service was excellent and the food was delicious.

response.snippet: We’re so happy you enjoyed the flavors and felt the Greek spirit in every bite. With gratitude, Symposium Greek Restaurant

reviews.snippet: We walked in on a Monday night, was seated fast. Decor was nice. Noise level was decent. Good came out quick. Waiter was good. The food was delicious. Took the soup to go, and was excellent. The food wasnt greasy. The plates were huge, so the price to food portion was a good value. We had some Mythos and Alfa beers. It felt like we were sitting back in Santorini on a late night dinner date.

response.snippet:
Raymond,

It’s wonderful hearing that your evening brought back the spirit of Greece in both atmosphere and taste.

With appreciation,
Symposium Greek Taverna

reviews.snippet:
We had dinner at Symposium for the first time tonight and everything was wonderful. Our favorites were the octopus, the mezze sampler (especially the tirokafteri), and the classic moussaka. The flavors had the perfect home cooked depth, true Greek classics.

The vibe is homey and cozy, great for a group of friends or families. We had the nicest servers, Alex and Elena, and we appreciated their hospitality.

The portion sizes were also generous and even though we were stuffed I’m glad we made room for dessert and Greek coffee- definitely recommend the galaktoboureko.

We will be coming back for sure!

response.snippet: Claire, it was a pleasure serving you and thank you for rating and sharing your experience at Symposium!

reviews.snippet:
Highly Highly Highly recommended! The general vibe of the restaurant feels homey and cozy, the staff is very nice, and most importantly; the food is delicious! The portions are big so you won't leave hungry!
They also have a special selection of wines that I recommend to try!
It's located close to the 1 train (Colombia University) so getting there is not a problem at all.
I definitely will be coming back!!

response.snippet: Vika, thanks for the review and the highlighting of your favorites!

reviews.snippet: This restaurant is definitely one of those jewels! It’s filled with eclectic artwork and the owners are super passionate about all the history of the space. It’s such a cozy spot. They are so warm and welcoming too!! There’s a hidden secret garden that’s so cool. The place is like a treasure chest! The food is delicious! They have so much to choose from. I think my favorites are the Pastitio, the Spicy Feta Dip, The Chicken Kebab, Meatballs… well I guess I just love everything! The wine is perfect too! This place is great for groups or parties or an intimate date night!

response.snippet: Thank you for your review and sharing your meal!

reviews.snippet: This place USED to be the absolute best Greek food in NYC. It was legendary. Now, the food is completely different and it is quite poor. The caviar dip was so light and wonderful and now it is a gooey, unappetizing mess. The pastitsio is covered in tomato sauce and now tastes Italian. The moussaka is just not what it was before. The pita was undercooked and flat. It used to be the absolute best. Will forever miss the old Symposium, with that wonderful , friendly man who ran the place.

response.snippet: Thank you for reviewing us!

reviews.snippet:
Ate at this historic restaurant with a friend who works at Columbia nearby . The space itself is incredibly beautiful. One of the loveliest and most welcoming spaces I’ve ever experienced in a restaurant. Service was also great and I appreciate that they chill the water in the ice bucket with the white wine so it comes to the table refreshingly cold.

The food was ok. We both got the puréed potato and beet appetizer which was excellent. My friend got a lamb burger that he really liked. I got the chicken souvlaki which was nothing to write home about. Both were part of a lunch special deal.

The table beside us got saganaki and a whole fish. That looked like a better meal, though I’m sure it cost more.

In short, I would go back but probably order something not on the lunch special menu.

response.snippet:
Stuart,
Thanks for sharing your thoughts an reviewing our restaurant!
We are looking forward to serving you in the future!
Best!

reviews.snippet: If you are a fan of Greek food this place is the one ! Amazing food and outstanding service, Elena and Nino are very nice and professional. We loved every single thing we tried from Dips platter to grilled calamari, chicken gyro lamb souvlaki and lamb shank. The wine , the beers and the sangria are also delicious. I would recommend this place to everyone. Thank you Symposium for an amazing dinner.

response.snippet: Thank you very much for revieweing us!

reviews.snippet: Authentic Greek food! Absolutely loved the dip sampler.

media.caption: Burger with crispy fries and ketchup

response.snippet: Tamera, We’re so happy you enjoyed the flavors and felt the Greek spirit in every bite. With gratitude, Symposium Greek Restaurant

reviews.snippet:
The Avgolemono soup was nice way to start a meal. The only regret was that I ordered a cup rather than a bowl. The Pastitsio was reminiscent of a lasagna with prominent notes of cinnamon and other spices.

The dining area exuded a warm inviting feeling that made me feel welcome. The staff was also nice.

response.snippet:
Leonardo,
Thank you very much for your review!
We are happy to hear that you enjoyed your meal at Symposium!

reviews.snippet: LOVED my chicken gyro! Everyone in our party enjoyed their meal. Definitely a hidden gem in NYC.

Very nice cozy restaurant with rich history and great Staff. Chef Dan came out and explained each dish that was brought out. Love the ambiance there, which is perfect for date night in a nice, quiet area of the city. I would recommend Symposium to anyone and EVERYONE!! Superb Greek cuisine and the sangria is delish!!

response.snippet: Thank you Carlos for sharing your experience, and rating us!

reviews.snippet: Great food! Our server was super kind and the food came out in a timely manner. Our group enjoyed every dish we ordered! The lamb was perfect. Highly recommend!

response.snippet:
Gabrielle,
We're so glad to hear you enjoyed your experience at Symposium, thanks for stopping by!

reviews.snippet: This restaurant is reminiscent of old style New York City homes with brick walls, wooden panels, and low lit environment. The service Sunday evening was excellent and delightful. The meal was delicious and well served.

response.snippet: Thank you very much for reviewing us!

reviews.snippet:
The $27 lunch special was well worth it, especially for a restaurant in Manhattan near to Columbia University.

The meat quality was quite good and the so were the sides.

I've been eating at Symposium for 29 years - at least once a year and, on many years, multiple times. My favorite Greek restaurant anywhere. You must must get the mixed-salad appetizer. Along with the warm pita that comes with it - I can eat this dish any day, every day!

response.snippet: Thank you very much for rating us and sharing with the others!

reviews.snippet: The inside of this restaurant felt capacious and cavernous. I must admit that I found it a little bit dark and isolating. But that's less a fault of the restaurant than a consequence of my being there by myself at around 3:00 in the afternoon. As for the food, it was fine. I had the lamb. It was neither the best nor the worst lamb I've had in my life. Portions were reasonably sized, and the price was reasonable. I have few explicit complaints, except that I want more than the simply adequate when I choose to go out to eat. So I'm giving three stars, though I admit that had I come here with a large party at around 7:00 or 8:00 at night, the atmosphere would have felt much more soothing and bustlingly alive.

response.snippet: Thank you, for sharing your experience!

reviews.snippet:
Very varied and good quality Greek dishes.
The 2 course special menu is excellent value for money, at 20 dollars.
Healthy and tasty food.
I recommend the Lavraki fillet and Youvetsi Me Keftedes.

response.snippet: Thanks for reviewing us and sharing the great pictures!

reviews.snippet: The food is top notch delicious! Our waiter Chris was super helpful and answered all questions. He even let us taste 3 different wines before choosing the wine we liked! Highly recommend trying this place out you won't be disappointed. 👍🏻

response.snippet:
Christopher,
Thank you very much for reviewing and recommending us, as well sharing the pictures!

reviews.snippet: Cute and cozy. We were there late, so it was empty inside. Every dish we ordered was amazing and we shared it all. Had a couple of bottles of wine that they got for us even though it was close to closing. We rushed ourselves out so they weren’t waiting on us, but we never felt rushed by the staff. Again, delicious food ! Kind staff.

media.caption: Food was too good to wait and take photos.

response.snippet: Thanks for rating us!

reviews.snippet: We had lunch. The dishes are pretty big, sharing a small symposyum as an appetizer and asking a souvlaki lamb then, I was completely full, even though I was pretty hungry. Anastasio, the server, makes you feel like you’re in a truly greek restaurant, given his knowledge of each dish and his greek soul. My brother and his girlfriend ordered a chicken gyro platter each, which was also really big and yummy. We were three and spent a total of $67. I’ll definitely come back.

response.snippet: Thank you very much for sharing your experience and reviewing us!

reviews.snippet: WOW!!! Best spinach pie ever! My wife spent time living in Greece and ate a spinach pie every day for lunch. She has been trying to find a similar pie for me to enjoy since I was not there. We have had spinach pies from the West coast to NYC. Here we found the best she has ever had and me as well. It was huge, thick, full of fresh spinach and cheese, flaky outside, hot, and served with style! Thank you!

response.snippet: Thanks vor visiting, we are glad that you had enjoyed our spinach pie!

reviews.snippet: I loved this place. The staff treated us so well and the food was so amazing. My husband and I both got the beef gyro combo plate and it was awesome. They put literal pieces of steak in it, which is so good. Also, I love the inside of the restaurant--I think it looks cool. Highly recommend this place if you like good Greek/Mediterranean food.

So it was my first time eating at a Greek restaurant and it was with a big group of around 16. The owner was super nice to us, so we got to try the pita bread and a light dish for free. Everything was really good :) love their chicken gyro!
Everything is amazing about this spot. A hidden gem. Food is delicious, service is great, prices are good, and atmosphere is amazing.

response.snippet:
Micah,

It means a lot to know you enjoyed both the food and the welcoming vibe here.

All our gratitude,
Symposium Greek Restaurant

reviews.snippet: Cheap fast-food quality for nice restaurant prices. The meal actually made me laugh because it was so underwhelming and overpriced. The vegetarian plate pictured below was $14.95….for unseasoned steamed vegetables and a quarter of a potato. The Kapama was $30.00 wasted.

We went on a chilly Saturday afternoon before the Columbia students were back. The restaurant was quiet, and we had a lovely, relaxing meal. Food was excellent! Service was a little slow but very friendly and kind.

response.snippet:
Ashley, It’s wonderful to know your quiet afternoon with us brought comfort and great food.
Thanks for reviewing us! Kind regards, Symposium Greek Taverna

reviews.snippet: Have to admit that the food is as good as in Greece. Amazing! Highly recommend this place. Very polite and friendly staff

response.snippet: Ionut, thank you for sharing and reviewing us!

reviews.snippet: The food was really good!! I will definitely be back

Terrible experience. Made a reservation yesterday (for today), received multiple confirmations, showed up to find the restaurant closed/under construction. The workers there called the owner who angrily shouted "Can't you see the sign says it's closed?" I told him we had a reservation, but before I could proceed he hung up. Not even an apology. I used to love this restaurant years ago but will never go back.

response.snippet:
Hi Karina,

We’re truly sorry for your recent experience. Although we shut down our reservation system, it appears that your booking accidentally went through. Unfortunately, we’ve been closed since last Friday due to a gas leak.

I also apologize if I spoke a bit loudly when my employee called me—I was in the subway at the time and wish our conversation had taken place under better circumstances.

We hope you’ll consider rebooking your dinner with us soon so we can show you the genuine hospitality we’re known for.
Wishing you happy holidays and all the best,
Chef Dan/Owner

reviews.snippet: I love this place, very cozy. The waiter is so nice with great service. I tried several food but I am not a big fan of olive, so I ask them not put olive every time.
the beef gyro is not real beef, it's highly processed beef strips. I didn't expect this type of beef with this price.

response.snippet:
Thank you for reviewing us!
for your information, those strips are shaved from a Gyro cone and the our meat is purchased from a reputable purveyor in Astoria.
Best,
Symposium team

reviews.snippet: I was craving Greek food and happened upon this place. Seemed like the perfect neighborhood restaurant. The waitress was very nice. This my salad was overwhelmingly drenched with lemon. I couldn’t eat it. They charged me for it anyway? She gave me a coffee on the house instead? To go to a kitchen and tell them the customer isn’t eating the 16$ salad because it was heavily dressed and to offer a free coffee? The lamb, although they didn’t ask me how I want it cooked, was very tender and delicious. But never going back.

response.snippet: Our apologies for the way things went!

reviews.snippet: While visiting the city a friend of mine who lives here recommended this quaint little restaurant with beautiful artwork that stretched from the walls to the ceiling tiles. When we walked in we were welcomed in like family! The owner came out to check on us multiple times offering up his favorite items off the menu and even offered a few samples to taste. The atmosphere, the customer service and of course the food was all definitely worth the trip. We were so taken care of and left extremely full and happy. I absolutely recommend this fabulous restaurant!

response.snippet:
Dear Gina, we are pkeased to hear that you had an enjoyable time at Symposium.
Thank you for taking your time to reviewing us!

reviews.snippet: The food is amazing. The place is so beautiful and the service is perfect

Avoid this place if you have food allergies. Neither the waiter nor the kitchen understood gluten gluten free. They served pita bread on the appetizer plate. The owner was very defensive when we reported this to him. The food was fair. The baked fish was probably frozen and had a layer of oil on top. I was served 1/2 of a small potato and the greens were definitely not spinach. There were no gluten free buns . My husband ate his cheeseburger on top of salad. The coffee and tea were not hot. Initially the waiter said all the coffee was decaf. When we inquired further he said they mixed the pots of regular and decaf. We hadn’t been back since we were students 40 years ago. What a disappointment.

response.snippet:
Thank you for reviewing!
We did our best to meet your expectations, but unfortunately it was very difficult!
Sorry, we had tried thoroughly!
And by the way, the fish is fresh and filetted by order, served with dandelions sauteed not spinach, as it clearly mentioned on our menu!

reviews.snippet: I'm OBSESSED. The food is impeccable! Get the tzatziki and the lemon potatoes! Everyone is so sweet and the vibes are always warm and charming. It's a must visit for me whenever I'm in town!

response.snippet:
Mallika,
We are thrilled to hear that someone is obsessed with our food!
Thanks for reviewing and sharing your thoughts!

reviews.snippet:
Whoa! The food was amazing! Im pescatarian, so I had the fish, and it was delicious. Everything was so fresh. There was a humus plate with 3 different flavors, and the cucumbers were beautifully decorated around them. I must have eaten all of the cucumbers. In some restaurants, a fresh cucumber can be hard to come by. The fish arrived on a bed sautéed spinach, WOW ❤️❤️. The sliced pita bread with the humus was addictive. I definitely ate way more than I should have. While I dont eat meat, the other folks I was dining with said the chicken and beef options were just as delicious. It was family style, so we had lots of options. The restaurant is small but quaint, and the customer service was amazing. The food came out quickly, and there were about 13 of us. We had a reservation for 1 pm on a Thursday, and it was not crowded.

There isn't a lot of space to move around, so I would be conscious of carrying large bags or strollers.

response.snippet: Zakiyah, Hearing that your group enjoyed so many fresh flavors in our cozy space truly means a lot to us. With gratitude, The Symposium Greek Restaurant Team

reviews.snippet: Service was excellent. Food was very good. Prices were reasonable and diversity of the menu was good. The Greek white wine I had was excellent. The meatballs were excellent also. The gyro meat was very good. However they hosted a very large group of people smack in the middle of the room taking up most of the smallish space, maybe 40 people in one long table. It changed the environment completely and not to mention the noise of the professors of their students were making. If that is common I won't go back.

response.snippet:
Aldo,
Sorry for the inconveniences!
The students are celebrating the end of the semester and most of all are gathering by Symposium.
It is mostly quiet during dinner time, but once in a while, get's noisy!
We appreciate your review, and look forward for your next visit!
Best,
Management

reviews.snippet: The food was the best and most authentic Greek food around. Tasos was an outstanding host. It was like having a meal by an old friend!

Had a Sunday lunch for five (we booked ahead). It was just such a fun and delicious experience. The waiter was really friendly and helpful, recommended some good dishes but also was honest with portion sizes (huge!) so we didn’t order too much. We had: Mixed dips mezze starter, moussaka (traditional and veggie), spanakopita, calamari, dolma and a Greek salad with chicken. There was so much food, we all took home a doggy bag. It was all delicious, there was nothing that didn’t feel fully authentic. Definitely recommend this place.

response.snippet:
Thanks a lot for your review!
Happy to hear that you enjoyed our food and service!

reviews.snippet: Most important tip you can get about this place: GET THE CHEESE. It's on fire. And it's so good. The ambiance is nice and service on top. Food was okay but I will stop by again definitely for the cheese (see picture... 🔥 mmm)

The food was really good but the 2 waitresses we had were kind of mean, in a way that they look at you and you know they hate you. They did not do or say anything wrong, but the whole service was cold and loveless, quite different from any other greek experience I am used to.

response.snippet: We're sorry to hear about your experience. Our team's goal is to provide warm, friendly service. We'll address your concerns and strive for improvement. We hope you'll give us another chance to serve you better. Sincerely, Symposium Greek Restaurant.

reviews.snippet: Absolutely the best restaurant in the area. Held an event for 30+ people here and it was a hit. Wonderful appetizers, entrees, and amazing service. If you want to host an event, I definitely recommend doing it at Symposium! The art on the walls make it a beautiful space, the music selection and overall ambiance is great as well. And of course, Chef Dan is a pleasure to work with. Definitely wonderful for smaller dinners as well. Eat here!!!

response.snippet:
Imane, it was a pleasure hosting your group for dinner.
Thank you so much for sharing your experience and rating us!
Looking forward to hosting you again!
Best,
Chef Dan

reviews.snippet: Delicious food and great service :) our waitress was really kind and happy to accommodate my dairy-free requests

response.snippet:
Carly, thanks for reviewing us and sharing with the others!
Please call the restaurant, we have something that you left behind! 2128651011.
Best,
Chef Dan

reviews.snippet: Great food, and their service is even better. Just like having dinner in grandmas house.
Amazing lunch spot! Value for money.

response.snippet: Thanks for rating us, we are pleased to hearing that you had enjoyed our restaurant!

reviews.snippet: A great place to teste delicious Greek food… the chef Dan is amazing!! High recommend!

response.snippet:
Joel,
Thank you very much for your kind review!

reviews.snippet: Eat here. The chicken egglemon soup - I could have eaten three bowls and nothing else. Roast chicken was lemony, garlicky - delicious. The Rice absorbed the lemony chicken. String beans were also delicious. Service is friendly, prompt and attentive. Atmosphere is intimate with art from the restaurant's old days.

response.snippet:
Thanks Amy, we are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the food, service and the atmosphere!
Best!
The Symposium Crew

reviews.snippet: Wow! I love this place, super delicious Greek food and absolutely wonderful customer service! Portions are large and the prices are reasonable. Our lovely server went above and beyond to ensure we had a very nice meal. Highly recommend!

response.snippet: Thank you very much for sharing your experience, and rating us!

reviews.snippet: The restaurant was chosen because my friend has been wanting to eat there for quite some time. The restaurant is located between Amsterdam and Broadway. Heavy traffic because of the college when I arrived they had about six table people. The hostess and the server were open and pleasant. The atmosphere was OK. The surface was fine however the food, unfortunately I did not find enjoyable. I crossed this restaurant off my list I will not return.

response.snippet:
Thanks for reviewing us!
Sorry to hear that our food didn't meet your expectation!

reviews.snippet:
We finally tried Symposium and didn’t just like it, we loved it.

The moussaka was out of this world, and was a more than generous portion. We also loved the saganaki, which was so soft and delicious, and the kolokethokeftedes were irresistible.

For dessert the galaktoboureko was our favorite from all, but the kormos was also delicious.

The team who took care of us was attentive and we loved the cozy home style vibes. Definitely recommend!

response.snippet: Lazaros, thanks for rating us and sharing your thoughts!

reviews.snippet: An Upper West Side GEM! You feel transported to a time when Ellington, Hemingway, Dali, or Baldwin had a meal and took in the Manhattan life. Vibrant and mysterious as the atmosphere demanded, but what was important was the food. A must experience for a New Yorker and better with a partner or a couple of buddies. Try their special or their vegetarian. I had their roasted chicken and double thumbs up! If you're lucky, you'll meet the friendly waiter that has worked there for 30 plus years! Outstanding service!

response.snippet: Thanks for reviewing us and sharing it!

reviews.snippet: The food was not tasty, the waitress was pushy and told us that we had to pay all together as a group and couldn't pay separately. My moussaka was frozen and absolutely tasteless. In the end, I said it was inedible. The waitress automatically included the tip in the bill, which surprised me a lot, as I wouldn't have left her a cent. I do not recommend this establishment. Unpleasant, unattractive, and with poor service.

response.snippet:
Maria, thank you for taking the time to write the review!
We are so sorry that our food did not meet your expectations.
You could've simply returned the moussaka and ordered something else instead!
We charge the gratuity for groups of 6 of more.
Best!
Management

reviews.snippet:
This place was an absolute gem! The service was beyond exceptional - with the chef Dan making sure my friend and I were well taken care of and served promptly. The entire we had was PATZARIA ME SKORDALIA, excellent and home made, and I had the AVGOLEMONO - creamy chicken soup with a dash of lemon. Then I ordered the chicken gyro plate (on pita with fresh chopped tomatoes,lettuce and the most dreamy tzatziki sauce with a large serving of rice from the prix fixe menu; my friend had the GARIDES MAKARONADA (shrimp, feta, tomatoes on ribbon pasta) which she said was tasty and truly flavourful followed by desert : PORTOKALOPITA which is was a dreamy pie with heavy orange overtones topped in a generous honey like sauce.

The bill for the two of us, with one Alpha beer each was truly reasonable - the whole dining experience reminded me of the beautiful Greek Tavernas I visited when I was in Athens - and the food was on parr with the city as well.

I’m from out of town but I will definitely make this my “go to” restaurant whenever I’m in New York ;)

response.snippet: Thank you so much, for reviewing Symposium, and we are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your dinner with us!

reviews.snippet: favorite restaurant! Such a great atmosphere, food is always amazing, and the owner and staff are passionate and very kind. I have to get the eggplant dip (melitzanosalata??) every time.

response.snippet: Dear Meredith, we are happy to hear that you had a great time at Symposium. Looking forward to hosting you again and again

reviews.snippet:
Cute cozy restaurant near Columbia serving delicious and well priced Greek food!

The dip platter was awesome and would highly recommend. I would definitely come back!

response.snippet: Thank you for your kind words! We're thrilled you enjoyed our Greek cuisine and cozy ambiance. Your recommendation means a lot to us. Looking forward to welcoming you back soon. Sincerely, Symposium Greek Restaurant.

reviews.snippet: Ate at Symposium for the first time in a few years. Always liked it, but today was exceptional. Apparently they got new ownership 6 months ago and a new chef. There were some new dishes, and the flavoring and sauces were quite unique in the best of ways. I highly recommend it to anyone who loves Greek food.

response.snippet:
Gary,
It was a pleasure hosting you tonite!
Thanks for reviewing!
Best!

raw_place.title: Symposium
raw_place.description: Greek restaurant offering traditional cooking in a large, old-school basement space & garden.
