I’m so happy today,I visited my friend and I find close by the Hungarian pastry shop.
The polish lady in the shop helped us a lot then we chitchat a little bit about Hungarian pastries and cakes.We picked so many I didn’t open the boxes yet but will let you know how was it. Must be good inside outside all table was taken. Line was getting bigger and bigger.
All pasties excellent!! My mom said the “francia kremes” not as good anymore in Budapest as here! The chocolate salted caramel outstanding too. Everything is sooo good! Thank you for bringing back my childhood sweets in New York. Top rated!!

A friendly Neighbourhood Café spot.

I really like the fact that it was run by women at the time I was there.

Its was also a very calm place to quietly read a book or just get to your work done.

I liked my coffee, but wasn’t out of the world amazing but good café coffee. I would visit it if I’m in the area

Kudos to the team for running the place so well :)

There’s something almost magical about spending time at The Hungarian Pastry Shop. In a city that constantly reinvents itself, this place feels like a warm reminder of old New York.

The moment you walk in, the atmosphere slows you down. The room has a cozy, intellectual energy that somehow manages to feel both lively and peaceful at the same time. You can easily imagine generations of Columbia students, professors, writers, and neighborhood regulars sitting with coffee and a pastry while working on their next big idea.

The pastries are outstanding. Everything tastes handmade, authentic, and prepared with care rather than mass-produced. Whether you're there for strudel, cakes, cookies, or one of their classic Hungarian specialties, there's a richness and depth of flavor that immediately stands out. The coffee is excellent, and somehow tastes even better while looking out toward the Cathedral of St. John the Divine.

What impressed me most is that the shop doesn't feel like it's trying to be trendy. It simply knows what it is and does it exceptionally well. That confidence comes through in every detail.

Part of what makes the experience special is the history. The Hungarian Pastry Shop opened in 1961 and has remained one of Manhattan's most beloved cafés for more than six decades. Originally founded by Hungarian immigrants and later purchased by the Binioris family, it has become a true Upper West Side institution while keeping much of its original character intact.

Over the years it has developed a reputation as one of New York's great literary cafés. Writers, artists, professors, and students have filled its tables for generations, and several well-known books were written there. The owners famously resisted modern trends like Wi-Fi, helping preserve the shop as a place for conversation, reading, and actual thinking instead of endless scrolling.

In a city full of beautiful bakeries and coffee shops, what makes this place different is that it has a soul. The pastries are wonderful, the coffee is comforting, and the atmosphere is unforgettable. It's not just a bakery. It's one of those rare New York places that feels woven into the fabric of the neighborhood itself.

If you're anywhere near 111th Street and Amsterdam Avenue, do yourself a favor and spend an hour there. Order something sweet, grab a coffee, find a seat, and enjoy a little piece of New York history.

The cardamom bun was good. Not overly strong. The baklava was good but super sweet(which all baklavas are to be fair). The danish, biscuits and hamantash were alright. There was a bit of a line on sunday
Everything tasted delicious and the pastries arrived fast. The downside is that there is little to no room to sit down, mainly because many people are taking up the seats with their computers.

This was my first time visiting. A lot of the reviews said it used to be better but I can’t compare.

I got a cheese danish and viennese coffee. Everything came out pretty fast and i enjoyed the outdoor seating.

The staff was nice and told me to sit anywhere and they would bring the food to me. Didn’t give me a number so I was a little concerned for how they did that for everyone but they nailed it!

I’ve been a few times at this cafeteria and I’ve also gotten desserts to bring home:
- the pumpkin pie and cheese cake mix is the best dessert they have.
- the balaclava isn’t close to the real middle eastern balaclava and I don’t ever order it again.
- the cardamon bun is dried while the raisins bun is better accomplished.
- the tables at the back lack natural light.
- if you sit near the entrance, the door keeps being opened/closed and it gets very annoying (and cold during winter).
- the prices are high but the quantity is also large.
- the staff is very kind and they will let you use your laptop.
I’ll keep coming and suggesting to meet there with university peers

media.caption: Framed book covers and air conditioner

reviews.snippet: I first went here with my brother and his friends in their post- college days (1970's) and was glad to "re-discover" it after moving to Upstate Manhattan 20 years ago. Still going strong and still unique. Yes, I've had better or more refined pastry elsewhere, but here it's consistently good. And the very college-y feel to the place is very welcoming.

I am so glad I tried The Hungarian Pastry Shop. I was curious how Dobos-torta tasted like far away from my home (Hungary). I liked the cream and that the cake was full of that. The top was my favourite. Meggyes rétes was also tasty and good. Don't miss it if you come to NYC (especially from Hungary)!

This place is phenomenal. I am in town from Montana and this was the best part of my vacation to Manhattan, New York City. Those baristas sure are great workers!

My only little question for folks is about the name. I came in expecting to practice my duo-lingo Hungarian phrases but I got lots of Albanian baristas and a funky polish one. Cannot recommend this place enough, run, don't walk now to go to Hungarian Pastry shop!

I loved the atmosphere at The Hungarian Pastry Shop. It feels cozy and full of character, the perfect place to sit with a book or just enjoy a coffee. The pastries are fresh and delicious, especially the strudels. It can get a little crowded, but that only shows how popular it is. Definitely a spot I would recommend to anyone visiting New York.
Best carrot cake I’ve had. Made a special one for my gf’s birthday with less than a day turnaround. Thank you! Almond horns are amazing too! Very friend service!
We got a few different options to try. Everything was absolutely delicious. I don’t know the names of the pastries but you can see them in the picture.

A great place to hang out for coffee in many original and unique forms (I love the Russian or Hungarian varieties), made to measure by extremely friendly staff. In a stylish and functional setting.
And don’t forget to enjoy some of the numerous excellent pastries. So many to choose from !
And all at very reasonable prices.
A very popular place. Arrive early if you want to find a seat. Or enjoy the coffees and pastries on the go.

This is my favorite place I have ever been to. I’m from Hungary but I spent my last year in the US and I’ve been searching for Hungarian food for months. When I found this I immediately fell in love! The people here are so nice and very helpful. Considering that we are in the US, they made the pastries still very authentic and amazing. I can only recommend this place!

I recently had the pleasure of visiting Hungarian pastry shop in the upper west side and I was blown away by their incredible cherry strudel. As a self-proclaimed pastry aficionado, I've tried my fair share of strudels, but this one was truly exceptional.

The crust was perfectly flaky and buttery, with a delicate balance of crunch and tenderness. It was clear that the bakers had spent years perfecting their craft, as every bite was a masterclass in texture and flavor.

The sour cherry filling was sweet and tart, with a depth of flavor that was both refreshing and indulgent. The cherries were perfectly balanced, neither too sweet nor too sour, and the filling was generous without being overwhelming.

What truly set this strudel apart, however, was its authentic Hungarian flavor. Every bite was a taste of traditional Hungarian baking.

The caramel custard was also delicious. The toffee top shell was a bit too sweet however

Rating: 5/5 stars

Price: $$ 5.50

Recommended for: Pastry lovers, fans of traditional Hungarian baking, anyone looking for a delicious dessert.

Hyped up pastry shop near Columbia University. The interior is cool, the waiting line long, the staff remains lovely. The pastries and cakes were nice, but to be honest, I would not travel across town just for that purpose.

Last year I had been spending time with my dad near the Hungarian Pastry Shop at the Peace Fountain, a couple months before he passed away. He was at the Amsterdam Nursing Home and we spent time outside near the fountain. I bought us some cake slices and cookies from the nearby pastry shop to bring him to eat. I was assisted by a wonderful woman, Gilda (I'm so sorry I couldn't remember how she spelled her name), who I believe was the manager. Despite how busy it was and the popularity of the place, she gave me the time to talk and asked about me. I told her why I was in the city and she listened with so much empathy and kindness. She listened to me and gave me so much encouragement. I can't praise her and this shop enough. They were filled with patience and care despite having a long line of people. This place a gem and I can't recommend it enough. I can't thank Gilda and the staff here enough. You made a difficult time so much easier. Today is the one year anniversary of his passing and I'm thinking of him today and the delicious pastries that made those hard moments so much sweeter.

This coffee shop and bakery is well known for a reason. I’ve been coming here for years, and the quality of their drinks and baked goods have remained consistently amazing, and you can tell everything is made with care. My favorites are their cappuccino topped with cinnamon, carrot cake, and linzer cookies. But honestly, you can’t go wrong with anything. On the weekends, be prepared for a line and a bustling crowd inside. It’s worth it!

Please do better.

We take pride in serving fresh pizza and maintaining a clean environment, and it’s clear we fell short during your visits. Your comments are invaluable, and we are committed to addressing these issues to ensure a better experience for you in the future. Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and we hope to have the opportunity to serve you better next time.

reviews.snippet: Famous Famiglia is the best place to get pizza in New York City. I’ve gone to this place for over 10 years. The quality of the pizza is amazing. My favorite slice is the Margarita or Grandma. It has a lot of flavor and you’re able to customize it with seasonings if you would like to. The prices are really good compared to other places and it’s very clean. Staff is always wearing a mask. I always see them clean the tables after being used and always recommend people to sanitize their hands. Overall, amazing experience. If you’re ever on the upper west side, stop by Famous Famiglia to get the best pizza in the city.

Typical greasy pizza joint. $5 for a slice of pepperoni. Big seating area in the back. Everyone here speaks Spanish - which I love. I miss fountain sodas. So tired of restaurants that only serve can soda. The pepperoni pizza was extra greasy.

response.snippet: Thanks for taking the time to leave a review for us! We're glad to hear you enjoyed our big seating area and that everyone here speaks Spanish, we love hearing that too! We're sorry to hear that you found the pepperoni pizza extra greasy and missed the fountain sodas. Your feedback is important to us and we'll definitely take it into consideration. We hope you'll give us another try in the future! Thanks again for stopping by.

reviews.snippet: First time here, couldn't make it to my usual spot on 106. Decor was simple like any other Famous Famiglia. I was greeted the moment I walked in and was kindly given a moment to decide what I wanted. Ended up with two plain sizes and garlic knots. The garlic knots was more on the dough side (cooked of course) for some reason I like my garlic knots crisper. The slices themselves were decent, I have had better.

Love this place. Pizza is ALWAYS good, never soggy or burnt. My brother has always gone to pick up the pizza from here, and last week is the first time I ever actually went myself, and the atmosphere is perfect, relaxing. The staff is super nice. I have a few pizza places near where I live, but they all suck!! This place is 40 blocks from my place and it's the best pizza. I'll gladly take the trip to eat good fresh pizza! Even your friendly neighborhood Spiderman has been here!! lol

response.snippet: Thanks, Ylia! So glad you love our pizza and vibe! It’s awesome that you took the trip for a slice. Can’t wait to see you again—whether it’s for pizza or a superhero sighting! 🍕😊

reviews.snippet:
Ate chicken parmagiana with penne pasta. It very tasty and the quantity was worth the price.

Shoutout to the person at the counter for being really nice :)
It's good to have an old school pizza place like this. Old Hollywood style. I hope it stays around forever. Friendly stuff, good slice, fast and quick.

As pizzerias go, this is good. They're nice. Ambiance is good--big mural of Venice on the back walls, painted by a local artist, 80s/90s music usually playing. I highly prefer this vibe to Koronet across the street.

We were really disappointed with our recent visit to Famous Famiglia. The pizza was cold and tasted like it had been sitting out for a while. When we asked if it could be heated, the staff seemed annoyed and unwelcoming. The service overall was poor, and to make things worse, we were overcharged by $20. When we brought it to their attention, they acted like it was an inconvenience to fix their mistake. My husband ended up throwing his pizza away, and we both regretted not trusting our gut. When we walked in, the place was completely empty, which should have been a red flag. Sadly, it’s not what it used to be. We gave it a chance, but won’t be returning.

response.snippet: Iris, we’re sorry to hear about your experience. We appreciate your feedback and will work to improve our service and food quality. Your satisfaction is important to us, and we hope to do better in the future.

reviews.snippet: Ate here with my mom after a doctor's appointment. Not impressed with the pizza, no flavor whatsoever and a little dry. The salad was just lettuce, tomato, peppers and tomato. Not worth the money. Won't be returning.

response.snippet: Thank you for your feedback, Lisa. We're sorry to hear that your experience didn't meet your expectations. We appreciate your comments about the pizza and salad, and we'll work on improving our flavors and offerings. We hope you might consider giving us another chance in the future.

reviews.snippet: The meatball parmigiana hero was absolutely amazing. I tried this with an order of garlic knots (with mozzarella) and it was entirely too much. Big sandwich topped with a lot of cheese. The garlic knots had a lot of cheese melted over them, too. This place serves delicious food, and delivers a lot more than I had expected. I'll return often.

response.snippet: Hey Edward! We're thrilled to hear that you loved the meatball parmigiana hero and garlic knots with mozzarella! We're all about serving up delicious food and we're so glad we could deliver more than you expected. Can't wait to see you back again soon!

reviews.snippet: Very good pizza and good service to go along with it

response.snippet: Your kind words, JA, truly make our day! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our pizza and had a great experience with our service. It's wonderful customers like you who inspire us to keep delivering the best! Thank you for being part of the Famous Famiglia family! 🍕❤️

reviews.snippet: i’m from long island so i have high standards for pizza. this is the first time i’m having pizza in this area that’s actually GOOD. many people don’t season the sauce, but this pizza was amazing! way better than mama toos
Pizza was ok, the staff very friendly, the place was clean and organized. BUT the prices are ridiculous expensive. I would buy it again only if I am joining other friends but not by myself.

response.snippet: Thank you for your feedback, O P. We're glad to hear you enjoyed the friendly staff and cleanliness of our place. We appreciate your honesty regarding the pricing and will take your comments into consideration. We hope to welcome you back with friends soon!

reviews.snippet: I always get a large pizza one half extra cheese and sausage

response.snippet: Thank you, Gerald, for sharing your order with us! We're glad to hear you enjoy our large pizza with extra cheese and sausage. If there's anything we can do to make your experience even better, please let us know!

reviews.snippet:
The delivery is constantly horrendous. Time after time the pizza has slid into a corner of the box and I am delivered a blob of cheese and dough soaked in tomato sauce.

I thought I had the solution if the pizza place doesn’t cut the slices. I’ll cut the slices at home. Unfortunately, the pizza guy ignored my request or forgot and slices the pie. And again I am presented a box with soggy slabs of dough soaked in tomato sauce, with twisted lumps of cheese.

Besides the ruined pizzas, their garlic knots are good.

Good Italian food. Their pizza is tasty, and the garlic knots are authentic 🤤
Prices are a little high for Manhattan, but it's to be expected. Recommend going there for lunch or dinner.

response.snippet: Hey Sleyk! Thanks so much for your 5-star review! We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed our tasty pizza and authentic garlic knots. We understand that our prices may be a bit high for Manhattan, but we're glad you think it's worth it! We can't wait to serve you again for lunch. Thanks for recommending us!

reviews.snippet: Best pizza I have had for a long time. Bread had that great chewy texture, sauce was flavorful and abundant. Nice and greasy, full of flavor, and just plain delicious. Delivered in good time as well.

Not only is the Pizza yummy and warm, but the pasta is Very very delicious. There is also plenty of seating for those who like to eat for lunch or any other time. Still visit often and the quality of Pizza is still amazing.

reviews.snippet: Went on Mamdani's recommendation and wasn't disappointed. Though the cheese tastes very similar to 2 bros (sorry, just being honest) the portions were of course much bigger on account of them being sized much larger. The margarita slice was delicious, with the marinara sauce tasting straight out of a good pasta.

Some of the best pizza I’ve had. Delicious perfectly made. Tastes like the way Brooklyn pizza used to be!! Brooklyn pizza is trash now with the exception of a few places. Will definitely travel to the city for this place !!

Hugeeeeee slices - bigger than you would expect!!

We got the eggplant parm and vodka sauce pizza, we really enjoyed! All condiments are available including hot sauce, garlic, crushed red peppers, etc. Big pizza selection including many vegetarian options. The eggplant parm pizza is a bit on the sweeter side and vodka one is very savory. Happy we tried Koronet!

media.caption: Large pizza slices, one with eggplant
Large New York style pizza slice

reviews.snippet:
Overall solid NY pizza.

The hype around Koronet's has gone down in recent years, but I just visited and it was still very good. If you don't want to wait long lines at Mama's Too, this spot is a short walk away. The flavor of the crust really stands out to me. I strongly recommend the Margherita slice with some red pepper flakes and parmesan on top. Of course their signature Jumbo Slice is a fun option, but I believe it's not as large as it once was.
Largest great tasting pizza I've ever had. Huge variety of pizzas. Fast service.

This place is TRASH.
The food makes you want to throw up.
Ordered a mushroom pepperoni and a margherita pizza and was handed some junk meant straight for the trash can.
A couple of cold disgusting slices with soggy pale mushrooms spilt all around the box.

Maybe the employees should eat some of their own rubbish.

media.caption: Slices of sausage and mushroom pizza

reviews.snippet:
Best pizza I’ve had!
The slices are HUGE and delicious.
Love the vibe of the place also!
5/5

It was pretty much what you expect from a pizza place regarding the atmosphere. The pizza was delicious, and the slices are absolutely huge. The crust was thin and crispy. The pepperoni was perfectly crunchy on the edges at times, and the cheese blended together seamlessly to create a wonderful flavor. I think about this pizza often and as always and can’t wait to go back. A Great pizza near Columbia university.

I have loved this place since first coming here in 1990 on a day trip from my native Queens. It bothers me, just a little bit, that Mamdani pronounced it the "best New York slice" since he is not and will never be a true New Yorker. That being said, the jumbo slice was excellent and brought me way back -- it was as good today as it was in my memory, which is hard to do. I highly recommend Koronet!

Several options, speedy service and best of all: delicious.

There was a decent crowd when I went in, but I had virtually no wait before I had a slice in hand. I also went back on a Saturday afternoon to order a slice as big as my head, and it did not disappoint. I'd recommend sharing it with a friend, but it's delicious on your own as well.

Compared to other pizza by the slice, I think Koronet has the best crust and sauce, putting it a slice above the rest for a similar cost. Underrated and delicious.
Fast service. Plenty of choice. The jumbo slices are really huge and 1 normal slice was enough for me. My wife couldn’t finish her jumbo slice. No public restroom.

This is one of the biggest slices I ever had. One slice is definitely good for 1 person (almost $8 slice). Their spinach and broccoli slice, and margarita slice is great. We were 3 of us and able to share 2 slices. Definitely worth visiting again.
Decent slice, unfortunately is no bathroom. They could sweep outside a little.

Koronet Pizza – The BIGGEST & BEST Slice in NYC 🍕🔥

Let me tell you Koronet Pizza has the largest slices I’ve ever seen in New York City 😭🍕! Like literally, one slice could feed you for breakfast, lunch, and dinner (and I’m not exaggerating lol).

I ordered a cheesy slice, and the flavor was everything perfectly crisp on the edges, soft in the middle, and loaded with that real NY pizza taste. It was so good that I’m already craving another one today.

The vibe inside feels classic New York chill, cozy, and unpretentious. It’s the kind of spot that makes you feel like you’re in on one of the city’s best-kept secrets.

If you’re in the mood for that true NYC slice experience go to Koronet Pizza. Come hungry… because these slices are next-level huge and absolutely delicious 😋🍕

#KoronetPizza #NYCPizza #FoodieFinds #BiggestSliceInNYC #PizzaLovers #NYCEats #Ciciamoreats

Koronet Pizza on the Upper West Side is an absolute must-visit if you’re looking for giant, delicious slices! These are hands-down the biggest pizza slices in NYC, and they don’t just rely on size—they’re perfectly balanced too. Each slice has just the right amount of sauce, cheese, and toppings, with a dough that’s soft yet firm enough to hold up to its massive size. Whether you’re in the mood for a classic cheese slice or something with toppings, Koronet’s pizzas always hit the spot without being overwhelming. It’s the perfect blend of flavor and portion, making it a go-to for a true New York pizza experience!

response.snippet: We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed our giant, balanced pizza slices. Your recommendation means a lot to us. We take pride in providing the perfect blend of flavor and portion. Look forward to serving you again soon. Sincerely, Koronet Pizza.

reviews.snippet: The biggest pizza slice in NYC. And tastes great also! The thin huuuuge slice does justice someone who grew up in New York City and loves this pizza more than pizza in Italy! Crust is chewy and light and it’s ultra thin to not feel guilty eating all of it. Will return anytime I can. The grandmas is done just right with chewy and crispy and flavors that make you super happy. Staff is nice and friendly! Always adds to the great experience. You won’t be disappointed.

20 year staple for my taste buds
Jumbo New York Style Slices and open on the late night have been very consistent for years. I recommend to all visitors of NYC
Today I went back 4/16 for my regular jumbo slice cut in 4 and season to taste and added some video

Koronet Pizza
2848 Broadway
New York, NY 10025

Allá Vodka with Basil Jumbo Slice

What drew me to this urban pizza is the enormous size of their slices. It’s definitely a unique experience being served a whopping 16” slice that envelopes the entire tray!

#koronetpizza #jumboslice #allavodkawithbasil

media.caption: Allá Vodka with Basil Jumbo Slice

reviews.snippet: Pizza was excellent, hot, and Very flavorful.. However, staff members weren’t friendly, especially whoever rang me up at the register. The Guy was short and dismissive. there are zillion pizza places in New York City where attitudes of employees are much more welcoming. The tables were dirty and had used napkins left on them. Not very appealing for anyone who wants to sit in to eat their slice. I don’t think I’ll be coming here again.

"Yo!This Ain't No Rays"
This is THE REAL DEAL iCONiC establishment. BIGGEST SLICES IN NYC. Quality Fresh Ingredients and TASTE!!! So happy they're still in business and they've expanded!!! A Must Have! can't wait to go back🍕🍕🍕🍕🍕

reviews.snippet:
Home. I love this place. Gets even better when it's just the regulars on a quieter night with no college kids who only started dropping by this year to stand around and order bottle Modelos (why?).

Love the pool. Love the bartenders. Love the bathroom. A real dive bar.

What more can I say? My home away from home.

I went there for the 1st time this weekend. Initially I thought it was a chill bar with a nice atmosphere. The bathroom was atrocious, but I could put up with it by carefully stepping around the flooding toilet. Unfortunately the bartender was so rude and condescending to us, that i cant justify ever coming back.
Old school bar kinda of unique

media.caption: Happy hour four pm to seven pm
Dark wood bar with mounted TVs

reviews.snippet:
Classic College Bar
1020' s not big end, but it doesn't repair the seats with duct tape either. Draught beers are generally 5 or 6 $. Depending on the time, the age varies greatly. At times, there is a grad school crowd and others rhe mix is much younger. Of course, there are random locals or tourists, but they definitely are the minority in most evenings, especially when Columbia is in session.
Amazing atmosphere, Tim the barman was very warm and friendly and the service was perfect. This was exactly what we needed on our trip, a dimly lit bar with good beer

Phenomenal bar. Real character and class. Local joint that mixes together undergrads, grad students, locals, and always drags in a couple stray tourists. The bartenders are lively, each has real personality - if you’re there early you’ll meet one guy who’s a little too drunk but that’s ok. Beer is 7-8, margs are good too. Pool table and darts keep things fresh. Could go and drink and talk for hours 10/10

We had an extremely frustrating experience at 1020 due to the rude and dismissive behavior of the bouncer. He immediately turned away my friend’s valid ID without making any attempt to verify her real birthdate as listed on her ID and verified by her other form of ID (her passport). Our entire group was clearly over 21, completely sober, and well-behaved, yet we were treated with unnecessary hostility and a lack of professionalism. This kind of poor customer service is enough for us to never return.

I visit this place pretty often after work or out with friends. Overall pretty relaxed environment, bartenders are attentive & generally in a good mood.
Asked the bartender on Monday to make me a Moscow Mule (Not on their menu) and they made me one of the best Moscow Mules I’ve had in a long time. Will come back again :)
Amazing bar with excellent drinks, great music, and a lively atmosphere. Staff was professional and friendly.

Asked for a diet coke and the weird dye job bartender huffed at me but gave it to me for free. I was gonna tip cause I felt bad for not ordering a real drink🤷‍♀️ Then I tasted it and it was really funky. Don’t know if it was old or he put something in it but probably will never go back.
Really cool bar, great bartenders, chill fun pool scene and a great mix of different people. Best bar in the neighborhood

This is a great neighborhood bar. The bartenders are very friendly and attentive. It can be a little crowded, depending on whether Columbia is hosting an event here or not. The drinks are reasonably priced and there's plenty of room for patrons to spread out. I've never had a bad experience here.

Love this bar it is the best place to go to after a dinner. Bartender is very nice and social, makes me want to stay longer for the hospitality. His name is Alex. Drinks are classic house and have a pool table, so it’s a good spot to go to for fair drink prices and pool.
I ask the bartender to play the green book and she didn’t play it

Just tried to go have a drink for my birthday. (8/29). Was ignored with my boyfriend for about 20 minutes. Finally the bartender (who most likely was drunk as I had seen him take shots right before with another Patron) totally bypassed us to tend to the group that had just arrived. Ridiculous. I’m a bartender and I’ve never felt so ignored at another bar. Management should seriously rethink who they have tending bar.

response.snippet: Oh No! I’m sorry to hear this Skye… If you have time please stop by again today or tomorrow during business hours and speak to the manager on duty. We would greatly appreciate it, Thanks again for the comments.

reviews.snippet: They do not serve food yet. The bartender was inebriated, yet sweet, but my sister had not finished checking out, and he pointed out that she didn't tip him. He proceeded to discuss that with customers at the bar. It's not cool. However, cool place once they get back to business .

Super low key bar. Has a pool table which is dope. Bartender cute too. If you see a tall gorgeous dark skins female ask for the bartender special. It's a sweat and light drink mixed with some juice and malibu. (Mind you not an official drink)

I met my husband here over 20 years ago, and I honestly thought 1020 would be long gone, replaced by a more polished, trendy NYC bar. I'm so happy to see it's still the same, and I can’t wait to go back!

It's a dive bar, so I didn't have high expectations. I came here with a group of 10, and we were seated in the back area. It's a nice semi-private space. The drinks are cheap here, and there's a nice billiards table; however, the place isn't clean and tidy. One of my friends has to return a drink because the glass had lipstick stains on it. He was not happy.

With extremely low expectations, you can have a blast here! Otherwise, you may wish to consider other nearby options.

response.snippet: Victoria, we are really sorry to hear your friend had an unpleasant experience. We trust the bar staff received your complaint, understood and replaced your drink immediately... Nobody wants that! Thank you for your review.

reviews.snippet: Exactly what you should expect from a dive bar. The service is great, beer selection will leave everyone satisfied but not blown away. It gets very packed during the weekend with the undergrad crowd from Columbia. Best visited during the week and preferably early.

reviews.snippet: A new favorite! I got the black squid linguine a diavola and lamb chops that was probably the best I’ve had in the city. The octopus is also delicious. Great wine selection too. Loved the live music with gipsy kings 💃🏽✨ a great way to spend Friday night with friends. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality Elis!

I stopped by with a group of friends, and we all agreed we’ll definitely be back. The food and drinks were excellent. We ordered the oysters, Caesar salad, fries, branzino, lamb chops, and every dessert on the menu. I highly recommend trying them all! Everything was absolutely delicious.

The owner, Elis, was incredibly kind and welcoming. He even offered us an umbrella while we waited for our car. Who does that these days?! That thoughtful gesture truly stood out and made our experience even more memorable.

Thank you, Elis Wine & Bar Restaurant, for a wonderful evening. We can’t wait to return!

The kind of atmosphere one would imagine in a Nyc wine bar, restaurant. Has a classic euro touch feel. Attracts an eclectic patronage. Drinks and food are top notch. Keep in mind at a cost. A tad bit high for the quality, but you do get quality in return.

A perfect place for a get to know me convo, or catch up with a few friends. Quiet, laid back vibe.

The owner and bartenders are very attentive and friendly. So service is a highlight.

Interestingly, they project old Charlie Chaplin movies on screen by the bar area. Enjoy watching from time to time.

There aren't a lot of choices for spots like this on the UWS region. The ones that are around tend to force a brisk walk.

So if nearby, its worth dropping by. If you live close then definitely stop by.
Went for Happy Hour and I left Happy! Pinot for $9, truffle fries for $8, $1 oysters!!! Yes please!! I’ll be back soon!

media.caption: Wine glass and potato french fries
Fresh oysters on ice with lemon

reviews.snippet:
We visited Elis Wine Bar & Restaurant during happy hour and, unfortunately, it didn’t quite meet our expectations. The oysters were not well-prepared. The calamari and truffle fries were average, and both the pasta and chicken were just okay — I’d rate them a 5/10.

However, the desserts were a highlight — moist, flavorful, and clearly the best part of the meal. I’m hoping that the non-happy hour offerings are more impressive, so I might consider giving them another try. Fingers crossed for a better experience next time.

Restaurant was dead empty on a Friday night (major red flag). Calamari was the worst l've ever had, absolutely no seasoning and definitely came of of a frozen bag. I'm. extremely happy that I didn't order the steak or the tuna steak because this place can't even make a simple hamburger. I ordered the double brisket burger, and when I say the brisket was beef jerky I'm not kidding. The waiter asked us if we wanted dessert because they were giving it away on the house. Man this was a TERRIBLE restaurant

Nice small wine bar. Good selection of food, draft beers and wine. Pleasant music background. Black and white movies on a screen (Chaplin?). Not a fancy shot, but a good choice for calming down or meeting friends. Try out the oysters during the happy hour!

We had a fantastic time at Elis Wine Bar this past Friday. The food was incredible and the staff was exceptionally welcoming. We were pleasantly surprised to find the Gipsy Kings performing that night, it was the perfect unexpected highlight. Thank you, Elis, for making our evening so memorable. We will definitely be back!

Very cozy and welcoming! Amazing and attentive service. From the Radeberger beer to the lamb chops, what an amazing combination of drink and food and vibes! It is truly a great place to spend an evening.

I had my sisters bridal shower here and had the most amazing time. The owner Elis is truly amazing and cares so much about his customers. The bartender Chris outdid himself in every aspect. Would recommend to anyone and everyone trying to plan an event or simply just have a delicious meal!! 10000/5 stars all around.

Great experience at Eli’s Wine and Bar Restaurant. The atmosphere is relaxed and upscale, perfect for a night out. The wine selection is impressive, and the staff is knowledgeable when it comes to recommendations. Food was well-prepared and flavorful, with good portion sizes

Very nice cozy place for wine and food. I really enjoyed this wine bar while I had a couple of glasses of wine and some food at the bar. The beet salad and tuna tartare were delicious. So was the Nero D'Avola I drank, a perfect red wine for a chilly evening. I appreciate the welcoming and friendly bar service. I am definitely going back to Elis Wine Bar solo or with friends!
Im a quality over quantity type of woman. 5 stars all around. The lamb burger was ABSOLUTELY DIVINE! The atmosphere was just what was needed. Can't wait to revisit!

I hosted my wife's 30th birthday here back in January and it was great! Elis and his team were attentive and helpful as we planned the event, worked within our budget and we're flexible. The food was delicious and every drink was even more so. Would recommend Elis Wine Bar for any occasion!

Our experience here was so-so. It has a lot of charm and the service was overall just fine, but sadly the food left a bit to be desired. Fries with my burger were soggy, and my date’s Bolognese was one of the most bland dishes I think I have ever been served in NYC. The drinks were just okay too, nothing to write home about.

The appetizers were good. Beet salad and a side of brussel sprouts.

Maybe we came at an off time, we probably won’t come back but you never know.

Also one note, these prices are curiously high! There was a glass of wine on the menu that was $22, and we googled the wine and it was $37 a bottle? We eat out enough to know if you’re charging $22 a glass that better be a $60-$70 bottle retail! C’mon you’re only supposed to rip us off a little bit when it comes to drink prices 😉
The food is excellent, the atmosphere is so cozy and the best part of this restaurant are the owners. They are very welcoming and funny :) their costumer service is 10/10.

A friend of mine took me here as it was close to his home. I was not expecting much but wow - the owner was ever present and VERY hospitable and just brilliant. The food and the wine was AMAZING! My friend had the lamb chops which he has on every visit here and I ahd the steak which was perfectly cooked - next visit to New York I will definitely go again!!!

It is chic, warm and inviting. The bathrooms are clean and spacious. My favorite item on the menu is the cacio e Pepe, and the portions are perfect! I like the Radeberger on draft. The owner (Elis) is charming, kind and a professional. He’s created a space that is truly a part of the community. This is definitely me and my partners favorite date spot! Once or twice a month they even have live flamenco musicians!

The drinks were fantastic — strong, well-balanced, and beautifully presented.As for the food, every dish we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. The menu had a great variety of options, from small plates to full entrées. Definitely a place I’ll be coming back to. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a fun night out with great food and drinks!
Amazing food! The filet mignon (medium rare) was cooked perfectly, the lamb chop sliders were packed with flavor, and the tuna tartare was fresh and delicious. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.snippet:
My friends and I chose Suite to celebrate our upcoming graduation, and unfortunately it ended up being a disappointing experience. We had barely sat down when the bartender with the loose waves came over to “remind” us about the two‑drink minimum. A drink policy isn’t the issue — this is New York, we all know how that works. The issue was the unnecessarily rude and policing tone he used, which immediately made us feel unwelcome.
When we went to order our first round, I asked if we could add our names to the karaoke list. I was told we couldn’t do so until both drinks had been purchased. Fine — except a large group came in after us and immediately started adding their names to the queue without buying anything. We also didn’t see the bartender approach them with the same “reminder” he gave us.
I won’t speculate on why our table was singled out while others weren’t, but the inconsistency was noticeable and left a bad taste. What should have been a fun celebration turned into an uncomfortable night, and we won’t be returning.

I love this spot. It's a small dive bar with karaoke, so don't go in expecting a quiet place to sit and be alone with your thoughts. The two drink minimum (and it doesn't need to be alcoholic, you can get water/mocktails) is super fair. I have a blast every time I go.

Pretty unfortunate that we were treated with so much disrespect and dismissiveness immediately upon entering by the bartender. It's hard as a queer woman to find queer spaces that are inclusive. I'd recommend The Hamilton that's right next door! It's not an explicitly queer bar, but the folks working there are part of the community and are extremely welcoming.

I hate to leave a bad review on a queer space, but it’s now the third time I come and the bar tender has an attitude, policing me and my friends (black and brown) and not saying anything to white people.

Comes up to the table, kareoke hasn’t even started, we just ordered our first drink, and says, “you need to order two drinks to stay or sing.” My friends submitted a kareoke card first and were they called, no. But a while man, on his first drink, I know because he was with our larger party, submitted his ticket, got his first drink, and then got to sing without waiting or even being told he needed to get two.

Then my friend gets told to “take it outside” with such a tone and attitude, because she was finishing food we had already come in with. Mind you, this same exact bar tender reprimanded my friends and I last time for tossing out someone’s crumbs of outside food and made us get out of a table because the people were outside but he was reserving it for them. If you guessed the people with the “reservation” were white you’d be right.

Everything is said with an attitude and his boss or manager just agrees with him.

It’s a dive bar with plastic cup drinks charging as much as the nice bars in Hell’s Kitchen and making a big deal over honestly very meaningless things. The bar tender had made our queer group of black and brown folks feel uncomfortable and unwelcomed. Please do better.

Every few weeks I try to give this place another chance because it’s convenient and instantly regret it. If you’re not friends with the bartender don’t expect anything beyond attitude and subpar service at best. The owner just apologizes constantly for their behavior but doesn’t remedy anything.
cheap drinks but the bartender ruined the whole vibe. rude to us from the start and selectively enforced the two drink minimum policy.
Amazing unique queer space. I wish the bathrooms were better, the stalls don’t lock 😔. If the bathrooms were safer/friendlier to everyone I would come more often. ❤️
This place for Karaoke is a happy place, very LGBTQ friendly, the amazing host is just incredible it pretty divey but lovely. Drinks are cheap and people are nice
Great bar and great crowd, nice bartenders and karaoke is super cool, the drag shows are iconic and cute! Don’t miss out! This bar is unique

I’m a 68 year old, straight female and I LOVE this place!!! This is such an awesome place to do karaoke!!! Victoria is amazing! The patrons are lively and encouraging!!! Every time I come back to the city, I’ll visit… and SING here!!🎶 🎤

They let someone literally scream into the microphone repeatedly at length last night during karaoke. The sound was already at TOP volume. The whole room was covering their ears with excruciating looks on their faces and they let the guy keep going/ no staff bothered turning the sound down a notch. The rest of the night was also super super loud, but as to be expected. Letting someone actually scream into a mic at length is not caring for the wellbeing of your patrons. Hearing damage is often irreversible after just one exposure to extreme volume. For those with audio processing or hearing related health issues, this is not a safe place without ear plugs. It was difficult to get fully carefree again after feeling like I experienced damage to my inner ear.

Wonderful oasis for the queer community uptown! The owner & his team are fantastic hosts for some inexpensive drinks & for fans of Indian cuisine, there’s a Kati roll run by the same owners. Highly recommended for everyone .. the queer community, the allies or just anyone looking for a fun evening.
Love it! My first time here and luis made these good drinks along with a great dragshow night!

Suite is the best gay bar in NYC. It’s not your traditional gay bar but it’s such a great vibe - people are chill, drinks are strong, no one is judge here. Victoria Chase leads the best karaoke and bartender Luis is always a DOLL!
The best lil karaoke joint in town!! Victoria is a goddess amongst mortals, Luis the bartender is going to sing on Broadway some day, and all the regulars are insanely talented. Love y'all ❤️ 💖 ❤️‍🔥

I LOVE Suite Bar. They’re always so welcoming and kind to their guests. About an hour ago a my friends and I wanted to grab a night cap. Eric, the bartender, was soooo sweet. They were about to close but he told us it was “last call”. He didn’t have to do that, but he did. And he graciously served us the drinks we ordered. Thank you Eric and Thank You Suite!

Got turned away because the bar tender thought my friend's ID was fake. We were pretty mad at the time but in hindsight it's pretty funny because it's one thing to think a fake ID is real, but how bad at your job do you have to be to think a real ID is fake. The bartender even bragged about being sooo discerning about fake IDs. What a joke.

A super-comfortable gay space near Columbia. We really have fun with the drag shows, and we nearly always meet new friends there. And the bartenders are always helpful and quick. One caveat: avoid the beers on tap; they've been off-tasting and flat every time we've been there.

My first gay bar experience, and it was pretty underwhelming. Went to see the latest Drag Race episode. Drinks were fairly cheap and the crowd was genuinely enthusiastic about Drag Race, but the atmosphere wasn't as collegial or communitarian as I'd expect. Leave it to the Upper West Side gays...
Great vibes! All are welcomed!

Always come on Thursdays to get food and drinks before going to work. For three consecutive weeks I've been getting charged more and more for the same things that I usually get. At first it was $17 (what i always payed), then it jumped to $19, and then, after ordering the same sandwich I order but without all the added stuff (no hashbrown, no bacon), you would think it's less, right? NOPE they charged me $22 dollars for that today. 3 weeks, three different prices for less food. Make it make sense.

The deli cooks are amazing though. It's the guy on the counter. Never getting food from them again and telling everyone around me that'll listen, because this is too much.

SANDWICH FULL OF MAYO??!!!! SUCH SLOPPY WORK!!! IVE BEEN GOING HERE FOR YEARS NO COMPLAINTS UP UNTIL THEY HIRE A NEW “COOK”!!! If you have an option online to get ketchup or mayo or whatever on your chopped cheese don’t put mayo when I ask for KETCHUP!!! Either way don’t put so much mayo!!!, making half of the sandwich a mayo chopped cheese.The cashier tried to say it wasn’t my order when I came back with the BAG and RECEIPT with my order details!!! Tried to kick me out for them NOT DOING THERE JOB!!! HELLO??? I’ve been going here for years and they just started putting OD MAYO on my chopped cheese. DISGUSTING!!! NEXT TIME DONT PUT HALF OF TH MAYO BOTTLE ON MY SANDWICH. NEVER COMING HERE AGAIN FOR A SANDWICH THEY SUCK. The little guy that works there making the sandwiches needs to fired bc he doesn’t know portions and just SLOPPYYYYY.

Good good food packaged well and ready on time. I picked up this meal after order directly on spicy gourmet deli app. But I have gone several times into the store before and every time I have been pleased

Spicy Gourmet Deli on 109th is hands down one of the most accommodating 24-hour delis on the Upper West Side. They have a huge variety of options, whether you’re grabbing something quick or looking for a full meal at any hour.

What really stands out is their hygiene, excellent customer service, and speed—everything is always clean, the staff is friendly and attentive, and orders are prepared quickly without feeling rushed. They truly treat customers like family and know their regulars by name, voice, and even address, whether you call in or stop by in person. That level of personal service is rare.

Definitely a neighborhood staple and a reliable go-to any time of day or night.

This deli always rushing orders and get most sandwiches wrong. They love putting a crazy amount of mayo on everything and forget other stuff that you request. I have been here multiple times and it's always something wrong with my sandwiches. I give up with this place.

Staff was super friendly!!!

Everyone was polite and helpful!!

Store is suppppperrrr organized, clean, etc. I actually smiled underneath my mask lol of how happy I was when I saw how clean it was. I was fed shocked not a lot of deli/ bodegas are this organized! I love it! Thank you to whomever is in charge of the store’s neatness and cleanliness.

My one recomendarían is to never eat at this bodega.

This place is it! The outdoor dining is done correctly and their service is quite good for the volume of people that there on a Sunday afternoon. They accommodated us outside with a view of the tv as we watched a soccer match and we're super friendly about it.

I alsoordered the fried chicken off of the brunch menu which was to die for...a friend of mine got the steak sandwich which was also very good.

The drinks were also a hit at our table i will definitely be back.

An old school gem keeping up with the times. Columbia bar with Mets theme. Craft & Macro on tap and cans at great prices. Unique seating nooks around bar and wimdows for better viewing. Summer camp menu of corn dogs, tater tots, wings with HUGE portions. Cold brew on tap too.

Wonderful Space. Truly a bar thay grown-ups can go to and not feel outta spot. The staff is most excellent 👌🏿
Great neighborhood spot. Food is great. The service and staff are wonderful, and I Highly recommend if you’re in the area.
Nice spot in the area. I was sold when I saw fried Oreos on the menu. Hailey L. Makes very strong drinks, definitely recommend.
It's a college dive bar with above average food, above average drinks and above average service. If you can't get on board with that, that's on you, not them.
Great disco Friday vibe. Great service. Aaron is a cool server. Good selection of booze. Lots of TVs for games. Great music
Always playing great music, some of my fav wings in the city. Good vibes all around.
Great place to hang out with friends and play trivia on Wednesday nights!

Service 10/10
Food burnt but hotdog delicious otherwise 5/10
The vibe 10/10
Drinks - depends on the bartender working behind bar

Stopped by after a work event and decided to explore the bars in the area—and wah-lah, found a gem. Affordable beers, great vibe, and a really welcoming atmosphere. The bartenders were kind and attentive—pretty sure mine was Emi—shoutout to her for not pressuring me to grab another beer when I just wanted to chill. Sometimes you just want a place where you can unwind after work and be left alone if that’s the mood, and this spot definitely delivers. Overall, I’d absolutely come back if I’m in the area.

Great bar, great food, great service. Only issue is there were too many cheaters at trivia night! I seriously don’t understand how you could be so immature that you need to cheat at bar trivia to make yourself feel good.

I honestly feel sorry for the group that was cheating because clearly they needed to boost their self esteem. It’s ridiculous that they denied cheating after I pointed out the absurd amount of questions that they had gotten right.

From a young age my father taught me that dignity and honor are the most important things in life. When I was just 18, through hard work and dedication, I was able to gain access to my six figure trust fund. Before I left for college my father told me, “son, you’re the smartest person in the world. You’re destined to do great things in life and no one can stop you. If you EVER lose to anyone at bar trivia it must be because they cheated. There is no other possibility.” So clearly I knew that this group could not have known all those answers because I didn’t know them.

If these scumbags are ever allowed to set foot in the Lions Head again, my father will be EXTREMELY upset, and you do not want that.
The burger is amazing, cooked to perfection. The bar has all sports on multiple tv's and has great backgroynd music. Just a 15-20 walk from the Red Subway.
Good spot, good beer selection, good drinks, great staff and really good wings and Cajun fries. Plenty of TV's staff will do it's best to accommodate viewing requests.

response.snippet: Thank you john for your kinds words and ongoing support! Hope we continue to accommodate you!

reviews.snippet:
This is easily the best bar around Columbia and truly an UWS gem. Great trivia night on Wednesdays, too. However, this last Wednesday, the trivia host and a bartender accused my squad of cheating in trivia since we were actually doing well for once. I didn’t appreciate these accusations, nor did I appreciate the guy who complained that we were “cheating”. Yeah… this guy couldn’t handle getting outsmarted and outplayed by some seniors in college (I’m gonna guess he goes to Columbia law). Crazy to think that a group of 6 men that all watch football don’t go 9/9 on Madden covers (we only needed 8 of them). And might as well assume that we don’t listen to Biz Markie, No Doubt, or the Cure while you’re at it. Maybe assume that we won’t successfully get a question about Wrigley Field correct even though I am from Chicago, too? But I digress. I didn’t appreciate people thinking we didn’t know our stuff solely on the basis of being among the youngest in the room. Will I continue to go here? Absolutely. And will I continue to buy $30 pitchers of Bud Light for my table? Definitely, despite having a college student level of disposable income. It is a tragedy that a blemish got placed on our great performance in what will be one of my last times at lion’s head trivia night, and I can guarantee that if we were cheating (which we were not), then we would not have lost on the final question. (New York trivia league– if you don’t want people having multiple phones out, don’t put a “just watch” option on your trivia page, for that implies that team members can have their phone out to also follow along on questions). Thank you lion’s head, and I’ll see you all next Wednesday.

Edit: Not sure where the throwing up on a jacket story came from. That did NOT happen… it was 7:30pm on a Wednesday. Keep in mind, these are actual adults making up stories about a group of college guys that beat them in trivia. Pretty funny, honestly.

reviews.snippet:
My wife and I stop by from time to time whenever we're in the mood for a drink. It's always lively, busy, and full of energy.

With multiple TVs throughout the bar, it's a great place to watch sports, and they occasionally host special events as well. We also appreciated the daily food and drink specials, which offer good value and variety depending on the day of the week.

The food is generally good, and the overall atmosphere makes it an enjoyable spot to grab some drinks and have a fun night out. If you're looking for a lively bar with a great vibe, this is definitely worth checking out

A typical bar with a restaurant vibe. A few TVs with sports, friendly staff, a few good draft beers on tap.

Amazing happy hour. $5 margaritas are tasty and they don't skimp on the alcohol. My favorite food are the wings and truffle fries.

Outdoor seating too. It can get busy and very loud. But at the same time lively.

It's classic sports bar style is familiar, has great food, friendly staff, a bargain happy hour. What's not to like. Stop by here if nearby.

response.snippet: Hi Robert, thank you so much for your kind feedback! We are happy to hear you had a nice time with us! We hope you join us again when you visit the neighborhood! Best - AHU MGMT

reviews.snippet:
We celebrated a friend and colleague’s birthday at Amity Hall with a group of twelve, and the experience was wonderful. Even without a reservation, the staff was very accommodating and quickly arranged outdoor seating for all of us.
We ordered margaritas, red and white wine, spritzers, and frosé. Every drink was excellent, and Happy Hour made it even better. We only ordered fries since we mainly came for drinks, but the service truly stood out.
The young women who took our orders were patient, friendly, and incredibly attentive. Despite being a large group, we never felt rushed and were able to enjoy our time comfortably. It was a great experience from start to finish, and I would happily return.

THE WORST SERVICE POSSIBLE! I've lived two blocks away from this place since 2013 & watched the bar changed names a couple of times. AMITIVILLE IS THE WORST OF THEM ALL! That's why I barely ever come here. The very few ones I did, the service at the bar has been SUPER SLOW!!! I came in today for the France v Iraq game & some cheap wings, sat down...& WAS COMPLETELY IGNORED FOR A WHOLE 5 MINUTES. I WALKED OUT IMMEDIATELY. ONE OF THE BARTENDERS EVEN WALKED PAST ME IF I DIDN'T EXIST. No, they weren't busy. I hope this place go under & change to a better establishment soon!

Admittedly, I’m a boring salad eater in a family of wings, burger, and BLT fans. But the kale salad was fantastic, especially considering this is a sports bar. Others at my table had the blt and wings and loved it. I’d like to come back for the bottomless brunch cocktails.

response.snippet: Hi Debbie, thank you so much for your feedback and we'd love to host you again soon! Have a wonderful day! Sincerely, -AHU

reviews.snippet: Iykyk the white girl from Iowa is the best. She’s kind, a baddie, and really helpful. We love her and she’s the reason we come back. Ofc the food is great but her energy is fun and engaging. I cannot recommend this place more.

Great place, would recommend to reserve beforehand. Went on a Saturday at 11 am. Got the bottomless mimosas, costs around $20 per person. Tried the orange and apple cider ones, both were really great, worth it. Got the flatbread breakfast and loaded fries. Both are reasonably priced, good quantity and tasted great. A good stop overall.
Drinks had no alcohol unforunately we had two margarita’s but we made sure to drink them only because we didn’t want to waste it. The hostess was a sweetheart though

media.caption: Iced pink cocktail with lime wedge

response.snippet: Hi Angelina, we do our best to serve well balanced cocktails using industry standard recipes! We can ensure you that alcohol is put into all of our cocktails. We appreciate your feedback and hope your next visit with us exceeds your expectations! Sincerely, -AHU

reviews.snippet: I’m from Maryland and I came here to spend the day , I searched google for a bar with outdoor seating and found this gem! I came on a day where there was live music and it was a chill atmosphere. The only downside was the service, it seemed there was a bunch a new people so we kept being asked the same questions. The food was outstanding and there was a large portion of fries! I would recommend this place.

response.snippet: Hi Parker, thank you for your kind 4 star review. Customer service is of the utmost importance to us and we apologize that you did not have a great experience in this respect. Notes have been taken and we will strive to improve this. We look forward to you stopping in again next time you are in the neighborhood! Best - AHU MGMT

reviews.snippet: Great place to visit for a quick snack and a drink after a long day at work. A lively bar with special events happening every week like the trivia nights on Wednesdays, offering fun experiences to you and your friends. Their happy hour drinks are also really worth it too.
Best Margaritas and chicken tenders in NYC

I went looking for a bar to catch a Mets game and found this place. A very large bar with a modern look. No physical menus were provided so it took me a few minutes to surf the online menu to find the happy hour deals. The beers prices were fairly reasonable. I ordered the Mango Habanero wings, cheeseburger egg rolls and mini burgers and all were very good. I found the manager and his staff to be very welcoming, particularly bartender Sheeran who was very attentive and pleasant. Unfortunately when her shift ended at 5pm the service and smiles dimmed a bit. The new bartenders were friendly but just not as engaging and required me to be more proactive to get their attention. Overall it was a very nice bar restaurant and I plan on revisiting.
I went here for the department’s fall mixer party. It was really crowded making it hot. But the good thing was the staffs were very professional and continuing bringing food for us.

response.snippet: Hi Ngoc, thank you for your kind review, we appreciate your feedback on the restaurants temperature, we will strive to improve this moving forward. Thank you again and we look forward to seeing you at the next gathering. Best - AHU MGMT

reviews.snippet: An above average sports bar close to Columbia university. Good variety of food around $18 for a burger and fries which is not bad nowadays. Big variety of drinks and they always show main sports events on their many screens. You can watch a game from any table except for outdoors. It’s a big place but can get crowded sometimes. They have a standing area close to the bar.

response.snippet: Hi Guy, we are thrilled to hear that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for your kind words and 5 star review! Best - AHU MGMT

reviews.snippet: Staff friendly and professional. Atmosphere/decor a bit dated but in a familiar way not worn out. It's a pub feel that you would want to visit often with your closest friend group. Chicken was dry. All greens fresh and tasty in salad. I think the pretzel was frozen and prepackaged then heated up or microwaved. Beer was great!

response.snippet: Hi Steve, we appreciate your kind review and will definitely address your feedback on our food! Wish you all the best! -AHU

reviews.snippet: This place usually is my go to when I moved to New York. 5$ shots some nights and really cool bartenders. Noticed it’s usually a college bar I’m a bit older so it didn’t bother me much; however to surprise after chatting with some of the patrons there I met a group of 18 year olds. They were comfortable in communicating that they have no problem getting in to the point where they don’t need a fake. Just seems like a very unsafe environment for both only the adult but also for teens. I will never give this place my service or time again. Also will be warning my friends about this place.

response.snippet:
Dear Emmanuel,
Amity Hall is deeply committed to providing a safe environment for everyone.
We have security on site weekly from Wednesday through Saturday checking IDs and when security is not present, all front of house staff follow a strict protocol to check age requirement before serving alcohol.
Should you ever experience something of this nature again, we encourage you to alert staff and management right away so action may be taken immediately.
Your comments have been escalated and further preventative measures will be enforced.
Thank you, -Amity Hall

reviews.snippet: This is the first bar my pal and I visited in NYC, and we are very happy about it. Out server was very polite, patient and helpful. The food was tasty, and all of our drinks were delicious! Shoutout to Selena for the suggestions and making my visit a very pleasant one. Don’t hesitate on making a trip here. The atmosphere is trendy, and the staff is wonderful. Will definitely make a stop here again sometime in the near future.

Did the brunch special with 1.5 hours of unlimited brunch drinks with the purchase of an entree. The apple cider mimosas we got were really good, and the staff were pretty good at refilling it. The food was also pretty good. There's outdoor seating for better weather

I really enjoyed this place! Great vibes, music, food and drinks! I’ll definitely come back again.
The service was also great, so it’s a place to go again for me 😄
I’d say I would have given it more than 5 stars if I could 😇

response.snippet: Dear Maya, thank you so much for your support and we hope to see you again soon!! -AHU

reviews.snippet:
ordered my food to go, so I didn’t get the full dine in experience, but I was honestly pretty impressed. The flavors were solid, everything tasted fresh, & nothing felt rushed or thrown together. Even as takeout, the food held up really well, which says a lot.

I’ll definitely be coming back, no question about it. Next time, I want to sit down, take my time, & really enjoy the atmosphere the way it’s meant to be experienced. If the food was this good on the go, I’m sure it’ll be even better dining in. Thanks.

response.snippet: Hi Hunter, thank you for taking the time to leave us a review and yes, please dine in with us next time! Looking forward to it! Sincerely, -AHU

reviews.snippet:
All around, this is a three star experience. The food is ok (some is poisonous), the service is fine, and the atmosphere is pretty clean.

We had ordered some chicken over rice, curly fries, and a protein smoothie. The restaurant proactively called us to inform us some ingredients of the protein smoothie we’re out of stock and we were able to make a substitution quite easily.

The curly fries are pretty good and well seasoned. It’s definitely a frozen packaged item, but this restaurant cooks them very well.

The chicken over rice is pretty decent but has some major issues. Nothing crazy to write home about, but it gets the job done in terms of the meat and rice. The giant issue comes with the tomatoes and lettuce. I believe it’s the tomatoes, but eating them had an extremely strong chemical cleaner taste and smell. I believe this restaurant has not properly washed those vegetables, or they have gone extremely bad and are still being used. Whatever it is, it tasted like something that could be poisonous and harm you. I definitely recommend asking that they do not put any veggies in your bowl.

Atmosphere is fine. They have a wide selection of anything you could need and it is all neatly organized.

reviews.snippet: Bought milk here recently and don’t realize until I got home that it was already over 2 weeks past the expiry date printed on the carton. Not only was the milk more expensive than other nearby retailers, it was expired… Never going to never shop there again.

Free coffee at the new deli that doesn’t steal!!!!! Amsterdam and 122nd
Check your receipt they steal!!!! And they change the price from the board to the time you get to the counter. I USED to shop here twice a day until they refused to reimburse me for almost 10 dollars they stole. They literally add to the total price and call it tax!!! And there is a God! A new Deimos opening on 122 and Amsterdam! I bet they won’t steal! Welcome to the neighborhood!

This used to be my favorite deli in the area for the past 10 years but this past year everything has become unreasonably priced, the staff is insufficient and rude, they have gotten me rotten condiments multiple times specifically marinara sauce with the mozzarella sticks and they always mess up my order. I’m never coming back it’s never worth it
Food is tasty and delicious.. Cashier from Ecuador is very professional and the guys making the sandwiches are very good.. Good place i recommend #LaCobra

NOT ONLY .. do they be adding prices .. like a BLT is 4.00 .. And it should not be when a hero is 6.. They are dirty.. I bought a bLT and it had parts of a fried egg and old onion I was grossed out.. I am going to notify the health department

Everything you want in a bodega. The cooks are fantastic and the whole crew has a great vibe... They've really become a cornerstone of the community! Food-wise, the breakfast sandwiches and the lamb over rice are particular highlights.

They Don't check to see what's passed expiration enough. Some of the Beverages be expired, brought some expired gourmet popcorn for $5. If you selling expired stuff least you can do is lower the price.
*Update* They will Tax you for using your Debit card. But it's completely random. I'll be paying 23cents or Close to a dollar at any given moment depending on who is behind the counter for Using a my card.
Got a smoothie and snack all three staff members I interacted with on a week day were polite and the smoothie slapped for a reasonable price . Was clean organized and had nice smell and atm worked.

If I could give this place zero stars I would. This is the 3rd time I call for delivery and have to call back because it’s been over an hour and my order has not gotten here. Everytime I have called, the excuse is that a different person took the order and my order has just been sitting there. They then, have the audacity to ask if you still want your order which has gotten cold and been sitting there. They don’t even bother to make you new sandwiches or come up with a resolution. The girl who works at night is Always rude and nasty. DO NOT WASTE your time! There are so many better delis.

8 dollars for a frost bite cheese and ham sandwich 😒 how is this consider a fresh sandwich? I miss the older staff.

Disturbing behavior, the employees act as if you are not paying them any money for their services! Food is never right that in person or over the phone! They give you others orders! Food is usually a hit and miss! All beachside they have listening problems. And the prices are way to high outrageous prices

Honestly, don’t waste your time you can order from tens of thousands of better corner stores in New York City. The food is not good enough for the horrible customer service that you get. The lady who takes orders over the phone is very rude and never listens! Order somewhere else and they never get the order right anyway and you waste so much time and money!

Ordered a gyro 🤢 DISGUSTING 🤮Lettuce was very hot and under the meat. Usually when I get gyros the lettuce, onions, etc is on the top.
