reviews.snippet: I got the crab set here with extra corn and everything was delicious! The crabs were extremely fresh and the meat was plump and juicy (with a ton of roe)! The boil seasoning was very flavorful. I will be back :)

response.snippet:
Natasha, always good to have you back.

That tray looked exactly how it should, fresh crabs, full and juicy, and that seasoning doing its thing. That flavor comes from a family recipe we’ve been holding onto for over 40 years, so it means a lot that you felt it.

And extra corn is a seasoned move at this point.

We really appreciate you coming back and sharing this. Looking forward to seeing you again soon.

reviews.snippet:
First order was phenomenal. I recently had a minor issue with my 2nd order and reached out directly. What stood out most was how quickly and professionally they responded.
They apologized immediately, communicated respectfully, and went above and beyond to resolve the situation even offering accommodations because I live in Brooklyn. That level of customer service is hard to find and definitely appreciated. Because of the way they handled everything, I’ll definitely be a repeat customer going forward. Their response alone speaks volumes about how much they value customer satisfaction. And the food is AMAZINGGGGGG !!!

response.snippet:
Lisa, thank you so much for taking the time to share this. Your review truly means a lot to us.

While we always strive to get every order right the first time, we're grateful you gave us the opportunity to make things right. We believe great customer service isn't just about serving great food. It's about standing behind every order and treating every customer with the care and respect they deserve.

Thank you for giving us that chance, and we're so happy to hear you'll be ordering from us again. We look forward to serving you the next time you're craving seafood, all the way in Brooklyn!

reviews.snippet: I’ve been eating Crabman Mike’s food from its inception on 125th street in Harlem and I’m so excited to see him bring his amazing food to a brick and mortar in Morningside Park! All these years later the food and flavor do not disappoint and are even better than what I remembered! Whether you are in the neighborhood or traveling in to experience the Cajun flavors…the food is well worth it and the service was great! He’s brought a gem to the neighborhood that’s worth exploring! I had the blue crabs and peel and eat shrimp with corn on the cob and potatoes. It was delicious down to the last bite! Can’t wait to return for more!

response.snippet:
Tonique, thank you for such a thoughtful review! It means the world to know you’ve been with Crabman Mike’s journey since the 125th Street days and are now here with us in Morningside Park. Carrying that legacy forward into a brick-and-mortar has been a dream, and hearing that the flavors are even better than you remembered is the highest compliment we could hope for.

We’re thrilled you enjoyed the crabs, shrimp, and all the fixings; that Cajun boil is our pride and joy. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another round, and we’re honored to be called a gem in the neighborhood.

— The Morningside Café Team

reviews.snippet: Shout out to the OG crab spot of Harlem!! Been going faithfully since the family was out selling every summer on 125th street! The new spot is awesome with the same great food and service. I eat there religiously in the summer…. Mike and his cousin never disappoint!!

response.snippet: Angelique, thank you so much for your kind words and for your incredible loyalty over the years. It means the world to us that you've been with us since our 125th Street days and continue to support us from our new home at Morningside Park Café. We truly appreciate your continued trust and are honored to be one of your go-to meals each week. Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We look forward to serving you again soon!

reviews.snippet: Fantastic! We went for my fathers 95th birthday and we had a great time. The food was delicious- crab, shrimp, mussels, and sides. So well prepared! And of course it was great being in our neighborhood at the park. We even got to watch the kids play baseball.

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for sharing this beautiful review. We’re honored that you chose to celebrate your father’s 95th birthday with us. It means a lot to know your family enjoyed the crab, shrimp, mussels, sides, and the terrace overlooking the park.

We’re especially glad your father was comfortable and able to access the terrace with his power chair. Mike was happy to accommodate your group, and we’re grateful to have been part of such a meaningful family moment.

Thank you again for celebrating with us. We hope to welcome you and your family back soon!

reviews.snippet:
Morningside Cafe is one of those rare neighborhood gems. On a sunny day, the location truly shines—right on the corner by Morningside Park, with a stunning glimpse of the cathedral roof in the background.
The food is fantastic and incredibly affordable. The standout is their medium-spicy seafood boil, made from a cherished old family recipe from the owner—it’s flavorful, comforting, and clearly made with care. That said, there’s something for everyone here, from classic burgers to solid vegetarian options.
They also serve alcohol (a big plus for a casual spot like this), along with coffee and other beverages, making it perfect whether you’re in the mood for a relaxed lunch, a casual drink, or a quick bite.

response.snippet:
Eva, this is such a thoughtful review. Thank you.

You captured exactly what we’re building here. A place where the food feels intentional, the space feels easy, and people can actually slow down and enjoy where they are.

That seafood boil is close to us, so it means a lot that you felt the care behind it. And we’re glad you noticed the range too, we want it to work whether someone is coming for a full meal, a drink, or just a quick stop by the park.

Appreciate you taking the time to share this. Looking forward to having you back soon.

reviews.snippet: 10/10 the food was amazing, prices were great. It was clean and we got cool bibs to keep us clean. They even showed us how to properly open up the crabs which was super nice because we were struggling. But again food was 10/10 and the staff is also 10/10.

response.snippet: Hi Lily! Wow—thank you for the 10/10 love! We’re so glad you enjoyed the crab boil and that our team could jump in to help with cracking those beauties open. We’ve got more seafood, smiles, and bibs waiting for you anytime. Come back soon for more park-side flavor at Morningside Café! 💙🦀

reviews.snippet: I was just there, spent over $40, and did not get exactly what I ordered. My food isn’t hot, it was wrapped up, and handed to me like it was my exact order. I was excited to try the blue crab, instead I get shrimp. The one star is for the customer service.

response.snippet: Bri, we’re sorry to hear there was an issue with your order. We have steps in place to check accuracy before food leaves the counter, and we wish we’d had the chance to correct this for you on the spot. Please reach out to us directly and let us know what was missing so we can make it right for you on your next visit. Our goal is for every guest to receive exactly what they ordered, served hot and fresh, every time.

reviews.snippet:
Morningside Magic!

If cozy charm and top-tier got together to open up a parkside eatery, it would be Morningside Cafe!! From the moment you walk in, you're wrapped in the scent of fresh seafood deliciousness. The hot dogs are yummy good too!! The proprietor Crabman Mike is friendly and lightning-fast. Perfect for lazy Sundays, power-through Mondays, or anytime you need a bite of pure happiness. Morningside Cafe is my new happy place!

response.snippet: Anne, your review is pure poetry—and it made our whole team smile. 💫 Thank you for seeing the heart and hustle behind Morningside Café. We’re so happy to be your new happy place! Come back soon for another hit of crab boil, comfort, and community. 💚🌳🦞

reviews.snippet: Great shrimp and corn on the cob. Got to meet Mike who treated us like family. Love the terrace overlooking Morningside. Coming back soon!

response.snippet:
Joey, thank you so much for the wonderful review! We're so glad you enjoyed the shrimp, the corn on the cob, and the terrace overlooking Morningside Park.

It was a pleasure meeting you, and Mike will be especially happy to hear your kind words. Making our guests feel like family has always been at the heart of what we do. We truly appreciate your support and can't wait to welcome you back for another great meal soon!

reviews.snippet: This place is delicious 😋. A real hidden gem. We had shrimp and blue crab, cooked perfectly. Mick even gave a demonstration on how to open a crab.

response.snippet:
Lewis, appreciate this.
Glad you enjoyed the shrimp and blue crab, and that everything came out the way it should. And yeah, Mike takes that crab walkthrough seriously, it’s part of the experience.

Happy we could make it feel easy, no wait, good food, and a solid time.

Looking forward to having you back again soon.

reviews.snippet: Fantastic shrimp, even better service! Crabman Mike has an awesome little shop here and is a stand up dude. Will definitely come back on my next visit to New York!

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for the fantastic review! We're thrilled you enjoyed the shrimp, and Mike will truly appreciate your kind words.

It was a pleasure serving you, and we're honored that Morningside Park Café was part of your visit to New York. We hope the rest of your trip was just as memorable, and we'll have the shrimp (and the crab!) ready for you the next time you're in town. Safe travels, and we look forward to welcoming you back!

reviews.snippet:
My two sisters and I went this past Sunday to celebrate one of my sister’s birthdays, and let me just say — Crabman Mike did not disappoint! From start to finish, the entire experience was absolutely incredible.

The food was out of this world. Everything from the blue crabs to the snow crab legs was bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. The fresh, plump, juicy corn was sweet and buttery — the kind that makes you close your eyes with the first bite. The clams tasted like they were just caught fresh from the sea that morning and brought straight to our table. Every bite was a reminder of why we love coming here!

The beer and spritz selection is another win — Crabman Mike carries beers you don’t usually see anywhere else, and his variety is top-notch. And if you’ve got a sweet tooth like us, don’t skip the yummy ice cream to top off the night — the perfect finish to an amazing meal.

The atmosphere is always awesome. Crabman Mike manages to attract the best crowd — from friendly neighbors to visitors from all over the world. Every time we’ve gone, we’ve met someone interesting, which makes the experience even more fun.

And of course, we have to mention Crabman Mike himself — he’s so engaging, attentive, and full of great energy. He doesn’t miss a detail — from making sure your condiments are ready to ensuring every guest is having the best time. You can tell he genuinely cares about what he does, and it shows in every part of the experience.

Whether you’re local or visiting, Morningside Café with Crabman Mike is a must-visit. Amazing food, great people, and an atmosphere you’ll want to come back to again and again.

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for sharing this beautiful review and for celebrating your sister’s birthday with us! We’re truly honored that you chose to spend such a special day at Morningside Café.

Hearing that every part of your experience—from the blue crabs and snow crab legs to the drinks, ice cream, and atmosphere—made an impression means the world to us. Chef Crabman Mike and our entire team pour their hearts into every meal we serve, and reviews like yours remind us why we love what we do.

We’re so glad you felt the warmth of the crowd and the energy that makes Morningside what it is—good food, good people, and Harlem soul. We can’t wait to welcome you and your sisters back again soon.

With gratitude,
The Morningside Cafe Team

reviews.snippet: Loving that Crabman Mike is in Morningside! We’re SO lucky to have his family’s amazing Cajun cooking in the park—once you catch those mouthwatering aromas, you’re hooked! Mike and his team are incredibly friendly, the prices are great, and the food is phenomenal. We’ve had the blue and snow crabs, mussels, shrimp—and don’t skip the corn! They also have burgers and dogs. Last time, our family hung out on the porch for hours, chatting and enjoying the beautiful view (and some great softball). The perfect place be!

response.snippet: Brigham, thank you. We’re so glad the café has become a place you and your family enjoy, and we truly appreciate your ongoing support. It’s been great seeing you and hearing your feedback. We’ll keep doing our part to make sure the food, the vibe, and the experience stay worth coming back for.

reviews.snippet: Fantastic food in a hidden gem of a spot! I had the shrimp and Cajun corn and it was really excellent. Some people nearby ordered the king crab and it looked and smelled incredible. This place is the real deal, the people couldn’t have been nicer, and I can’t wait to go back, it’s the kind of small business you root for and support.

response.snippet:
Thank you, Timothy! We love hearing that the shrimp and Cajun corn hit the spot — and yes, the king crab is definitely a showstopper. It means a lot that you recognize us as a small business worth rooting for. Serving fresh seafood with warmth and care is what we’re all about, and your support helps us keep growing right here in the park.

We look forward to welcoming you back soon for your next seafood feast — maybe that king crab next time!

— The Morningside Café Team

reviews.snippet: Unfortunately, the business hours listed are not accurate at all. There were several people waiting outside on 9/16 since 11am and it wasn't open even after 1:30pm. It says they open at 11am on google and 12pm on the morning side park website. Regardless there's no way to contact anyone & no signs for updates regarding closure. Extremely disappointing and a waste of time if you are traveling far. Please do better. People want to support you and this isn't how you treat them.

response.snippet:
Thank you for sharing your feedback, 1neta. We’re truly sorry for the confusion and inconvenience you experienced that day. On September 16th, our family faced a medical emergency when Crabman Mike’s father was hospitalized, which required us to delay opening until 2pm once a team member was able to step in.

We did post the update on Instagram, our main communication channel for schedule changes, but we realize this may not have reached everyone waiting on-site. We’re taking steps to make updates more visible across platforms so guests traveling from farther away aren’t caught by surprise again.

We deeply appreciate your intention to support us — this café is built on community, and your feedback helps us do better. We would love the chance to welcome you back and provide the full experience of fresh seafood, Harlem hospitality, and care.

— The Morningside Café Team

reviews.snippet: New favorite place! Fantastic food, varied menu w/a little something for everyone, at every price point (Cajun crab/shrimp plates! Also coffee, beer, smoothies, burgers/hot dogs, salads, sides, and more) Mike the owner has a smile as big as Morningside Park (and also makes *amazing* shrimp). Go! Sit and enjoy the beautiful park! Support this new business! For reference, we went in July ‘25, and they were open 11a-9p, w/add’l plans to expand breakfast/pastry offerings soon.

response.snippet:
Jill, thank you for such a thoughtful and energizing review! We love that you’ve made us a new favorite spot and that the variety on the menu — from Cajun crabs and shrimp to smoothies, coffee, and kid-friendly treats — hit the mark for you and your family.

Mike’s smile really does match the size of the park, and we’re thrilled you felt the warmth of both his cooking and hospitality. We can’t wait to welcome you back, especially as we expand with new breakfast and pastry offerings. It’s guests like you who help us grow into a true neighborhood staple.

— The Morningside Café Team

reviews.snippet: Some of the best food I’ve ever had. I’m determined to eat through the entire menu. It’s clear the food was made with love, the staff is friendly and the owner and his team were gracious enough to give us tips on eating crab and other seafood. This is a must-have. Can’t wait to try the next item on the menu.

response.snippet: London, thank you for this amazing review. We're so glad you and Lily came by and EVEN MORE glad we could get you through your first blue crab battle! It was too good not to jump in. We love sharing food AND technique around here. Looking forward to seeing you again and cheering you on as you work through the rest of the menu.

reviews.snippet:
first time trying blue crab!
they gave me a shell cracker and it was a delicacy I'm not used to, to be honest

I'll have to try the crab legs next time around

response.snippet:
Corey, first crab experience is a big one.

Blue crab can definitely catch you off guard if you’re not used to it, but that’s part of what makes it a bit of a rite of passage. Glad the team got you set up with the cracker.

And you made it through, so congratulations, you’re officially initiated.

Come back for the crab legs next time. A little easier to navigate, but just as satisfying.

We’ll be ready for you.

reviews.snippet: Lovely setting and lovely people. The food here is so fresh and delicious and we don’t have a lot of great seafood options in the neighborhood so it’s really exciting this place opened up. Sitting overlooking the park is so relaxing, no better outdoor seating in the neighborhood. I’ve already come twice since it opened and can see myself here weekly!

response.snippet:
Thank you, Neena! We’re so glad you’ve enjoyed both the food and the setting — hearing that you already feel at home here means a lot. Fresh, flavorful seafood in the park is exactly what we hoped to bring to the neighborhood, and we love knowing it’s become part of your routine.

Next time, we’d love for you to try one of our seafood boils while you soak in those park views — it’s the perfect way to enjoy an afternoon in Morningside. We can’t wait to welcome you back for your weekly visit!

— The Morningside Café Team

reviews.snippet:
Stumbled across this spot and am sooooo pleased I did. I would trek to the 1 again just to come back here.

Flaky, incredible pastry with savory cheese 8.5/10

The Ekmek 10/10 so creamy with a nice texture from the pistachios and bread and not too sweet at all. So glad I asked what this was and tried it!! Incredible.

The tiramisu cheesecake also 10/10 just the perfect blend of everything you love about both of those desserts. Not too sweet. Very creamy.

Highly recommend!

response.snippet:
Jordanna, thank you so much for this wonderful review!
We're thrilled you discovered us and found the trip worthwhile. We especially loved reading your thoughtful descriptions of the Ekmek Tsoureki and Tiramisu Cheesecake, it's always rewarding when someone appreciates the textures and balance of flavors that make them so special.
We're also happy you enjoyed our savory cheese pie and took the time to explore something new. Thank you for your recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you back the next time you're making the trek uptown! 😊

reviews.snippet: This is the best coffee we have had so far in the month since we have moved to the city. Ezge was working and was so kind and helpful. I got the Freddo Cappuccino and the kids tried both flavor of Eclair. We cannot wait to come back.

media.caption: Omonia Cafe iced coffee and pastries

reviews.snippet:
It was a wonderful experience to stop by at this coffee shop the staff is really kind and attentive and they make you feel at home. The coffee is the best I have ever tried on the city and the pastries are out of this world is a really nice place perfect to read a book or just spend some quality time.
I highly recommend to try the tarts and the baklava.
My favorite spot so far.
♥️♥️♥️

We got the spinach pie, which was a great savory breakfast, their orange pie which is their most popular and the bougatsa which is a custard dessert not too sweet. All was very special food to you have to try. Welcoming service and Ezggce helped to guide us to make the best choices when ordering!! Thank you for the great experience!

The coffee here is super tasty and the "Orange Pie" is incredible, all served by wonderfully kind staff. Such a treat compared to the other impersonal coffee shops in the neighborhood. The Greek pastries are really worth the trip. My husband tried the Orange Pie without realizing the NYT named it the best in the city and could hardly come up with suitable adjectives to describe how good it was. Everyone should go here!

response.snippet:
Tara, thank you for this beautiful review! Hearing that you and your husband enjoyed both our coffee and our Orange Pie means so much to us! We were honored when The New York Times recognized our Orange Pie, but praise like yours from our guests is what truly means the most.
We're also grateful for your kind words about our staff. Creating a warm, welcoming experience has always been at the heart of Omonia, and we're thrilled that it stood out to you. Thank you for making the trip to visit us, and we look forward to welcoming you back agian soon! 🍊☕️ 😊

reviews.snippet: The coffee is sooo good! Freddo Cappuccino is what I get. Soooo good. Such friendly service here! Good food and pastries too.

I got the ice tea and Ekmek Tsoureki, which is a traditional dessert. It was delicious! I love the center cream, which has the right amount of sweetness. The owner was also really pleasant and explained to me the tradition desserts available. I would come back to try different desserts!

This is a wonderful neighborhood coffee and pastry shop, with delicious gelato as well! The food is great and the coffee is always fresh. But the best part for me is the people who work there - my kids love going to say hi to Izge and give her hugs. She is particularly incredibly kind and sweet and always adds a big smile to our day.

I ordered a customized cake at Omonia and it came out absolutely BEAUTIFUL!! Exactly what I envisioned! The raspberry layers made it juicy and refreshing.
Customer service was excellent. The lady at the shop was very pleasant and made communication smooth and effortless. Prices are also very reasonable.
P.S. since it’s a Greek bakery, all their desserts are rich in flavor (not just sugary).
I would highly recommend Omonia to anyone!

response.snippet: Melisa, thank you for such a beautiful review, and please excuse the delayed response. Custom cakes are truly a collaboration, so hearing that it came out exactly as you envisioned makes us incredibly proud. We're so glad you felt cared for throughtout the process by our team. Your recommendation means a great deal to us and we look forward to creating something beautiful for you again.

reviews.snippet:
A cozy little gem in the heart of New York! Omonia Café serves delicious Lavazza coffee, perfectly brewed and rich in flavor. The “morning girl” behind the counter is super sweet and kind, always smiling and making you feel welcome.

Their pastries are incredibly fresh and tasty you can tell they’re made with care. Everything here has that authentic, homemade touch.

Approved by an Italian! 🇮🇹☕🍰 Highly recommended for a relaxing coffee break or a sweet treat.

response.snippet: Giulia, thank you for such a thoughtful review. Please excuse our late response. We love that you appreciated Lavazza and the care behind our pastries. Your compliment "approved by an Italian" made us smile.🇮🇹☕️ Looking forward to your next visit.

reviews.snippet: I come to NYC every year to visit family and this is our neighborhood coffee shop. It's an amazing small business that serves DELICIOUS cakes and treats and delectable coffee. The staff are always so nice and it's such a joy to stop in every year. Couldn't recommend it more!

response.snippet:
Kim, thank you so much for your kind review! We're honored to be part of your annual visits to NYC and delighted that you enjoy our cakes, coffee and treats.
Your compliments about our team mean the world to us. And while we always look forward to seeing you in person, you don't have to wait until your next trip....many of our holiday favorites can be ordered through our website and shipped nationwide.
Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to welcoming you back!

reviews.snippet:
Delicious pastries and desserts! A great selection - the best in the neighborhood.

I had the absolute best cheese danish I've ever had at this bakery! So tasty and delectable. I had never thought to warm up a cheese danish but my goodness it truly made it a next level dessert.

We also ordered a chocolate pudding + cake dessert that was also very tasty.

Would ABSOLUTELY come back here and try more of their tasty desserts.
Impressive amount of choices, the 3 desserts I tried were all very good. There is a tiny amount of seating, but not much. Would definitely go back!

I am blown awayyy, absolutely in love with the pastries here!! The orange pie was to die forrrr 😍 this is officially my new favorite spot! 😍 I was greeted by Theresa and Ezgi. Before I tried the food, I knew I would return because the girls there are so nice, I had a very lovely time in the short time that I was there! But after having the orange pie, the strawberry shortcake cake and the mousse; its official!! I’m going to return as much as I can haha. Please give these girls a raise! They are amazing. ☺️ My son and I felt very welcomed

response.snippet:
Mariana, this absolutely made our day, thank you!
We're thrilled you loved the orange pie, the same one featured by The New York Times as the "best orange pie."🍊✨ Theresa and Ezgi will thrilled to see this. We can't wait to welcome you back at 2801 Broadway!

reviews.snippet: I suggest you make in-store purchases only. For my 2 delivery orders the hot chocolates were not wrapped sufficiently and both times there was substantial spillage. So much so that in the second order the other item was ruined. The woman on the phone very politely questioned why this happened to me twice, as if it was somewhat suspicious. She never seemed to grasp that the problem was with her staff, not my honesty.

response.snippet:
Jonathan, thank you for your feedback. We're very sorry to hear that you experienced issues with your delivery orders, particularly on more than one occasion.
While we take great care in packaging our beverages, we understand how frustrating it is when an item arrives spilled, especially if it affects the rest of the order. We are reviewing our packaging procedures with the team to help prevent this from happening in the future.
We also regret if any part of your conversation with our staff left you feeling unheard. Our intention is always to understand what happened and assist our guests as best we can. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention and hope you'll consider giving us another opportunity in the future.

reviews.snippet: We are avid customers at this bakery. Everything is always extremely fresh and delicious. Espresso is amazing as well as all the baked goods. The service is always given with a smile and the workers are very quick to help us decide on what sweet treat to indulge on. We will continue to be regulars at this lovely establishment!!!

response.snippet: Hi Mads, thank you for the kind words and awesome review! We are delighted to hear that you had a great experience. We strive to provide the best pastries, baked goods and service! Your feedback lets us know we’re on the right track. We appreciate your support and hope to see you again soon!

reviews.snippet: Omonia is hands down my favorite bakery in the city!!! The quality of the food is incomparable. They have such an eclectic selection, from classic Greek desserts to pastry staples like napoleons. I love their savory food as well, especially the spinach pie (they have one with cheese and one vegan!) The customer service is top notch. Ezgi is always so helpful and sweet! My family orders custom made cakes from them for every big event and the quality and care they put into each order is impeccable. Highly recommend!!

Found this place on Google and came for a morning coffee. My absolute favorite: freddo cappuccino. So so good. The Turkish barista was so sweet and welcoming.
Try it if you haven't!

Don’t walk, RUN! Omonia is our neighborhood favorite. The seasonal pumpkin muffin is to die for. The orange pie is absolutely delicious, and you can’t go wrong with anything at this Greek establishment. The workers offer excellent recommendations and greet you with so much warmth. Love it here 💙

response.snippet: Hi Bané! We deeply appreciate this amazing review! We’re thrilled that you got to enjoy our new seasonal item, as well as some of our signatures. I hope you continue to enjoy our wide range of products, thank you!

reviews.snippet:
The Tiramisu here is honestly one of the best in the area—the flavor is spot on. However, the freshness is hit-or-miss. Sometimes it’s clearly day-old, and the texture just isn't the same.

It doesn't feel right to pay full price for a non-fresh slice. I’d suggest marking the production dates or offering a small discount for day-old items so customers know what they’re getting. I love the flavor and would hate to stop coming because of the inconsistency!

response.snippet:
June, thank you so much for your thoughtful review and kind words about our tiramisu.
We're honored to hear you consider it one of the best in the area! Our tiramisu is made fresh and because it's a delicate dessert, the texture can naturally vary slightly as it settles. That said, consistency and quality are extremely important to us, and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention.
Thank you for your continued support. We look forward to welcoming you back!

reviews.snippet: I came here on a Thursday night the vibes was a younger crowd. The staff were amazing from the security, to the host, to the DJ playing the latest Hip-hop and R & B music. They are definitely welcoming which is amazing, but the younger crowd wasn’t for me. I had my temperature checked at the door my friend and I didn’t order any food so we just ordered a drink and the drink was watered down which was unacceptable. I ordered the Blue Hawaii I felt like I was drinking Hawaiian Punch Polar Blast it definitely tasted like juice 🥴. I knew I wasn’t staying long because the younger crowd was just not for me (no shade). Also they have hookah here which was $40 cash.

Great Wings, Amazing fried Shrimp and Waffle Fries. Oh Did I forget to mention reasonable prices for both food and drinks. Definitely a spot to check out. Great Music as well. Owners are present and very nice.
Drinks are delicious, strong, and cheap! 🙌🏼 good spot to stop at for a bar hop night.

The female bartender looked me right in my face & didn't greet or acknowledge me. Went 2 seats down & served my cousin. She didn't know the price of drinks either. We left after that 1st round. I'll never go back!!!

reviews.snippet:
Harlem Tavern is a solid, casual spot with a relaxed neighborhood feel. The outdoor seating is probably the highlight—great for sitting outside when the weather is nice and just enjoying the atmosphere.

The menu is comprehensive straightforward, with classic comfort food like burgers, sandwiches, and brunch options. The food is between good and average, nothing overly memorable but satisfying.

Service is friendly, though it can be a bit slow when it gets busy, which is fairly common during peak times.

Overall: a good, easygoing place to grab a meal or a drink if you’re in the area

We had a wonderful time, we enjoyed our food. We enjoyed the music all night long and were able to get our dance on and enjoy ourselves.

reviews.snippet: Great option for a Sunday jazz brunch. Music was fantastic and food options diverse and tasty. Brunch is only $20 and includes a cocktail.

The chicken and waffles here ended up being 90% waffle, like 10% chicken, which was pretty disappointing.
Seriously, it was actually kind of amusing how small the chicken was compared to the size of the waffle. They put the eggs on top at first to cover it up, but it becomes clear once you take the egg off.

Other than the tiny chicken, though, this meal wasn't bad. It came with country gravy and two eggs as a side - both of which were decent enough; my eggs were cooked a bit over-hard rather than over-medium, but not too bad.
The waffles were really good. While I did have to ask for syrup from the server - it was very dry before that - after the syrup the experience became a lot better. These waffles were nice and thick throughout.

The chicken was not good. There was absolutely no crust on the outside - I'm not even sure this was fried chicken; it just seems to have been baked. That certainly is not what one expects with a chicken and waffles dish. Just really bad.
It's also just incomprehensible to me why there was a massive amount of a lettuce salad in the middle of this dish. Like why

The price is the one thing that's not terrible here, as it cost less than 20 bucks for this plus a mimosa. That's a pretty good deal

Overall, I've had a lot of chicken and waffles, but this might be the worst of the bunch. 3.5/10

Food is okay (nothing to write home about… I’ve had the fish and chips, Parmesan fries, and salad before). they make up for it with the drinks, very generous with the pours. Bartenders are extremely friendly and nice. Watching a sports game here is great… unmatched vibe especially for Knicks games

Visiting from out of town and came here. Food, service and atmosphere were fantastic. We had Noah and Alishia (sorry if I misspelled her name or got it wrong) serve us and they were so fun and accommodating. If and when I come back to this area, this will be my go to spot.

Came to watch the Knicks finals and had an incredible time. The atmosphere was great. There was a long line outside the door, and the restaurant was over capacity, but the ownership managed expectations and dealt with the situation with kindness. I had an amazing night. The food was basic bar food, but I don't expect glamorous food when I am aiming to watch sports. Also, they have SO many TV's and the music was fire!
Atmosphere was Beautiful!!! Once Again New York did not disappoint. I loved coming home. The food was great.

I have eaten at Harlem Tavern several times and although the service was never great, today was just a disaster. We, 4 adults and 2 hungry kids arrived. We were seated quickly inside. We asked for water 4 times and then, atfer 30 minutes, got it ourselves. But that was far from the worst part. We waited for over an hour for chicken tenders and fries and some eggs. We asked several waitstaff and hostesses what the delay was and no one could answer. Finally, after more than an hour, as we were standing up to leave and go somewhere else, our order arrived with absolutely no apology. The food was cold and soggy--had clearly been sitting somewhere for 45 minutes. We only stayed because the kids were starving. We will not be going back.

reviews.snippet: Their food was good. I had an HT burger n truffle fries, which was delicious, Latisha had the jerk quesadilla, and Robinson had calamari and fish 🌮. The service was good. She was caring, making sure we were good and had everything we wanted. When the check came, we told her how much to charge, but she winded up charging $2 extra. Our total was $82.20 she charged $84.20, plus we gave her the 20% tip. She deserved it, but let us give it to you. She seemed to be the only waitress on the floor that I had seen, and it could have been a mistake also...all is forgiven. The atmosphere was a laid-back cool vibe. Music R & B was playing, not loud, just right. We had a great time and will go back again.

We didn't receive the food or drinks we ordered. 😢

After placing our order (wings as an app, two rum punches, two burgers, and one catfish), we waited 30 minutes. I asked our server if there was an estimated time for the drinks; they said they would check. The place was packed, with a FIFA watch party and a bar crawl, and customers just wanting to dine so slower service was understandable. After 50 minutes, the server returned, noting our table order ticket had been misplaced. In addition the kitchen was doing a reset to get back on track. We were given the option to restart the order and wait 30 or more minutes or not to dine. By that point, we had already spent 30 minutes waiting for a table and 50 minutes waiting for our food, (with the kitchen reset we couldn't even get an appetizer to hold us over) so we decided not to wait any longer. The server did offer complimentary drinks, in our hunger drinking wouldn't have helped us.

Others in my party had visited before, it was my first time.

I enjoyed sitting in, however it took so long to get orders in because there was so many people. My assumption is that there was not enough servers that day. So I’m not bashing anyone specifically but I do wish service was a bit faster because I would finish a drink and I have to wait 20 minutes to order another one.

This was one of the most disappointing dining experiences I've had, and unfortunately, we never even got to eat.

After being seated, we waited without anyone coming to greet us, take a drink order, or even bring us water. While we were sitting there, another family was seated right next to us, and a server immediately came over to welcome them and bring them water before anyone had acknowledged us.

I tried to find the manager to address the situation, but none of the servers seemed to know where the manager was. When I asked if we had an assigned server, I was told that they don't assign servers to tables—they simply ask someone to take care of new guests. Clearly, that communication failed, and we were completely overlooked.

After waiting with no service and no resolution, we decided to leave. First impressions matter, and this experience showed a serious lack of organization and communication. Based on our experience, I can't recommend this restaurant.

Hello,
I wanted to reach out and express my frustration over something that happened at Prestige earlier today.
I put in a prepaid order through Grubhub for a breakfast burrito around 1pm so I could pick it up at 1:30pm-1:40pm. I like to order ahead of time while at work so when I go on my break, my burrito is ready. I only have 30 minutes of my break so I did not want to wait and waste time, especially because I hadn’t eaten anything else earlier.
I got a notification around 2:08pm that my order was ready for pick up. I got caught up with some work so I wasn’t able to leave for my break until about 2:30pm. I get to Prestige and ask the woman at the counter for my burrito and she kind of hesitated and was like “uhhh it’s been a long time. It’s probably cold.” And I said I did not care at all if it was cold because I was just extremely hungry at that point. And then she pointed to the guy behind the deli counter and was like “he has it.” He then replied by saying “I ate it. It was too long and got cold.” And the woman said that he was just joking but then he proceeded to show me the half eaten burrito and sort of chuckled like “that’s too bad.”
I didn’t say anything and just ran out extremely upset and disrespected. How dare he eat something that I paid for just because it was sitting there? They didn’t even call me or try to contact me before enjoying my food. And to joke about it in my face? Just unbelievable and it honestly ruined my day.
I was able to get a refund through Grubhub, but I just wanted to express how unprofessional and disrespectful that was from your staff. The whole point of me ordering it ahead of time was to have it ready and just pick it up regardless of how hot the food was.
Thank you.

reviews.snippet: Amazing!! I’ve been wanting to try this spot for a while because their coffee shop has my favorite donuts in the city. I finally got to stop by while my sister was in town visiting, and it was incredible. We got the shakshuka and the breakfast pizza with potato egg and onion. It was so delicious!! The shakshuka had. nice kick to it and was really flavorful, not too monotonous in flavor like some other places can be. I will definitely be coming back again with friends to try the other breakfast pizza flavors!

We found this excellent spot in NYC for an amazing meal. Inside it has a warm atmosphere that is sophisticated but charming. The food choices are very interesting. We finally decided on a delicious Caesar salad and the zucchini pizza. Both were excellent! The zucchini tasted like it was fresh from Nonna’s garden. They have a great happy hour too. We are going back to enjoy again.

I’ve walked past this place countless times and finally stopped in and i am glad I did. Arrived around 6:30 PM on a Saturday with no reservation and were seated immediately. Service was fast and friendly, and the vibe is great: dim, lively, and a bit loud in a good way.

We shared the sausage and elote pies. The crust/undercarriage is the real standout, seriously phenomenal. The elote pie is a must-order. The sausage pie, though, fell a bit flat; I could barely taste the sauce or cheese.

Overall: fresh, vibrant food and a great atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back—especially to try the short rib burger.

My wife and I have been coming in frequently and I have just been so impressed. First of all the owner and the staff know a LOT about cocktails and wine. Second the food is to die for. The anchovy pasta is absolutely heaven, and of course their special elote pizza.
And finally just such a warm inviting chill place. Our new hot date spot!!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Super Nice Pizza is our go to spot, and for good reason. We live just a couple of blocks away and find ourselves back here again and again with our three kids in tow. The pizza is what keeps bringing us back, it's fantastic every time, but the whole experience is what makes this place special. Beyond the pizza, they've got a great menu with plenty of other awesome offerings, and a cozy bar that makes it just as good for a relaxed night out as it is for a family dinner.

What really sets this place apart is the team. They're always welcoming and accommodating, especially with a family our size. We go often enough that they know us by now, and there's something really special about having a neighborhood spot that feels that personal. It's rare to find a restaurant that treats you like family, and that's exactly what Super Nice Pizza does.

If you're in the area and haven't tried it yet, do yourself a favor. Great pizza, a menu worth exploring, and a team that makes you feel at home. Five stars all the way, and we'll keep coming back for more.

👍👍 Thumbs up!

Came in expecting pizza, but the **brisket short rib burger** completely stole the show. So good I came back *twice in the same week*. Perfectly cooked, juicy, and served with a huge portion of fries.

**Pro tip:** Ask for the burger off the *secret menu* — it takes it to another level.

Don’t skip the **calamari + cherry pepper appetizer**. They’re good separately, but amazing when eaten together in one bite.

The **espresso martini** was smooth and well-balanced.

Owner is hands-on and checks in on tables, which is always a nice touch. They also have a **rewards program** and offer a **birthday discount** (make sure your server scans your QR code before paying).

Great spot for date night, friends, or family dinner. Would definitely return.

Amazing addition to the neighborhood! This place feels cozy and neighborhoody. Our waiter was professional, friendly, and personable :) Service was super quick. Smoky potato pizza was GREAT, with the tomato and olive pizza coming in second. Caesar salad was divine (not drenched in dressing — important!) and came in a fun sharing portion. Would be great if they had pizza knives. Coming back soon!!

media.caption: Smoky potato pizza; tomato and olive pizza

reviews.snippet: This was yet another great meal at Super Nice Pizza, don’t let the name fool you! Everything is super fresh and delicious, currently the summer melon salad is divine! Great pizzas as usual and the steak special was top! Also as I couldn’t decide with Pet Nat to order, the owner gave me a taster of two before I made my decision! Really appreciated that. Best place on the UWS!
Really great pizzas and salads! Very friendly staff, and the tiramisu to finish off the meal was perfect.

WOW! I dream of great eggplant parmigiana and found my answer with Super Nice Pizza’s eggplant parmigiana sandwich!!!!
It is truly stuffed with eggplant smothered in the most delicious tomato sauce. The sandwich is huge!!

As I was starting to leave, the aroma of baking chocolate drifted through the cafe. A woman sitting near me and I started talking about what smelled so wonderful. It was their chocolate cake baking and of course I now had to try! Wonderful surprise!

Our server, Sofia, was the bonus to our visit.
Sofia took great care of us with her friendly, warm, and inviting style. Also made a great latte! She made us want to come back!

So glad I discovered Super Nice Pizza at the beginning of my NYC visit as now I can return again before I go home to Chicago!

media.caption: This is only half of the sandwich!

reviews.snippet: Super nice is such an amazing NYC staple. I frequent the east Harlem cafe location but have found myself coming back to the west side more and more to go to the restaurant. Dinner time options are great but I think the breakfast and brunch options are sleeper hits. The breakfast burrito and pancakes are to die for. You can tell everything is homemade with love by how good it tastes. I love that they have dedicated vegan options, too. This is something that’s not super easy to come by. All of the cafe locations and baked goods are 12/10 and if you haven’t tried their donut or guava and cheese danish what are you doing?! I don’t really leave reviews unless a place leaves a lasting impression on me and super nice has done just that.

Super Nice Pizza... A Hidden Gem on the Upper West Side
What an absolute gem, right in my own backyard! Super Nice Pizza captures everything that makes dining in New York magical. The atmosphere radiates a cool, effortless vibe, where every detail feels intentional yet relaxed.
The pizza? Mesmerizing in both concept and flavor, perfectly blistered dough with that just-right chew. The menu surprises, the bar impresses (proper beer glassware; yes, they care!), and the lighting sets the mood beautifully: softly lit for dinner, dimmed and candle-glowed as the evening unfolds into something almost speakeasy-like, with an evolving soundtrack to match.
We sat in the cozy window nook, comfortable, sexy, and alive with the joyful hum of people having a genuinely great time. The staff is attentive and warm, completing the experience.
Kudos to the team and to Dan Cohen, a true restaurateur who’s created something truly special on the Upper West Side.
_______________________
And just when you think it can’t get better; there’s an amazing bakery right next door. Don’t miss the authentic tiramisu or the crazy delicious layered chocolate cake. It’s hard to leave room, but do yourself a favor: take dessert home, pour a glass of wine, and enjoy an intimate, sweet ending with someone you love.

Best pancakes in the UWS. Got the chorizo breakfast pizza and burger and also wonderful. Can’t wait to try the dinner menu. Staff was welcoming, food came quick, and everything was delicious. Highly recommend

Having had their doughnuts, we were curious to try their pizza. Prior to making a reservation, we looked for pictures of the food. After seeing the clam pizza and the towering slice of cake we were sold. Not only did the clam pizza and coconut cake exceed expectations, but we were also impressed with all the fine details, from the flatware, earthenware plates, to the beer glasses and everything in between. The feel of the restaurant with the exposed brick and half curtains in the windows, was like something you'd find in the Village. The service was quick and polite and they took time to answer questions about the beer and the dough used for the pizza. This is a wonderful addition to our neighborhood. We'll be back with more of our friends. Congratulations!!

Very nice pizza. Got the clam pie and the clams were fresh tasting and not overcooked. The dough was great. Very enjoyable. My friend got the vegan pizza with vegan cheese and it was actually quite nice. The chocolate cake is a must have but be prepared to share and/or take it home because it’s enormous. Space is open and sizable but it fills up

Lovely new gem on the Upper West Side. The food was delicious and it is not just pizza... something for everyone. Very good wine list and the cocktails are inventive and expertly mixed. And oh my god.... the coconut cake is unbelievable. I don't generally eat cakes but this was exceptional. Also, the owners are incredibly gracious and warm hosts. This is what going out eat should feel like. On my favorite list !

Can’t remember the exact name but the pizza with the sausages, Amazing
And you can’t leave without having one of the cakes for dessert, even if you have to pack it up to take home
Because at 1 AM you’re gonna wish she had it
🔥🔥

Super rude!

We very excited to try super nice pizza, after having enjoyed super nice doughnuts. We reserved a table and assumed we would be eating at a table, which was not an assumption shared by super nice. We were seated at a cramped bar with no explanation, and no other option, and no apologies. The hostess was very rude.

All evening we heard the bar staff discussing how they didn't like to work at the place, which was not a surprise. I assume the commandments are to squeeze in as many people as they can.

We may have enjoyed the atmosphere if we were not banging elbows at the bar.

The food itself was good. The first bite into the pizza was heavenly. However, by the end my mouth felt parched due to the dryness of the crust. One suggestion could be to offer a dipping sauce. We got the pepperoni and mushroom pizza. Also a fennel salad, which was nice.

As always annoyed by the assumption that the minimum tip would be 20%, with options going up to 25%.

Super Nice Pizza has me in a chokehold. The chicken parm is unreal — cheesy, saucy perfection — and the Caesar salad is plentiful, shareable, and easily one of the best I’ve had globally thanks to that incredible dressing. The clam pizza? To die for. And if you somehow save room, the coconut cake is a must — freshly baked in-house, light yet decadent, with a salted caramel ribbon woven through the layers that takes it over the top. Come with an appetite because you’ll want to try everything. The staff is amazing, the owner is fantastic, and it’s truly the perfect addition to the neighborhood. Get there, you won’t be sorry.

A lovely neopolitan pizza shop for the neighborhood. Pretty packed when we got there. Nice salad and meatballs, great sauce. Don't think I've had a clam pizza with whole clams shell and all before. The juice spilling onto the pie a bit. Nice sausage pizza and a huge chocolate cake to share.

reviews.snippet: I’ve been wanting. To try lavains cookies for over two years now. Today Ive made the impulsive decision to finally try it. Best decision I ever made. It best insomnia and crumbl cookies any day. The service was pretty good as well. Despite me constantly asking the cashier for the wrong cookie she was very patient with me and even broke down the various cookies they had including the names without making a fuss about it. She then helped me find the cookie I truly wanted and kept a smile on her face the entire time lmfao. I failed to ask for her name before I left but if you ever decide to come this joint just look out for a pretty black lady with a bright smile and a compelling voice✨ Definitely would come back 9/10

reviews.snippet: Absolutely amazing cookies. Had the caramel coconut chocolate chip and the lemon cookie. Both were perfect and soft.

reviews.snippet: Great bakery. A little off the path of most NYC visitors but totally worth it. Take the subway and walk 10 mins and you'll be rewarded with some great cookies and other bakery items. Take it to go and eat it in Central Park.

response.snippet:
Joseph, we're thrilled you made the journey to our Frederick Douglass Blvd bakery! Thanks for spreading the word that we're worth the trip, and we love that you enjoyed your treats in Central Park.

Warmly, The Levain Team

reviews.snippet: Heard this was one of the top ten cookies in the country and I'd have to agree. I did only try the vegan chocolate chip walnut cookie and it was delicious. They were massive cookies, thick junts for sure but so good. Service was nice and I really liked the outside seating to try these cookies. I will say that eating the fresh is the best way to consume these delicious cookies.

response.snippet:
Khalidah, we're thrilled you loved our vegan chocolate chip walnut cookies at our bakery! Thanks for the kind words about our team and seating area. We look forward to your next visit!

Warmly, The Levain Team

reviews.snippet:
8/17/25, 7pm

I got their Levain a la mode- you choose any cookie and pair it with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. I got the dark chocolate chocolate chip cookie, which was $5.75 and the scoop of vanilla ice cream was $4.75. So in total I paid $10.50 for the cookie and ice cream combo. The cookie was fresh, soft, and gooey and reminded me of a brownie! I wish they have more ice cream flavors in the future :)

response.snippet: Janiqua, we're thrilled you enjoyed our Levain a la mode with the dark chocolate chocolate chip cookie and vanilla ice cream at our bakery! Thank you for the kind comments about our cookies. We appreciate your feedback on offering more ice cream flavors as well. Warmly, The Levain Team

reviews.snippet:
I had such a great experience at Levain Bakery, and Zoe made it even better. From the moment I walked in, she was warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind. She took the time to help me choose (which is not easy with all those amazing cookies 😅) and made the whole visit feel personal instead of rushed.

Her energy was so positive, and you can tell she really cares about customers. On top of that, everything was fresh, delicious, and exactly what you expect from Levain.

Zoe is the kind of person that makes you want to come back again and again. 10/10 experience!

response.snippet:
John, thank you so much for sharing this! We're thrilled to hear that Zoe provided such wonderful service at our Frederick Douglass Blvd bakery. She's truly a special part of our team, and we'll make sure she knows how much her kindness and helpfulness meant to you. We can't wait to welcome you back soon!

Warmly, The Levain Team

reviews.snippet: Googled ‘best cookies’ & this bakery came highly recommended to try in NYC ~ It did not disappoint. Some of the best cookies I’ve had! I tried the No. 1 bestseller, Choc chip walnut first & it was insanely good. Warm, slightly crispy on the outside but perfectly soft & gooey on the inside w the subtle crunch of the walnut. I ate the whole thing in one sitting which was a lot to handle but I don’t regret it. I later enjoyed the Dark Choc Peanut Butter at home. That’s my fave one 🥰 I ended up ordering 10 more cookies online the next day to take back home to New Zealand for my family to taste a little bit of NYC. Safe to say, they all enjoyed them. Thank you Levain Bakery, Harlem! Your warm, friendly & efficient service did not go unnoticed either. I can’t wait to come back☺️

response.snippet: Thank you for the great review. We love to hear that you enjoyed our Choc Chip Walnut and Dark Choc Peanut Butter cookies. It's so sweet that you brought a taste of NYC back to New Zealand for your family. We can't wait to welcome you back! -The Levain Team

reviews.snippet: A bakery serving god-tier chocolate chip cookies with walnuts. I was told about this chain’s famous chocolate chip cookies and was worried they were overhyped. After taking one bite into it, I immediately realized they were properly-hyped. I don’t know how this location compares with the other Levain Bakery’s, but I’ll definitely be stopping by at more now thanks to this location.

response.snippet: Abdullah, thank you so much for sharing your experience! We are so happy you enjoyed our cookies! We appreciate your 5-stars, and we look forward to welcoming you back soon. 🍪 Warmly, The Levain Team

reviews.snippet: Definitely worth it the hype!!! I'd take other thousands cookies 😍🍪

response.snippet:
We're thrilled you loved your visit to our Frederick Douglass Blvd bakery! Your excitement means the world to us, and we can't wait to welcome you back for more freshly baked treats.

Warmly, The Levain Team

reviews.snippet: By far one of the best cookies I have ever had. If your love gooey cookies these are definitely the ones for you. Their cookies are huge, crispy on the outside and gooey- almost like a cookie dough on the inside. Their coffee is pretty good too. Definitely worth stopping by!

I’ve said this once and I’ll say it again! Levain has the best cookies in nyc. Sure you’re gonna pay a small premium, but that’s NYC. There’s lot of other bakeries that charge more and don’t offer half the flavor that these cookies have. We got the classic chocolate chip walnut as well as the chocolate peanut. The chocolate peanut veas out favorite. Fortunately there wasn’t a line, service is efficient, the space is small but very clean and we will continue to always come back when we’re in the area!!!

response.snippet: Thanks so much Dwight! So glad you loved our Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter cookie!

reviews.snippet: I love this place for the walnut chocolate chip cookie. I highly recommend you try it but make sure it's hot or at least warm so you can really get a feel for the gooey feel of it. The cookies are $4 each and defiently worth it.

media.caption: My favorite (make sure you leave some for me)

reviews.snippet:
Let me tell you something about this place... You don't have many options but the flavors are there.
The cookies are big and soft with the crunchiness from the outside.
The attention is very good and if you want of course you'll have different drinks to pair with your cookie.
You don't have places to seat because this location is for to go, but two blocks from there you have a beautiful park with benches. Levain is my option for cookie time!!!.

response.snippet: Thank you so much, Ariana! So nice to hear!!

reviews.snippet: Had to see what the hype was about with these cookies. Tried the chocolate chip, it was good and had a high ratio of chocolate to cookie. The cookies are very rich and sweet.

response.snippet: Megan, thank you for giving our famous chocolate chip cookies a try at our Harlem bakery! We're delighted you enjoyed. Our team takes great pride in hand-crafting each batch fresh daily using simple, quality ingredients. Warmly, The Levain Team

reviews.snippet: I was a little reluctant to make a purchase from Levain Because they seem so high class. I’ve seen the other Levain Bakeries throughout the city and I’ve peaked into the window and all the patrons look like either Wall Street investment bankers, ladies who lunch, and people who make a six figure salary. But the other night I let down my resolve. A friend invited me to dinner at her flat. And neglected to get anything for dessert. I volunteered to buy something as a sort of hostess gift/dessert. So I went to Levain In Harlem and purchased a half dozen of assorted cookies. The cookies were stellar. They were a combination of cookie and cake. The flavor notes were a direct reflection of the description. The texture was perfect. Just the right amount of sweetness without being overly sweetened. They were expensive. But oh, so worth the price. At my friend’s dinner we had them with vanilla ice cream as an accompaniment. The dessert could not have been better. Everyone raved about the cookies. While I don’t think I will purchase them as a casual every day cookie. I do think I will purchase them in future for just such an occasion once again. This bakery proved itself to be a significant part of our local community. So glad they are here. Oh and the customer service was stellar as well. Overall, I endorse.Levain.

response.snippet:
Gregory, we're thrilled you discovered our Harlem bakery and gave us a chance! It sounds like our cookies made the perfect addition to your dinner gathering, and we're so happy everyone enjoyed them. We hand-make everything fresh daily using quality ingredients, which is reflected in our pricing, and we're grateful you felt they were worth it for such a special occasion.

Sincerely, The Levain Team

reviews.snippet:
Amazing!!! I can't explain what is the cookies! They are the best in NYC and in the world! Awesome!!! The local is tiny, but the taste is gorgeous. In Harlem, you don't get big lines.
I wish I could have the cookies recipe. 😍

I was really excited to try Levain's cookies, the hype was real. And they didn't disappoint. Best cookies I've ever had in my life. Crispy outside, but super super soft and moist inside and super deep flavour. Just amazing. We tried the original, really nice, but the dark chocolate and peanut butter one stole my heart. Never had a cookie like that one. They were also super filling. What a place.

Delicious! Cute! Teeny space but really adds to the vibe! Chunky, buttery cookies packed with such fantastic flavor—I’ve never had anything like them. The white chocolate macadamia nut, chocolate chip walnut, and double chocolate were amazing. Thank you for such a treat!

response.snippet:
Olivia, we're thrilled you loved your visit to our Frederick Douglass Boulevard bakery! It sounds like you discovered some wonderful flavors, and we're so happy our cozy space added to your experience. Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts with us.

Sincerely, The Levain Team

The almond croissants? Perfection.And don’t even get me started on the NOLA iced coffee…cherry on top 🤤😇🤗

reviews.snippet: I had never heard of Super Nice Coffee and Bakery. However, that all changed this morning. The donuts here are truly outstanding — easily the best I’ve ever tasted. If you haven’t tried their bakery and coffee yet, this place is a must. I can’t wait to try the pizza. I’m also told the pancakes filled with Nutella are off the hook. Totally recommend this amazing spot.

I LOVE this place! The window set up is quick and super convenient with my dog, the coffee is good, and I’m not usually a donut person but think about these they’re soooo yum!! The texture is just unmatched! Only thing is I wish they had a way to serve single donuts that wasn’t a bag— the glaze just transfers right to the bag and the donuts don’t have filling, the glaze is all the flavour.

Great donuts! We tried the chocolate and plain glazed. They were soft and fresh. I tried their coffee as well and went with the apple butter latte; one of the specials. I thought it was ok, I preferred their pastries over coffee but it’s still a nice spot. It’s just a window to order from outside but my drink was made quickly.

I've always liked Super Nice Coffee and Bakery. Amazingly, I've never been indoors, I order from the window. The donuts are fantastic. Prepare yourself because they are large. I've eaten other pastries from here and they are quite good. I'm not a coffee drinker but my wife is, and she digs the coffee.

Woke up with a Friday morning sweet tooth? Super Nice is the spot to go!

Just a small window serving delicious pastries and coffee in the UWS, a few blocks from Central Park. I got the cinnamon bun, a chocolate-glazed donut with a black drip coffee, and that did the trick perfectly!

Oh, and love the logo ahah

10/10

A few weeks ago my last day of a beach vacation was looming and I told myself, at least when I get home I can have a Super Nice donut. Yes, they're THAT good- the thought of them eases last day of vacation depression. And it's easy- if there's a line it's manageable (and worth it), they have good QUALITY coffee to go with their perfect donuts, and the service is quick and friendly. They also gave other delicious pastries- but it's that plain glazed (crack-ish) donut I crave. I've been to both locations and they're equally amazing. I'm trying to be a better person and not gate keep in 2026- thank me later. Run don't walk. Before too many people learn about Super Nice 🍩🍩🍩

They really are the best donuts in NYC. Believe the hype! The savory options are also decent, as a savory girlie myself. Don't skip the NOLA latte. Then treat yourself to dinner at the chef's pizza restaurant next door. It's all good stuff.

So delicious- seriously my fav spot for a latte and sweet treat in all of new york. Vegan donuts- so good! The best I've had since going vegan (and my friends like their non-vegan pastries too). Super fun seasonal drinks as well! Love this place
Cool vibe. Walk-up window service coffee and glazed donut. Think cronut meets yeast donut- really good.

Everyone says Super Nice has one of the best donuts in town, and they did not disappoint! I love how thick and the softness of the donut is giving. You just have to know the right flavors since some I really didn’t like some were too sour for my liking but as you see everyone was suggesting the pistachio and coconut flavors. The dough of the donuts, hands down 🙌🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼

The drip coffee was good too!

We did try reheating it in air fryer and it was still good 👍🏼

Review Edit:

The donuts was the one reheated in the air fryer. NOT the coffee 🤦🏼‍♀️🤷🏼‍♀️

response.snippet: Bless you for reheating coffee in your air fryer.

reviews.snippet: big fan of my favorite neighborhood coffee / donut shop! i’ve lived across the street or around the corner from them for 5 years, the coffee, the employees, the pastries, the donuts—all 10/10 i’ve never been and been disappointed in what i’ve received! big big fan & recommend to everyone who lives in the neighborhood!

I’ve never really liked American donuts they’re usually too sweet, oily, and hard for me to digest. But the donuts here completely changed my mind. Even though they’re large, they’re unbelievably light and fluffy, and honestly the best I’ve ever had.
Absolutely delicious. I can’t wait to come back again soon!(I had cinnamon sugar and pecan glaze)

Super Nice Coffee and Bakery is a neighborhood gem. I’m so glad we discovered it. I haven’t tried anything that wasn’t outstanding. We particularly love the croissants and other pastries. They have amazing donuts, too. If you haven’t yet discovered Super Nice, you’re in for a treat. But that’s not all! Now Super Nice is doing pizza (amazing), breakfast burritos (haven’t tried yet), and delicious sandwiches for lunch!

1. Sugar lime seasonal flavor, and cinnamon roll were amazing! My friend was also incredibly excited that they sold peppermint mochas in the spring!😂

2.Madelyn was an amazing barista! She was diligent, kind, and level headed under the changing circumstances around my order! She deserves a raise and so much support

Amazing donuts, especially the loganberry, delicious coffee (even just the iced coffee and drip) for around the same price as Dunkin. I highlyyy recommend! It’s the perfect place to stop by on the way to Riverside, Morningside or Central Park! The cinnamon roll is great too but a little too sweet for me.

Best vegan donuts ever!! I would eat these every day if I could. The passionfruit and mango chilli flavors are my favorite! Everyone who works here is so sweet but special shout out to Ashley who always makes my super nice experience better 🥰

Best donuts around, and their pastries are incredible too - cinnamon roll & guava cheese danish especially. Great rotating coffee specials. They also send out deals towards the end of the day! Exactly the kind of spot you love to have in your neighborhood, but worth traveling for as well.
Best donuts in town, I would eat two dozen of them if I could. Get the crazy flavors if you’re feeling frisky but the classics (glazed, cinnamon sugar, chocolate, you know) can’t be beat.
The best doughnuts and croissants on the planet. Can not stop ordering from here. The coffee is absolutely incredible as well.
The food is so good! And there are so many not sugary options 🥰 the hot milk tea selections are really good. Definitely recommend!!!
A very nice place and amazing tea and cakes. Must be Out of your expectations! Will come here often.

The egg tart is good but they give me one matcha tart when I order a bundle of 6. Some stuff was not in the machine like the pig floss one which I had to order on the side

Update: The manager has reached out very quickly and have given a refund. Props on customer service

reviews.snippet:
Back at NaiSnow and thank god they are finally in Manhattan! I no longer need to make the trek to their Queens locations :’)

I made sure to arrive early just to snag these viral tiramisu egg tarts… JUST LOOK AT THAT CROSS SECTION!! Most importantly, they’re very affordable (only $4.5 each) considering how many layers and fillings you’re getting.

＊Matcha Tiramisu Egg Tart 抹茶提拉米蘇蛋撻 $4.5
＊Coffee Tiramisu Egg Tart 咖啡提拉米蘇蛋撻 $4.5
The layers are decadent: the base is their original egg tart, topped with coffee/matcha flavored sponge cake and mascarpone cream, then finished with a dusting of matcha or cocoa powder. The cake is so moist it melts in your mouth.

Surprisingly, I preferred the coffee one over the matcha, though my mom liked the matcha one more. The matcha flavor could be richer imo.

＊Caramel Egg Tart 焦糖可頌蛋撻 $3.9
The egg tart lean more toward the Portuguese style, with a laminated crust and a rich, jiggly egg custard filling. The crust was incredibly buttery and flaky. Honestly such a steal for the quality!

＊Daily Green Bottle 小綠瓶 $6.9
Full of fiber and vitamin C, and naturally sweetened. I liked the green apple juice and kale flavor. A healthy alternative to boba!

＊Super Avocado 超能牛油果 $8.9
A filling option/meal replacement, and I loved the oat popping boba. It is not sweet at all and the yogurt is smooth and thick.

＊Velvet Matcha Layered Latte 超厚千層抹茶 $5.9
Rich, creamy and decadent with a thick layer of matcha cheese foam.

reviews.snippet: The egg custard tarts were flavorful and the crust was firm and flaky. The dining area is somewhat limited and there was no restroom. It might be a good idea to order take out.

Egg tarts are so good!!!!! As soon as I walked into the shop, the smell of those egg tarts totally got me! The filling is so creamy and the crust is so crunchy! The milk tea is also high quality and servers are all very nice and friendly. Definitely gonna come back again!
Amazing tea and bakery shop near Columbia. Best egg tarts I’ve ever had. Highly recommend!

reviews.snippet: The pastries here are so good! I tried a few tarts and they were beautifully made and delicious. Drinks were also great and the staff were very nice. Perfect for a quick treat.
Their egg tart is my current obsession! So good!! 😍 Soft and crusty and warm. Comforting feeling and happy tummy
Really nice place to visit. The drinks are really good and it is a good place to talk with friends.
very yummy egg tarts and drinks. egg tarts are flakey and not too sweet so perfect. currently buy one get one free on some drinks! must try

Best cafe near campus hands down. Very delicious cream-tops and beats popular spots downtown. A true hidden gem (plus points for nice
customer service)

The food was absolutely splendid the way the cocoa melted with the white tea. It was just a pleasant experience plus the atmosphere is so aesthetic great for studying and for all my Columbia university people they have a sign just for you.

So delicious and fresh! Got the white snow and wasn't expecting it to be so balanced and flavorful. Partner got the mango sago and while that flavor combo is really popular, this really was the best one I've had in NY
The food and drink here are awesome. Especially the matcha tea and tart!

Naisnow Tea & Bakery feels like one of those polished, modern tea shops that knows exactly what it’s doing. The egg tarts are the clear highlight, beautifully caramelized on top with that glossy, slightly blistered finish that promises a creamy custard center and a flaky, crisp crust. The savory bacon potato tart adds a comforting, cheesy option if you’re not in the mood for something sweet. The shop itself is clean, bright, and well-organized, with cohesive green-and-white packaging and charming rose displays that make everything feel giftable and Instagram-ready. It leans more toward a stylish, mall-bakery vibe than an artisan café, but if you’re looking for a reliable, photogenic treat that tastes as good as it looks, this spot delivers. Really love!!

So happy NaiSnow opened a location in the UWS!

The mango sago was refreshing and I enjoyed that they used fresh mangos. The matcha tiramisu was rich and flaky, but I personally prefer their regular egg tarts more. Great spot to grab some snacks or relax before class, as they have a few tables inside as well.

Stopped by NaiSnow near Columbia and really enjoyed it.

The strawberry pro bottle was refreshing and flavorful, not too sour, with great texture from the popping oats. The super avocado drink was filling and well balanced, with lots of real ingredients.

We also tried a couple of egg tarts — flaky even when chilled and not overly sweet. Great spot for a casual afternoon drink or dessert, but it does get busy on weekends.
The drinks were great but make sure to try the egg tarts too — they were fresh and delicious!!

reviews.snippet: Melba’s was recommended to us by someone at our hotel, and it was absolutely worth the 15-minute walk to get there. We ordered a nice variety of dishes for the table, and everything was fantastic across the board. If I had to pick a favorite, the catfish took the crown, it was cooked perfectly and full of flavor. Everything else we tried was just as impressive though. Great food, great portions, and clearly a spot the locals and hotel staff are proud to recommend. We’ll definitely be back next time we’re in town.

media.caption: Fried chicken with mac cheese and fries

reviews.snippet: I stopped to get some takeout after class. This was my first time trying the restaurant. The servers were more than kind and very patient with me when I was reading the menu. The chicken is very juicy and savory. The yams are cooked well and have the perfect amount of sweetness. I also had the carrot cake (great), the mac and cheese (good), and my favorite: the catfish bites. Would recommend!! (No pics for the yams or chicken, I finished them too quickly..)

We stopped at Melba’s for lunch and really enjoyed it. We got there early, so thankfully there was no wait. The fish and fried chicken were both really good and not greasy at all. The mac and cheese was tasty, and the greens had a nice spicy kick. My wife enjoyed the chicken and waffles.

The rice and beans were just okay and probably not something I’d order again. Other than that, the food and service were both good. Overall, a great lunch spot and I’d come back.

We had such a wonderful time at our retirement luncheons today! I was pleased with my choice of salmon with yams and collard greens, which was absolutely delightful. The service truly stood out—our young lady was incredibly patient and kind, making the experience even more enjoyable. The servings were generous and the food was simply amazing. I wholeheartedly recommend Melba's for wonderful, flavorful meals at reasonable prices. It's always a pleasure to indulge in good food and great company!

We chose Melba's last night. The place is really nice. I love the art decor and music. Our waitress Tati (Tatiana) was amazing. I tasted a small piece of my daughter's Egg Nog Waffle. Whew, that taste was out of this world. That Tres Mac n Cheese was definitely a crowd please. I would certainly come back. I love the neighborhood as well.

Soul food at its finest! Our family visited for the first time on Father’s Day, and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. The food was absolutely delicious, and the atmosphere was great. The vibe was positive and welcoming, and our server, Brian, was attentive and friendly.

I did have one minor complaint. For the price we paid, I felt that the restaurant could offer an introductory snack, such as bread with butter or cornbread, which is a staple in soul food restaurants. However, aside from this small issue, I had a wonderful time and highly recommend this place.

One of the best fried chicken I’ve ever had. Melba’s Restaurant really delivers amazing Southern comfort food. We had the fried catfish, French fries, yams, fried chicken, mac and cheese, and chocolate cake — everything was delicious and full of flavor. The fried chicken was especially outstanding: crispy, juicy, and perfectly seasoned. Great atmosphere, friendly service, and a place definitely worth visiting again. 🍗🍰✨

reviews.snippet:
I was very excited to visit and support this southern restaurant. I enjoyed the music and the staff was pleasant. Drinks: Strawberry henny was good. Appetizers: Cesar salad was good, the wings were delicious, the deviled eggs were different. The eggs tasted like a fried catfish with pickled egg filling like from the picked egg jar (I hope that makes sense). Mains: glaze salmon was over cooked and undercooked in the center. I was dry and lacked flavor. Fried chicken was also dry and lacked flavor. Mac and cheese was good, but it was all cheese it didn't have taste like it's not seasoned just cheesy. The Yams look fake because they are so orange but they aren't. Mine were actually under cooked and hard. The spinach was good and garlicky. Dessert: lemon blueberry cake and this was okay. It tasted like pudding mix and it was crumby not moist, but maybe it was because it was cold.
Melba came into the restaurant, but didn't greet anyone which was a bummer, but its okay.
All in all I would give it another try. This may have been an off day for them.

I had an amazing brunch with friends. The award winning chicken & egg now waffles did not disappoint!
My friends had the ox tail with greens and yams. The rum punch was so good, I thought I was in Jamaica.

If you're in Harlem, visit Melba's 😍😍

Delicious food and great vibes only! The place was packed so I was really glad we made a reservation. We ordered a bunch of stuff and split it with the table which I think worked out really well. The chicken and two sides was huge and lasted me two more meals after that!

Melba’s is a Harlem staple for a reason. The restaurant that neighborhood icon and restaurateur Sylvia’s daughter created is known for its hospitality, cozy, welcoming atmosphere and its delicious southern cuisine.

Don’t miss out on their perfectly done chicken and waffles. It’s a classic treat! I hear they have a show in the works with Oprah as well. May not be so much of a local secret for much longer…
