reviews.snippet: I was extremely angry about the stale food I received at Melba’s, so I spoke with Charisse, the manager, on my way there, and she said to come in. When I arrived, I was seated right away, but the food was terrible. The oxtail was old and stale, the collard greens were burnt and smelled bad, and the mac and cheese came out with so much cheese—just look at the pictures. When does southern mac and cheese look like this? Flat and melted. The fried chicken was black inside and red. My daughter said, “Mommy, this food is old.” I replied, “I know, baby, let’s go.” I was upset because I could have just gone to my Italian pizza shop in Brooklyn. I remember taking my father to eat at Sylvia’s, and they would never serve food like this. I only tried this restaurant because I saw the Knicks' Jalen Brunson with her in a picture, and I thought, “Oh,New York Knicksecially since my favorite basketball team, the New York Knicks won a championship. This is about supporting black businesses, like my daughter said; some people cook, but “Mommy, you are a chef; it’s a difference.” I don’t know if Melba is even aware of how things are being managed in her absence, but now I’m headed to South Carolina for some soul food. I already feel sick, and I’m even angrier because I brought my children with me. Charisse, go play with your mother and stop the nonsense; you know that food came out of the garbage or was extremely old. I strongly believe it came out of the GARBAGE. My kids was there and to do that to CHILDREN IS WRONG ‼️ MY DAUGHTER WAS VERY UPSET AND SAID MOMMY MY TUMMY HURT. She only bit that one price we gave everything back and only paid for the shrimp 🍤 Shout to the waiter Miller I gave him a nice TIP because he knew the food wasn’t right. ‼️

If you want some soul food that actually touches and feeds your soul, come here. The food is absolutely amazing. Literally some of the best soul food I've ever had in my life. The mac and cheese.............I'd do some dastardly things for that mac and cheese. The service is great, awesome customer service. Shoutout Tatiana! I love that this is a black owned establishment, you can just feel the culture when you walk in and sit down. Now I have to meet Melba and give her a bear hug because she changed my life.

The food was terrible. I ordered the so called Jamaican oxtail there was no Jamaica in it at all flavorless no scotch bonnnet no nothing. Food was so bad didn’t even want to take it home. No one leaves food behind. The catfish was good. The chicken was good. The collards weee corny. The white potatoe salad was awful. The Mac and cheese was gooey and cheesy. The way people like it. One and done for me. That’s not southern cuisine but a waste of time and money. Then one of the workers was sweeping the floor as we were eating. Who does that? One and done for me. The fried chicken was okay. Ordered drinks that came out thirty minutes later and they came out warm a hot sweet tea and a warm lemonade. The bill came I’m to 100.00 dollars. People will eat anything .. not me and say it taste good . I can’t and I will not lie. For reviews or ratings

reviews.snippet:
If you’re anywhere near Harlem and not stopping by Melba's Restaurant… you’re missing out—seriously.

From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm, welcoming, and full of life. But what really made the experience unforgettable was our server, Bryan. Top-tier service. Attentive without hovering, friendly without forcing it—he made us feel like honored guests, not just customers.

Now let’s talk about the food… because wow.

The waffles? Soft, perfectly cooked, and just the right balance of crisp and fluffy. The fried chicken? Hot, seasoned to perfection, and bursting with flavor in every bite. I’m not exaggerating when I say it was so good I had to slow myself down—I was about to hurt myself trying to enjoy every bite too fast.

My wife ordered the veggie pie, and she was absolutely ecstatic. Every bite had her smiling—fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care.

Everything we had was on point. No misses. Just straight excellence from start to finish.

Melba’s is not just a meal—it’s an experience. We’ll definitely be back… and next time, I’m coming hungry all over again.

Upon entering the restaurant, I noticed that the host was seated on a stool with his back to the entrance. In my opinion, this was unwelcoming, as hosts should be positioned to face the door and greet guests as they arrive.

The main dining room was fairly busy, so we were seated in a secondary dining area. Unfortunately, this room was nearly empty and noticeably drafty, which detracted from the overall dining experience.

Our server appeared to be new but was polite and attentive. However, there was an error with our order. My uncle specifically requested grilled catfish but was instead served fried catfish. I ordered fried chicken with mac and cheese and garlic mashed potatoes. The chicken was extremely dry, and the mashed potatoes lacked flavor. The mac and cheese, however, had a pleasant texture and was the highlight of my meal.

The bill was reasonable for an establishment that is often quite busy on weekends. That said, I would not consider this one of the best soul food restaurants available. It seems that, as with many restaurants that start strong and gain popularity, the quality of the food has declined. This is not a restaurant I would prioritize when recommending places to visitors, as there are better options in the area.

I had an amazing time at Melba's. It was my second time coming time coming to this restaurant, and I enjoyed myself with my friends. The food was delicious. The service was great. I loved the vibe and the soul/R&B music that was playing. I usually don't go to Harlem as much, but going to this place in Harlem is definitely worth it. I will indeed come again, and tell more people about it.
I usually don’t like catfish, but here ! It was good and yes the oxtail were good and gave a decent amount.

reviews.snippet:
I've seen Melbas featured on New Yorks daytime talk shows frequently Sherri and on Kelly & Mark. The host really raved about how good the food was, so I thought I would eat there while visiting from out of town. We were planning to eat at the restaurant in person, but could not make it due to time retraints, being our last day, so we decided to order delivery. My mom and I ordered the southern fried chicken Dark meat & wings as a meat choice. For the sides I ordered collards greens and garlic mashed potatoes. My mother ordered collard greens and the Mac & cheese. Unfortunately we only received 3 wings a piece, no drumstick, no thighs, just wings🤨😒. The wings were just blaw, not really well seasoned for my taste. Mashed potatoes were garlic less. My mom said her mac& cheese was ok and the greens tasted sweet, which was weird for us. I had the Red Velvet cake for dessert, it was ok. My mom had the yellow cake with chocolate frosting and she said it was dry.
Unfortunately this food did not live up to the hype.

I came here for the first time last night (Thursday, 7/23/2026) with my husband and a few friends . It is small and cramped. One of our party remembers was running late and the manager initially refused to allow us to sit until our fourth party member showed up, even though we had arrived under a pre made dinner reservation. We had to stand outside , waiting, for about 30 minutes. One of my friends expressed her displeasure with the manager about our being asked to stand and wait outside. They finally agreed to let us down.

The restaurant was moderately filled and they clearly had multiple empty tables . And so why we had to wait , when we had a reservation, and while there were at least 4 or 5 empty four-seater tables, makes no sense.

Ambiance was okay . There were several children playing around in the middle of tables, which was not acceptable or safe.

Our waiter was okay . But we spent more time looking for him than being served by him.

And finally the food…I had the fried chicken (white meat), peas and rice, and potato salad . The fried chicken was very dry. I didn’t finish it. The rice was solidly very good . The potato salad was mediocre and didn’t taste much different than one from a grocery store deli. My husband has the fried chicken (dark meat), yams, and Mac and cheese. His sides were pretty tasty .

I was quite underwhelmed with the food and the entire experience . I won’t be coming back.

reviews.snippet: Came here for a friend date. Safe to say, we've found a new happy hour spot. Great prices, tacos were great, drinks were hitting. Our host was very attentive, despite the large crowd. 10/10 will be back!

The food here has no flavor. They have no idea what birria or black beans or rice are; they clearly know nothing about Mexican cuisine. It’s Mexican in name only. On top of that, the waiter was inattentive, didn’t know the menu, and ignored our table. Terrible service—maybe was still in training? I don’t know. I am never coming back to this place, and I’m leaving this review so people know about the terrible quality of both the food and the service here. To make matters worse, they include the tip automatically, as if they know they’re doing everything wrong and need to guarantee their money somehow.

I have been a patron of this establishment for approximately eight years, since its inception at this particular location. I consistently recommend this specific branch to my acquaintances and family members. The exemplary customer service provided is precisely what I seek in such an establishment. Julie, whose given name is Julia but whom I affectionately refer to as Julie, is truly exceptional. She demonstrates remarkable dedication, patience, and a pleasant demeanor, despite being relatively new to the team. Her proficiency in this line of work significantly enhances my desire to return at every opportunity. The atmosphere is akin to a second home, and the manager, Shah, is equally impressive; he is a man of integrity who manages his establishment with utmost care. This location and its staff are, without a doubt, outstanding. I rate it a perfect 10 out of 10.

Ela gave us great service from start to finish. She was friendly, attentive, and took the time to help me choose something from the menu. Her recommendation was excellent, and I’m really glad I went with it. I also just moved to the area, and after this experience, I can already tell this place is going to become one of my regular spots. Thank you Ela for making such a great first impression—I’m looking forward to coming back!

Last week i went for a friend’s reunion party,,First of all i will mention about their weekdays deal,,they got plenty of it including happy hour. If we talk about food then honestly they got authentic mexican taco’s , Bowl’s and more,,their happy hour drinks are really good as well. Besides they got good music with live DJ. I will highly recommend this place for any kinda dinner party ,,
Good music,,good food ,,goood vibes😊
I will definitely go again😊

I have been coming to this place for over five years. It has always been one of my favorite neighborhood hangout spots and a place where friends and family would gather. One of my friends even moved to Florida, and when she came back to visit, the first thing she said was, “Let’s go to Cantina.”

Unfortunately, since the change in management, this place has gone downhill. The menu now feels like a typical, run-of-the-mill Mexican restaurant and has lost much of what made it special. There is also a new waiter, and every time I come in, there seems to be an 18% service fee added to the bill—whether you’re dining in or ordering takeout. It feels like it’s being slipped onto the check without much transparency.

What is most disappointing is that management seems more focused on attracting a different crowd than taking care of the neighborhood customers who have supported this business for years. Loyal customers are the reason places like this succeed, and it no longer feels like that loyalty is valued.

After five years of coming here regularly, today will be my last visit. It’s sad to watch a neighborhood favorite lose the qualities that made people love it in the first place.

Cantina Taqueria & Tequila Bar in Harlem did not come to play with the portions these appetizers could feed a small army! The seafood paella was the star of the night: flavorful, packed with shrimp, mussels, and calamari, and served piping hot in a generous skillet. The atmosphere was lively without being too loud, and the staff were super attentive and friendly. Definitely a great spot for a group dinner or a casual night out with friends. Come hungry you won’t leave disappointed!

My Girl Julieeeeee gave wonderful service. we Had outside tables with a booth. Energy was amazing!!! Music was a mix of Reggae, Spanish, R&B very culturally Throwbacks and all. drinks was amazing ordered two and was lit before I finished and still leaving with my third

9/10 … The food and drinks were great. My only complaint is I’d probably have two bartenders back there. And I saw the Spanish guy behind the bar who was making drinks for the tables grabbing cherries & limes barehanded . Like more than once. But other than those two things. It was great times on a taco Tuesday

Incredibly unaccommodating. I had already stacked up a significant bill at the bar and was actively ordering more when my friend arrived. Since there were no seats left, I saved one, but the host took it away, saying, "Someone put this chair here by mistake, I’ll bring it back when your friend comes." He never did, and then acted completely confused when I asked about it. On top of that, they refused to give us a table unless I bought even more food.
This place gets a lot of business, and because of that, they treat you like you're worthless. It was Juneteenth, so local Black-owned restaurants were packed, but even on a holiday, this establishment couldn't bother to be accommodating. They left us with no choice but to close our bill and leave. I will never spend my money at a "Cantina" ever again. Lesson learned.

Came here for a birthday celebration and this place was amazing. When I tell you that the staff was short but they did the damn thing, they did the damn thing. One person on drinks, one person on serving, one person in kitchen. Thats 3 people to a full restaurant and they all did good. I had drinks and some wings and it was great. The wings was tasty and fresh and the drinks hit (if you know what i mean)I had the Henny something with some fruity flavoring and it was sooo good followed with a few Sangrias that was tasty as well. If I head back to that side again I would always stop there. They were all great!!! Music was fire as well. Great DJ!!!

This was one of the worst restaurant experiences I have ever had. The music was earsplitting and so everyone was screaming to talk to each other, making the entire space unbearably loud. Because of this we ordered our food to go. My server Ricardo said he would let me know an ETA and then never returned to the table. When I found him to ask about the food, he brought it out from the kitchen immediately. The tacos were so pathetically small that I actually thought they got the order wrong- the chicken taco pictured below cost over $5. We were then charged an 18% auto gratuity fee despite not having received any table service. When we tried the food after leaving, we were horribly disappointed. The tacos were not only tiny, but also cold and did not taste good. Overall, everything about this experience was abysmal- the atmosphere, service, and food.

Again- this taco cost FIVE dollars + a 18% auto gratuity fee with no table service.

FIRST OFF MUSIC always good at both locations. This one is on 8th avenue . Came here after work this is my second time coming to this location . FROZEN rum punch 10/10 always . I had a meal off their special menu and it was BOMB portion size very well. Overall 10/10 . Bathroom huge . I didn’t take pics of the place some people don’t want to be in photos lol.
This Sunday we went to seafood Sunday and the food was delicious, I loved the place , 10 out of 10 to this restaurant in New York, the best ❤️❤️💪💪
We came for the seafood sunday and were not disappointed. The food is delicious and the service was amazing. Our waitress ela was cheerful and attentive and made us want to come back
I came in on a Wednesday and had Christian as my server and he was amazing and so knowledgeable I’ll definitely recommend coming here for a good vibe they also have 1/2 wings on Wednesday!
Ela is the greatest server I have ever encountered. She gave me great recommendations and checking in with enthusiasm for hospitality. I will be coming back.

Cool Mexican restaurant located on Harlem's restaurant row. They were formerly housed on a location on 7th Avenue and glad they moved in our street level because those stairs walking down to the prior establishment for deadly....lol

A we popped in for happy hour and were pleasantly surprised with great drinks and an array of happy hour food options.

We had a couple of tacos some beers a margarita and some shots. Definitely try the fish , shrimp, and jerked tacos.
This place is a joke. Tiny cold dry tacos + 18% gratuity for bad service and tasteless food!!!!! The only thing that was decent was the street corn 🌽. And TURN THE MUSIC DOWN!!!!!!

media.caption: Cold and flavorless. I was still hungry after this. Very disappointing

reviews.snippet:
I had a horrible experience at Cantina. The manager was unhelpful, and the bartender accused me of stealing during a very busy time instead of properly paying attention to what was going on. On top of that, I was charged incorrectly the bartender added a tip twice and then tried to explain it away by saying it was due to taxes, which didn’t make sense.

Overall, the service was unprofessional and uncomfortable. I would not return to this location, and I expected much better.

reviews.snippet: Cute restaurant and really slow service. We got the beet salad, proscuitto pizza, burrata pizza, and the tiramisu. Skip the beet salad, the leaves were so bitter and the beets you get aren’t very much. The pizzas were good and the tiramisu wasn’t that great

response.snippet:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We're glad you enjoyed the pizzas.

Regarding the beet salad, one of its key ingredients is radicchio, which naturally has a pleasantly bitter flavor that is characteristic of many traditional Italian salads. We understand that this flavor profile may not appeal to everyone.

We're also sorry to hear that the service felt slow. Looking back at your visit, our team was able to promptly take your order and bring out your drinks and salad. There was a longer wait for the pizzas, as our pizza station was experiencing a particularly busy period at that time. We appreciate your patience and understanding, as each pizza is prepared fresh to order.

Thank you again for your visit and your comments. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide an even better experience next time.

reviews.snippet:
I loved this place and I’m sad I didn't get photos of the food. A very fun place owned by a delightful guy who employs his friends. They WANT you to have a good meal. They WANT you to have a good time. They WANT to cater to what you are expecting.

So refreshing!

Three of us came here before heading to a concert at St. John the Divine. That's an easy 10 minute walk from this place. I wasn't sure what to expect. but the reviews were good so we tried it. The three of us split two appetizers, one pizza and one pasta. It was just the right amount of our light appetites that night.

I wish I remembered our delightful server's name. He was so proud of the place and what his friend had done with it. Well deserved praise all around. I made a reservation since we were there close to Valentine's Day. I'm glad I did. It filled up completely over the course of our meal. Enjoy!

response.snippet: Thank you Laura for dining with us! We cant wait to have you back!

reviews.snippet: Absolutely DELICIOUS pizza! The pizza was flavorful and the crust was bouncy yet crunchy. We also got some broccolini, which was delicious, and finished dinner with homemade cannolis. We’ll definitely be back.

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for the wonderful review!

We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the pizza and appreciated the balance of flavor and texture in the crust. It's also great to know that the broccolini and our homemade cannolis were highlights of your meal.

We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back to Verdello again soon for more pizza and Italian favorites!

Grazie,
The Verdello NYC Team

reviews.snippet: Nice neighborhood spot! Very cozy atmosphere and decor. The pasta’s made in house and you can tell from the quality of the food. They also have a good happy hour from 4-6:30. Service was great too!

response.snippet: Thank you Ariana! We look forward to Welcoming you back

reviews.snippet: Tried the place for lunch today. We had the rigatoni in tomato sauce and the potato pie. Both were super delicious! Our 5 year old loved the pasta and we loved the pizza , fresh and crisp. The folks that took care of us were warm. Loved the ambiance , very airy and breezy and in a quite part of the neighborhood, great for kids. 10/10 recommended!

response.snippet: Thank you Sudar! We are looking forward to welcoming you again

reviews.snippet: The staff was so sweet and warm and the food was delicious. As a large group we got to try a lot - meat plate, cheese plate, calamari, tomato/burrata salad, endive salad, the burrata pizza, margarita pizza, ribeye, branzino, and all 4 pastas on the menu. I loved it all.. my faves of all was the 2 pizzas and the ribeye. Will def come back.

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear that you and your group had such a great experience with us.

It sounds like you truly explored the menu, and we're so happy you enjoyed everything from the antipasti to the pastas. We're especially glad to hear that the pizzas and the ribeye were your favorites! Our team will also be delighted to know that their warmth and hospitality made your visit even more special.

Thank you again for spending your evening with us. We look forward to welcoming you back to Verdello soon for more delicious food and good times!

reviews.snippet: We loved this place. Excellent pizza. Excellent wine. Very quick service. Nice and open windows to the lovely night. Nice atmosphere. All around five stars. My only criticism - the only fly in the ointment, if you will, is that I wish they had some salads with green leaves (like a nice arugula salad).

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the pizza, wine, service, and atmosphere. It's especially nice to know that the open windows and beautiful evening added to your experience.

We also appreciate your suggestion regarding green salads. While our menu currently features a few salad options, including our Gem Salad, we're always listening to guest feedback and will certainly keep your recommendation for an arugula salad in mind as we continue to develop our menu.

We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another five-star experience!

reviews.snippet:
Ordered delivery
Pizza came cold and they are 3 blocks away also.....Thought I was getting a Cesar salad with actually anchovies (which I love) for $16 OH SORRY SALAD WAS $19. This is what I got. Salad and dressing with slices of parm. When I called he said the anchovies in the dressing. No kidding and could have brought Cesar salad dressing from supermarket that had more anchovies OR anchovies flavor. A real Italian restaurant would have put some actual amchoviss since it was advertised "with anchovies" not ceaear salad DRESSING containing anchovies flavor which i couldn't taste. Dont get the Cesar salad not worth $19 dollars

response.snippet:
Thank you for your feedback,

Our Baby Gem Caeser salad is prepared in the traditional way, with anchovies blended into the dressing, not served as whole fillets on top. We make our dressing in house using premium ingredients, and its not comparable to mass produced supermarket versions. The anchovy flavor is intentionally balanced and refined, rather than overpowering. Whole anchovies are not part of this dish.

As for the pizza, it was made on time and ready promptly. The order then remained to be picked up from the delivery service for 35 minutes before leaving. Once an order is waiting on or picked up by a third party courier, we no longer have control of over delivery time or temperature.
We stand by the quality of our food and how it is prepared

Best,
Verdello NYC

reviews.snippet:
We had the pleasure of celebrating my husband’s birthday at Verdello recently, and it was an absolutely wonderful evening from start to finish. The restaurant struck the perfect balance — delicious food, warm and attentive service, and a beautiful ambiance that made it ideal for a special occasion.
We started with the Prosciutto Crudo pizza, which was fantastic — thin, crispy crust with high-quality ingredients. We followed that with the lamb ragù pasta, which was rich, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. To finish, we shared the cannolis, and my husband declared them the best he’s ever had (and he’s had many!). Every dish was fresh, delicious, and full of flavor.
Our waiter, Leo, was outstanding. He was friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome without being intrusive. The service enhanced the whole experience.
The ambiance is one of Verdello’s biggest strengths — elegant and inviting with just the right level of energy. We could easily talk and hear each other throughout dinner, which is rare and so appreciated on a celebratory night out.
We left completely satisfied and already planning our next visit. Verdello is a true gem — highly recommended for date nights, birthdays, or any special occasion. We can’t wait to go back soon!

response.snippet: Thank you Jaye for the wonderful review! We are thrilled to hear you loved the Prosciutto Crudo Pizza, the Pappardelle with lamb Ragu, and the cannoli. We are so happy to hear that Leo made your experience special. We hope to see you again soon

reviews.snippet: A wonderful Italian restaurant with an attention to detail. Flavor and plating were superb. The pasta is house made. We also enjoyed an excellent barata pizza and happy hour from 4-6:30 pm on house wine, pizza, most pasta dishes and select cocktails. For dessert we had amazing cannolis with orange zest and pistachios. An intimate, modern setting with excellent service.

response.snippet: Thank you So much Lauren!

reviews.snippet: Verdello is amazing! The pasta tastes so fresh, the brick oven pizza is delicious, and the wine selection is perfect. Cozy vibe, friendly staff, and great food all around — definitely my new go-to spot on the UWS!

response.snippet: Thanks for your Review! Please keep us in mind for your next meal out!

reviews.snippet:
This place was positively wonderful. And the staff - so friendly, and so kind!! My wife and I came here from out of town, celebrating our anniversary. We wanted carbonara, and this restaurant made it for us, even tho it was off the menu, just so we could check an experience off our NYC trip wish list.

And the food was great too. We’re really happy we went here. Check it out if you’re in the area!
Called to watch game 5 of the Knicks game and was pleasantly surprised to find seats! The Cesar salad and zucchini and sausage pizza were fantastic!

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for the wonderful review! We're delighted you were able to grab a seat for Game 5 and enjoy the excitement of the game with us.

We're especially happy to hear that you enjoyed the Caesar salad and the zucchini and sausage pizza—those are two of our favorites as well!

We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience and look forward to welcoming you back soon for another game, meal, or both.

Thank you again for your support!

— The Verdello Team

reviews.snippet: The food was really good. The coal fired pizza had a crispy crust and great flavor. The pasta was fresh and cooked perfectly, and the calamari was crispy and tasty. Nice atmosphere and friendly service. I’d definitely come back.

response.snippet:
hank you so much for the wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the coal-fired pizza, fresh pasta, and crispy calamari. Our kitchen team works hard to focus on quality and flavor, so your feedback truly means a lot to us.

We’re also very happy that you enjoyed the atmosphere and friendly service. Creating a warm and welcoming experience is something we care deeply about at Verdello NYC.

We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back again soon!

reviews.snippet:
The linguine seafood was the star of the show – a generous portion of perfectly cooked pasta, tossed in a flavorful sauce with fresh shrimp, clams, and mussels. Every bite was rich, aromatic, and incredibly satisfying.

The grilled fish dish was equally impressive – tender and juicy, with a crisp, well-seasoned skin, accompanied by delicious grilled vegetables and a bright red pepper sauce.

The heirloom tomato and burrata salad was fresh, vibrant, and beautifully balanced with pesto and basil.

And for dessert, the cannoli was absolute perfection – a crispy shell filled with silky ricotta and a subtle sweetness that ended the meal on a high note.

Everything was presented with care and tasted even better than it looked. Highly recommended – can’t wait to come back!

response.snippet: Thank you for the Review! We love hearing about our customer's positive experiences and we cant wait to have you back!

reviews.snippet: Still my favorite family owned Italian restaurant. Good is excellent here. Wood fire pizza and delicious classic Italian dishes. Meatballs are just like nonna makes. Great attentive service. Gets crowded so make sure you have a reservation. It’s worth the trip uptown for some great food.

media.caption: Meatballs- appetizer comes 4 to a serving

reviews.snippet:
Food was great. Got the tortelloni, rigatoni, and the baked eggplant. Delicious.
The vibe was romantic, dim, and action packed if you sit next to the pizza maker.
The service was lackluster. The server seemed like he didn’t want to seat us because we were dressed too casual. We waited 20 minutes for menus and then just pulled it up from Google photos. Once he noticed we were looking at the menu online, he rushed over with paper menus and rushed us to order. The server had also just smoked a terrible cigarette so you imagine the smell.

Food is fine yet terrible service. A/C isn’t working, the windows aren’t opening. The place feels like an aquarium. We couldn’t finish the dinner due to the temperature inside the place. The place is a literal oven. Poor choice. Coward staff. Odd atmosphere. UNPROFESSIONAL!!! One star overall.

response.snippet:
Thank you for your feedback. We understand that the temperature in the restaurant did not meet your expectations during your visit. However, our air conditioning system was operational, and our staff did their best to accommodate guests throughout the evening. At Verdello, we strive to provide a welcoming atmosphere and attentive service to all of our guests, and we take comments like yours seriously as we continue to improve.

We appreciate your visit and your feedback.

reviews.snippet: Our first time at the restaurant and it was really great. Ari was absolutely wonderful, and the food was irresistibly delicious and fresh. We loved every moment and can't wait to return!

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review!

We're delighted to hear that your first visit was such a great experience. It means a lot to know that Ari helped make your evening special, and we're thrilled you enjoyed the fresh, delicious food. We truly appreciate your kind words and can't wait to welcome you back for another memorable meal at Verdello. See you again soon!

reviews.snippet: We had a delightful family dinner at Ortomare. The service was exceptional, welcoming, and attentive, which was a big plus for us with kids. The food was top-notch - the Margherita pizza, made in the visible fire oven, was a hit. The spinach salad with olive oil, balsamic dressing, and goat cheese was a flavor explosion. The sage ravioli was a standout, with a noticeable taste of sage that was a real treat. We capped off the evening with the amazing chocolate lava cake and vanilla gelato. And we can't forget to mention their excellent selection of Italian wines. Definitely worth a try.

raw_place.title: Verdello NYC
raw_place.description: Casual, earthy Italian restaurant offering wood-fired pizza, wine & spirits & outdoor seating.

name: Via Piante
address: 110th St &, Manhattan Ave, New York, NY 10025

reviews.snippet: Look forward every Saturday to getting my gluten free baked goods from Via Piante at the Down to Earth Farmer's Market right by Morningside Park. It's the best gluten free bread I've ever had and has the most delicious sweet treats. You can tell, and most importantly, taste that Tanya puts a lot of care into everything she bakes.

I get my Via Piante gluten free ciabatta bread in morningside park at the farmer’s market on Saturdays. It’s an unbelievable product— and currently my favorite sandwich bread. The Pullman loaf pictured — is my second favorite of Tanya’s breads. It’s sturdy yet not dense, for the quick peanubutter sandwiches on the run. It never crumbles which is a gluten free miracle. The pugliese is 👌🏻

Via Piante makes the best gluten-free baked goods! Their ingredients are clean, and I really appreciate the complex, nuanced flavors in many of their breads. Wishing them all the best and continued success—I hope they expand soon!

This bread really deserves an enthusiastic shout out! I’m typically not a fan of gluten free bread as it usually has a gummy texture and lacks the body and crunch of really good bread. I recently tried Via Piante gluten free bread and was truly AMAZED!
Toasting gluten free bread sometimes mitigates its many flaws, but this bread is delicious untoasted with a crunchy crust, and excellent texture and body. When toasted, it’s sublime!
The owner and baker, Tanya Ponder, is a master and has really hit the jackpot!
If you love bread, and I do, give yourself a real treat and try Via Piante gluten free bread!

Lately I’ve been trying gluten free food and it’s hard to find something that tastes good. Love the taste and the texture of the bread and the cookies have become my daily ritual. Love their little healthy indulgences ❤️🙏

I typically can't eat anything gluten free, but these are so delicious! It's the first time I couldn't tell the difference and really enjoyed a gluten free bread. I'm recommending to my friend who only eats gluten free food. Can't say enough great things-love it!

I recently tried the multigrain pugliese, and wow, what a delight! The crust had a satisfying crispness that is rare to find gluten-free bread. I also really enjoyed the flavor from their combination of grains.

This bakery has definitely set the bar high for gluten-free bread, and I can't wait to see what else they have in store. If you’ve been missing the taste and texture of real bread, you need to try this place!

Just had this bakery cater a baby shower, and I have to say, their cookies were a hit! They were not only delicious but also exactly what we asked for. Can’t wait to dig into their breads next time. Highly recommend for any event where you want tasty gluten-free treats that everyone will love!

It always amazes me when people who are selling food designed for people with allergies, are rude and annoyed when immunocompromised people ask them detailed questions to make sure that their food is safe to eat.

Really crusty chewy delicious bread that happens to be gluten free. You can tell great love and care is put in to each item. I have not tried the pastries yet...looking forward to heading back to the park on a Saturday.
excited to have discovered such fantastic, gluten free baked goods. I'm always finding ways to replace gluten in my kitchen and the selection and quality is amongst the finest i have had.

I'm a huge fan! I discovered Tanya's stand at the Morningside farmer's market on Saturdays—I eat gluten but her baked goods are so good (and I love that they're so much better for you) that I've been preferring them over regular ones. Try everything.
Sometimes it's raining out in Morningside Park, but the food and service are always excellent. Delightful, gluten-free pastry selections.
The pies... oh, the pies! So grateful to have run into these baked pieces of heaven at a mutual friend's party last fall. Everything I have tasted has been perfection.
The bread is delicious, the texture is just perfect. Addicted!
New favorite local gluten free bakery!

Ingredienti semplici, vegani e gluten free.
Una persona appassionata e talentuosa.
Mix di sapori e consistenze incredibili.
Packaging adorabile.
L'unico difetto? Che è aperto solo un giorno a settimana!
Sabato dalle 9 alle 14 al mercato presso Morningside Park.
E ha anche molte varianti di panificati salati deliziosi, andateci!!

Simple ingredients, vegan and gluten-free.
A passionate and talented person.
Incredible mix of flavors and textures.
Adorable packaging.
The only downside? It's only open one day a week!
Saturday from 9 am to 2 pm at the market in Morningside Park.

reviews.snippet: Amazing food! One of the best Mexicans I've been to. Reasonable price too. My steak taco was great

Diana is always soo sweet and makes sure my orders come out correct and if not shes quick to fix the problem. I love coming here and eating here. Its a regular staple in my weekly orders . Muchos buenos

response.snippet: Thanks for the love, we’re happy to hear Diana takes such great care of your orders and that we’re part of your weekly routine, we truly appreciate you and look forward to your next visit.

reviews.snippet: The tacos are good and the steak nachos. Also purchased a side of rice and beans and they were SO SALTY, the birria as well. I just don't understand why they ask what sauce you want for a taco and then not send it. I've ordered multiple times and they are so cheap with the sauces. Each order is supposed to come with it's own tiny sauce and they ALWAYS send one four pack of sauces for the entire order. (sour cream, green, red and guacamole) Had to eat my taco extremely dry as my sister used the only guacamole sauce sent for her nachos. Get it together and start adding the sauces included with the order. Place is always busy so I'm sure things are good but this is of course my experience.
Great food and portion sizes. Great drinks that are fresh. Service is fast and friendly, a fun spot
If you in Harlem don’t forget to check out Home Made TAQUERIA, tocos to die for!!! Spicy level to reach and a lot of Latin energy (💃🏼🕺🏻) 10/10 employees very respectful!

response.snippet:
Hi there,
thanks for the amazing shoutout. We love that the tacos, spice level, and lively Latin vibe hit the spot, and it is great to hear our team felt so respectful. We appreciate the 10/10 love.

reviews.snippet:
This spot is truly a wonderful place to grab a bite. The service is great, the food is even better, and the atmosphere ties it all together. Their giant tacos are my absolute favorite — packed with meat, loaded with cheese and peppers, and bursting with flavor.

They offer a wide variety of meals, desserts, beverages, and cocktails, so there’s something for everyone. Their tequila options are especially fun — full of flavor and guaranteed to leave you with a nice little buzz. Everything was delicious, though a bit on the pricey side.

Overall, this place is definitely worth a visit. You have to try their food. I promise you won’t regret it.

response.snippet: Thanks for the amazing review, we’re glad you loved the giant tacos, variety of drinks and the overall vibe, even if it felt a bit pricey. We’d be happy to cook for you again anytime.

reviews.snippet: Very good place, my favorite was the nachos i got half chicken half steak and it was delicious. The steak is very flavorful and so is the chicken. I live in Brooklyn but it's worth the travel to come here!!

response.snippet:
Hi Tania,
Thanks for sharing this, we’re glad you loved the half chicken half steak nachos and flavorful meats, it means a lot that you travel from Brooklyn to visit.

reviews.snippet: My second time ordering take out here and even though the food is pretty good the portions are still really small. Asked for pico, they charged a dollar extra. Fine. But I get home and it's smallest amount of dry pico I've ever seen. It was so small I can't believe they have the nerve to charge for that. Ordered a Steak burrito with guac. It ran me 20 bucks. A little pricey tbh but, fine again. Get home and the size of the burrito is super skimp. If I spend 20 bucks on a burrito I expect it to be stuffed. Wont come here again, not willingly at least.

response.snippet: We’re very sorry to hear about your recent experience and appreciate you sharing your feedback. We understand your frustration with the portion sizes and the extra charge for pico — that’s certainly not the experience we want for our guests. Your comments will be shared with our team as we work to ensure better value and consistency. We hope you might give us another chance in the future to provide a more satisfying experience.

reviews.snippet: place was beautiful to eat in prices were amazing but the quality of food is a little lower than expected. however flavor profile of the steak reminded me of the flavor my mom would make my food so it was comforting. i genuinely enjoyed it but just needed a slight better quality. i did not like the beef empanada tho, something tasted off

Dude! The food is good! I was expecting taco bell but no way. The birria is not great but it is not bad either. Needs a stronger flavor. The fish tacos are grilled fish! They need a proper tartar sauce though. The empanadas were chock full of meat but tiny. The restaurant is beyond adorable! I love the colors and declrations.

These dishes are really tasty.
The restaurant is clean.
The only downside is they don't have enough staff, especially on Fridays.
The staff they do have are super helpful, but they're swamped.
The atmosphere is okay, more family-oriented. No loud music.

response.snippet: Hola Jhon, muchas gracias por tu reseña y recomendación. Nos alegra saber que disfrutaste nuestros chilaquiles y que tu familia también pasó un buen momento. ¡Esperamos verte pronto nuevamente en Homemade Taqueria Jackson Heights!

reviews.snippet: The food was very good and within a decent and affordable price range especially for new york. The service was quick and the menu options were very expansive and there was something for everybody- suitable for vegetarians and children. The atmosphere was also quite pleasant and overall the place is a good quick stop if you're in the mood for some good authentic mexican.

response.snippet: Thank you for taking the time to share your experience at Homemade Taqueria - Columbus, Matilda! We're glad to hear that you enjoyed the food, service, and atmosphere during your visit. We strive to provide a wide variety of menu options that cater to all preferences, so it's great to know that there was something for everyone. We hope to see you again soon for more authentic Mexican cuisine!

reviews.snippet: We came for the taco Tuesday deal and it was beyond amazing! The tacos came out hot and fast, the tacos itself came with a double tortilla (iykyk) and with a good amount of meat. The service was very friendly and attentive and good ambiance. Would come again.

I used to love going to this place; I used to recommend it until a month ago, when I took two friends of mine, both elderly adults. The music was so loud that I kindly asked to lower the volume because my friends started to get uncomfortable with the noise. Instead of hearing my ask, they kept the high volume and ignored it with a very disrespectful gesture.

That was the last time I went, and of course, every time someone asks me about this place (even though I used to love it), I say don't go; they are not kind people, and the place is too noisy.

What ashamed.
The food is excellent. Ate in and delivery! Staff is lovely. Not crowded when I ate there. It’s bright and I would prefer a bit less light , but all else is what makes it worth it!
Very good simple Mexican food. They have Tacos, Quesadillas, and Tortas (sandwiches). Horchata is really good and they have a great variety of Jarritos. Their Birria is a favorite.

This place is great, the only downside is the portions are big that I couldn't finish it! Ordered the horchata, one of the best I've had, creamy not too sweet and full of cinnamon flavour but no sight of the cheap powder. The sweetcorn with mayo and cheese was so fresh and sweet. By the time the main came I was already full, taco, quesadilla and tostada. I chose beef and after a while they all tasted the same. Next time I'll order a burrito instead. It came to $32 ~£25.
Typing one handed. Currently eating the best tacos I’ve had in my life. Just go. Al pastor….

response.snippet: Thanks for sharing! We're thrilled to hear you're enjoying the al pastor tacos. Enjoy your meal!

reviews.snippet: The food was delicious and prices were reasonable with good portions. We had combo #2 with chicken which includes a quesadilla, a tostada and a taco. The chicken was well seasoned and it was my favorite. We ordered a streak burrito and a tres leche cake. The steak was good and the tres delicious was delicious. We look forward to going back there soon. I want to try the churros next. Great little Mexican place in the upper west side in Manhattan. The decor and little touches were great as well.

response.snippet:
Hi Jasmin,

Thank you for the fantastic review! We’re thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the food, especially the chicken and steak, and that the portions and prices met your expectations. The Tres Leches cake is always a favorite, and we’re excited for you to try the churros on your next visit! We appreciate your kind words about our décor, and we can’t wait to welcome you back to our little spot in the Upper West Side.

Best regards,

reviews.snippet: With out a doubt the best Mexican food we have had. Extremely clean and the staff or super friendly. We will be back at every chance we get.

thanks for the amazing feedback, we’re glad you enjoyed the food and noticed how clean the place is and how friendly the team was, we look forward to welcoming you back whenever you can come in

reviews.snippet: Good normal slice. Crackery crust and lots of toppings. My chicken and peppers satisfied a craving, albeit for $6.50. Prices are what they are today.

Was in the area on a time crunch and craving pizza on a Friday during lunchtime. Not gonna lie, used Chat G for advice on a good slice nearby walking and this spot showed up #1. Margarita and veggie slices were absolute fire and I can’t wait to go back next time I’m there. Old school pizza joint feeling inside with friendly workers. 10/10

I have been searching for a good pizza place near where I live. Tried so many. Finally I L’Ora!!! It’s easy for a pizza place to get the best ingredients for toppings. But what really makes the pizza stand out is the dough and the sauce! And L’Ora has met my standards of a great NY pizza!!! So happy I found this place!

Basic set up but WOW what delicious pizza and arancini. Owner very kindly spoke to us in perfect English and made us feel very welcome. We were tired and hungry and this was the perfect place to stop.

Honestly, we are always willing to give a new place a try…but we were quite disappointed.

This isn’t pizza. It’s soggy flatbread.

Our ~$35 pizza was extremely wet, not crispy anywhere, and did not have much flavor. We’ve ordered delivery from so many other pizza places in the area and everything is so solid. L’Ora has a long way to go. Avoid!
I was disappointed with their grandma pie. The crust was burned, the sauce tasted like Rao sauce, and the cheese is not good quality cheese.
Fresh, tasty and reliable. My go to pizza spot in Harlem, can never go wrong.🙏🏿

The food is actually really good here. I was just cringed when a worker was preparing pizza behind the counter and used his bare hands to grab the bag of pepperoni and continue to use his bare hands to place the pepperoni pieces on the pizza dough. Im sure that is not sanitary. Things like this can cause food contamination. I'm sure they know this, but choose to do otherwise. Please be mindful where you eat.

response.snippet:
Thank you for your feedback and for mentioning that you enjoyed the food — we truly appreciate it.
We always take food safety very seriously, and I wanted to clarify an important detail about NYC food handling rules for anyone reading:

Under the NYC Health Code, bare-hand contact is permitted when handling food that will be fully cooked to the minimum required temperature. Pizza is baked at extremely high temperatures (typically over 500°F), which destroys any potential pathogen's before it is served.
(24 RCNY Health Code § 81.09)

Our pizza maker only handles the pizzas during preparation — he doesn’t touch anything else in between — and always washes his hands any time he steps away or comes in contact with anything outside the pizza station.

For items served ready-to-eat without additional cooking (like salads or toppings added after baking), gloves or utensils are always required — and we strictly follow that rule.

We appreciate your concern and the opportunity to clarify this for guests. Thank you again for visiting and sharing your thoughts — we hope to serve you again soon.

reviews.snippet: Food has changed since the spot got acquired. The quality of the sauce has really gone down a lot, theres way less zing in it. Can't find the lasagna slice on the menu either. Not bad and good crust but a real dissappointment. Hoping they find their legs soon. I may return to try the italian classics

response.snippet:
Thank you for taking the time to leave your feedback — we really do appreciate it. We’re still fine-tuning a few recipes as we settle in, and hearing what guests miss or prefer is very helpful to us.

Our lasagna slice will be returning, and we’d love for you to come back and try some of our Italian classics — we’re confident you’ll enjoy them. We hope to have the chance to serve you again soon and earn that “zing” back for you.

Thanks again for stopping by and for giving us the opportunity to improve.

The sauce the snap on the bite and taste are all amazing! Work up an appetite at morningside park then come have yourself an amazing slice of pizza ❤️

reviews.snippet:
Stopped by Bixi Harlem for dinner and filmed the experience for Jaguar’s Guide TV. This was a really good Harlem dinner spot where the food, vibe, and atmosphere all worked together.
The space has a cool, stylish energy that makes the night feel like more than just a meal. Service was smooth and pleasant overall, nothing over the top, but definitely solid.
Food was the strongest part of the experience. The pork dumplings were a strong starter, the Japanese yam tempurawas fire, and the vegetable fried rice with fried chicken katsu was the standout for me. That dish was a 10/10.
It’s not a cheap dinner, but for a full night out in Harlem with strong food, good service, and a dope atmosphere, the experience delivered.
My breakdown:
Food & Drinks: 9.5/10
Service: 7.5/10
Value: 8.5/10
Jaguar’s Hospitality Score: 8.5/10 🐾
Overall, Bixi is worth checking out if you’re looking for Asian-inspired food, cocktails, and a cool dinner vibe in Harlem.
Full episode is on Jaguar’s Guide TV on YouTube if you want to see the full breakdown.

I had a pretty good experience here. Struggled between deciding to give 3 or 4 stars, I’d say 3.5 for my final review.

Great atmosphere, great crowd and music. Nice seating, you can pick from outdoor and indoor.

Very nice happy hour menu which includes food (didn’t get to try any). 10 dollars a drink for craft cocktails which I guess isn’t bad and the happy hr runs until 8 pm including weekends, which is hard to find. It’s rare to find a lychee martini on happy hr, but I’d have to say it’s not the best lychee martini I’ve had, it tastes very sour. I’m not a fan of sweet drinks either, but the overall flavor profile and balance is off for sure.

I also tried another drink off the happy hr that starts with a H and it’s similar to a rum punch, that was actually made decent. The bartender is pretty friendly and gave my friend a free shot for happy hr.

Sadly there is only one bathroom and frequently a line but my experience, it goes by quick.

Overall, I recommend, definitely a vibe here and I’d return for sure.
Dope old skool bar. Drinks are strong depending on the bartender there that night. Good food with confusing menus.

Went to BIXI in Harlem after having a bad experience at another restaurant, and baby… BIXI completely saved the night. From the moment we walked in, the energy was immaculate, the definition of a vibe. ✨

10/10 across the board. The bartenders went above and beyond, even singing Happy Birthday to my bestie, which made the night feel extra special and personal. The drinks? Absolute perfection… balanced, flavorful, and clearly made with intention.

If you’re looking for great music, top-tier cocktails, and a staff that genuinely cares about your experience, BIXI is it. Harlem did not disappoint. We’ll definitely be back.

response.snippet: Jayde - Thank you so much for taking the time to write a review. We are so glad you enjoyed the vibe and cocktails at BIXI. We look forward to seeing you again soon! Cheers

reviews.snippet:
Went here for the first time with my family on Sunday, August 17th. We originally had a reservation for 4:30 and they give you a 15 minute grace period. I called to left them know we would be later than that and they were accommodating and said they will still be able to seat us. We were a table of 4 and arrived at 5pm.

The vibe is cozy and the decor is cute. I would come back for a date night. The bar is in the front when you enter and then there’s the dining room. There’s also additional seating in the back and there’s only one bathroom.

We ordered our appetizers from their happy hour menu; they have happy hour everyday from 4-8pm. However, some items aren’t discounted that much- like the 3 pc wings from HH are $9 but regular price is $10. The sweet chili wings were good, but I do think the menu is a bit pricey especially for the quantity that you get.

The highlight of the meal was the lemon sesame chicken. It was very tasty and cooked to perfection. The rice was so soft and buttery and literally melted in your mouth with each bite. 10/10 definitely would recommend and would get that dish again!

Con
My first time here was good. However the only thing I didn’t like was that when we asked for the bill, they had originally charged us a 20% gratuity. BUT, in their menu it states that gratuity is added after 9pm! We were there at 5pm and got the bill around 6:30pm, so we were confused to see that added. It didn’t make sense to us. Our waitress said it was because we were a “large party of 4” but she said she could speak to the manager and get the charge taken off and that’s what she did. I don’t mind being charged gratuity, but if you state that you do it after a certain time, then follow that!
This is a hidden gem. It was a grown and quaint atmosphere. Food and drinks were delish. They even had great music .I have found my new Friday night spot.

This is one of my favourite places in Harlem to enjoy expertly curated cocktails and food bursting with flavor. The staff is absolutely impeccable. They are so kind and caring with their hospitality. The cocktail I had was called “Stiletto” and the name definitely suits it well.

media.caption: GET THE LYCHEE MARGARITA AND THANK ME LATER!

reviews.snippet:
I visited Bixi on Valentine’s Day to meet a friend, and unfortunately it turned into one of the worst service experiences I’ve had.
At one point I asked the bartender if I could briefly charge my phone. He told me to come back in 10 minutes because it was busy, which I completely understood.

When I returned, instead of helping me, the bartender raised his voice at me in front of the entire bar. It felt unnecessarily aggressive and embarrassing, especially considering I i had done exactly what he asked and waited patiently. No one stepped in to de-escalate the situation, and the whole interaction left me feeling really uncomfortable.
The hostess later tried to explain that he might have been “having a bad day,” but honestly that’s not an excuse to speak to customers that way—especially on a busy night when people are just trying to enjoy themselves.
I came here expecting a fun evening out with a friend, but instead left feeling disrespected. I hope management addresses how staff communicate with guests, because no one should be spoken to like that for simply asking to charge their phone.
Came here for the first time with friends, the atmosphere is so welcoming, service is amazing and quick. Our server was great and friendly! The drinks were delicious and the food was even better.

response.snippet: Danielle Thank you for the review. So glad you had a great experience with us. We look forward to welcoming you back at BIXI again very soon. Cheers!

reviews.snippet:
Bixi Harlem is hands down one of my favorite spots in the city! The ambiance is stylish yet welcoming, making it perfect for a night out with friends or a cozy date night. The real star of the show, though, is their lychee martini—easily the best in NYC. It’s perfectly balanced, not too sweet, and always made with fresh ingredients. I love to switch it up and get tequila instead of vodka and it’s a hit every time.

Beyond the cocktails, the service is always top-tier, and the food menu never disappoints. Alex and JB are my usuals but everyone that works there is great. It feels a home away from home. I always grab a seat at the bar but they have a lovely back room and enclosed front/back patio.

Lastly their happy hour can’t be beat! $10 lychee martinis (and tons of other food/drink deals) until 8pm ever day!

response.snippet:

reviews.snippet:
Overall, Lido is a good spot. Everything is good except the calamari which was just ok. No real flavor. The aioli that comes with it is very good though. The sauce for the salmon is really tasty...a stand out for me with the whole dinner. The creamy garlic bread is a good appetizer. Creamy and a not too crunchy. The branzino is tasty and has crispy skin 👍. Could have more vegetables with it. The Tiramisu and warmy bread pudding for dessert were both good. The restaurant is pretty tight. Tables are pretty close together. Hard to get in and out when other diners are next to you.

Would definitely return here.

reviews.snippet: We went to Lido for lunch the day before Thanksgiving 2025 and I must say the food, service, and atmosphere was outstanding! For appetizers, my cousin and I shared the calamari fritti and my husband had the roasted veal meatballs (he ate them in a NY minute and I missed the photo op...). For the main course we had chicken marsala and spaghetti arrabiata. The cocktails (especially the espresso martini and the strawberry lemon drop) were wonderful! Everything we ordered was excellent! The portions were generous to the point that we had zero room for dessert. So, you get delicious food, great service and a generous meal for the money. It was a lovely dining experience and we look forward to returning next time we visit NYC!

reviews.snippet:
LIDO is one if my low key spots that always delivers a good meal with the perfect balance of energy and people.
The food is consistently on point and never disappoints.
The owners are also super sweet and amazing and definitely care about their customers and their dining experience.

A Memorable Harlem Gem That Keeps Me Coming Back

Years ago, I came across this spot on a recommendation—and it left such a lasting impression that I knew I had to return. This recent visit confirmed exactly why it earned a place on my personal list of must-try restaurants.

Nestled in Harlem, this restaurant is part of a neighborhood that has seen tremendous change over the past 30 years. While gentrification brings complex emotions, one positive is the emergence of exceptional dining experiences like this. It’s a beautiful reflection of Harlem’s evolving food scene—where history, creativity, and hospitality meet.

We visited for brunch and went with the bottomless Sangria and Mimosas. The Sangria surprised me—it was much lighter than expected, with a crisp, refreshing taste. At first, I thought it might be the white version, and the staff didn’t hesitate to bring over both so I could compare. That thoughtful touch set the tone for the entire meal. The service was friendly, prompt, and attentive without ever feeling rushed.

The white polenta was everything I hoped for—smooth, creamy, and full of flavor. It brought back all the good memories from my first visit. The braised short rib was melt-in-your-mouth tender and incredibly flavorful. These are the kinds of dishes that show real care and technique in the kitchen.

The atmosphere is just as inviting as the food. There’s a vibrant energy in the space—stylish yet relaxed, making it perfect for everything from a leisurely brunch with friends to a date night or special celebration.

Whether you’re a local or visiting New York City and want to explore Harlem beyond the typical tourist stops, I can’t recommend this place enough. It’s a true gem—where the food is memorable, the drinks are generous, and the service makes you feel like a valued guest. I’ll absolutely be returning again.

Caught them overcharging me about $4 more than the original price (which is about 50% more than what I was supposed to pay). Didn’t even say sorry to me. Pay attention to the prices because they seem to be trying to get away with charging more than what is listed.

Including ones who just seem to be hanging out in the store and not buying anything. And nobody even HINTS that they should, even though the sign on the door says "Mask Required."

The staff usually has their masks below their chin, and I don't mind that, since they're behind plexiglass. But when they come out from behind the counter they don't pull them up.

It's only like that at night, and my guess is that it's because the owner isn't around. But I stopped going there at night, because I don't feel safe.

BEWARE! The cashier will add 1~2 extra dollars when you buy more than 4 items. This happened to me twice, and I'm not visiting again. MAKE SURE you calculate your items' cost on your own to make sure.

I went there 5 times. Out of that there were 3 times I didn’t ask for a receipt. Came back 3 times because the dollar amount charged on my card is higher than the number cashier read to me. Just got a 26.47 charged for a 25.47 purchase. Harmless mistake of course xd.
Occasionally I am in this area for work, and evert time I come to this deli for lunch. Food is good, really really good, affordable and I am yet to buy a sandwich that I haven't finished
Im not kidding, best cutlet sandwich you can get at a Deli. and the owners are so sweet and kind! amazing service
The guys here are so nice, it's got everything you need for a quick grocery run, and the chef is great. Happy to call this my corner store.

Owner went above and beyond to help me when they were out of stock of something I needed! Super nice guy!
Great, affordable sandwiches. Only problem is that they're a bit slow, but that's cause they make your sandwich from scratch. Open 24/7 and always fully stocked.
I remember the stuff used to be like $6-8 for the sandwiches. Even though the price went up, the food is still amazing. Props to the chef, really chill guy.
Best deli on the block! Super friendly service

They've never heard of a Reuben sandwich, go figure in NYC deli...or horseradish or sourkraut..., if you try to just pull the ingredients together inside to do yourself...but ok... you're a NY deli...hmm. thanks...oh and they're NOT inexpensive, they overcharge everything and yes - Bodega, NOT DELI. Anybody's monkey can make an egg sandwich drunky McSloppy students and party dummies
