reviews.snippet:
Cooper Leaf Bakery is located in South Harlem, Manhattan, and offers a great mix of charm and energy, it really feels like a little piece of a French café in the middle of New York.

As soon as you walk in, you notice the atmosphere. The bistro-style tables, the layout, and the décor all give it that classic

French brasserie feel, while still keeping a lively New York vibe. It’s the kind of place where you can grab a quick coffee or sit down and enjoy a relaxed breakfast or brunch.
Right at the entrance, there’s a large counter filled with pastries and viennoiseries that all look delicious croissants, sandwiches, and more. Even if you don’t order food, everything looks fresh and beautifully presented, making you want to come back and try more.
When I visited around 11:30 AM, the place was packed, which says a lot about how popular it is. The staff was busy but handling things well, baristas keeping up with orders and servers taking care of the tables. You might have to wait a few minutes for a seat, but it’s definitely worth it.

The coffee was a highlight. I had a latte with almond milk, served in a large cup, which made the price feel reasonable for New York. The espresso was smooth and well-balanced, not too strong, not too light.

Looking around, most people were enjoying breakfast or brunch, pastries, sandwiches, and more. The overall vibe felt like a relaxed weekend morning. I also noticed they serve alcohol, so it’s not just a bakery, it can easily double as a casual brunch or light dining spot.

Overall, it’s a warm and lively place with great coffee and very appealing food. Definitely somewhere I’d come back to next time to try the pastries.

response.snippet: Rabah, this means a lot—thank you! Really glad you picked up on the details, from the space to the coffee. And yes, it can get busy around that time, so we appreciate your patience. We’ll be ready for you when you come back for the pastries.

reviews.snippet:
CopperLeaf is my favorite spot in the neighborhood, I always stop by whenever I'm in the area. The pastries are always fresh, and the new focaccia sandwiches are soooo good. The focaccia is perfectly baked, packed with turkey, crisp lettuce and juicy tomatoes that make every bite feel light and fresh.

What really got me though, was the Baltic Chilled Soup. It's super light, refreshing, and packed with flavor (and such beautiful colors)! It's perfect for a hot summer day. If you see it on the menu, definitely order it. I think it's seasonal, and it's an absolute must try while it’s lasts.

response.snippet:
Aiste, this made us smile.

We love that CopperLeaf has become one of your neighborhood favorites, and we’re so glad the new focaccia sandwich hit the mark. The Baltic Chilled Soup is especially close to our hearts, so it’s wonderful to hear how much you enjoyed it.

Thank you for the thoughtful review and for encouraging others to try it while it’s in season.

reviews.snippet:
I visited Cooperleaf Bakery and overall had a nice experience. The space is pleasant and the food was enjoyable.

However, it’s not a traditional table-service setup, which felt a bit unusual to me. You place your order first and then find a seat while waiting for your food, which made the experience feel slightly disconnected compared to a full-service restaurant.

That said, once the food arrived, everything was well done and satisfying. It’s a good spot if you’re okay with a more casual, self-service style, since we provide 20% tips…

media.caption: Herb omelette with roasted vegetables and potatoes
Smoked salmon toast with capers and dill

response.snippet: Thank you, Lisa, for taking the time to share this. We’re glad the food and overall experience landed well. Our format is a more casual, order-first style, but we hear your point about it feeling disconnected and will keep refining the experience so it feels more cohesive. We appreciate the feedback!

reviews.snippet: Stopped by Copperleaf Bakery & Coffee and it was definitely worth it. I always get my pastries from here and they never disappoint. The cinnamon roll was soft, fresh, and perfectly sweet without being too much, and the banana bread was super moist with great flavor. The shop itself has a clean, cozy vibe that makes it a great stop for coffee and baked goods. Staff is always friendly and everything tastes fresh. Definitely one of my go-to bakery spots.

response.snippet:
Thank you, Nia — we really appreciate the support.

We’re so glad the pastries and coffee keep bringing you back. The cinnamon roll and banana bread are two of our favorites as well. Our goal has always been to create a neighborhood bakery and café Harlem locals can stop into for fresh pastries, breakfast, brunch, lunch, and great coffee any day of the week.

Looking forward to welcoming you back again soon!

reviews.snippet: Phenomenal staff, super friendly owners, very fresh food ingredients that leave you feeling good! And their coffee is top notch—they’re using beans from renown New York roasters. Definitely worth trying everything!
Ube cheesecake was delightful! Just so you know their matcha is unsweetened but still great flavors. A bit on the pricier side but it’s NY. So good I recommend coming. They are so so sweet!

This new bakery is such a gem! As someone who regularly visits cafés, this will become my new go-to.

Food: The heirloom avocado toast is definitely worth the money. They were generous with the avocado and it was bursting with flavor. It had a hint of umami, sweet, sour, and spicy. It was a unique take on avocado toast but I really loved it; it was delicious and surprisingly filling. The copperleaf egg sandwich is a simple, delicious sandwich. The daily granola yogurt was really good. It had so many fresh toppings and the yogurt was thick and flavorful. The coffees were also great. Very strong and rich coffee.

Service & Atmosphere: The servers were very friendly and professional. The café was also very clean, I loved the clean decor. It's quiet enough to work and read, but it's also a great place for friends to talk quietly. There's enough seating but not so much that it could get packed. The restroom was also very clean. I'd definitely come back for the food and to work/read.

media.caption: Heirloom avocado toast (left), copperleaf egg sandwich (right), daily granola local yogurt (above)

reviews.snippet: This little bakery in Harlem is close to my house. The food was sooooo delicious. I had the chicken parm sandwich or at least it resembed a chicken parm. It came with a delicious salad as well. The sandwhich was quite substantial as you can see in the pic. The atmosphere and service were amazing as well. I cannot wait to have brunch here again.

response.snippet: Thank you, Tyrone—means a lot, especially as a neighbor. Glad everything from the food to the atmosphere came together, and we appreciate you sharing the photos. See you again soon!

reviews.snippet: Very nice interior. Just popped in for some coffee but the food looked good and seemed reasonably priced. The cashier was very nice. Had a salted caramel latte which was nice and salty, very good. The Irish cream cold brew just had whipped cream on cold brew so it was a little lacking.

response.snippet: Thank you, Zoe—we’re glad you stopped in and enjoyed the coffee and the atmosphere. Appreciate the honest feedback on the Irish cream cold brew as well—we’ll work on improving that. Hope to see you again soon!

reviews.snippet: This was a delicious adventure! This cafe is a great new addition to Harlem. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable, the atmosphere was perfect, and most of all the food was impeccable! I highly recommend the croissant- it is flaky, buttery and doughy, and the presentation is perfect. (Get it warmed too!)

I’ve given CopperLeaf Bakery quite a few tries because it’s such an interesting place, but the overall experience is a real mixed bag. To give credit where it’s due, the food side of things is impressive. The Korean Brisket Sandwich is pretty phenomenal, and the pastries I’ve tried have been consistently good. On top of that, several of the employees are really wonderful and bring great energy and excellent customer service to the space.

Unfortunately, the experience falls flat when it comes to the actual coffee and the overall hospitality. The espresso is my go-to order, and it is consistently really bad.

The service from specific staff members also needs work; on more than one occasion, I’ve had to ask the young lady who seems to be the main busser to clear a dirty table, and she has rolled her eyes and handled it begrudgingly.

The biggest issue, however, comes from the top. The owners behave incredibly weirdly. They will look you directly in the face and say absolutely nothing (no greeting, no acknowledgement, nothing…). They completely skip the bare minimum baseline of greeting people who patronize their establishment. It creates an incredibly odd, cold vibe.

For a much better price point than CopperLeaf, there are just too many other coffee shops in the area that serve a better espresso and actually make their customers feel warm and welcomed.

response.snippet:
Hi Melvin — thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback and for giving us multiple visits.

We’re genuinely glad to hear the food, pastries, and several members of our team left a positive impression, especially the Korean Brisket Sandwich. At the same time, we’re sorry that other parts of your experience felt inconsistent and fell short of the welcoming atmosphere we aim to create.

We take your comments regarding espresso quality, table maintenance, and overall service seriously, and we’ll be addressing them with our team as we continue refining operations and hospitality.

We appreciate the honest feedback and the support you’ve shown by continuing to visit us.

reviews.snippet: So happy that this place opened on my block! I went in the other day, and was wanting a fun beverage. one of the baristas, Shane (sorry if I spelled it wrong), kindly recommended her personally crafted iced rose matcha latte. It was one of the best matcha lattes I’ve ever had! The pastries are also top notch, and the place is always got people coming in and out which is a nice vibe for a new cafe.

media.caption: Matcha-vanilla pound cake and iced rose matcha latte

reviews.snippet: So grateful for this new Jewel in Harlem!!! Everything about this place is a lesson in excellence. I now consider myself a regular, and I couldn’t be happier with their food, service, ambience & drinks! If you live in the neighborhood and haven’t been yet, you are missing out! If you don’t live in the neighborhood, CopperLeaf Bakery is worthy of being a “destination” café and traveling for!

response.snippet:
Thank you so much, James — this truly means a lot to us.

We’re incredibly grateful for the support and so glad you’ve been enjoying the food, coffee, pastries, and overall brunch experience. Creating a neighborhood café that’s also worthy of being a destination spot for breakfast and lunch has been part of the vision from the beginning.

Looking forward to welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.snippet: Great cafe. Breads and pastries baked fresh. I enjoyed the butternut squash soup, which came with some baguette slices. The atmosphere is laid back but refined. Easy to come with kids or with friends. Baguette was perfect (although a bit pricey). I will be back!

media.caption: Perfectly spiced Butternut squash soup with baguette

reviews.snippet: Nice and stylish bar. The coffee is good, but the biscuit I tried was nothing special for its high price. It has relaxed and chill vibes, and you can also stay with your laptop. The interior is nice.

media.caption: Fresh cookie and hot black coffee

response.snippet: Thank you, Michele—we’re glad you had a nice visit and enjoyed the atmosphere. We also appreciate the feedback on the pastry and will keep refining. Hope to see you again soon!

reviews.snippet: Food is delicious. Drinks are great. Staff very professional and accommodating. Reggie the baker is a master.

response.snippet:
Thank you so much!

We're thrilled you enjoyed the food, drinks, and brunch experience. Reggie will be especially happy to hear your kind words—he puts incredible care into everything that comes out of the bakery each day.

We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

reviews.snippet:
I’ve came here a couple of times to try their offerings and honestly I find everything to be ridiculously over priced. Im born and raised in Harlem and have never seen prices like this anywhere. The packaging needs to be a bit better if you’re gonna sell pastries at 8-10$+ Where is the marketing? Albert is the best.

I’ve sat down and watched the waitress handle patrons rudely. Really brings the experience down some. I think this place has a severe identity crisis. I dont know if they want to be casual spot in the neighborhood or fine dining with the pricing. Ordering is annoying and everything is ordered at the counter. Not feasible. I liked the tall guy with the long hair, always had a nice temperament. Always smiled and greeted me. Now the service is somewhat cold. Probably wont return.

response.snippet:
Hi Jose — thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts and for visiting us on multiple occasions.

We're glad to hear that some members of our team made a positive impression and appreciate your feedback on the overall experience.

As a new business, we're continuing to refine our service and operations while staying true to our vision: a neighborhood bakery and café built around house-made pastries, quality coffee, and thoughtfully prepared breakfast, brunch, and lunch. We understand that our approach may not be for everyone, but we take all feedback seriously and are always looking for ways to improve the guest experience.

We appreciate your support and wish you all the best.

reviews.snippet: I love this place, it's my favorite local cafe. The coffee is good, the fresh baked pastries and food are great, but mostly is the lovely people that work here! (Shout-outs to Shane, Albert, Jimena, Alexis, Olivia, and all the rest!) The whole staff are kind and generous, just wonderful friendly people. Truly, it's the good vibes that keep me coming back (it is a little pricey admittedly, but mostly worth every cent!) Every now and again I sit here and draw-- it's the perfect spot!

Absolutely loved my experience at Copper Leaf Bakery! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I tried their chai latte and it was something special they actually make the chai syrup by hand, and you can really taste the difference. It felt so authentic and comforting. I also had their cappuccino and mocha, and both were perfectly made rich, smooth, and just the right balance of flavor.

Their chicken Milanese sandwich was amazing fresh, flavorful, and super satisfying. The avocado toast was also delicious and beautifully prepared.

What truly makes this place stand out is the people. The staff are incredibly sweet and welcoming, and the owners are honestly the highlight. They are such kind, genuine people, and you can tell they put real love into everything even handcrafting their own flavored syrups.

This place feels warm, personal, and high-quality all at once. Definitely a must-visit I’ll be coming back for sure! 💛

response.snippet:
Thank you so much, Pramity — this genuinely means a lot to us.

We’re really happy you enjoyed the chai, coffee, avocado toast, and Chicken Milanese sandwich. We put a lot of love and care into making things in-house, especially our syrups and pastries, so it’s incredibly rewarding when those details are noticed.

More than anything, we’re grateful for your kind words about our team and the atmosphere. Creating a warm neighborhood café in Harlem where people can slow down, enjoy breakfast, brunch, lunch, coffee, and fresh pastries has been the goal from the beginning.

Can’t wait to welcome you back again soon!

reviews.snippet:
Best cheese cake I’ve ever had in my life. It melts in your mouth!
The chicken Milanese sandwich is fire, it’s hard not to keep reordering it. Did I mention the cheesecake?
Love the owners and staff, friendly all around. Oh yeah, amazing cold brew and espresso drinks!☕️
Cheesecake!

response.snippet:
Thank you! We had a feeling the cheesecake might steal the show.

We're so glad you enjoyed everything from the Chicken Milanese to the cold brew, and your kind words about our team truly mean a lot. See you again soon—we'll keep the cheesecake coming!

reviews.snippet:
We ducked into Chocolat to escape the rain and ended up discovering one of the best parts of our trip.

We had brunch and, a little over an hour later, decided we had room for dessert. We ordered the chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream, and let me just say this: if they serve dessert in heaven, I imagine it tastes something like this. We told ourselves we’d exercise a little self-control, but the warm cake and melting ice cream had other plans. We practically wolfed down every bite of that delicate, moist, heavenly goodness.

Now, here’s where the fried chicken comes in.

My husband looked at me and said, “I need something savory to take the sweetness out of my mouth.” Don’t judge us. 😂 I flagged down a waiter and ordered a side of chicken. That chicken arrived piping hot, crispy, perfectly seasoned, and every bit as memorable as the dessert. It was so good it felt like manna from heaven.

It’s loud and although service was lacking the food was amazing, the atmosphere was welcoming, and what started as a quick escape from the rain turned into a meal we’ll be talking about for a long time. We’ll definitely be back. 🍫🍗☔️

response.snippet:
Hi, Bebe,
Thank you for ducking in out of the rain and giving us the chance to turn a quick stop into a memory you’ll be carrying home with you. Stories like yours remind us why we do what we do.

That chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream has tempted many guests into abandoning their self‑control, so you were in good company. And the way you described that warm cake meeting the melting ice cream — that’s exactly the moment we hope people experience.

We also love that the fried chicken made a surprise appearance in your brunch journey. Sweet, then savory, then sweet again… that’s a Harlem rhythm right there. Hearing that both the dessert and the chicken hit the mark means a lot to our team.

We appreciate you mentioning the noise and the service. Your feedback helps us tighten up the experience so the hospitality matches the food every time.

Rain or shine, we’re grateful you found us — and we can’t wait to welcome you back for round two.

reviews.snippet:
Good soul food restaurant in Harlem! Perfect for groups!

Location: It is located at the corner of W 120th st and Frederick Douglas Blvd. The restaurant is big with lot of seating. Street parking is available.

Service: we went with a group and definitely help us.

Food: I only ordered the fried chicken with red velvet pancakes. And the chicken was the star here. It was very crunchy and well seasoned. The red velvet pancakes were burnt tho but still taste good.

Price rating: 8/10. It was not expensive for the good food and location.

Definitely will come back to try other food on the menu! But that chicken was perfect.

response.snippet: Hi, Mark. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you for the review!

reviews.snippet: Went for a birthday Sunday brunch celebration with 8 people. The food, drinks and service were great. Had the red velvet waffles with catfish, and Chocolat Signature Sangria. The catfish had delicious flavor, and waffles were on point. The Sangria ....❤️‍🔥. The server was also great in recommending drinks, and friendly. Would definitely recommend and recommend making reservations. The vibe was chill.✨️🎊🥳

response.snippet: Hi, Tonya. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you for the review!

reviews.snippet:
Had a great time. Whenever someone comes in town to visit this is where I take them. I absolutely LOVE the shrimp & gritss. I need to know how take make the Lobster roux. I’ve also had the seafood croquettes and they were good as well.

I only have a low score because the service wasn’t that great. We had a reservation and still had to wait to be seated but the host forgot about us and we were just standing there for quite some time. Once we were seated it was the same. The server didn’t check on us often. It took him a long time to come back and it just pretty much stayed that way until we left.

response.snippet: Hi, Remy. We appreciate the kind words and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

reviews.snippet:
Amazing service,shout out to Malik for being able to deal with my complicated family with a smile.
Good Music very chill not too loud so you can still hear each other talk.
Strong drinks
I had shrimp tacos which were good
The crab cake were good and big enough to share
Ribs are falling off the bone tender
The sweet potatoes were bland
Going back for the truffle fries
Restrooms are clean
Sunday brunch day you can find parking near by.

response.snippet:
Hi, Porscha,

Thank you for spending your Sunday with us and for showing love to our team. Malik will be thrilled to hear he made your visit smooth and enjoyable — he handles every table with heart, even the “complicated” ones.

I’m glad the vibe hit just right for you — good music, strong drinks, clean restrooms, and dishes that delivered. The shrimp tacos, crab cakes, and those fall‑off‑the‑bone ribs are guest favorites for a reason. I appreciate the honest note on the sweet potatoes; feedback like that helps us keep leveling up.

We’ll have those truffle fries ready for you next time. And yes, Sunday brunch parking nearby is one of Harlem’s underrated blessings.

Looking forward to welcoming you back soon.

reviews.snippet: When you arrive, the aroma of chocolate is all around making you feel happier and ready to eat. The staff is very friendly and I felt welcome. Iordered fried chicken as an appetizer and it was tempura fried and cooked perfectly. For my entree, i had the oxtail with Mac and cheese and plantains. Ssooo delicious! Ordered a slice of cake for dessert. I haven't tasted it as of yet, but i honestly expected black rum cake. The cake was more almond cake and it tasted hard and old almost like it had been sitting around for a while. I wouldn't get it again. They charge gratuity automatically which I almost didn't notice and almost doubled the tip so watch out for that. Overall, this is a beautiful place and I recommend it

response.snippet:
Hi Janell,
Thank you so much for sharing your experience with us. We’re delighted to hear that the aroma, atmosphere, and hospitality made you feel welcome from the moment you arrived. It’s wonderful that you enjoyed the fried chicken appetizer and the oxtail entrée—those are guest favorites, and we’re glad they hit the mark for you.
We truly appreciate your feedback about the cake. That’s not the experience we want for any of our guests, and your comments help us ensure our desserts are always fresh and aligned with expectations. We’ll be reviewing this with our pastry team right away.
Thank you as well for mentioning the automatic gratuity. We include it for parties of a certain size, but we understand how easy it can be to miss, and we’ll continue working to make that as clear as possible.
We’re grateful for your recommendation and for taking the time to leave such a thoughtful review. We look forward to welcoming you back for another delicious visit.

reviews.snippet:
My husband and I had a great experience dining here. The food was excellent ,I’d give it a 4.5 out of 5. The atmosphere was warm, inviting, and made for a very enjoyable meal. What really stood out was the cleanliness. The dining area was spotless, and even the bathroom was exceptionally clean, which says a lot about how well the restaurant is maintained.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this restaurant and look forward to coming back again!

response.snippet: Hi, Vickeara. Thank you so much for leaving us a stellar review!

reviews.snippet:
There was mold on the cheese in my meal, which was understandably concerning. I appreciate that the kitchen promptly remade the dish. However, I felt the overall guest experience could have been handled with more care.

A manager did not come to the table to acknowledge the issue, and there was no follow-up gesture such as a dessert or adjustment to the bill. I was still charged full price for the entrée.

I’m sharing this feedback in hopes it helps enhance how food safety concerns are addressed in the future, ensuring guests feel supported and well taken care of.

response.snippet:
Hello Tatiana,
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We truly appreciate you bringing this to our attention, and I’m glad the kitchen was able to remake your dish right away.

I also want to clarify that we use pepper jack cheese in that entrée, which naturally contains pepper flecks that can sometimes be mistaken for mold. Even so, your concern was completely understandable, and we never want a guest to feel unsure about the quality of their meal.

What you described regarding the follow‑up is something we take seriously. A manager should have come by your table to acknowledge the situation and ensure you felt fully supported. That additional touchpoint matters, and we’re addressing this with our team so we can handle moments like these with the care and hospitality you deserve.

Thank you again for helping us improve. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide a smoother, more attentive experience.

reviews.snippet: The atmosphere was a vibe. Our waitress Ashley was the best! The food was delicious! I didn’t get a drink but everything was good!!! Red velvet Waffles with fried chicken and cheese grits and applewood smoke bacon. Very very goood!!

response.snippet: Hi, Nicole. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you for the review!

reviews.snippet: Me and my husband enjoy coming here. The food and drinks are always good. The Bartender Ro is the best! He always takes care of us. Seating at the bar with him is always worth it. Me and my husband had the bottomless brunch was definitely it for me like always.

response.snippet:
Hi, A.
Thank you so much for spending your time with us. We love hearing that you and your husband always enjoy the food, the drinks, and the vibe at the bar. Rio will be thrilled to know he continues to make your visits special — he’s truly one of a kind.

Bottomless brunch with him behind the bar really is a whole experience, and we’re grateful you choose to share those moments with us. Looking forward to welcoming you both back again soon.

reviews.snippet:
It’s me posting a review of my Valentine’s Day dinner more than a month later (and after breaking up)😅 better late than never right? Tbh so glad this spot had an open table for us after the original VDay plan flopped. The restaurant we were gonna go to moved locations but still showed its old location on Google Maps 😭

Andy was our server at Chocolat and he was such a DELIGHT! Answered every question I had and laughed at all my jokes 🙂‍↕️ but in all seriousness I love how knowledgeable he was and made me feel super confident in what I ordered, which I ended up LOVING!

I got the salmon burger (8/10) and my date got the turkey burger (7/10, better than average, could’ve been spicier, decently sufficient)

I love that the salmon burger CAME with avocado, onion, arugula and tomato 😋I also asked for lemon aioli on the side, highly recommended!

media.caption: Salmon patty sandwich with avocado and fries

response.snippet:
Hi, Jaida,
Thank you so much for sharing your Valentine’s Day experience with us — late reviews are absolutely welcome, and we’re glad we could be the bright spot after those last‑minute plan changes!

Andy will be thrilled to hear your kind words. He truly loves what he does, and knowing he made you feel confident, cared for, and entertained means the world to our team.

We’re also happy you enjoyed the salmon burger — and yes, that avocado–arugula combo is a favorite around here. Great call on the lemon aioli too. Your date’s turkey burger notes are appreciated as well; feedback like this helps us keep leveling up.

Thank you for the 4/5 across the board. We’d love to welcome you back anytime for another great meal and an even better experience.

reviews.snippet: Six ladies from California seeking the best soul food experience. Found it at Chocolate Restaurant. Food was creative and very good. Don’t miss out when coming to NYC!

response.snippet:
Hi, Lynn,
Thank you for choosing Chocolat during your NYC visit. We loved hosting your group from California. Hearing that you found the soul food experience you were looking for means a lot to our team. We’re glad the dishes hit the mark and appreciate you spreading the word. Come see us again next time you’re in the city — Chocolat will be ready for you.

reviews.snippet: The wait staff seemed a little sluggish around 4-5pm on a Friday. I asked for a cup of coffee with Bailey's. It took 4 people and 15 minutes later to receive my order and the drink was barely warm! I had the bbq wings as my appetizer, they were pretty good. I also ordered the Fish Tacos and Sweet Potato Fries as my entrée. The Tacos had more salad than fish, but the fries were excellent 😋 I think this place could be hit or miss depending on the time and day of the week😌

response.snippet: Thank you for joining us and for sharing such a thoughtful review. We’re glad to hear you enjoyed the BBQ wings and those sweet potato fries — they’re definitely guest favorites. We’re sorry your coffee with Bailey’s took longer than it should have and wasn’t served at the right temperature. That’s not the level of efficiency or care we aim for, especially during that late‑afternoon window. Your feedback about the fish tacos and overall timing is truly helpful, and we’ll be reviewing it with our team to ensure more consistency throughout the day. We appreciate you dining with us and hope we have the chance to deliver a smoother, fully enjoyable experience on your next visit.

reviews.snippet: This was an amazing brunch spot. The staff was attentive and friendly towards my group. The drinks were tasty and strong, and the in-house DJ was amazing, bringing in the vibes. As for the food....impeccable. I got the Slow Braised Beef short ribs, and it was cooked to perfection. The portion was enough, and the flavor was well worth the price. Would definitely come here again

response.snippet: Hi, Harmonee. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you for the review!

reviews.snippet: Walked in on a Sunday during brunch was greeted and asked if we wanted to be served indoor or out we chose out . Just sat us asked if we wanted any water . How never came back with water. Then 5 min later waitress came to table not really warm greeting!! Spoke to fast just felt rushed!! Nice atmosphere considering!!

First restaurant we visited while in New York. This place is an entire vibe from the time you enter the doors until you leave. Amazing food! Excellent service. Mailk and Tobe were wonderful. You can tell that they truly care about the guests. Tobe has an energy that is unmatched. I will definitely be back!! Thank you so much for the wonderful dining experience.

response.snippet: Hi, Matesa. We are thrilled to learn that you had a positive experience with us!

reviews.snippet: I hosted a Birthday party/ surprise engagement dinner. The staff was very professional & accommodating. I used the VIP room. I recommend you reserve ahead of time. The food was great. I loved the atmosphere. I would definitely recommend this place 100%.

response.snippet:
Hi, Troi.
Thank you so much for celebrating such meaningful moments with us. It’s an honor to host your birthday party and surprise engagement dinner. Our team will be thrilled to know their professionalism and care helped make the night special. We’re glad you enjoyed the VIP room, the food, and the atmosphere. Your recommendation means everything to us, and we can’t wait to welcome you back for more celebrations in the future.

reviews.snippet: This time around was for Mother’s Day. We made reservations and did not get sat down until an hour and half later. What I will say is the hostess was great. She stayed professional at all times. She should have received helped knowing it was crowded. Also there should have been a cut off for reservations on the open table site. Still will go back. Thank you Sarah for being a great waiter.

response.snippet: Hi, Shay. Thank you so much for leaving us a stellar review!

reviews.snippet: The service was amazing from the guy at the door. He was more polite and welcoming than my actual waitress. Overall this is my 2nd time there. My kids love the food. I wasn't a fan of the salmon but the it was good. I would still back for the red velvet waffles.

response.snippet: Hi, Daydai. We appreciate the kind words and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

reviews.snippet: The food was delicious and our server was professional and kind. Great restaurant choice! We will definitely be back.

response.snippet: Hi, Mj. We appreciate the kind words and are glad we could provide you with such a positive experience! Thanks for the great review!

reviews.snippet:
**TL;DR Summary**
Coffee and lattes done with excellence. Food is really good. Definitely worth walking by the chain coffee shop to get here
---

## Why My Rating
**Food**
We had a vanilla chai, regular coffee, a latte. All were superb. One in our party had food and loved it. Great coffee shop aura

**Atmosphere**
Small rustic coffee shop feel. Definitely hit this 100%

**Staff**
Even one busy very joyful and welcoming. Knowledgeable about what they're doing

**Cleanliness**
Excellent

**Price**
Felt like it was value for what we got!
---

## Additional Notes (Optional)
If you're looking for seating, don't stress when you first walk in, there's some extra seating out back on the porch. It's really nice.
---

## Rating Logic

I rate based on expected experience for that type of place rather than comparing all restaurants equally. I also avoid posting negative reviews unless you have had three consistently poor experiences.

Celiac/gluten intolerant BEWARE - they store their gluten free lemon loaf in the same main shared pastry case!!!

I was shocked to see this and shocked the staff seemed completely surprised that isn't safe, didn't apologize, didn't offer me a new loaf, or address what I said really at all, just continued on with the remainder of my order/drink. I genuinely just wanted to be sure they knew so hopefully others don't get sick from what is listed as gluten free food, and it was a busy Sunday morning so I wanted to also be respectful of employees.

Vibes are cute but I would never feel safe eating anything listed as gluten free here/at all due to seemingly no awareness or education of what that means and how to not make people ill, or responsiveness to support customers. I walked several blocks out of my way - celiacs will understand - as a disabled person using a mobility aid, after making sure there was something I could eat there.. and now I'm about to do all that again to actually find a bite 🫠

Very good coffee shop and owner, what a nice surprise. The coffee flavour and strength were mellow and balanced, kind of typical, but a good latte overall and a better one with vanilla. Nice selection of bakery products like the lemon cake or the almond croissant I had. The seating area takes you to the past with its old and characteristics style

We live in the apartment upstairs and frequent this coffee shop a lot. A great space to grab a dope cup of coffee and the chef making the food is amazing. I would recommend the LOX bagel if you are out to treat yoself. The atmosphere is cozy and a great place for a solo working event with your computer or a date. Small and not a ton of room but perfect if you're looking for a nook to hide in for a few hours. Outside back patio too!

Great coffee and vibes. Quick service and taste profile was bold and smooth for a cap to go.

I love the morning vibe of this place with local Harlemites grabbing a coffee and reading a paper. It also has a cute outside seating area.
Friendly staff, good cafe, street side terrace and nicely decorated. Great atmosphere.

This is one of the greatest coffee spots in the city I go and work when I am in the city. The food and coffee as well as pastries are all utmost delicious. It could be pretty hard to find a seat between 10 AM to 5 PM since there are a lot of people working at this cafe. During the summer time you can enjoy the back yard as well.

The best service, the staff is professional and nice.
A great place to work on a laptop.
The coffee itself is excellent and so are the pastries.
I highly recommend the place; Thank you very much friends.

Nice cafe for its historic, yet hipster setup and vibe. Alot of people come here to work and they have a bar side as well. Also some games like darts and light pastries. There are few outlets and the wifi is a bit shirt so can't stay too long and limited seating indoor but they have an outside igloo as well.
I ordered a decaf americano and it was good. Not too roasted, good balance.

I'm so glad I found this while looking for a local place to get coffee. We had an Airbnb in Harlem and wanted something original and we found Double Dutch! It was so good we came here the next morning. The drinks tasted so good! And get the pastries!!! The staff was beyond awesome. They were helpful and friendly and I just loved the vibe from that shop. The aesthetics were so cool and everything about it seemed so comfortable. Definitely making this a regular stop when I'm back in town, seriously worth a stop.

This place is so wonderful! They were so accommodating of me and my service dog, the staff was so polite and the food was delicious. It's quiet enough that you can get work done but not so quiet that you feel like you can't have a conversation. Will definitely be back!

Went there a few times during a trip to NYC. Very popular, often fully packed neighborhood coffee shop. Iced coffees were very watery, flavorless. During next visits we ordered flat whites which were much, much better, 10/10 drink. Unfortunately they charge 1usd for plant milk. The food is great, tasty, filling, but also a bit overpriced. Please note that the kitchen doesn’t open until 9-9:15, before this you can only order drinks. Good, friendly service. Overall, recommended, with a few remarks
Cozy atmosphere! Super cute place to work or catch up with a plan. Cappuccino was great. The gentleman with braids who made our coffees was very friendly and added to our experience.

Stumbled upon this cafe and all the more worth it. Warm atmosphere, inviting staff, delicious eats, great coffee/tea under an umbrella of reasonable prices. A wall of mirrors for some self portraits. There's an open patio tucked in the back. Nice place to link up with friends or work on your laptop. Super considerate physical distancing protocols. Definitely recommend!

Double Dutch is such a gem in Harlem! ☕️ My absolute favorite is their lavender latte — perfectly balanced and so flavorful. I’ve also spent a few days working from here, and the vibe is always amazing. The space is inviting, with a welcoming atmosphere, and they also have outdoor seating and a lovely patio, which is perfect for warmer days. Definitely one of my favorite coffee spots in the area!

Stopped by here for a quick coffee, was great. Staff was friendly and great atmosphere both inside and outside. Coffee was freshly ground and also recently roasted. Personally did think it was expensive but prices seem to be in line with the other places I had coffee. Do recommend!

Reliable neighborhood coffee shop, good for working on your laptop, but it doesn’t have great lighting inside— they have an outdoor terrace that’s nice during the warmer months, and a smaller overflow room with bar-like sitting. I usually get their matcha, which is not as sweetened as in other spots.
Love the cozy space, and the coffee/bagels were phenomenal! Everything we hoped it would be!

I LOVE DOUBLE DUTCH!!!! their staff is super friendly and sweet and i want to be their friend. their coffee is always yummy, and their pastries are always fresh. can't wait until it gets nicer outside so i can sit in the backyard!

The place has a relaxed vibe and the outdoor seating is very nice, shaded and often not too crowded. The drinks were ok and the açaí bowl was good, just a bit runnier than I’m used to. Overall, I think it’s a nice place to go to, for a conversation or to work.

reviews.snippet: I would love to give this place a better rating one day - however, I have lived in this neighborhood all my life and have tried to go to this spot, along with the coffee shop… every single time I leave upset. The people who work here have a superiority complex. The service has consistently been questionable, or just straight up bad. I know their regulars love it - but you need to have a relationship to even be acknowledged immediately. As someone who has worked in the service industry the behavior at this place is simply baffling. If you’re actually from Harlem, tread with caution. It’s unfortunate - they have a great space and the music is usually pretty good. Maybe you’ll have a good experience as a transplant.

Held my birthday party for 25 people here. They were so kind and helpful, and the minimum spend is not too high. Everyone had a great time (in no small part helped by the fact that the drinks are strong and yummy)! Highly recommend.

I came for my birthday in February, so I feel bad for waiting so long to post, but we came with a very large party, and the place was booked. We were about to leave when the server came up and told me he had secured the adjoining coffee shop as a party room for us. He literally saved the day, as I already had 20 or so people en route. After that, we had incredible and attentive service, delicious shared bites and carefully crafted cocktails. Mess Hall and their staff went way above general expectations of NYC service, and we will all be back regularly. Thank you so much Mess Hall, and sorry for the late review!

I’m extremely disappointed and wanted to love this place so badly. It took over 10 minutes for our waitress to come up and get our order and was not friendly. Our drinks came out with no garnish or straw. My cosmopolitan tasted like it was from on the rocks premade bottle. When we asked for our check she ignored us.

Mess Hall is my go-to to grab a drink with a friend, or simply sit with a book and a beer and enjoy the vibes. The music is fun and the service is always friendly (shoutout to Adam!), and the rotating happy hour beer selection is solid.

I like the artichoke dip, but would happily give up everything else on the food menu if they'd bring back hot dogs.

Stopped by with friends and ended up staying much longer than planned. The space has a great vibe—lively but not chaotic—and it’s easy to actually enjoy a conversation while still feeling like you’re out in NYC. The drinks were well made, reasonably priced, and the staff clearly know what they’re doing.

What really stood out was the atmosphere and service. Everyone was friendly, attentive without hovering, and genuinely welcoming. It feels like the kind of bar you can come back to regularly, whether for a casual drink or a fun night out
Absolutely love this bar. A true neighborhood gem. Rudy served us and very knowledgeable. A+

This was our first stop while bar hopping in Harlem. It was really busy but we found bar seats. The drinks were good and strong and the bartenders were really nice! We stayed for a good while and ended up ordering some guacamole. We had some interesting and almost intrusive guests that wouldn't stop talking to us but other than that, we had a pretty good time. I'd come back next time I'm in town!

My friends and I have been coming here almost every week for over two years! It’s the perfect neighborhood bar — casual and chill vibe, great staff (Derek is the best!) and solid drinks & snacks. We ❤️ mess hall
Best trivia night and best staff! Always feel like part of the community here. Very cozy atmosphere. Fun seasonal draft selection. Claire and Derek are the best. Thank you!

I love this place the ambiance is beautiful the people that work there are so sweet and attentive the music they play is always great. Food is great and drinks as well are all nicely priced. I also really like the crowd that goes there all really nice people feel very comfortable there wish I could give this place 10 stars

Mess Hall is one of my go-to spots in Harlem! It’s hard for me to find a bar where I feel totally comfortable going solo, but Mess Hall is the exception.

Their happy hour can’t be beat - drink specials until 8pm! The drinks are strong, the prices are right, and the vibe is always chill but fun. The space has a cool, laid-back feel, and if you go in the summer sit in the front sidewalk seating. Or their cute backyard.

The staff are all great and genuinely kind people.
I come here every week for trivia. The management is great and good service. They have my favorite pretzel in the city. Great ambiance as well.

To the owners: please train your bartenders in basic customer service.
I asked for a hot tea. If it’s not available — that’s absolutely fine.
What is not fine is the eye-rolling, the sighing, being told “this is a bar” in a condescending tone, and then discussing me with another guest while looking at me like I’m stupid.

Some bars do serve hot tea. Asking doesn’t make a guest an idiot.
Respect costs nothing.
Mess Hall offers a relaxed atmosphere and well-prepared modern American dishes. Friendly service and quality ingredients make it a solid choice for a casual meal in New York City.
This is one of my favorite bars in Harlem. They’ve got a great trivia night on Tuesdays and a phenomenal staff. They’ve got the best pretzels in the city!

My favorite bar by far, vibe super chill, small cozy with great happy hours all week long! Staff super friendly. Recommended 100!

FYI they have a very limited food menu, more like to grab a little something while you enjoy your drinks.

I love Mess Hall so much, especially in the summer with the outdoor seating. I bring my friends often and they share the same sentiments. The bartenders and other staff are wonderful. I don’t really explore the food as much, but the fritos and chili from my last visit was hot and filling. My go to is the frozen margarita - delicious and strong.

Excellent cocktails and service for the price. This place caters to mid-market clientele of all ages. If you bump into someone under 35 (in general), they are respectful and ambitious. This is perfect for a first date and a great neighborhood happy hour meeting place, any day of the week.
Best bar in Harlem. Caesar had a 10/10 customer service and made us feel so welcomed. Highly recommend!

reviews.snippet: This place is a total rip off. I ordered a bacon egg and cheese sandwich, and it had two small strips of bacon on it, for 7.50, AND they charged me 1.00 extra from what is advertised because I went in there at 5:30am. Complete rip off…not a single bodega charges that kind of rate, and if they do it wouldn’t be a slim sandwich. They buy their food from the same places everyone else in a 5 block radius does. Not worth the double prices at all.

Got the pre made chicken parmesean, the individual proceeded to reheat it in the same device all other bodegas use to bread, regardless when i took a bite the bread was warm but the chicken was ice cold, ridiculous....

Do not bother. Extremely overpriced. Don’t go unless you want to get ripped off. Ordered 2 sandwiches & when I tell you they literally only had 1 slice of turkey in them… to then charge me 14 dollars each for them. It was basically bread I paid for. If you have money to throw away, by all means go.

This store is not my cup of tea. I work the Harlem overnights and often times find stores some open including this one. I try to find stores that accepts ebt instead of paying cash. This store is not it. You can tell the type of people who the cater to. When I walk inside the store automatically I got shot with an attitude. When I pulled out my debit card to pay the lady gave me a smile like she was being biased about me asking about ebt. I stop going here because it's overpriced, food is terrible and service is biased. The only reason they get customers because those people are tasteless
29 dollars for a “burrito bowl” (no protein) and a juice, insane prices portions is barely okay. Better go to an actual restaurant for that same price. Most 4-5 are old reviews so don’t get fooled.
I came to Central Park and found this store near it and what can I say about this store! Top 1 near Central Park from service,food, desserts, salad bar….everything clean and fresh and delicious!
Newly opened corner deli where starbucks used to be. Clean space, deli, salad counter, plus for not another smoke shop. Best of luck with the Grand Opening!
Very nice deli and the chef is friendly. Service is friendly. Food is delicious!
Had the Hot Reuban Sandwich tonight. Delicious! Definitely hit the spot!

This place is a great spot in my neighborhood and Andrea the cashier is very welcoming and friendly including the chef as well.

She kindly recommended me a quesadilla that I now get frequently the chipotle chicken quesadilla.

The food here is delicious and the chef makes the food with a lot of care.

I’ve stopped by this deli a few times because it’s conveniently located, and while the food is decent enough for a quick bite, the experience tends to be hit or miss—mostly due to the service.

The cashier is pleasant. Friendly, efficient, and always greets you with a smile, which is a nice way to start your day. Unfortunately, the same can’t be said for the guy who handles breakfast.

Every time I’ve ordered in the morning, he acts like I’ve just ruined his day. There’s always a scowl on his face, like making breakfast sandwiches is some huge inconvenience. He never says hello, rarely makes eye contact, and generally gives off a “don’t bother me” vibe. It honestly feels like I’m interrupting his break, even though he’s clearly on the clock. It’s uncomfortable, and it makes what should be a simple and pleasant experience somewhat stressful.

If the management could work on improving the attitude behind the counter, this place could be a lot better. Until then, I’ll probably only stop by if I’m in a rush and have no other options.
17$ for two small gatorades and a fair life. Go across the street get the same things for 8$.
Added scam charges to my order (“Tax - 4.99”), so a few sodas and some herbal tea came out to $23. Avoid this place.

The place creates total pleasure. The quality of ingredients shows in every tasty bite. The staff was excellent and everyone was ready to help! The menu here includes all the foods I seek out. The value here exceeds all alternatives.

Really good service
Try the Paninis! Really healthy smoothie and juice selection too!(and healthy food in general)
I really enjoy the food... The Bagel and the cheesecake tasted so good.... And served with the smile... 🔥❤️

I am not the type to write reviews but HANDS DOWN to this place!!! My children loved their smoothies and I personally had the best coffee you could ask for. Must be because the cashier (very charismatic) made sure she took our order to the detail for us to love our beverages, which made us feel truly special. They also a huge assorted amount of groceries.
Overall, this is fantastic place with great atmosphere to stop by if you are taking a walk in the afternoon by Central Park.
Will definitely be back!
Worst cinnamon roll of my life but lovely deli

You really pay for the wood shelving here.

It is one thing to have overpriced sandwiches in Manhattan, it is another to make an Italian hero with bologna and mayonnaise and sell it for 13 bucks.

I thought I got the wrong sandwich; they tried to tell me it was pastrami.

Absolute baloney, I tell ya.

Mom's Deli is a great addition to the neighborhood. I'm in there nearly everyday getting food and coffee. It's a clean establishment, the food is great and the staff is welcoming. Andrea is always taking care of customers at the register and keeps the place lively around the clock with good music and atmosphere.

Loved this place! Not much room to stay and eat (if that’s what you’re looking for).

I mentioned it was my first time and the cashier gave me a free sample of the apricot rugelach. I ended up buying the chocolate and the raspberry rugelachs and an apple turnover.

Everything looked great and tasted even better! I’ll definitely be coming back to Lee Lee’s next time i’m in the city!

media.caption: Assorted pastries available. Bottom row is rugelach

reviews.snippet: WOW. just wow. I came here two years ago, but am still thinking about the rugelach and found some photos and so am writing this review. Yeah, it’s so good. I dream of this place and waiting for the opportunity to make it back :,)

Delicious authentic rugelach - I got all three flavors and every component delivered. Nice depth of flavor, you can taste the fruit and nuts used to make the base. The interior is cozy, like a time capsule… next time I want to try the cheesecake/ flan looking dessert in the fridge!

Delicious variety of baked goods. I had my first rugelach from here and also got a scrumptious red velvet cake with a tasty cream cheese frosting. I’ll definitely be back for more. Not to mention friendly service and a warm, inviting atmosphere that feels like home. Definitely recommend for anyone looking for tasty baked goodies in Harlem.
Good assortment of rugelach. The apple turnover was good too. Nice small shop that’s really nice inside
I should have written this reviews years ago. This is simply the best rugelach you will ever have and it is true no matter where you come from. Lee Lee's should be a National Landmark!

Lee Lee’s Bakery in Harlem never disappoints. Everything I tried was fresh, flavorful, and absolutely delicious — you can tell the quality and care that goes into the baked goods. The customer service was just as memorable. FRANCIS was warm, attentive, and made the visit feel welcoming from the moment I walked in. I was hoping to meet Mr. Lee this time around but just missed him — maybe next visit! Either way, this bakery is a gem in the neighborhood and always worth the stop.

Lee Lee’s Baked Goods of Harlem has the best rugelach pastries I have ever eaten. They truly are the King of Excellent Rugelach pastries.

Rugelach are often served on Jewish holidays like Hanukkah and Shavuot, though of course they can be made anytime throughout the year. Jewish families typically serve them during Rosh Hashanah, when sweet foods are made to signify a sweet new year.

The hospitality of at Lee Lee’s reminds me of Southern charm, you will feel at home. From the moment you enter the bakery.

Apricot rugelach’s are my favorites here. Don’t take my word for it, give them a try. I placed my order ahead, had exact change, plus a tip and the staff was kind enough to have my order ready. They are really the best.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Lee Lee's Baked Goods in Harlem is an absolute gem! As a first-time visitor, I was thrilled to receive a complimentary Rugelach, and it was delicious—perfectly flaky and filled with rich flavors. The warm, inviting aroma of freshly baked treats fills the shop, making it hard to choose just one thing! I also tried their signature pastries, and each bite was pure bliss. The friendly staff made the experience even better with their helpful recommendations. If you're looking for a cozy spot to indulge your sweet tooth, this is the place to be. Highly recommend visiting!

You walk in and are greeted by the friendly owner who is utterly devoted to making high quality baked goods. The homey warm atmosphere calls to mind another era of small individually owned shops. He cut me a generous slice of freshly made carrot cake that is really 2 servings — see photo — (cost 7 bucks!) and I have to say it was the tastiest I’ve ever had (and I do like Lloyds and Magnolia, but this was better). The rugelach comes in 3 flavors and is quite good too. Lee Lee’s strikes me as a true Harlem/NYC institution along with classic local spots like Sylvia’s that you have to try at least once.

Found this place while looking for dessert in Harlem. We tried a bit of half the shelf…very fresh and everyone enjoyed it. Cookies are on crispy end of spectrum but still very nutty w pecans and so good. Rugelach varieties are all good. Carrot muffin was so so good and I’m not even a huge fan of it…just fresh and moist.

Got some carrot cake(slice) and 2 cookies! I didn’t see Lee Lee but there was an old timer sitting right outside the store. When I entered it was like being in a candy store. I smelt the sugar and I saivated almost immediately. This place was one of my saved places.👌🏻
Excellent rugelach. The young man working the counter was friendly and engaging. There’s a nice variety of other baked goods as well.

reviews.snippet:

Traditional Harlem bakery - best rugelaugh in nyc (super tasty and nicest baker / owner). Definitely worth the visit. All other pastries looked nice too and so adorable.
Owner is lovely and the apricot rugelach was delicious, definitely recommend. I also got a yummy peanut butter cookie.

reviews.snippet: We went to Tropical Sensation to celebrate the grand opening of Athena's World Travel. We had a group of 6 people and all 6 of us agree that everything about our experience was wonderful. The atmosphere was great. Our server, Sharmaine, was amazing. The food was delicious. That was our first time at the restaurant and we plan to go back again and again. There were so many great items on the menu at affordable prices. The portions were very generous.

The Mompataio was really good, the flavors all came together really well and helped give moisture to the Fried Pork Chops. The Fatty parts of the Pork were very tasty as well. My spouse enjoyed her meal as well, the chicken was tender and worked with the caramelized onions with the bell peppers giving it some crunch. Overall, the textures here were good with the entrees, and I would definitely have the Mompataio again. Overall, it’s a casual dining experience, and kind of gives NYC Diner feel but with a Caribbean warmth.

media.caption: Fried pork chicken and rice dishes

reviews.snippet:
🌴✨ Tropical Sensation

A Little Taste of the Caribbean Right in the City!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

From the moment I sat down, I could already tell this spot had that authentic island soul warm energy, friendly staff, and plates that instantly make you feel like you’re somewhere tropical.

🥣 Starter: I began with the Sopa de Mariscos, a hearty seafood soup rich with flavor. It had that homemade Caribbean comfort the kind of broth that’s seasoned with love and a little heat, packed with tender seafood and depth.

🥑 Appetizer: The Maravilla Verde (green plantain stuffed with meat and topped with avocado, red onions, and a touch of citrus) was a star on its own. The onions added the perfect bite and the presentation was beautiful.

🍗 Main Course: For the entrée, I went with the Pechuga a la Parrilla grilled chicken breast served with crispy tostones and a little side slaw. The chicken was juicy, smoky, and brushed with that signature green sauce (definitely the highlight!). Everything felt fresh and flavorful.

🥕 Sides: The sautéed vegetables broccoli and carrots — were cooked perfectly, still crisp with just enough seasoning to balance the meal.

🍹Drinks & Dessert Menu: They’ve got a great drink list with house margaritas, sangrias, mojitos, and tropical cocktails that fit the vibe. And for dessert? Don’t miss the Dulce de Coco or Tres Leches Cake if you love a sweet ending.

Overall, Tropical Sensation delivers exactly what its name promises a vibrant, feel good Caribbean experience that hits all the senses. Whether you’re craving comfort food or a fun night out, this place brings island flavor to every bite. 💛🌴

📍Tropical Sensation
🍽️ Caribbean / Latin Cuisine
💫 Must-Try: Pechuga a la Parrilla + Sopa de Mariscos
📸 IG-worthy dish: Maravilla Verde

Came here on a Tuesday evening to celebrate my friends birthday. It’s a small place but there was definitely a booth seat in the back for my friend and I. My friend has been here prior and ordered the Pollo Parmigiana with rice and beans instead of pasta 😂 lol I ordered the Camarofongo and a side of white rice. My dish was decent. I probably wouldn’t order it again because the mashed fried plantain dome is a lot and thick-heavy. Flavors weren’t bad though. I’m pescatarian so maybe next time I’ll try a fish dish.

I ordered chicken, plantains and salad for my mom for takeout to bring to her. She really enjoyed it.
The food was good. The prices were great. I’d go back.

What a delightful and cozy restaurant!!! ✨✨The staff makes your eating experience so welcoming. The spices melt in my mouth, and my taste buds are leaping on delight. I'm so thankfully stuffed that I'm upset I can't eat all my food!! I love how the food is top quality at an affordable price. As a New Yorker that's refreshing, since this is one of the most expensive cities in the country to live in. The struggle is real but God is bigger. This dish was the stew goat + sweet plantain with French fries at the side. This is my second time here, and I cannot wait to come back. Great food with even greater people. I pray they continue to be blessed, and even more prosperous than they already have been. The passionate servants heart is poured into the ambiance and every single dish served. I highly recommend this amazing restaurant.

Love Rosa Pizza. The variety makes me want to try all of them. There is something for everyone's taste palette. The cashier was very kind and welcoming. Great atmosphere. I'll keep coming here for my 🍕. I recommend them to everyone i know.

Great healthy slices here! Somehow this newly constructed place has pizza that feels healthier to my body. Just good solid quality food. It’s not overly seasoned, they could work on that bit, but it’s excellent excellent basic ingredients that taste good and feel fresh and healthy. That’s why I’ll he coming here again and again.

Good pizza at a good price. I usually just grab a slice of the pepperoni or the square tomato sauce slice.

Super fresh toppings! I had the Buffalo Chicken slice! It was full of chicken and the slice was super filling! The atmosphere is also relaxing! The staff is friendly as well. Reg. Cheese slice $3 w/ toppings $6.50.

Would also be great if they carried slices of cheesecake, chocolate mousse, and other specific treats.

Layout/atmosphere

Food/drink
*Steamed Pork Dumplings (with soy sauce) - Good

Food was mediocre and expensive for what you get. (realistically like three stars. ) I did not tip and the lady was really pissed and yelled at me. Glad I didn’t tip.

Had the pork dumplings and cold sesame noodles. I’ve been looking for noodles like this for a long time! They are so delicious and have the perfect amount of sauce on them. The dumplings tasted very home made in the best meaning of the word! They tasted so fresh. I was served very quickly and got my food quickly.

I highly recommend this place if you’re in the area. I’ll be back to try the other dishes for sure.

Note: I spent about $20 on both the noodles and the dumplings, and it made me quite full.
Depends on timing, the food is really good and lots of vegetarian options. Sadly the flavor tend to be inconsistent, often bland. More geared towards folks who can’t handle spice.

response.snippet: Richard, thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We appreciate your feedback about our vegetarian options and understand your concern about the flavor consistency. We hope to welcome you back soon for a better experience.

reviews.snippet: Absolutely DELICIOUS soup dumplings! I can't even make myself try new things because they're so yummy, although I'm sure everything else is just as good.

response.snippet: Nikki, thank you so much for your kind words about our soup dumplings! We're delighted to hear that you find them absolutely delicious. We take great pride in crafting these dumplings to perfection. While the soup dumplings have certainly won your heart, we'd love for you to also try our other signature dishes like the Dan Dan Noodles on your next visit. Looking forward to welcoming you back soon!

reviews.snippet: Really cool spot! I’m pretty sure the owners are the same as Wu and Nus, but the Dan Dan noodles are equally as tasty. Service was really nice, and the vibes were immaculate!

response.snippet: Hi Alexa, thank you for the kind words! We're thrilled you enjoyed the Dan Dan noodles and had a great experience with our service and atmosphere. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

reviews.snippet: My girl and I had the pork and kimchi soup dumplings (6),its her fav at this spot. I enjoyed the soup in the dumplings, a bit tangy from the hint of kimchi flavor. The rice cake was good and big meat. Overall cute place but kind of expensive. ($46)

Been here twice so far, the first time I got veggie dumplings based on other reviews and beef pancake wrap-YUM. The second time I ate here I got pan fried dumplings and those blew the veggie dumplings out of the water!! Delish :) great place in Morningside to get dumplings. Looking forward to trying some of their other menu items. Both times food has been hot and fresh.

address: 2220 Frederick Douglass Blvd, New York, NY 10026

reviews.snippet:
Great bar in Harlem with an extensive selection of gin that I love. The cocktails and bar bites were absolutely delicious. This is definitely my new neighborhood spot!
The owner Marco is a sweetheart and makes you feel welcome.

An impressive selection of 80+ gins from all over the world. Sat at the bar with 4 friends, we each selected a gin that spoke to us, had G&Ts and discussed tasting notes. The perfect way to spend a Sunday afternoon. Service was lovely. Space is small with only 12 seats at the bar but even when it filled up we were very comfortable. And if you're not into gin they still have all the lovely Spanish wines and a wide selection of every other liquor too. A welcome addition to the neighborhood.
Incredible gin bar with top notch service with cozy welcoming vibe. If you’re a gin fan do the 4-sampler. Totally worth it.

reviews.snippet: I travel around the world, and this is the best food I had in a long time. This restaurant is worth of a Michelin star! Amazing!
Fantastic. I had the Sea Bass! Oh my goodness delicious 🤤
My favorite new spot in Harlem! Great drinks, great vibes & great company 😊
The most elegant bar and restaurant in Harlem. Carefully crafted cocktails, wonderful service, beautiful food.

reviews.snippet:
This was one of the best meals I’ve had in a while. Balanced, delicious, fragrant, hot, and satisfying. Came here on a very frigid Sunday, and even though it was *freezing* out I was still shocked there weren’t more folks here because the food is so delicious.

Cynthia was our server and she was so sweet and fun to chat with!

We started with the meatballs. They smelled so incredible we cut one in half before I remembered to get a picture. Nothing has made me want to learn to make meatballs like these did. They held their shape, but were nearly fall apart tender, and also so juicy. The red sauce they were sitting in was incredibly flavorful. The bread was soft and crispy at the edges - I only wished I had more.

We got the brunch cotoletta and the waffle cotoletta. The breaded pork chop was so wonderfully crispy and tender. I can also be very picky about hollandaise, but loved theirs. Rich, a touch tangy, and not overly thick. The arugula salad on top of my cotoletta brought an appreciated lightness and balance to the whole dish. The thinly sliced green apple brought a touch of sweetness that also paired well with the flavors of the pork chop and the hollandaise. The poached eggs were cooked to perfection. Loads of liquid gold to dip my pork chop in!

To top it all off we got to try their tiramisu. My partner doesn’t love tiramisu but enjoyed this one!

I can’t wait to come back and try their pizza.

media.caption: Crispy pork cutlet with arugula salad, poached eggs with hollandaise, and lemon wedges
Breaded Pork chop with waffles and hot honey butter
Breaded pork chop and waffles with hot honey butter and maple syrup

reviews.snippet:
I visited this place to watch a soccer match, but had a very unpleasant experience.

A female server repeatedly ignored my attempts to order, interrupted me several times, and was very rude throughout my visit.

The way I was treated felt discriminatory and made me feel unwelcome. Because of this experience, I have no intention of returning.
Honestly the best pizza I’ve had in New York to date. We shared the St Nic and it was brilliant, already looking forward to working my way through the rest of the menu.

My husband stumbled upon a Reddit post that listed all of the best pizza places in the city, broken out by categories. Being pizza aficionados ourselves, we scrolled the list and agreed with many of his choices. 314 was one of the places he mentioned and when we looked it up, were pleasantly surprised how close it was to our apartment. We just went there for date night and totally understand why it made the list. The pizza was outstanding, as well as the burger, the ambiance was cozy yet lively and the staff was genuine, attentive and friendly. Our waiter, Ed, cared deeply about our experience at the restaurant and it really showed. We will be back!
Best restaurant in the neighborhood by far. Pizza is amazing, food authentic and delicious and I love seating at the bar to try all of their crafted cocktails. Great experience every time

response.snippet:
Lorenzo, your kind words about our food and the bar truly make our team’s efforts feel worthwhile.

It’s wonderful to know you’ve had such consistently enjoyable visits, and we’re grateful to be your neighborhood spot.

With gratitude,
314

reviews.snippet: best pizza ive had in nyc, better than l'industrie imo but I prefer neopolitan style pizza. staff is amazingly attentive, pizza dough is perfectly chewy and fluffy, and great variety with different pizza offerings. only downside is can be kinda loud when doors are open or eating outdoors because of the elevated train station next door, sometimes sticklers for grammar but otherwise a really great experience! would recommend dining in over takeout, as the pizza is best piping hot. highly recommend!

I must say 3 1 4 was such a pleasant surprise, I sorta underestimated it. I came here to grab a cocktail after having some ramen not too far from this location. I must say the cocktails 👌🏽 perfect, amazing, delicious and so well balanced. I enjoy cocktail bars with mixologists that blow your mind away & don’t leave that brick oven pizza out everyone raves about.

They have live jazz every Wednesday at 7pm ! ✨

The gnocchi al fungi was 10/10. Very filling and delicious. The pizza was okay, wasn't anything unique or amazing.
We went on a weekday so it wasn't crowded. The place is clean and quiet, and the service is great. We didn't like the small table they had us at so the server moved us to a larger table. The cozy and dim vibe would be perfect for date nights.

Yummy pizza, good price. Dough is really good especially if you dine in. Ordered the Bari pizza and will totally recommend. MSM students get 10% discount! Gnocchi specials was very soft and tasty too.

Love their cocktail illustrations in their menu!

This is a perfect little Italian date night spot! Totally a hidden gem in Morningside Heighs, it’s literally 16 minutes uptown on the 1 train and is serving up very high quality wood fire oven pizza and several legit pasta dishes! 🍝

You can seriously taste the difference of a wood fire oven pizza versus not and their dough is homemade, light and airy. And they even have gluten free options. Dinner at the bar is also an option, their drink menu is kinda wild.

Here were some menu highlights:

🍕 Columbia Pie: Vodka sauce, mozzarella, grana, double basil pesto
🍝 Gemelli: Fresh pasta with shrimp, tomato sauce, burrata, spicy peppers, spinach
🍄 Orecchiette: Broccoli rabe and ricotta pesto, sundried tomatoes, pecorino, fried mushrooms
🥃 Trick or Treat: Rye whiskey with cinnamon, Campari, honey, and Nardini Amaro

good lasagna. Very mediocre pizza. Spongy dough, not served hot, good toppings and generous serving, but the crust was not at all tasty. Reasonable cocktails. If you avoid the pizza, the place seems like a decent bet.

My girlfriend found this restaurant on Inkind and realized that their pizza was highly recommended! We ended up at the restaurant for brunch and the brunch menu caught our attention! I got the waffle cotoletta & she got the brunch cotoletta. The amount of food is amazing for the prices. Our dishes were beyond delicious. Cannot wait to come back and try the pizzas. Don’t forget to get the meatballs- they’re to die for!!! Also our server, Cynthia gave us their tiramisu which again delicious.
It’s a nice place but very loud and sometimes hard to hear one’s dinner companions. The pizza is good but I like a crisper crust. Great arugula salad with hazelnuts. High quality friendly service!

Pizza was excellent and the staff were very friendly and accommodating. Atmosphere was also very nice. It’s a tight seating arrangement and no air conditioning. I wasn’t too crazy about the baked clams appetizer. Not a lot of flavor and some sand. I was expecting more like clams casino and these were definitely not.

Great pizza and pasta. Tiramisu is light and fluffy ( amazing ). Bartender is one legit dude and wish him the best!

Highly recommend 314!

response.snippet: Scott, we really appreciate your opinion. We try to do our best both in the kitchen and behind the bar. We love and cry when someone appreciates it. Grazie and we hope to see you soon

reviews.snippet: Everything you want in a restaurant: delicious food and drinks, friendly and attentive waitstaff, nice clean atmosphere, consistently updated specials. You can tell everyone wants to be there and takes pride in their work which adds to the experience.

Great neighborhood spot for pizza.
Tried it many times and my family loves it.
Friendly staffs and good Atmosphere with a real pizza oven. Very delicious dough.
Casual Italian restaurant in Harlem. Good servings but food or quite there for me. Really good service and prices #Harlem #NYC

response.snippet:
Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us and letting us know our team made you feel welcome. We’re always aiming to create a more satisfying dining experience and appreciate hearing where we can do better to get your 5stars. Grazie and please come back for another Bar314 experience!

All our best,
Bar314

reviews.snippet:
The place is very nice for all kind of occasions. But the food!!! The food is AMAZING! We have pizza Babba OMG it will blow your mind, brick oven definitely make the difference.

We had so many plates… frutti di mare, arancini, burrata, pasta and porchetta!! delizioso!! Delicious. Tks chef.

Wine recommend it by a lovely waitress: Super Toscana. Tks Roberta, So on point!!

Had Calamari and Orecchiette with sausage. Perfect. The pasta was amazing, the pesto ricotta mixed with grated cheese, sundried tomatoes, and especially the deep fried mushrooms (a bacon-like flavor) created a well balanced flavor profile which was incredibly delicious! The Calamari was nice and lightly crunchy. Not very busy on a Sunday lunch, service was great. (I know the photo looks gross but thats after I made a mess of it!) Its really good

I was walking around the upper part of Central Park and decided to exit on 110th street to find food and drinks. Using Google Maps, I walked over to Cafe Amrita on 110th.
It is a large space with ample seating inside. There is a large bar back on the right side.
I got a turkey cheese wrap with chips and ice tea.
Wrap tasted fresh and the tea was not sweet as I ordered.
The vibe is very nice and I could see they had a lot of regular customers.

This combo bar and coffee shop with long hours could be in any European or South American capitol - but we New Yorkers are lucky it's here. A nice place for Columbia students to study, and for working dudes who drink beer and watch the game on a big TV. Great neighborhood feel. ❤️

Truly enjoy every time!
Breakfast is filling and tastes great. Love the hot chocolate and enjoy the teas!

You can order takeout!
The lunch is great, well served and perfectly packed to go!

Great place to go study, read, and have a chocolate chip muffin with coffee. There is outside sitting, there is acholic beverages, and fruits.

Overall, GREAT place, especially to start your day.
