Egg & Cheese Sandwich with Ham on a Bagel 🥚 🧀 🥯

reviews.snippet: If I could give this cafe negative stars, I would. I came across this space due to it being open later than other cafes & fairly reasonable prices. Size is quite large & seemingly a good place to do some reading & writing. The first time was fine, just grabbed a tea. Second time grabbed a cookie. Today, I just attempted to complete a 3rd visit only for the rude man behind the register to come to my table asking if "I wanted anything & I hadn't bought anything". This only after 2 minutes of me sitting down, attempting to wait out the crowd formed at the register. I then told him that I will come up only for him to rudely spat, "You only bought a cookie last time". I've never experienced anything like this. Beyond the fact that I'm being surveilled & pressured to buy things I do not want, the service is not great, cleanliness is not of standard & staff is not welcoming. A woman sitting next to me also witnessed what occurred and was very disturbed by that behavior. We both cut our visits short. No customer should ever have to deal with hostile environments created by business owners. This is a terribly ran business.

I often get my bike repaired next door at Larry's Freewheeling. Always see a crowd in this cafe, and finally check it out after a decade. It was my first AND last time. Service was mid; took a long time with zero sense of urgency. The coffee tastes burnt and bitter - I didn't finish the iced latte. The bagel was incredibly sad for an NYC bagel, and lacked an NYC amount of schmear.
I'm glad I tried it! I just won't be going back. If you're looking for coffee nearby - highly recommendimg Superhet Coffee!!

Server brought menu to others AT the table while insisting I come up to the counter for the menu and stand there to order; perhaps they were regulars. Ask for my oatmilk latte to be served in a ceramic cup since I was sitting at a table and staying to eat, got a paper cup instead and when I ask for ceramic was told I get more in a paper cup. Even after an 18% tip, I can't get the ceramic cup which cools faster and doesn't come with the papercup/waxy smell and taste. There was no offer to warm my scone which DID come on a ceramic small plate!

I’ve been a loyal patron of Amrita Cafe for over eight years, and it never disappoints! The atmosphere is consistently pleasant, with a delightful mix of classical music, jazz, and even some modern pop or hip-hop. The staff, especially the cashiers, are always friendly and attentive, making you feel right at home.

The culinary highlights are truly remarkable. The chef’s skills shine through in my go-to order: the bacon, egg, and cheese on a croissant. It's always delicious! And I can't forget to mention the cappuccino—it's consistently on point and has become a bit of an obsession for me. The fresh cookies are a must-try, with the chocolate chip cookie reigning supreme, closely followed by the oatmeal cookie.

Conveniently located on 110th St. by Central Park, Amrita Cafe is perfect whether you're looking to enjoy breakfast or lunch inside or take your drink outside to soak in the park's beauty. It’s truly the perfect little café for the area! Highly recommended!

I've heard of this place for lunch, unfortunately all I did was to have a coffee and brownie and were very yummy. Def will liek to come back and give a try to the food. The only thing is that when I was there, most tables and chairs had food crumbs. The staff saw me cleaning and changing tables and didn't bother to come clean. Other than that it was ok. A 3 overall start rating beacuse I did not have a full experience. Once I get ill adjust accordingly.

Your average neighborhood cafe and bar. Stopped by for a hot coffee and small bite on a cold winter morning.
Smiley friendly staff and fast service.
Affordable prices.
Came here both mornings during my short stay in NYC. Very friendly, attentive staff. Tasty coffee & cozy atmosphere. A lovely landmark of my trip

This is my favorite post-run spot. They don’t allow dogs which is my only complaint! Otherwise, it’s great. The vibe is great and the bacon, egg and cheese croissants are delicious. The coffee is okay. This is an amazing place to watch football games.
I ordered a Jay's Jeepney and blueberry scone. Service was great. Cute, Paris-style vibes. Great place to sit in the window and people watch.
Coffee and food were made to order and fresh. Seating was a bit limited for large groups such as mine. Otherwise service was great.
Very good brunch spot that's open early! The brioche french toast and eggs benedict were good. It's good if you want to sit outside with your dog too.
Was ok food but service could be better specially because you are obliged to tip for “service”

Very rude barista. He was rude from the start when I was placing an order. I came to enjoy a coffee, and work a bit while I wait for my husband. Horrible experience.
Brilliant coffee, friendly staff and delicious food. Breakfast brunch lunch or dinner. Whether I'm in the mood for a morning coffee or a salad and sangria (white or red), this is where I'm heading.

I walked in with my dog in my backpack with only his head popping out, there was a large husky dog in the restaurant so i figured he’d be fine and no one said anything otherwise so I ordered a drink. The waitress then proceeded to make my drink and when eventually i was called to get my drink she THEN informs me no dogs were allowed. when i pointed out there was already a dog in the establishment she told me it was a “service animal” however the dog was walking all around the bar without any insignia indicating it was a service animal. She ruined my comfortability here and didnt make me feel welcome at there place. Not a good way to make people feel welcome at your establishment.

This place feels like home every time. Love hanging out here. The owner is the nicest man, very kind and caring. Good quality hookahs and delicious beverages.

This place is amazing, i have frequented them for years. Very authentic hookah bar. No alcoholic beverages, but the hookahs make up for the lack of alcohol and very affordable.

This establishment is crooked & is robbing the people in the community!! There's a senior citizen building across the street & they are price gouging their items in the store!! They are charging taxes on food & They are charging extra charges if you're using a credit card!! One morning I purchased 3 breakfast sandwiches and a coffee!! One of my favorite ❤ stores in the neighborhood the FATHER and Son are cooler than a fan... The morning guy on the grill is the best!! They have a good selection of IPA BEERS 🍺

name: The Fox Harlem
address: 2224 Frederick Douglass Blvd, New York, NY 10026

reviews.snippet:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The Fox in Harlem is an absolute gem! From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed by a warm, stylish atmosphere that perfectly captures the energy and character of the neighborhood. The food is outstanding—every dish is beautifully presented, packed with flavor, and clearly made with fresh, high-quality ingredients.

The service was exceptional from start to finish. The staff was friendly, attentive, and genuinely made us feel like valued guests. Whether you’re stopping in for brunch, dinner, or cocktails, this is a place that delivers an incredible experience every time.

If you’re exploring Harlem or looking for a fantastic place to eat in New York City, The Fox should be at the top of your list. Great food, amazing service, and a vibrant atmosphere make this an easy five stars. Highly recommended—we’ll definitely be back!

response.snippet: Thank you so much Bran for taking the time to send a review. We are so glad you enjoyed your time with us at The Fox and look forward to seeing you again soon! Cheers!

reviews.snippet: Went here on a Saturday night. Atmosphere was chill and the staff were very welcoming and kind. The Angus burger was delicious, cooked how I ordered it, and I think their chipotle aioli was made in house (if not, it was still good). Sweet potato fries were okay but came out quite hot which I appreciate. Fun music was playing but it was plenty soft enough to have an easy conversation with your party. 9 TVs. Cool spot, definitely recommend.

response.snippet: Guillermo thank you so much for your review. We are so glad you enjoyed your time at The Fox and look forward to seeing you again soon. Cheers!

reviews.snippet: Spent a Friday evening here. Arrived with no one here and still had to wait almost 30 minutes for a draft. Service is exceptionally slow and the food is a joke. We received about 10 chips to go with their $12 guacamole and salsa. Fine if you are just coming for a drink, I guess.

I gave this place more than one chance, and unfortunately my experiences kept getting worse.
The service has consistently been disappointing. The bartender frequently leaves the bar to socialize with regular patrons or handle other matters while customers are left waiting to be served. As someone who isn't a regular, I never felt welcomed. The atmosphere seemed much friendlier toward familiar faces than new customers.
On a previous visit, I ordered the mango habanero wings. To my surprise, only two wings were hot. The rest were refrigerator cold, as if they had never been heated properly. I've never had an order served like that anywhere else.
My most recent visit was even more concerning. My bill was $25.05, and because I was dissatisfied with the service, I intentionally left a $0 tip. I wrote "$0" on the tip line, "$25.05" on the total line, signed the receipt, and kept my copy.
Two days later, I received a Cash App notification that my completed charge had increased from $25.05 to $30.05. I disputed the unauthorized $5 increase and submitted my signed receipt showing the $0 tip and $25.05 total. Cash App investigated the matter and resolved the dispute in my favor, refunding the $5.
Whether the overcharge resulted from a mistake or something else, customers should always keep their receipts and compare them to the final amount that posts to their account.
Between the inattentive service, cold food, and payment issue, I have no reason to recommend this establishment.

response.snippet:
Ashar:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are genuinely sorry to hear that your visits to The Fox did not meet your expectations.

As the owners, who live in the neighborhood it is our goal to create a friendly but still professional restaurant.

Regarding your concern about the credit card charge, we appreciate you bringing it to our attention. We take payment accuracy very seriously and have no interest in charging a guest incorrectly. While we cannot determine what occurred based solely on a Google review, we would welcome the opportunity to review the transaction and investigate what happened. If you are willing, please contact me directly with the date and approximate time of your visit and a check number if you have it, so we can look into it thoroughly. Susannah@lidoharlem.com is my email. I hope to hear from you.

We value all guest feedback because it helps us improve, and we appreciate you taking the time to let us know about your experience.

reviews.snippet: This place is a good spot for the happy hour after-work drinks during the week or to watch a game. The staff were polite and provided good service. The food from happy hour menu was hit-or-miss, with the beef sliders being a highlight, while the loaded tater tots were hard and the chicken taco was flavorless.
Got the nachos with chicken and all the flavors of wings (mango chili was so fire). Food and service were pretty solid, ambiance was pretty classic for a sports bar

response.snippet: Thank you Saaketh. We are glad you enjoyed your time with us at The Fox. We look forward to seeing you again soon. Cheers!

reviews.snippet: Really nice workers but the food is a scam, avoid it. Our guac was barely a tablespoon…unbelievable.

The fox is convenient. The food is always tasty. The atmosphere is always cool collective vibes. The neighborhood is vibrate. This is a great location for happy hour. Small dinners, family get together, etc. I recommend this.

response.snippet: Thank you Kevin. We are so glad you are enjoying The Fox. We look forward to seeing you again soon. Cheers!

reviews.snippet:
Since visiting New York City, The Fox has truly become our place. It actually opened around the same time we were on vacation, and we randomly decided to check it out , best decision ever. From that first visit, it was amazing.

We met Chris, the manager, and he really sets the tone for the whole place. He’s personable, welcoming, and genuinely cares about the experience. You can tell he runs it with intention.

What started as a spot we visited on vacation turned into our “backyard” after we moved here. We literally live right down the street now and come in often!!! watch games, hang out, and unwind. It’s never just a quick stop, it’s always a good time. The atmosphere is fun, welcoming, and consistent every single time.

The staff is incredible. We’ve met so many great people here, and at this point we can honestly say some of them have become close friends. That says a lot about the kind of environment The Fox creates.

And the food? Always great. The vibe? Always right. The energy? On point.

Nothing bad to say just a solid, consistent five-star experience all around. If you’re in the area, this place is a must.

response.snippet: Tina - Thank you so much for the amazing review. We strive to be a favorite neighborhood space with good food and great vibes. So glad to hear you are enjoying The Fox! Cheers!

reviews.snippet: I was referred to this restaurant by a sister restaurant lido, lido is so exceptional so I knew the fox would be amazing. But unfortunately it wasn’t very good at all. I felt the service was very slow in general, but my biggest craving was steak and eggs. The potato’s … perfect. Eggs good. But the steak. I asked for medium rare. I wanted that bad boy bleeding. But I was served a well done steak that was definitely cooked in an air fryer and not a grill. So disappointed. That’s all I can say,

response.snippet:
Hello Joe
I am so sorry that you were disappointed in The Fox. We definitely strive to keep all three of our restaurants at the same level. We are always happy to replace anything if it isn't to your liking. I will share your feedback with the team. We hope that you do give us another try.
Sincerely,
Fox Team

reviews.snippet: Cool Tight Spot American Food Menu Drinks Are Strong Nice Cool Vibe

Enjoyed a great happy hour at The Fox Harlem. The bartender was amazing and very friendly. Our food was sooooo good we ordered another round. Sliders, wings and fries all excellent. We even met the owners! They are both women and fantastic. Highly recommend!

response.snippet: Hello Kortney Thank you so much for the review We are so glad you enjoyed the food, drinks, and hospitality at The Fox. We look forward to welcomign you back again very soon!

reviews.snippet: Tonight heading out to the iconic Apollo Theater we stopped for a bite to eat. The Fox Harlem has good solid bar food. The butterfly shrimp and the angus burger were both cooked well and delicious. Unfortunately that was the best of the night. The coffee after dinner was old and burnt. I am a coffee lover and will forgive a lot but not that. As for dessert, you’re better off flagging a Mr. Softee truck because they only have one dessert and they were out of it. You could do better than The Fox - but you could do worse

Nice sports bar in Harlem. Plenty of tvs and quite spacious. Was there on a sat afternoon and there was a nice crowd, service is excellent, food is ok, a little greasy and I didnt like the fact that my sandwich didn't come with fries. Also no cash which is a negative so I'll give it a 4 out of 5

The food wasn’t really to my taste, but the atmosphere was amazing. If I lived in New York, I’d want to come here every time there’s a basketball game. The staff were also incredibly lovely and friendly.
I had brunch with my Uncle and I was very pleased with the service. On a Saturday afternoon, everything was great.

response.snippet: Ray - We are so glad you enjoyed your time with us at The Fox this past weekend. Thank you for taking the time to write a review! We look forward to seeing you again soon.

reviews.snippet:
Favorite neighborhood spot and I don’t even like sports. All the staff is so great. Chris will remember your name and your drink and make you feel like you’re part of the team.

Go for happy hour - they have great food specials. Don’t sleep on the nachos or vegan wings

response.snippet: Caitlyn- thank you so much for taking the time to review. We are so glad you are enjoying The Fox. See you soon!

reviews.snippet: 3pm Happy Hour! It's early, and that's cool, but nothing to write home about. 'Hot' wings had no heat. Mozzarella sticks were standard freezer-to-fryer fare, but came out hot and crunchy. Went at 3pm and found staff friendly, but inattentive. $25 for 4 wings, 4 mozzarella sticks, and a beer. Content Hour, at best.

response.snippet: Thank you for taking the time to review The Fox. We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.snippet:
Casual, sport bar at this intersection in Harlem.
Many photos of sport personal on the wall of this bar with black and white stripes. Not pricey, I went during happy hour.
The staff are friendly and service was excellent.
Plenty of seating including patio.

Stop by if you are walking by, highly recommend

response.snippet:
Thank you Hasanain for leaving a review. We are glad you enjoyed our sports bar!
Cheers

reviews.snippet: Ample large flat screens to watch the World Cup matches, but my burger was made by a chef that definitely didn't take any pride in cooking--- bun was soggy, lettuce was limp and fries were overcooked. I would think twice about returning.

raw_place.title: The Fox Harlem
raw_place.address: 2224 Frederick Douglass Blvd, New York, NY 10026

reviews.snippet: This is simply the most wonderful, familial, and bustling bar to find on the upper west side. With drag bingo, open mic nights, as well as trivia by the resident host, Zach—you are bound to have a swell time. Engorge the vegetarian hot dogs during happy hour, enjoy the frozen margaritas and seasonal ciders, and don’t forget to say hi to the bar’s fishies.

Fun atmosphere not as “Dive” as I thought (from the name) it was actually kind of done up the ceiling and fixtures were really interesting perhaps restored not sure the history of the space but it was more Glam/Dive. I was there for a friend of friends fundraising drag bingo… We got our drinks easily (even though the place was packed to standingroom. staff was friendly.

We accidentally spilled two entire Guinness and the owner and bartenders were so understanding and kind about it afterwards— we still had such an incredible night and this place has an incredible energy! Can’t recommend enough! Great crowd :)

Two daytime visits. Perfect dive bar atmosphere. The bartenders were very nice and knowledgeable, drink food recommendations were excellent. Their service was fast and friendly. The food here is fantastic bar food. The burgers are excellent. Fries and tots crispy and hot, perfectly seasoned. Grilled chicken sandwich was also delicious. I was very surprised at the quality of the fries and tots. This place is great and will become a staple for my wife and I. Thanks for the great establishment for us to visit!!!

Update: still love this place!
I had about 5 drinks in here whilst on a solo trip from abroad (2024). Bartenders were cool and they had a good selection. Top quality bar I’d do my best to become a regular if I lived nearby
Awesome time I spent here last nite. Very friendly crowd

Whether you are a professor, student or not, if you live anywhere near Columbia University, you really need to head over to Dive 106 (located on Amsterdam Ave. at 106th St.) for a great selection of beers on tap, cocktails, whiskeys and wholesome, fresh, and satisfying pub food. In my opinion, they have the best chili dog and wings around!! They also have a very nice Happy Hour and the bartenders are welcoming and cordial!! This is Not your typical dive bar, though. It is actually a beautiful space. The beautiful and decorative tin ceiling is the original ceiling from many many years ago. Rumor has it, the place has been a bar since 1949. The owners of the bar today, restored the ceiling back to its original splendor. And it really makes an impression! Don’t miss out!!

response.snippet:
Hi Michael,

We are so happy that you appreciate all we've done to make Dive 106 great. We think the space is really awesome and all of our staff works hard to put out a product we can be proud of from drinks, food, ambience, and service. Hope to see you back real soon.

Cheers,

Lee, Nick and Howie

reviews.snippet:
Ordered a simple soup salad and mac n cheese. What I received was horrible. The soup was super oily and separated. There was no salad and the mac n cheese was just messy. Nothing about this order was appealing and speaking to the management was of no use.

I don't know how they received 4.5stars. This was definitely a 1 service.
I love all the Dive bars — really good balance of great beers, good food, fun atmosphere, neighborhood vibe, friendly staff, and a good mixed crowd. Highly recommended!

Had been here for drinks and a quick bite. Not many options for cocktails so went for a frozen margarita which was good. We ordered fries which were nice and crispy. However we didn't quite like the chicken tenders in buffalo sauce. The chicken was not fresh, was dry and rubbery. This was recommended by the waitress so I was expecting something good but it wasn't worth one bite.

I like the Dive bar mini chain - I think there's 3 on the upper west side. That said, it's a bit of confusing Manhattan situation. The place looks like a dive - very divy decor and you can wear anything but it's still Manhattan so the beers are $6-9 - is that a dive price? Well the atmosphere is definitely not pretentious like too many other places...

response.snippet:
We appreciate you enjoying our bars, but you fail to mention the beers we carry that are inexpensive , Bud and Bud lite, Genny Crream Ale, and Miller and we also offer a few cost conscious beer and shot deals. also we boast of an awesome happy hour. All that being said Manhattan being Manhattan rents, labor costs being what they are we we do the best we can to serve the Upper West Side we appreciate your patronage.

Cheers,

Lee

reviews.snippet: Good bar with friendly waitstaff and a good selection of beers and rotating drafts. There is a rather large menu (especially for a bar) and the kitchen is open until 2am. I didn't order any of the food though (dinner plans elsewhere). Will return to try it and enjoy the happy hour specials.

Nice vibe for friends and couples, and even single creepy people like me ( solo ), I have tried the classic grilled cheese with fries with a Bud light beer, all good and the waiter was friendly. The setting arrangement is cool with many out tables in air.
They have a convenient outdoor seating area with heaters. Their turkey burger with fries is great, and there are many drinks to choose from.

I've had drinks here before but never food. I walked past in the morning and saw they had a lunch special, select sandwiches with a side salad or fries, $9.00!!!!!!!
Food and service is excellent! Especially sitting near the open windows on a beautiful spring day!

response.snippet: Thanks for the support, Carol! We loved having you here for our lunch special. We love sitting by the windows, too! -Cheers from Lee, Nick, and Howie

reviews.snippet: I want the world to know that this is the best matza ball soup you will ever try. My grandmother has been making this soup for me for over 25 years and her recipe is amazing but I have to say after trying this Mexican matza ball soup I was just in heaven. Also the staff is super friendly and the bar is very clean. Music isn’t crazy loud and over all it was a great experience. Thank you Dive 106

This place saved the day after our unpleasant experience literally across the street, and on my birthday celebration with friends.

I normally would have looked up reviews of a place first before deciding but we really needed to just go somewhere else. Imagine our surprise when we were welcomed right away and attended to immediately, despite the place being busy. Thank you, Max! :) Upon settling in, we all agreed that we like the place, so out of curiosity, I looked up their reviews, and wow, 5-stars all the way! Living up to people's reviews it seems!

Overall, we really loved the vibe of the place and the staff, it just makes you want to stay and enjoy the rest of the night. Fast forward to almost 4 hours later, you can imagine how many more round of drinks we've had, plus we enjoyed their nachos with grilled chicken and yummy fries!

The music was great and as the rest of the evening went on, the place became even more packed! Service and staff didn't slow down and we were attended to from start to finish. You just earned 5 new/more customers and regulars, Dive106! We're definitely coming back! =)

response.snippet: Joanne, we are so glad you were able to enjoy your celebration with us! Thanks for dropping in -- come back soon! -Cheers from Lee, Nick, and Howie

reviews.snippet: Great service, and awesome spot to hangout :) this whole chain of bars is incredible.

My fiancé & I went on our first date here in 2019. When we got engaged, my fiancé decided to surprise me with a party here to celebrate. The owners were so kind to us and helped us to throw the best engagement celebration.
I would give this bar 0 stars if I had the option. Waitstaff is super rude and disrespectful. Just a terrible experience overall.

Italian sandwich… salami was bologna or some kind of mystery meat. I asked the girl on the phone when i ordered for pickup if coldcuts are precut or sliced. She said sliced fresh so i asked for thincut boars head ham. This doesnt even look safe to eat let alone like boars head.

response.snippet:
We’re sorry that your sandwich did not meet your expectations. We pride ourselves on using fresh ingredients and preparing orders carefully. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
We value your feedback and hope to serve you better in the future

reviews.snippet:
$3.00 for a quart of milk, after I said I was paying cash.
Apr 16, 2026. Most convenience stores charge more, I understand, but at similar stores in the area, $2.50 is the norm.
Last time I go there.

Columbia Deli

Layout/atmosphere
*Convenience store/deli; takeout only

Food/drink
*Amsterdam Special Sandwich (Spicy bologna & ham, tropical cheese, lettuce & tomato) - good; little greasy but didn’t take away from the sandwich
These guys carry charleston chew candy bars. Just dropping this review here so anyone searching google maps for them will have it turn up!

response.snippet: Thank you for the review

reviews.snippet: Super clean! Employees are very nice and accommodating. My sandwiches are always fresh and never greasy. Best deli in the neighborhood!!
HORRIBLE! And then they let anybody in the back that don't belong there !!!!
here the cashier tried to deceive me for $2
He said my card was declined although i had more than enough on it and called me broke infront of everyone and the said im just kidding, like such a bad customer service
got a smoothie, chopped cheese, and a gyro. everything was delicious. bust it up with the workers while i was waiting. cool spot
The best place in town they got the best chopped cheese. Fast service friendly staff. Love that place👍
They were rude and disrespectful. They told me the wrong price of the item. He cursed me out for no reason. I don't recommend anyone to go there.
The best deli in uper west side i like their chicken cutlet sandwich
Great place and the deli person are very good people 👍
Columbia deli is the best deli I ever seen they are very professional and clean store
Their chopped cheese is amazing !!!
The smoked turkey sandwich is our favorite, so so delicious!
Nice food and I appreciate the good service ❤️
Picked up my NY lottery!
Yummmy best food in town
The best deli in New york

Loved it here! The cardamom and lavender latte was great with both flavors coming through and not being too sweet. The signature Morningside sandwich was also rich and delicious. The space’s set-up is lovely, and the owner Aliyah was lovely to chat with and created such a welcoming atmosphere from walking in. Highly recommend!

media.caption: Iced cardamom and lavender latte and morningside breakfast sandwich

reviews.snippet:
I had an incredible experience at I Like It Black this past weekend. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm, welcoming, and full of genuine community. Aliyyah, the owner, was absolutely amazing—super friendly, engaging, and intentional with every person who came through the door. We had a great conversation, and it was clear how much heart she pours into her work and community.

The coffee was outstanding—beautifully crafted and full of flavor.

I also want to add that I’ve been a fan of Aliyyah’s bakery, Make My Cake, for many years now. I’ve visited countless times over the years, and the quality, consistency, and care have always been top tier. It’s no surprise that the same excellence and hospitality show up in her coffee shop as well.

If you’re in Harlem, both of these spots are absolute must-visits—exceptional products, authentic service, and a true sense of community. I’ll definitely be back.

response.snippet: Akera...Simply THANK YOU for the ❤️!! Look forward to you returning soon.

reviews.snippet: Extremely warm and inviting vibes, adorable aesthetic, and great service. Matcha is very high quality and they just started offering student discounts! Owner Aliya is a delight.

media.caption: Matcha latte with cookie and mug

reviews.snippet: LOVE THIS PLACE!! My friend got an iced matcha and I got the cardamom and lavender iced latte. Trinity (hope I’m spelling your name right!!) was so nice and sweet and suggested adding strawberry to the matcha which SET IT OFF!!! Trinity is such a lovely spirit and the drinks were delicious. Will be back!

My first time staying in Harlem and I stumbled on an incredible Black-owned coffee shop that was an absolute vibe. The owner radiates a vibrant, beautiful energy, the space is visually on point, and the coffee and food were outstanding.

I ordered the Morningside sandwich, a blueberry muffin, and an oat-milk latte—10/10 across the board. The hot-sauce kick on the “crisps everything” butter croissant was next-level, and that muffin has no business being that good.

Black ownership x Black & Brown coffee-maker supporters—you simply can’t go wrong here. I’ll definitely be back.

response.snippet: Thank you for spending time in our shop and the review! Have an amazing holiday season!

reviews.snippet: I love supporting Harlem black owned businesses! I go out my way to do so! First time here ! I had a latte & croissant sandwich! They had no cheese for the sandwich! My croissant was fresh and good ! Didn’t like the turkey bacon it’s the thin Oscar Meyer type! No menu to look at ! Had to look on the wall ! But everything there not listed! So the cashier had to tell me what they also had! She was nice and pleasant!

Awesome coffee, and awesome pastries!!! Muffins are some of the best I’ve tried, love the lemon poppy one! They aren’t too sweet which is awesome. Owner is super nice too, she struck up a convo with me and even offered to connect me with some people in my industry. Really nice environment and great service overall.

response.snippet: Thank you for your kind words. Look forward to seeing you soon!

reviews.snippet: I ordered a cardamom lavender latte iced I wish I had made it sweeter after tasting but felt I didn't want to be a bother. I have to become more assertive about getting things the way I enjoy them especially when using money to purchase it the whole point of any coffee or eating place is having a nice experience not feeling like ur being rushed or u have to compete for polite efficient service with other customers

Popped in for a matcha wasn’t expecting it to be 10 dollars. When receiving the drink realized it was fairly small given the high price tag. I understand matcha is a bit pricier but 10 dollars…that’s insane especially considering it’s not high grade tasting. Someone else came after paid 10 dollars for straight black coffee. The barista was nice though.

response.snippet: Hi Tenzin..$10 for drip?! That’s highly unlikely unless 6 shots of espresso was added. Matcha does remain one of our high grade quality, most loved beverage. Like our Famous Southern Cold Brew and Pumpkin Pie Vanilla Chai(you can get all year) price will spike once you add a non diary milk. Let’s not forget NYC sales tax. Thank you for stopping in and supporting. FYI 2026 will start college student discounts!

reviews.snippet: Nice little coffee shop. Didn’t have any of the food, although it looked quite good. I had the Cortado, which I was pleasantly surprised at the nice coffee flavor. Great service as well.

Beautiful new coffee shop in Harlem- I like It Black opened on March 1st and I sadly took until August to discover their delicious and delightful coffee

Owner Daniel was super polite, accommodating professional and nice.
The coffee was DELICIOUS - definitely the best coffee I have had in Harlem.

I was envious of the woman behind me who ordered a matcha lemonade that looked so refreshing. I will be back to try the food which looked delicious- avocado Turkey bacon - I am looking at you- and the strawberry iced tea

Super clean, lots of food and drink options, saw some freshly baked muffins cooking that looked delicious - nice owner- wonderful black owned business to support reasonable prices etc

———————— ———————— ————————
After discovering I Like It Black earlier this week, I had to go back ASAP with my partner to try their food. We were both super impressed by their coffee- both for the delicious taste and improved focus after- without the negative side effects we typically experience from drinking coffee from Starbucks or dunkin etc.,

I like it Black- has something for everyone, while their drip coffee was perfect black- they have oat milk and many fruity and refreshing tea and lemonade based drinks on the menu as well.

Whether you are served by the owner Daniel or one of his super delightful baristas (shout out to the amazing Amy) you will be welcomed warmly and treated with kindness. The atmosphere is good vibes here! And they were nothing but eager to answer all our questions about the menu and beans!

Now for the food- which man oh man was so- incredible!

You want to know my cure for the Monday- it's somehow still a pandemic- blues?!? - a breakfast sandwich made by the owner Daniel. Perspective changing delicious.

I HIGHLY recommend the Uptown Cristo- traditionally on a French toast muffin- I opted for a fresh baked blueberry muffin that was so perfectly grilled - ah I am drooling thinking about when I get to eat this again. I ordered my eggs fried with Gouda (SOO melty and perfect) with Turkey sausage patty on this delightfully grilled muffin. It was warm and comforting and filling - just the perfect way to start my day. I washed it down with their peach iced tea which was so refreshing! I like that it is unsweetened but

My guy had the Morningside breakfast sandwich- two eggs any style, avocado, cheese and a Turkey sausage on a croissant with hot sauce - he chose Swiss cheese which he enjoyed thoroughly! He liked the Turkey sausage as much as I did. He was as impressed as I was by the quality and taste of the food and coffee at I Like it Black. He even went in to chat with the owner about where they source their beans (see the beautiful large Merge Coffee Company bag- and hear the nice story behind the family owned company). Roasted frequently in small batches - it's fruity and tasty! You have to try it for yourself!

As a kid, I always loved waking up early on the weekends and getting to go with my dad for a treat at our local café. I would have loved if he brought me to I Like it Black - they have martinelli's apple juice - my favorite from childhood ! And a bakery with amazing cupcakes next door? Childhood heaven! I Like it Black is super dog friendly as they have plenty of benches and tables out front - and so my day was further brightened by a delicious meal enjoying my neighborhood and miring some precious pups

I Like it Black- I am so thankful you are here!

This place is warm/ receptive and black/copper-colored, like eye like my environments. The young lady, Trinity, is so pleasant and only adds to the great ambiance. Definitely was a great choice to visit and WILL be coming back and bringing some frens.

I give it a 5 stars for staff friendliness, coffee shop charm. The barista was v personable and let me stay past closing time. I don’t drink coffee so I got a chai latte and it was a 4/5. They use a boxed chai but wasn’t my favorite flavor. The pricing is fair. Would come back again and try their matcha and the baked shop next door.

Update: PHENOMENAL AGAIN!! I totally enjoyed my visit back!! Made the icing to my visit to NY sweet, again! 😊

This place was wonderful!! My family and I had the most amazing experience here. This family owned business made everyone that came in feel like they were special and cared for. I even bought a company t-shirt!

Finally got a chance to visit I Like It Black. I think the owner might have been working the coffee machine. The vibe was super friendly and welcoming. Great coffee and highly recommend the egg, cheese and avo croissant. We'll be back for the cupcakes next time 🎂
Amazing cozy spot esp. on a rainy day like today! The bakeshop next door is connected so a really great space, and the drip coffee + chocolate chip cookie was so delicious!

I stopped by to grab a cappuccino, cinnamon bun, and a muffin. Limited space, more like a to-go place.

☕️Cappuccino was great. Creamy and balanced taste.

Cinnamon bun was delicious as well. Moist and doughy texture. Rich one.

Muffin was slightly dry for me.

I recently purchased a tres leches cake from this bakery, and unfortunately, it was a terrible experience. The cake reeked of spoilage and tasted just as bad, making it obvious that it was expired. Tres leches is supposed to be rich, moist, and indulgent, but this was the exact opposite—it was unsafe to even consume!

When I buy from a bakery, I expect freshness and quality, but this was a huge disappointment. Selling expired goods is not only unprofessional but also a serious health risk to customers.

I urge the bakery to review their quality control practices immediately, because this experience has completely lost them my trust. I won’t be coming back unless drastic changes are made.

You can modify it depending on how formal or informal you want to sound!

I like this place so much … I even applied to work here. With my non-barista skills, I will give an objective review on the coffee and the food here. First and foremost the name says it all. The vibe and the decor brings out a rustic and chic vibe that will make you want to chill there all day. They have outlets by the tables and if they are full. Be sure to check out “Make my cake”, next door you can bring your coffee over . I only drink cold brew , black, nothing else. My gf has had the matcha with lavender syrup which really kicked up the matcha experience. If you fancy a meal the avocado toast is excellent. You can add turkey sausage and eggs… but you really don’t need it. The staff already has made great recommendations every time we go. I really can’t go a day without this coffee. Starbucks who? Dunkin ? Nope I’ll save my few bucks and chill at “I like Black” coffee shop.
The Morningside breakfast sandwich is incredible. Can order on an everything flavored croissant, which is delicious. Coffee is great too!

media.caption: I was hungry and took a few bites first

reviews.snippet: This place is above 5 stars. The owner felt like a neighbor and was very generous. He gave us a free slice of cake that was so delicious and unforgettable. The coffee was the best I have ever drank in my life. It was strong and very aromatic and earthy. The food was unbelievable. I regret not ordering more for the drive home. The setting and service was amazing. I will definitely be going back to this place when I am back in NY. Thank you so much for your generosity and making us feel so welcomed.
Wow I can’t get over this place. The service was so warm and welcoming. The sambusa was so good. I’m normally prefer red meat but the chicken stew was incredible.

It’s my first time in New York and I’m so glad we were in the area and came across this place. After a long and stressful day of travel and medical appointments, this warm and inviting atmosphere was just what we needed. The food and drinks were amazing and so full of flavor. It was perfect for sharing. The service was very friendly and attentive. Our meal here revived my soul after a tough day. Thank you! ❤️

This was my first time eating here and the food was so good. Presentation was beautiful and the service was outstanding. It was lovely to eat outside even though the train mags it a little noisy. Can't wait to visit again!

Simply outstanding food and service. The coffee and teas were excellent. The food was amazing. The deserts were outstanding too. The service was just heartwarming. Great value for your money to! The bean appetizer, chicken drumsticks and beef dishes were to die for. The carrot cake and rum soaked cake were divine!

Incredible food, amazing outdoor seating, our kids love Cafe Massawa! We love to go here as a family. Our son loves the shiro & injera, as well as the fries! And We love the food as much as he does! The staff is great & the energy of the place is amazing! Thank you for being a great place to eat & hang on this little stretch of broadway!
I love coming to Cafe Massawa. Not only is their food flavorful and delicious, the service is immaculate. Come here and you’ll enjoy the vibes.

media.caption: Savory toast with avocado and eggs

reviews.snippet: I’ve been slowly making my way through the lunch/Dinner menu and I cannot emphasize enough just how delectable every dish is. The lemonades are very refreshing without being overpowered by sugar and instead tastes exactly as listed on the menu. The staff are always so kind and add to the peaceful ambiance of the space. Whether eating in or out, dining here is always such a wonderful sensory experience and a highlight of my lunch break. The cafe rightly deserves and earns all five stars.

The owner is a very welcoming, polite, and hard working guy. He made sure our experience there was nothing short of exceptional. The injera was amazing! They have vegan options, as well. In photo: Beef Tibs, Shiro, and Alitcha

Polite service, delicious food this was my first time having this dish and it was amazing! I would definitely come again. Just a bit pricey but worth it for a fresh meal that has flavor. Also the honey wine is the best wine I have had!!

Came for lunch and got the zigni with timtimo and green salad. Outstanding. Service was faster than I am accustomed to in an Eritrean restaurant and I really appreciated that! Reasonably priced for how much food you get. I will definitely come back when in NYC. My only complaint is that they had a vegan sampler, but not an omnivore sampler. I like to get one for myself and eat on it for days 🙂 No liquor license yet.

Great service and food, an exceptionally filling meal that’s perfect for sharing. As far as Ethiopian goes, you don’t get a ton of toppings, but you certainly won’t leave hungry. The guys that work here are great, and the neighborhood is lucky to have this spot.

media.caption: Tsebhi beghe and dhero with four vegan sides on injera

reviews.snippet: The food here is sooooo good. Best ethiopian in NY. Fresh flavorful, perfect Ethiopian food and what I would expect. I’m from LA where Ethiopian food is plentiful and it’s been hard to find authentic reliable places here. But this is it. Server seemed to be on his way out so he was slightly inattentive. (Forgot to give me water carafe and forgot to put in my Sambusa order). But honestly it’s okay, because the food came out fast enough that I didn’t even need an appetizer. The girl that took over at the end was super sweet. 10/10, will be back time and time again.

Best experience having traditional Ethiopian food here everything was delicious. The service was great and I can’t wait to come back again. We got the injera and beef tibs + berber wings, they were to die for!

The food was delicious, the service was great, and the atmosphere is so welcoming and cool.

We ordered the vegan sampler, sambusas (the chicken was great, the lentil one was ok), and the star of the show the Doro Wat (which was called by the Eritrean name on their menu but it's the chicken drumsticks with the tomato onion sauce and it's insane).

To top it off, for dessert they have carrot cake from Lloyds which was a treat! Everything was delicious and I can't wait to come back.

There are not enough adjectives to describe the wonder of this food! I had an out of body experience...yep it was that amazing! Definitely a returning destination for me!! Service was steller. Stopped in for a quick snack before a walk and returned for dinner! 5 stars are not enough!

Got the quesadilla and a meat + 2 vegan entree combination. You can’t go wrong with any of the dishes, honestly. Hearty, savory stews served with light, tangy injera!! And we got a rum raisin cake with coconut ice cream for dessert, naturally.

I ordered the vegan sampler and it was delicious! Every single one was very flavorful and loved the injera. The server recommend the ginger tea (forgot to take a photo), and I have to say it's the best tasting one I've had in a while! The ginger taste is prominent without being bitter and went well with the honey provided. I'm totally satisfied!

Had a great lunch here today. It’s a casual spot but it has nice big windows with lots of light.

I’m wishing great success to the new kid on the block - Cafe Massawa!

reviews.snippet:
Mama's TOO! is an absolutely spectacular, world-class pizza destination that has completely taken the culinary world by storm, leaving pizza lovers in total awe of its innovative craftsmanship. The entire experience is exceptionally nice, masterfully executed, and kept remarkably clean, whether you are visiting the iconic original Upper West Side location or the bustling West Village shop. Stepping past the glass counter reveals a magnificent lineup of jaw-droppingly beautiful round and square pies, creating an instant atmosphere of pure excitement that makes every minute of the wait entirely worth it.
The revolutionary Cacio e Pepe pizza is an absolute triumph and mind-blowing to experience firsthand. It is completely easy to see how this masterpiece was named the absolute best pizza in the world—it completely reimagines what a slice can be. Built on a shattery, long-fermented crust that is spectacularly crunchy on the bottom yet wonderfully light and airy inside, the pie replaces traditional sauce with an ingenious, rich base of whipped mascarpone and aged mozzarella. It is then finished with a literal snowstorm of freshly grated Pecorino Romano and Parmigiano Reggiano, alongside cracked black pepper that is perfectly toasted in a roaring 575°F oven. The resulting flavor is a profoundly bold, tangy, and deeply satisfying combination that perfectly honors the classic Roman pasta while elevating pizza to a whole new global stage.
Equally spectacular are the shop's wonderfully fresh, gourmet house-made sides and appetizers. The Bruschetta is an absolute blast of vibrant flavor, served over exceptionally crisp, perfectly charred bread that boasts a gorgeous crunch with every single bite. Piled high with beautifully seasoned, ripe diced tomatoes, fragrant basil, and a flawless drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, it is incredibly refreshing and balances the rich, cheesy decadence of the pies flawlessly. Between the world-shattering ingenuity of the Cacio e Pepe and the immaculate quality of the classic sides, eating here stands as an absolute triumph and a beautiful, unforgettable celebration of modern New York City pizza culture.

I reviewed their Village location before, and now I finally checked out the Upper West Side spot… and wow, they did it again.

Mama’s TOO is honestly one of those rare, one-of-a-kind pizza places that just gets everything right. This is exactly what you expect from a top NYC slice — perfectly crunchy dough, that beautiful crisp on the bottom, and flavor that’s just beyond amazing. Every bite hits.

The original setup here was tiny — basically grab your slice at the door and go. And yes, people would still line up in the cold just to get a piece of this heavenly pizza (which tells you everything you need to know). But I’m actually really happy they expanded a bit so now you can step inside, stand, and eat. Trust me, in NYC fall and winter, that small change is a BIG deal.

As a New Yorker, I highly recommend this place — like seriously, add it to your must-visit list if you’re coming to NYC 😉 I genuinely want people to skip the tourist traps and experience what real, incredible NYC food tastes like.

Hope you enjoy this city as much as I do… and start with this slice 🙂

reviews.snippet: The best Sicilian pizza I’ve had in my life! Everything about it was perfect. The crust was crispy and not too doughy, the sauce wasn’t too much, and the toppings were great. I loved their vodka square and angry nonna. I will be coming back to try the rest of the slices this summer.

Mama’s Too serves a pretty good pizza with solid flavor and generous toppings. The crust has a nice texture, and you can tell they use quality ingredients. Some of the specialty slices are creative and definitely worth trying.

That said, while it’s very good, it’s not the best pizza in New York. The competition in the city is extremely high, and there are spots that stand out a bit more in terms of overall balance and consistency.

Still, Mama’s Too is a strong option if you’re in the area and craving a good slice

reviews.snippet:

I would defend this place with my life. We got a bruschetta slice and an 18th ave, both my favorites, and we were not disappointed. I’ve also never had a bad experience with the service. Air conditioned indoor standing space. God bless 🙏🙏🙏

Mama's TOO is worth the hype.

This branch is conveniently located near the 1 train, so it's an easy stop if you're in the area. I strongly recommend the vodka slice, the cacio e pepe slice, or the 18th Ave slice. The biggest downside is how popular the place is, combined with the lack of indoor seating, so it can get packed very quickly. They have short counters along the wall to eat on, but space is limited. If you want to avoid the long wait, go right after they open or between 2 and 5 p.m. It's absolutely worth it.

I checked out this viral pizzeria since it’s all over TikTok and I happened to be in the area. Be prepared cuse the line and wait are pretty brutal. The place itself is extremely small, so if you’re claustrophobic, you’re probably not going to feel comfortable. It’s very crowded, and you’ll be shoulder to shoulder with people, constantly bumping into others.
I went with the cheesesteak, which was very good and reasonably priced at $23. I watched the owner making everything in house, including the rolls, which definitely deserves credit. The sandwich had a great crunch, maybe even a bit too hard for some. I didn’t mind it, but it does take some effort to chew, so if you have sensitive teeth, it might not be ideal. The thick cut onions were a nice touch and added good flavor.
Since we wanted to eat it hot and fresh, we tried to find a table, but that turned into a stressful experience. Space is tight, and everyone is competing for seating. It’s first come, first serve, and if you hesitate for even a second, you’ll miss your chance.
The pizza selection looked really good, but I wasn’t in the mood to try it this time. Overall, if you’re willing to deal with the chaos for quality food, this spot might be worth it. That said, none of the other customers seemed bothered, so maybe this kind of experience is just standard for NYC.

Mama’s TOO! is a must-visit for pizza lovers in NYC. Known for its thick, crispy square slices, the pizza is packed with flavor and perfectly balanced with a crunchy crust and rich toppings. Each slice feels indulgent and satisfying, making it worth the hype and the wait. 🍕

reviews.snippet: We came during a pretty slow time which was soo nice to have the space to hang out, eat and enjoy the tunes. We tried a variety of pizza but the Gorgonzola & peaches was the most unique - it was a nice switch from savory to sweet. We tried the bruschetta, a pesto one and pepperoni. The crust was crunchy but soft and it had just the right amount of toppings to not be overwhelming. This will definitely be a pizza that we seek out on our next trip.

Took these slices home to try and even cold, they were amazing! Thick but light and airy crust. Each slice was different and tasted so darn good!! Angry Nona, Funghi, and Cacio e Pepe were my favorite! But honestly every slice hit!!

Mama’s TOO! on the Upper West Side is hands down one of the best pizza spots in New York City. If you love great pizza, this place is an absolute must. From the moment you walk in, you can tell this is a neighborhood favorite, with the smell of fresh pizza in the air and a line of people excited to grab a slice.

The pizza here is truly next level. The crust is perfectly crispy on the outside while staying soft and airy inside, giving every bite an amazing texture. Their square slices are legendary—thick, flavorful, and loaded with the perfect balance of sauce, cheese, and toppings. The ingredients taste incredibly fresh and everything is clearly made with care. You can tell the team here takes pride in every pie they serve.

One of the best parts is the variety of creative slices they offer. Whether you go for a classic slice or one of their specialty squares, you really can’t go wrong. Every slice feels like a perfect mix of traditional New York pizza with a creative twist that makes it stand out from the crowd.

Even when there’s a line—and there usually is—it moves quickly and is completely worth the wait. The staff keeps things moving while still being friendly and welcoming, which adds to the great experience.

If you’re exploring the Upper West Side or doing a full NYC pizza tour, Mama’s TOO! should absolutely be on your list. It’s the kind of place you visit once and immediately start planning your next trip back. Easily a five-star experience and some of the best pizza you’ll find anywhere in the city. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐🍕

First time here and it was delicious! Great variety and you can tell they use quality ingredients. We stood and ate at the bar (no seats) before heading the Central Park. Great place to stop for a quick bite on the go! Will come back!

We had so many options to choose from for pizza in New York, but we decided to give Mama's Too a try as we had heard good things. We tried one of the square slices. They kindly cut it in half for us as it is quite a large slice. We tried the vodka sauce slice, and it was amazing. Crispy on the bottom, saucy on top! That vodka sauce is stupendous. I know it isn't a traditional NY slice but this was one of our favorite pizzas of our trip! Staff were friendly and efficient. The place was quite busy, but we got our food quickly. It is standing counters only here. I would definitely recommend!! We will make sure we come back next time we are in New York!

Just as a note there is no public restroom here

Let me recount the story of how I know it’s time to stop supporting a business. Mama’s Too is ostensibly doing better than ever…line out the door, expanding into new locations including the very popular West Village location. Yet every time I come here, I am less satisfied. The quality of the slices has gone down hill, and then don’t get me started on the customer service. I feel more taken care of at a Chipotle than I do here. The last time I came in, it was pouring rain. The store wasn’t busy. I ordered 2 slices, which came out to $15. I asked for them to go. Few minutes later the employee hands me my pizza teetering on a flimsy paper plate stuffed carelessly into a paper thin paper bag. I looked outside at the downpour and back at her and asked, “Did you run out of boxes?” She replies, “Boxes are for 3 slices or more.” Well folks, that’s a wrap for me at this place and I suggest you do the same.

Definitely worth the hype! This place is easily in my top 5 for sure. I’ve tried pizza from so many places in so many countries, and I still love this place so much. It’s just so delicious. The only downside is there’s not much room to eat in and it’s usually pretty crowded.

We stopped by for take-away and tried three different slices from their many flavors: the Vodka square, a slice and the bruschetta. We stopped by for take-away and tried three different slices: the Vodka square, a slice, and the bruschetta.
The pizzas definitely lived up to the hype — great flavor, crispy crust, and the thick dough is amazing.

However, the experience was a bit frustrating. We waited over 30 minutes, and people who came after us got their orders first — even a guy who ordered around eight slices! Seating is very limited, so unless you’re ready to wait, getting a table isn’t likely.

I’d still recommend the pizza because it really is good, but if you don’t want to stand around waiting forever, maybe try one of their other locations instead.

Amazing pizza… just bring patience (and maybe a snack for the wait)😅

I've had a lot of cheesesteaks over the years, and nothing has come close to this. If you're looking for the best Philly cheesesteak in New York, this is the place. I'll absolutely be back!

Edit a few years later: I only recently started getting butcher items from here - ground beef, chicken breast and thighs, wings - so have to add that the prices for these items are better than anywhere else we shop. Usually you gotta ask at the front for them to shout out for someone to man that station just fyi, but quality has been good on everything we've had (it's not perfectly pre-trimmed $9 chicken breast, but for $4 the actual meat has always been surprisingly good and better than most places at higher costs, not stingy, etc).. definitely don't be afraid to check it out!
I love this store on my block. They make the best sandwiches and there friendly. AND THIS IS MY HOOD. FIVE STARS NOTHING LESS!!!!

Conveniently near the train station and a bus stop...so perfect if your in a rush to go. The sandwiches here are elite! Impressive selection of cold cuts. About everything nd anything you need I'm pretty sure you'll find here. PLUS, they deliver " helLO " 👍🏽

Not a huge selection of items, but have your basic necessities when in dire circumstances. Friendly service behind the register, although if you need more than just your basics I'd recommend going to Central Market two blocks away.
The best iced coffee in the neighborhood, the sandwiches are delicious 🤤. This deli is a must stop in the morning or afternoon.
I go for snacks its great but I don't shop for anything else there or ever get sandwich so I can't say how good it is overall
Small neighborhood store with all the essentials including deli cold cuts meats poultry and more. Owners are great.
I'm loyal to Ranch Deli a block over on Columbus, but I'll be real, the BEC here is better.
Best Sandwiches in Town and not expansive. Thank you for you great service during our vacation.
This is a better deli around this area. Nice inventory and product. Nice Philly cheese sandwich too.
The food was delicious but the female servers were not too friendly. The me servers were far more accommodating and friendly.
It's nice and convenient for the area. A block away Central Park as well as sand park with sprinkles for kids.
Great sandwiches! They’ll make breakfast ones anytime.
If you speak Spanish they will treat you nicer. Decent Dominican bodega.
The shrimp and avocado wrap was good. Its a good size and great paired with French fries. The service was great. Its a fun friendly atmosphere.

reviews.snippet: Toast is a fantastic New York restaurant. It’s stood for many years because the food is always delicious. They don’t need bells and whistles like a lot of other NY restaurants because the quality speaks for itself. I think we may have arrived slightly earlier than they were actually open but they sat us quickly. I had the Cuban sandwich and it was possibly THE best Cuban sandwich I’ve ever had. Pretty sure it’s the GOAT when it comes to the Cuban sandwich. So good.

reviews.snippet:
I went on a Tuesday early evening with my niece. The spot is kid friendly I saw a few kids there during my visit. There was only one server/bartender when we first came in and she seemed quite overwhelmed so it took her some time to come to us to get our order but the food came very quickly and other servers started to arrive so she could focus more on the bartending.
It’s happy hour M-F 3-7 so i ordered a couple well tequila drinks. They were not strong. I barely tasted the alcohol. The food on the other hand was very good. I had the catfish wrap and fries which was light but filling. My niece had shrimp quesadillas and a side Ceaser and she enjoyed both. The quesadilla was super cheesy and the salad was quite large.
It was a nice day and they had a few seats outside. Music played but at a low volume so easy to talk

I gotten their lunch special, it comes with a half chicken sandwich (fried or grilled) and Cesar salad. They have 2 separate Happy Hours! The daily 4:00 - 7:00 PM - including Drinks & Bites. Nights 10pm - Close, Mon-Fri Drinks Only.

reviews.snippet:
Genuinely such a great spot to eat on a semi regular basis. Been here multiple times and the food is always enjoyable and more importantly it tastes fresh. Another awesome thing about this location is that the meals all taste just as good as they look! The fries really are that crispy, the salad really is that balanced, and both the entrees really are the star of the show.
I would have liked to see the waiter be more approachable and attentive but he’s also the only one so it’s understandable!
Last thing is that it is pretty hot in here. I’m not sure if the AC was down, but New York heat mixed with hot served food would really benefit from having a cooler environment.

reviews.snippet: I’m from Iowa and this place is amazing. I’ve been through many places in NYC with a similar background and style and this place is the best. The atmosphere at a minimum is 6 stars and the service was even better. The food topped it all with the cherry on top. Our server was amazing and helped our larger group out perfectly. Food is slightly on the higher end of expense but you get exactly if not better than what you pay for. 100% worth it and 100% reccomend.

The Servers were friendly, and we really enjoyed our visit! Plus, they also have a lovely terrace!

reviews.snippet: This staple, Morningside Heights neighborhood restaurant has been under new management and they’re doing an exceptional job. The day manager, Kevin, has really improved the bar’s craft beer draft list. I find it far superior than most trendy restaurants. Also, he has a super relaxed vibe and I’m always learning something new from him. After all, he is a proud graduate of UC Berkeley. And, Juan, the night manager, really cares about maintaining a high level of customer service, and he’s also fun to chat with. Further, the entire staff is very pleasant and will often engage you in a lighthearted, and sometimes in a deep, but worthwhile conversation (I’m thinking of Cody). Further, the food is excellent! I call it, “gourmet comfort food.” And the liquor selections and cocktails are also very, very good.

reviews.snippet: Live jazz on Fridays. I thought the food was quite bland, but salt and pepper helped a little. The Mac and cheese is extremely cheesy, rather than creamy, and was great. The Caesar salad was not good, really. It just had very little flavor and tasted almost like plain lettuce. It could use grated cheese and grated pepper. If you have Caesar salad on your menu really guys, invest in $4 pepper grinders for the tables, if not a couple server grinders. The little salt & pepper matching glass sprinkle things aren't cutting it. Hot sauce would be cool too. Not bad overall, the jazz was FANTASTIC. I heard it while I was walking by and changed my plans, had a drink and dinner there, instead. Live jazz is really what makes this place stand out from the three other restaurants within 50 feet. I never would have glanced at it otherwise but I'm definitely going back tonight.

raw_place.description: American comfort fare like burgers & sandwiches in a roomy, retro diner space plus a full bar.

reviews.snippet: While walking around Central Park, we stopped by this place to get a caffeine fix and some sweet bread. The crossaint was light and aire with freshness. Thank you Lian.

I got to know this place thanks to my daughter Natalia, and it was love at first sight. 💜
Purple Waves is a beautiful, cozy spot with delicious coffee — perfect for eating, working, or simply enjoying a peaceful moment.
What I loved the most was its coherence and purpose: if you want your coffee to go, you need to bring your own cup; they even sell products like milk in returnable glass bottles. 🌿 A truly genuine commitment to the planet!
I had the pleasure of meeting the owner and talking about sustainability and purpose… such a lovely and inspiring person.
Without a doubt, one of my favorite places in NY. Highly recommended from the heart! ☕️💜

Great gift to the neighborhood. Food is not just tasty but good for you. Ingredients were outstanding. I enjoyed delicious crunchy toast with hummus, whole chick peas and shredded multi colored carrots with pickled veggies. All of the menu looked good. Espresso drink with oatmilk was perfect. Come with your own cup for take out coffee because there really isn’t good recycling for all those #5 tops. New addition of packaged foods from local farms is a bounty for this area and well worth a visit. Cafe inside and out was very pleasant.

Loved the super friendly staff, including the owner who stopped by to ask how everything was going; the menu was quite varied and healthy, & lattes great, especially the 2 seasonal ones we tried; ambiance delightful — lots of sunlight, good mix of seating, cheerful decor w. lots of goods from local farmers & vendors in market section, free WiFi, & location central to subway & bus stops, though on edge of busy and bit chaotic traffic circle, making cafe signage not as prominently ideal. Outdoor seating a big plus during warmer months which this clearly wasn’t, but chairs still optimistically there :D

Cafe works hard to operate sustainably and therefore participates in an innovative local program that offers recycling of fresh flower arrangements post their short life at a special event, so not wasted. Very creative!

Highly recommend checking out as would be a regular IF lived in NYC, and not Somerville, MA!
The coffee was too toasted. It didn’t taste great. We really liked the atmosphere. The waitress was super kind.

Love this place!! What a gem. I got the egg salad sandwich & coffee and both hit the spot. The sandwich was served with a delicious side of greens… the dressing was sooo good. It’s also a beautiful space to get some work done.

I love that sustainability + community are a huge priority for this small business. You can tell they really care. They reduce waste as much as possible + have great events.

Highly recommend Purple Waves!!! Will be back soon 💚

response.snippet:
Hi Vivian,

Thank you for your wonderful words! We’re thrilled you enjoyed your visit and that our commitment to sustainability and community stood out. We’re excited to share we're rolling out a new series of community events, including poetry and reading parties, as well as collaborations with various artists and creators from our vibrant community.

Follow us @purplewaves.nyc for updates, and swing by for daily Happy Hour from 3 PM! Hope to see you again soon! 💚

Best,
Purple Waves

reviews.snippet:
Absolutely blown away by Purple Waves! From the moment I walked in, the vibe was relaxed yet vibrant, the staff incredibly welcoming, and the food—wow. Every bite felt thoughtfully prepared, but one dish truly stole the show: the grain bowl.

This wasn’t your average grain bowl—it was a symphony of textures and flavors. Perfectly balanced, nourishing yet indulgent, with fresh, high-quality ingredients that made each forkful better than the last. It’s rare to find something that hits both comfort and creativity so perfectly.

Highly recommend this spot if you’re looking for something unique, satisfying, and full of soul. Purple Waves, you’ve earned a fan!

response.snippet:
Thank you so much, Diana — your words truly made our day! We're so happy the experience resonated with you, and that the care we put into everything—from the food to the vibe—came through. Hope to welcome you back soon!
Follow us on Instagram for updates and events: @purplewavesnyc

reviews.snippet:
Overall a good experience.

You do pay up mostly for the ingredient origin - i didn’t find the food to be that great otherwise.

The coffee wasn’t the best - note that they won’t serve you To Go unless you bring your own cup, which is an interesting choice being at the corner of a subway station.

response.snippet:
Hi Jan,
Thanks so much for stopping by and sharing your thoughts. Our focus is on local and sustainable ingredients, which can affect pricing, but we’re always working to make sure the food and coffee live up to the quality of the sourcing. We’re also in a transition right now, expanding our new sustainable market and refreshing our menu and coffee program.

Our no single-use policy is part of our low-waste mission. It's an adjustment, we know, but we love seeing guests who are willing to make small habit changes for the planet. We also carry collapsible reusable cups that fit right in your pocket for next time. Hope you’ll come back soon and see how we’re evolving!

Warmly,
Sharon

reviews.snippet: This place is amazing. Excellent coffee. Creative menu and delicious food. Beer and wine selection on point. Pleasant space in a great location…beautiful view of Central Park and Frederick Douglass Circle Plaza. Kid friendly. Practices sustainability. Wonderful addition to the neighborhood!

I got the lox toast and upgraded it to an everything croissant. It was heaven!! I def recommend stopping by and trying this place out, you will not be disappointed

reviews.snippet:
The place is nice inside with a selection of groceries available for purchase and some other items. Went in for a coffee but you have to bring your own cup, so I got something out of the fridge. The draft latte I bought tasted sour, and after a sip with a few chunks I checked the expiration - it had expired three months ago. Gross.

Not mad patrons have to bring a cup, I’m all for sustainability. But the canned coffee left an awful taste in my mouth. Literally. Tried calling to notify them there were expired products stocked but someone picked up and didn’t say anything before hanging up.

This place has my favorite egg salad sandwich in the world. I live an hour away but I will literally travel just for their egg salad sandwich and a lovely time al fresco with a friend! The vibes are so nice here. I also love their lattes.

Used to be my favorite place to eat and work, but no more. The sandwiches that were so tasty are gone. Most of the seating is gone, in favor of a random assortment of specialty groceries that ill-fits the neighborhood. So sad. Probably the coffee is still good, but I don't bother as I don't want to spend time there anymore.

Our first experience here was great! Maple sea salt latte was flavorful, raspberry donuts were delicious.

Second visit, tried the winter spice latte, another specialty. It was good but not exceptional, not distinguishable from a regular pumpkin spice. Asked about the raspberry donuts and was told they were a special and wouldn’t be coming back. Fair enough! Can’t carry everything all the time. Tried the lemon loaf, which was good but the tiniest slice of lemon loaf I’ve ever seen. Overall an average visit, not worth the trek out of the way or price paid.

Third visit, tried their “artisan milk alternative” with their honey cinnamon latte. They “don’t have” the reusable travel cups that they used to sell and don’t offer disposable cups, making the only option for coffee to sit in the shop and have it in a mug. Truly one of the nastiest coffees I’ve ever tried. Inedible. Burnt, bitter, almost medicinal in taste. The barista was able to remake the latte with regular milk but told us that’s just how their speciality milk tastes, which seems off to me.

Also, for a shop to insist on customers sitting in for their coffee, you’d figure the latte art would at least be the standard little heart shape or simple pour, but no. Some of the worst looking lattes I’ve ever seen. Disappointing after such a promising first visit.

Wonderful to have Purple Waves @ #frederickdouglascircle (NE corner of #cpw & #cpn) join the neighborhood! It’s the absolute best/most delicious addition to #frederickdouglasblvd #restaurantrow in a *long* time!!

The cafe fare is elevated & utterly sublime (the lox are a must try, made by their amazing Chef Ella!); the coffee & chai are top notch; the vibe is cool; & the intention is community-focused. The place is light, airy, & cozy/modern. The owner (Sharon) and her team are super warm, courteous, & competent- just right attention.

response.snippet: Thanks so much for your support and kind words!! We are so excited to be here and look forward to continue serving this amazing community for years to come.
