reviews.snippet: Lovely little establishment. They don’t offer “to go” cups and instead they give u a reusable cup to bring back. Environmentally friendly, kind, cute and cozy. The wine list is also nice.
Grabbed an espresso here. Very friendly lady and awesome small nook. Hidden spot up here. Recommend!

name: Trufa Pizzeria
address: 3161 Broadway, New York, NY 10027, United States

reviews.snippet: Solid slice for the university crowd. Not too pricey but a little pricey given the dough is a bit doughy and the sauce is too sweet. Still a good drunk slice.

Reliable slice of pizza. Friendly staff. Nothing super special but reliable, affordable, and solid slice. I've had plain, pepperoni, and Hawaiian slices. All fine. There a small number of tables in the space for waiting or eating.

The pizza especially the margarita has sugar in it. Someone admitted this. I got the eggplant margarita for $6. This was my second time trying to give them a chance. I regret it. There are better pizza spots that are farther away, but worth the walk. It feels like they changed the recipe to taste like candy.

Pizza is alright, but the problem was they force charged a tip thru grubhub. If I knew they used their own delivery staff I would have tipped, but grubhub doesn't show until after you place the order. Either way if they would have added a $2 tip cool, but no they did an $8 tip!! Mind you I only ordered 3 slices & was just 13 blocks away with me meeting the delivery guy outside. Just watch your charges the next day when dealing with this pizzeria & contact grubhub if they do this BS with you.

Trufa Pizzeria is a great spot to grab a slice of pizza in NYC. The garlic knots are definitely a standout, with a fluffy and soft texture that melts in your mouth. They are definitely worth trying, especially if you're a fan of garlic.

The pizza itself is a good standard NYC pizza, which means it's pretty darn good. The crust is thin and crispy, while the toppings are tasty and flavorful. While it may not be the most unique or inventive pizza in the city, it definitely hits the spot when you're craving a classic slice.

I recommend! The pizza has a nice crispy, the dough is perfect! The sauce was amazing. The right amount of grease (if you’re from NYC you know that makes a good pizza) it was freshly made. The Garlic knots was super soft and so good.

Trufa Pizzeria

Layout/atmosphere
*Five tables, TV; cake display below pizza display

Food/drink
*Regular slice - Good; flop but some crisp on crust; sauce not sweet
*Red velvet cake - Good; moist (don’t think it’s made in-house)

response.snippet: Thankyou for your visit and great observations. We look forward to serve you again

reviews.snippet: Friendly service, classic NYC pizza shop.
Best pizza ever. If you are nearby, please stop in for a slice. It is always fresh and the customer service is outstanding.

Went in to try the cheese slice and it was $2.50. Couldn't pay with credit card. I think you need to spend $7 before you can use credit. The slice isn't even that big to cost so much. I know $1 pizza the tastes better. Not worth the price at all. Didn't have any flavor to me. I had to add seasonings. It's edible if it was the only option but I wouldn't return. Besides the service sucks. I got a burnt pizza and when I mentioned it, nothing was done to give me a better slice of discount. Just attitude and no apology. They shouldn't even be serving burnt pizza at all.
It's a good NY pizza by the slice place. We ate here while waiting for Grant's Tomb to open. Slices are kind of pricey but also very big. Recommended.

response.snippet: Thankyou!

reviews.snippet: Now this is Harlem pizza I can get behind. Beautiful quality cheese, sauce, & crust make a highly satisfying regular slice, w/ a sausage slice for good measure & additional flavor. I wouldn't doubt if Trufa was about as well esteemed as Patsy's! I must admit that I'd walked past this place several times before noticing it.

user.name: Anne Hathaway did not spit in my food.

reviews.snippet: The dough and toppings are (almost) always so fresh! Unlike many pizzerias, Trufa puts a very generous amount of veggies on their veggie pizzas. The eggplant slice they do is addictive.
Love the Margharita, very good pricing for what you get. Enjoyed my slice 100%
XL Ultimate Veggie pie was quite tasty. Fast, friendly service. Happy to see a new spot open in the neighborhood!
the best cheeses pizza i ever had in nyc

As a native New Yorker, I don’t know what all the complaining in other reviews is about. I had a regular slice and it was great. Thin, crisp crust that didn’t sag with a nice tart sauce and perfectly good cheese. Service was super friendly, if just slightly slow. Yes, at $3.75 it was a little more than I expected, but has anyone heard about inflation? And the slice was very good sized. About those reviews upset about the minimum credit card, grow up and get some cash.
Their grandma slice is unmatched. Moved out of the neighborhood and think about this place often.

response.snippet: We missed you as well, we hope you stop by whenever you come around our neighborhood 😉

reviews.snippet: This pizza is one of the best you can try in NY. Especially the margarita. Cool people and nice folklore latin music always in the background. If you need only a slice, keep in mind; minimum $10 charge for electronic transactions.

A cut above the typical NY slice. Good variety and generous toppings. Their vodka sauce is AMAZING! Staff is friendly and service is quick. They have an amazing selection of deserts too! Orders under $10 incur a fee when paying with plastic.

reviews.snippet:
Ordered the chopped cheese on a roll less than $10
I was on my break from working doing InstaCart and found this place, definitely come and order 1️⃣
No cheese inside that’s crazy and idk what say not order there again everyone check your food before buying or do not go back there..
Very community oriented and if u need credit they will help u out till next time.
Good deli, they have good coffee and good food. The salad bar looks nice but I didn’t get a salad. Good service too - like these guys.

Pros: Friendly, good chip selection, and the breakfast sausage is good

Cons: Orders are often wrong (we've receive someone else's sandwich three times), prices will vary by who's working (I've watched the cook and cashier argue about what the price actually is), and nothing is seasoned well so you're fully dependent on the outside ingredients to make up for it (i.e. the eggs are bland so order pepper jack cheese).

Fantastic service!! I had to use the restroom so bad and couldn't find one anywhere and they let me use theirs. We got 2 bagels and a Fiji water and it was less than $8. Their food in the case looked amazing, we just weren't too hungry. Next time we're in the city we will be back, even if it's just to say hi to our fellow Giants fans!!

Absolutely great food on the go. Definitely fresh. A wide variety of items to choose from. If you missed your Restuarant and you need something to eat. The very best choice to go for were you will be definitely satisfied.

All three were fantastic, it made for the most delicious breakfast I’ve ever had! Service was very friendly as well, couldn’t have asked for anything better! Looking forward for trying more of their menu options while I’m here!

reviews.snippet:
Love this neighborhood spot 💖
My favorites are the mini carrot bundt and the mini apple pie🤗 both so good and never last long. My daughter is all about the cookies, especially the chocolate walnut and pistachio (she has great taste 😆) and my sister loves the pan de yuca🤗

reviews.snippet: Cinnamon and blueberry items are fantastic. The blueberry muffin is actually a BLUEBERRY muffin, rare to find anymore. Very friendly, clean, new local fav. Not a huge selection, yet focused and on point.

reviews.snippet: Great neighborhood spot with friendly service and very good baked goods. More of a grab and go place, but does have a couple seats. Love the mini apple pies and muffins in particular — but also don’t sleep on the empanadas. Support this place so it sticks around.

reviews.snippet: Egg sandwich on pan de yuca was delicious. Also liked the banana muffin and pistachio cookie. Will definitely go back to try more items on the menu.

response.snippet: Thank you so much! We’re glad you enjoyed the coffee and brioche pastries. We really appreciate your support and hope to see you again soon!

reviews.snippet:
I’m a huge baked goods connoisseur and I was getting together with some friends with whom I’d already reviewed this month’s Cronut flavor, so I wanted to treat them to something fun and new from somewhere I hadn’t been before.

When I saw another reviewer mentioned guava brioche I knew I was willing to go out of my way while walking home to get some. Luckily I got the last two, I think they were around $5 each. The store is small but the gentleman behind the counter was super friendly. The case was full of delicious looking baked goods, so I’ll be going to go back to try something else soon. Not to mention there’s a menu on the wall of other food options and some empanadas.

The brioche was delicious! Guava is kind of an uncommon flavor but when I travel in Florida I always look for it in panderias.

Edit: I’ve also tried an iced coffee, pan de yucca, and empanadas while going back for more brioche - all great!

response.snippet: Thank you so much for such a thoughtful and detailed review! We're really happy you enjoyed the guava brioche and that you came back to try more—like the pan de yuca, coffee, and empanadas. We truly appreciate you going out of your way to visit us, and we look forward to delighting you with more treats soon!

reviews.snippet: Happened to walk by just for a coffee. The atmosphere was very pleasant and inviting. Decided I wanted a pastry to compliment my coffee. Settled on cheese twist and a muffin. The cheese twist is by far one of the best I've tasted in NY. I can only describe the food as.... Delicious.

response.snippet: Thank you so much for your kind words. We’re delighted you enjoyed the coffee, atmosphere, and pastries. Hearing that our cheese twist is one of the best you’ve had in NY truly means a lot to us. Hope to welcome you back again soon ✨

reviews.snippet: Great food, everything clearly made fresh and from scratch. Always order the enfrijolada with egg and guava scone. Owner is the nicest. Just a neighborhood gem, couldn’t ask for more

response.snippet: Thank you so much for your kind words and support! We're so happy you enjoy our fresh food, especially the enfrijolada with egg and the guava scone. It means a lot to us to be part of this wonderful neighborhood. We can't wait to see you again!

reviews.snippet:

reviews.snippet: It’s still the hole in the walls that make all the difference in NYC. Love my huge fresh out of the oven guava bun, and an Americano how it should be.

reviews.snippet: Amazing food! Fahsa was our most favorite - a sizzling lamb dish! The service was great! The older gentleman and the kid behind the counter were very welcoming and helpful. All in all, a restaurant that was incredible in all avenues.

I had the Kabesh with lamb! The lamb was so tender the rice was perfectly spiced ! All my cravings were satisfied . Thankful I found this spot. Can’t wait to try their other dishes … I wanted to take another order of kabesh to go haha! Their salad their green sauce and baba ganoush ! Amazing!!!

Was taken her for a birthday lunch. The food was tasty and filling. HALAL.
The falafel plate included seasoned rice, hummus, lettuce, tossed salad, and onions.

I did not have the garlic sauce and thank since the included dairy products. NOT VEGAN.

The falafel was very crispy, just like I love the crunch when biting. I love spice and hot pepper, so I add some of my homemade pepper sauce and I ate too much. It was so crispy add to the flat bread which was another story. Took home half the food for lunch tomorrow 😋

The tossed salad included cucumber, carrot, lettuce and tomato. If you are allergic to tomatoes like I am, do not request the toss salad...it is pre-made with tomatoes.

The hot freshly baked flat bed was at least 18 inches in diameter. It has bubbles and pockets of charred puff..Just the way i like it.
The vegan falafel plate was on point.

My friend had the odqat chicken which was well seasoned and made into a pancake. Chicken stripes with eggplant, onions, garlic, sweet red peppers, spices and tomatoes...She also had it over the seasoned basmati type rice which had roasted onions, red pepper, garlic and carrots.

Everything is cooked to order. Many items are featured in the heating trays.

The guest next to me had EVERTHING on the menu...the shawarma was huge...they left with many containers.

Soft drinks and water are available.

Desserts are available. However, I did not have room left in my belly to see the desserts.

Breakfast lunch and dinner are served.

Many people visited. A number were return patrons. The lentil soup closed by the couple at the next table look very filling g, and was piping hot when brought to their table.

Close to Metro North, NYC buses and trains.
Walking distance to the Studio Museum of Harlem, Apollo Theatre, the Alhambra and Adam Clayton Powell building.

reviews.snippet: Great hummus. The Yemini bread was phenomenal. I got the roasted honey lamb and the rice it came with was so flavorful.

This was my first time eating here and I’ll definitely be coming back! The staff are very friendly and respectful, and the platters are generous in size. They don’t skimp on portions, which makes it a great value.

The food is incredible. The eggplant and mixed veggies dishes were my favorite. I also got white fragrant rice and baked chicken.

The spicy green sauce is also very nice.

The food here is phenomenal and great value for the money. Don’t miss the lamb and the flatbread — tasted amazing!!! If you’re ever in NYC don’t miss this great find. Better than a lot of much fancier places I’ve tried in the city!

media.caption: Lamb haneeth with fragrant basmati rice

reviews.snippet: the best. had the fahsa and to be fair I have nothing to compare it to. But amazing. Especially for a slow eater like me. Note you need a cold drink. And the bathroom was clean.
Incredibly tasty! The shrimp stew served hot and spicy with LARGE flatbread was mouth watering! So glad I read the reviews, this restaurant does not disappoint!

I had an amazing dining experience at Yemeni Restaurant NYC! From the moment I walked in, the warm and welcoming atmosphere made me feel right at home. The staff was friendly, attentive, and eager to ensure a great experience.

I ordered the lamb haneeth, and it was absolutely delicious. The meat was perfectly tender, slow-cooked to perfection, and infused with incredible flavors. It practically melted in my mouth! The seasoning was spot on, and the portion size was generous. It was served with fragrant basmati rice that complemented the dish beautifully.

The side dishes and fresh bread were also a fantastic touch. The Yemeni-style bread was warm, soft, and paired perfectly with the flavorful sauces. The traditional tea at the end of the meal was a great way to wrap up the experience.

Beyond the food, the restaurant itself was clean and comfortable, with a cozy ambiance that made the meal even more enjoyable. It’s clear that the chefs take pride in their cooking, and the authenticity of the flavors really shines through.

If you’re looking for authentic Yemeni cuisine in NYC, this place is a must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more dishes! Highly recommended.

Had Albanian and lot of middle eastern places yet not any Yemeni food yet (had a lot of their coffee though). Went with a friend and now I question: Where has it been all my life here at NYC! It is very close but i always skip when I travel close. Don’t be intimidated by the name or location, try it and also get addicted.

The drinks were a perfect start-a yogurt-based drink (something start with S?) that was tangy and salty and super cooling. Then half way through we added mint lemonade, that was bright and refreshing to counterbalance the rich dishes.

Food:
lamb zurbian—deeply spiced and fall-apart tender lamb, paired beautifully with fluffy, flavorful rice. I loved the crispy fried onions/shallots in there. It is rich without being super oily.

The liver was a surprise favorite—surprising the lightest dish of the day due to tomato content. They are lamb livers perfectly cooked and packed with flavor.

Their flatbread, omg, three times the size of my face. Nicely charred outside, pillowy soft inside, fluffy and stretchy. It has texture and flavors of a pita on the outside and soda biscuits in the middle.

And the sauces—every single one added a bold, vibrant kick that elevated the dishes even more.

Dessert:
Please don’t skip dessert, or you can eat it as an entree. They are warm, comforting, and just the right amount of sweetness and texture.

Massoub
Banana-bread based topped with cream and nuts and corn flakes. Mushy (good kind) at bottom. Great if you are into banana with cream.

Areeka
Date-bread based topped with cream and nut and corn flakes. More dense at the bottom than Massoub. Loved the dates. We took home the leftovers and actually ordered one more to go.

To top it off, the service was superb—warm, welcoming, and attentive. Can’t wait to come back.

media.caption: The amount of food is a lot!

reviews.snippet: You have to try this place! The food is absolutely delicious, especially the Fahsa – rich, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The portions are big and very satisfying, so you’ll definitely leave full and happy. The restaurant is spotless and very well kept, which makes the dining experience even better. On top of that, the staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, always serving with genuine enthusiasm and warmth. You can really feel their passion for both the food and the customers. This has quickly become one of my favorite spots, and I can’t wait to come back again. Highly recommended!

A must order would definitely be the classic roasted lamb over rice haneeth the lamb was incredibly soft and tender and the rice was delightful. It comes with this great okra veggie stew on the side of the rice. I definitely prefers this over the chicken kebsa however, but perhaps if I had ordered lamb kebsa it would be just as good as the lamb haneeth.

Above all I loved the meat over hummus dish with this fresh crispy yet soft massive piece of naan bread they give. The hummus was flavorful and yet it still felt filling and light compared to the heavier haneeth dish that’ll put you in a food coma!

Definitely recommend this place for the food quality and the sweet Yemeni hospitality.

I’d say I wasn’t impressed walking past by but once I walked in, my opinions have changed.

Decors are sweet, staff are super friendly, food amount is very generous. Lamb chops elsewhere are tiny lollipops but theirs are huge with meat covered in charred, crispy fat. Their bread is also really good for any dipping or wrapping.

Would recommend!!!

reviews.snippet:
Authentic Dominican flavor.
With so much offerings in and around NYC, El Tina stands out for its authentic and unassuming comida criolla Dominicana. The lunch crowd moves in and out quickly. Take out and deliveries are picked up quickly. When our party of 4 walked over from Barnard college, we knew the walk would be worth trudging through the heat and humidity of summer in NYC.
There is an extensive list of daily lunch specials-which includes Moro, a choice of protein, and 3 pieces of maduros. We’ve ordered the carne guisada, rabo guisado, chuleta frita, and mondongo.
Papaya milkshake, strawberry milkshake, and a side of maduros.
Will surely come back many more times.

Some of the best Dominican food I’ve had in NYC hands down and the staff is super friendly! I got the roasted chicken, yellow rice, red beans, potato salad, and beef empanadas. Everything was super fresh and so flavorful the empanadas were juicy and had a great portion of meat. I told the person taking my order that I wanted to practice my Spanish and she was super patient and helpful, it’s definitely a trek here from Brooklyn but it was so good that I’ll be back!
I am visiting from California and this was the first time I have ever had Puerto Rican food; it was amazing. Katherine was so kind, so helpful, and gave amazing recommendations.
The food was great! And lovely customer service. The best! And the coffee was the best.

response.snippet: Thank you for your patronage and wonderful remark

reviews.snippet: If you look for fast services and good traditional latin food , you can choose this place. Food is fresh , a good price and great flavors. Servers are kind and are attentive to your requests. The place is always clean. There is like a buffet delivery service, too. You ask what you want, they serve it and you take it home. The only cons is that the place have a short capacity and at some hours it gets full of customers. This is why he gets 3 in atmosphere. R

The good was amazing and the staff very nice.
I will recommend this place

What can I say, it's a great Spanish spot we saw on the way back to the hotel. Service was great, the staff was helpful and the portions were like your Spanish friends grandma over feeding you. It was all delicious, and very tasty, chicken was amazing, as was the chicharron. Loved it and the piece was huge. We ordered dinner portions by accident, but still ate quite a bit.

Would not hesitate getting food from here again.

response.snippet: Thanks for your support 🙏🏼

reviews.snippet:
Found this gem through Reddit, came to get out of the tourist traps and try some Domican food.

And yeah, it lived up to everything.

The chicken is tender, flavoursome and falls off the bones. The beans are in a world of its own and the salsa is tangy, so and cuts through everything in the best way.

response.snippet: It is our goal to fulfill our customers expectations , thank you for stoping by

reviews.snippet: BIG Thank You to C/Katherine the food was amazing!! We will be back soon!

i’ve been coming here for years, but I really think that they have changed the cook. The food was horrible. Ordered pepper steak $15 and all I got was huge pieces of onions and peppers and maybe five pieces of steak which were greasy stale and soggy just nasty the beans horrible my husband also got a order horrible dry fried chicken overall it’s not the servers fault but if you’re gonna charge so much money at least make sure that your food has quality if I can give zero stars for the food I would. I always try to give the a chance and come back but this time was the last.
Love coming to the spot. Service and food is always great. Highly recommend

Have you ever tasted Dominican food? In New York we call it Spanish food!

El Tina food will give you the experience to explore your inner spinish self!

The rotisserie chicken falls of the bone, which is so delicious and tasty its delightful putting it in your mouth. I don’t eat pork but i was told the roast pork is a must have.

Get this, island food it’s like your mama’s kitchen.
