El Tina Harlem Restaurant captured by Dracinc | Donn Thompson 1
El Tina Harlem Restaurant captured by Dracinc | Donn Thompson 2
El Tina Harlem Restaurant captured by Dracinc | Donn Thompson 3

response.snippet: Thank you so much for your wonderful review , we appreciate you spreading the word about our food

reviews.snippet: Food here is amazing! Options are endless and authentic. I moved to Texas a year ago and while visiting this weekend I HAD to stop here and get lunch and orders to take back home. Cariña took very good care of me. She was so sweet. I went to a different place yesterday and it did not deliver the way Tina’s always does. Love them!
Excellent food and very nice service. The oxtail was beyond delicious. I highly recommend.
My fav place in the area, the food is TOO GOOD!! Love the staff here, they're so kind💗💗

response.snippet: Thanks for those beautiful words

reviews.snippet: really great portions and delicious food!

I had such a great experience here! The food was absolutely delicious, especially the bistec con arroz, which was so flavorful and perfectly cooked. Everything we tried tasted fresh and homemade. The service was wonderful too; everyone was so friendly, welcoming, and attentive. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for amazing Dominican food!

Small spot but has a few seats available. The staff is friendly, everything was clean, and the food is great fresh hot and perfectly seasoned,
They have a simple but very good salad dressing,Their pork mofongo was amazing, and so was there oxtail, rice, and beans
parking was not great but found a spot 2blocks away.

response.snippet: Thank you for your your support and patronage

reviews.snippet: Katherine was great. She provided excellent customer service. Food was delicious as always
The food is very delicious and the server was quick and very nice to us. The restraunt is small but you can sit and eat and taste the amazing seasonings.

raw_place.title: El Tina Harlem Restaurant
raw_place.description: An array of traditional Latin American plates doled out in simple, compact quarters.

reviews.snippet: Excellent food and service. I came for breakfast and had the huevos rancheros which were delicious but different than traditional ones I have had before. Also enjoyed a lovely cup of tea. The server/barista was extremely friendly and we struck up conversation about Mexican and Colombian cuisine

I was really excited to try this restaurant because the atmosphere is fun, cute, and inviting. Unfortunately, my experience went downhill once I was seated downstairs.

The service on Sunday afternoon was extremely underwhelming. As a solo diner, I felt largely overlooked by the server, a young Caucasian gentleman working at the time. I noticed him taking the time to explain highlighted menu items to nearby tables and providing them with multiple menus, while I had to wait just to make eye contact and get basic service. It took a while before he brought me water, and I even had to ask for a second menu myself along with checking in on my coffee item. It took so long but as soon as I asked about it to cancel it he said it was being prepared.

I’m a very patient person and have years of experience working in the service industry, so I understand that busy shifts happen. However, the lack of attentiveness was disappointing and made me feel like an afterthought throughout the meal.

Unfortunately, the food didn’t make up for the service. While the dishes looked very nice they were bland, lacked flavor, and fell well below expectations. I left feeling disappointed because I had been looking forward to trying this place.

Additionally, the downstairs restroom was extremely dirty and in need of immediate attention. Between the poor service, disappointing food, and unclean restroom, this visit fell far short of what I expected. The staff may benefit from additional training, as there is definitely room for improvement.

What a beautiful experience! From the outside, the restaurant is unassuming, but once you step inside, a narrow staircase leads down to a glistening dining room. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, and the food was truly delicious. The birria and mole were the best I’ve ever had outside of Southern California. I’ve never been to Mexico, but to me, the food had a warmth and depth that felt truly special.

media.caption: Mexican dinner with barbacoa and chips

reviews.snippet: Great spot for a fun night with friends. Drinks are the star (tamarind margarita = obsessed), and the staff is always amazing. It’s lively but not one of those places where you’re yelling across the table all night, which makes it even better.

media.caption: Spicy rim margarita and printed menu
Tall cocktail with dried lime garnish
Street seating with teal awning and chairs
Enchiladas mole with onion and queso
Fried calamari with smoky chipotle aioli
Crispy fried calamari with lime wedge
Bar counter with red neon sign
Espresso machine with coffee syrup dispensers

reviews.snippet:
This was actually my second time here and it was even better than my first!

I had the cucumber habanero margarita and it was spicy!! So def not for the tame, however the flavors were delicious, I got two lol.

I also ordered the ceviche mixtos and their salad with steak added. The steak was seared beautifully, absolutely gorgeous on that fresher than fresh salad. The ceviche was some of the best I've ever had. Tender, juicy, tangy, layered flavor components and the whole thing felt like it was blessed by poseidon himself.

I will def let this be a spot for me moving forward, especially when hitting up the local shopping (there's target, tjmaxx home goods about 6-7 min walk away.)

This is a truly hidden gem near Central Park,my boyfriend and i went there for Valentine's day and it was truly one of the best restaurants we've been here in NYC .
Food was amazing,drinks were out this planet and our server he was just the best.
Highly recommend for any kind of day,truly Mexican food ❤️

This place tops the list of my favorite neighborhood spots. All dishes I've tried are wonderful. Outdoor seating option additional to the basement is great, service is fantastic. I'll keep coming back! Birria, enchiladas, huevos rancheros are my favs. Gluten free clearly called out on menus.

This meal was Amazing. The staff was super friendly and helpful. They make one of, if not the best margaritas I have had in a long time. The food was very traditional, which we LOVE! Proper size handmade corn tortillas. We sat inside downstairs and the atmosphere was lovely.
We will be back! So pleased with everything about our time here.

Picked this place because we needed a breakfast near where we were staying for the weekend. Looked pretty unassuming from the outside, but the food and service were both incredible. I ordered the huevos rancheros - they were delicious- and my Mexican boyfriend said his chilaquiles were some of the best he had ever had!

Chefs deserve the tips. Service absolutely sucked tonight. The bartender and the bus boy found it more important to drink corona in front of the customers than to attend them. I have over ten years of food service experience and look forward to leaving %30 tips. Unfortunately, my experience this evening was less than sub par. We had to ask for menus, to place our order, for drinks, for the check, and they forgot to bring the guacamole at the start. It’s a good idea to stop drinking on the job and do your job if you actually expect a tip. It is too bad that this experience made me not want to return. The food is actually some of the better and more authentic Mexican cuisine I’ve had in New York. My partner is from Mexico City and she likes it too. My advice to the owner: keep the chefs, hire some female workers, get rid of the machismo servers and get serious about your restaurant.

Absolutely amazing Birria tacos! Authentic and delicious, overstuffed and filling! The Cantarito Tradicional is my new favorite drink. Everyone on staff was so nice and friendly and the atmosphere is fun and inviting! Will be back when I’m back in the city!

Absolutely delicious and fresh food.
Sevice was incredibly attentive.
Good vibes all around 🤩

Delicious food and excellent service. Highly recommend. The guacamole was delicious, and I also enjoyed the other appetizers we tried. The creamy mango margarita was strong but really good. I ordered the enchiladas suizas with cheese and a side of beans. It was super tasty, and leftovers the next day were really good too. For dessert, the flan was awesome. Churros were really sweet, so I personally didn't love them, but others in my group liked them a lot.
Such a great spot! The margaritas are well made, the food was delicious.
This place always hits, fantastic margs, great food. Caesar is awesome.

Love this place. Does it look small and cramped on the outside? Yes but head inside and down the stairs and you are transported into a relaxing, open, welcoming oasis. The food was well prepared and full of flavor. The drinks were perfection. The service was helpful and attentive without being overbearing. Hit the happy hour on taco Tuesdays and you can’t miss!

After my third visit Felt like I needed to complete a review for this amazing neighborhood gem. The kitchen is cooking up some heat. The food is beyond what you’d expect from this unassuming gold mine. Highly recommend the brunch steak and eggs to die for and that damn Kale salad. Can’t forget about Cesar the bartender super friendly whose only mission is excite your palette with amazing cocktails. Definitely have to stop by.

Great food and amazing drinks! Highly recommend the margaritas and we tried the esquites, the ceveche, the brisket and Carne asada tacos. I highly recommend all these

The host is super friendly and we got seated immediately. They have outdoor and downstairs seating. I would definitely return when in the neighborhood.

They offer a discount to pay in cash and our bill was around $70 which is a good price for all this food. They also have happy hour and lunch specials

The food and atmosphere is good. Although I ordered a medium steak and they served me well done. I asked for the steak to go back to the kitchen and order to be corrected the WAITRESS then began down grading her service. I did a 60 min mimosas she intentionally took my cup and did not refill my order forcing me to order another hour of mimosas which is not an issue to me but the issue is she attempted to argue with me which I had to remind her I am a paying customer so if I request another drink and / or order there should not be an issue since this is the SERVICE industry. I was not rude when addressing anyone, this was my first time here and thanks to the “bartender/ waitress” this will be my last time here. Unfortunate since the steak and eggs with potatoes was so delicious once the order was corrected

Amazing atmosphere and delicious food! I think it’s on the pricier end for the meals and is why I offer 4/5 stars for the food rating; however, I’ve gone back twice already and enjoyed it equally both times. Major commendations to the ceviche that I have added a photo of! Their margaritas are particularly good and their staff are more than happy to discuss flavours of both food and meal options. Also, a majority of their food is gluten free and was a huge bonus for my company and me as we all have varying degrees of gluten intolerance.

raw_place.title: The Calaveras NYC
raw_place.description: Chill choice for Mexican cuisine with a vibrantly decorated space & a petite patio.

reviews.snippet:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

While visiting New York on a one-day trip from Boston, we decided to have dinner at The Ellington, and it turned out to be one of the highlights of our day!

Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. The mussels in the garlic white wine sauce were incredibly fresh, and the sauce was so flavorful we didn’t want to leave a single drop behind. The classic burger was juicy and perfectly cooked, served with crispy, golden French fries. The Margherita pizza had a beautiful, unique presentation and tasted just as good as it looked.

I also tried The Ellington’s house beer, and it was fantastic—fresh, aromatic, beautifully balanced, and one of the best beers I’ve had in a long time.

For dessert, we shared the pistachio crème brûlée and the apple tart, both of which were outstanding. Paired with great coffee, they were the perfect ending to an amazing meal.

The prices were very reasonable for the quality of the food and service.

A special thank you to our server, Nahid, who provided exceptional service. He was incredibly friendly, knew the menu inside and out, and made excellent recommendations based on our preferences. His hospitality made our evening even more enjoyable.

Thank you, The Ellington, for making our New York trip even more memorable. We’ll definitely be back the next time we’re in the city.

Greetings from Boston! ❤️

response.snippet: Sara, what a brilliant 5 star review! A trip in from Boston and dinner at The Ellington ending up as the highlight of the day says a lot. Really glad the mussels delivered and that Nahid made the night even better with recommendations that hit the mark. Come back and see us again on the Upper West Side whenever New York calls. Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet:
Made reservations for brunch, but wasn't needed. The place was rather quiet on Sat, but it was also freezing outside.

Got a cozy window seating and loved the ambiance thanks to their floral interiors along with holiday ligthing right next to our table. Noise levels on the quiet side and easy to have conversations.

They have a decent kids menu, and the Chicken Fingers ($10) were perfect for our little one. Huevos Rancheros ($19), and Vegetarian Omelette ($19) which was served with home fries and tossed salad was a good portion. Kimbo Coffee ($4.25) was actually pretty good although would've loved it to be warmer. Refills were slow to come. Food was inline with our expectations.

Food arrived within 8-10 mins of placing our order, so yeah, really quick! Our initial server/waiter wasn't that attentive but their crew members were definitely more alert.

Overall, pretty decent experience.

response.snippet:
Hey Ameya, thank you for such a wonderful review and for sharing such fantastic photos! We’re so glad you enjoyed the cozy window seating and our floral atmosphere during your brunch.

It’s great to hear that the kids' menu was a hit with your little one and that the Huevos Rancheros lived up to expectations. We also appreciate the honest feedback regarding the coffee temperature and the pace of refills; we’ll certainly look into this with our crew to ensure we’re more attentive during our quieter shifts.
We look forward to seeing you and your family back at The Ellington soon! Cheers, The Ellington team

reviews.snippet:
Delightful Tea for Two!
A dear friend and I met here for afternoon tea. The tea sandwiches were all delicious and fresh. We got cornbread and fig butter on the side which did NOT disappoint! Service was very attentive and the decor/design of the space is beautiful. Will absolutely be back!

response.snippet: Thank you for the brilliant 5 stars review and the lovely afternoon tea pictures, Melissa! Afternoon tea for two on a day like that sounds just right. Really glad the tea sandwiches and cornbread with fig butter hit the spot — that combination is a favourite. We will pass your kind words along to the team and look forward to welcoming you back to the Upper West Side soon. Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet: Went with a small group and really enjoyed the food and cocktails. Fun atmosphere was nice. Good vibe.

response.snippet: Thank you, Dave! Really glad you and the group had a good time. The food photos are great too, always nice to see the kitchen's work captured well. Hope to see you back at The Ellington on Broadway soon. Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet:
The Ellington is my go to for Brunch whenever I’m in NYC. The food selection and preparation is excellent and the service is unmatched. Staff is always pleasant and attentive. The ambiance is elegant and there are several different options for seating depending on your vibe. The outdoor patio reminds me of a garden cafe in France. The drinks are spectacular and well crafted in the cutest glassware. I’ve been a regular here for over 3 years and they never disappoint. The manager Cherri is a darling and the server Nahid is irreplaceable!

- Katt, Kevin and the Baby

response.snippet:
Nema, three years of brunch loyalty is the kind of compliment that means the most. Really glad the food and drinks keep delivering, and that Cherri and Nahid keep making every visit feel personal. The patio pulling off that garden cafe feel again is exactly what we like to hear. Come back and see us again soon for more brunch.
Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet: We often visit this restaurant and our experience is always positive. Today, however, we particularly appreciated our server, Nahid, who went out of his way to make sure that a member of our party who is recovering from a recent accident that limits the use of her hands felt comfortable and able to enjoy her meal. His solicitude and professionalism contributed to our enjoyment of a lovely meal.

response.snippet:
William, that is exactly the kind of care we want every guest to feel, especially when someone needs a little extra attention at the table. Nahid handled it with real thought and we will make sure he hears this. Come back and see us again soon.
Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet: Our waitress was very helpful with alternative options and our requests. Everyone was pleased with their meal. The piano music was a bonus.

response.snippet:
Mars, really glad the team could work through some alternative requests and that everyone left happy. You can't beat a bit of live music and the piano rounding out the evening is exactly the kind of detail we love hearing about. Come back and see us again soon.
Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet:
My wife and I visited on our day off and had a very pleasant experience. Since it was a late lunch on a weekday, the restaurant was relatively quiet, which allowed us to enjoy our meal in a relaxed atmosphere.

Our server was friendly and attentive, and we enjoyed most of the dishes we ordered. The overall experience was comfortable and enjoyable.

If the opportunity arises, I would be happy to visit again

response.snippet:
Thank you for the brilliant 5 star review Sean! A quiet weekday lunch with your wife sounds like a great way to spend a day off. Really glad the team looked after you and that the food hit the mark.
Hope to see you both back on the Upper West Side soon. Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet: As usual, we had a wonderful meal at The Ellington. We had a Father’s Day brunch today and while we always enjoy our food, today we also had an exceptional server Nahid. He brought us delicious complimentary corn bread muffins and was very attentive. Loved the jazz pianist whom we could hear while dining on the patio.

response.snippet:
Thank you so much, Leigh! Five stars means a great deal, particularly from a regular. It is always wonderful to hear that the food continues to hit the mark, and Father's Day brunch on the patio with live jazz is hard to beat. Nahid will be delighted to read this, we will make sure he does. Hope to see you back on the Upper West Side very soon.
Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet: We came to The Ellington for Mother’s Day brunch and had such a wonderful experience! The atmosphere was beautiful, the food was amazing, and the service truly made the day feel special. Nahid was absolutely outstanding — attentive, friendly, professional, and made us feel genuinely welcomed from start to finish. It’s rare to come across service that memorable. Thank you to Nahid and the entire team at The Ellington for making our Mother’s Day brunch so enjoyable. We’ll definitely be back!

response.snippet:
Thank you, Salman! Mother's Day is one of our favourite days to host and it means a lot to hear it felt so special. Nahid will be absolutely delighted to read this. We hope to see you all back with us soon.
Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet: If you’re in the area, you have to take some time and stop at the Ellington! I’ve been here many times before, and it never disappoints. The staff is absolutely lovely and the food is delicious. Their cocktails are also some of my favorites in the city. In fact, this restaurant has become so important to my boyfriend and I that we had some of our engagement photos done here. Truly, everyone is always so lovely and the vibe is extremely cozy and welcoming. I can’t say enough good things about this place!

response.snippet:
Thank you for the amazing 5 star review Kelly! Engagement photos at The Ellington, that genuinely means a lot to us. Really glad the food, cocktails, and the whole atmosphere have kept you coming back over the years. We hope to see you both back on the Upper West Side very soon.
Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet:
Our 'foodie week' in Manhattan hit an unexpected peak at The Ellington! We pivoted last minute for Mother’s Day, and it was the best decision we made.

The outdoor seating was perfection and the food was delightful, but the real star was our waiter, Nahid N.

Even with a packed house, he was the definition of grace under pressure—attentive, informative, and genuinely cheery. While NYC has endless dining options, we’ll be returning to The Ellington specifically demanding that we sit in his section again.

Nahid N, you are the man! Thanks so much for being a highlight of our NYC trip. We will be back.

response.snippet:
Thank you for the brilliant 5 star review Wheaton! A last minute Mother's Day pivot that ends up being the highlight of a foodie week in New York City, we love that. Really glad the outdoor seating and the food delivered, and Nahid will be absolutely delighted to read this. We hope to see you back on the Upper West Side next time you are in the city.
Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet:
We come here often, and it never disappoints. The food is amazing, the service is fantastic. The restaurant is spacious and welcoming. We’re never hurried thru our meals. There’s a bar area, outdoor seating and large inside dining areas. Tables are well spaced, lots of room for accessibility♿️
They have a great menu - this time we had “snacks” - cauliflower, calamari and guacamole. Lots of healthy options. They also had some very pretty drinks. Make sure you check out the delightful little drink menu/booklet!
Meter street parking.

My partner and I had a lovely Sunday afternoon brunch here at the Ellington. The food was delicious, the jazz pianist was lovely and our server Nahid was awesome! He was so friendly and gave lots of great recommendations. We will definitely be coming back!

response.snippet: Thank you so much, Aaron! Five stars means a great deal to us. Really glad Sunday brunch delivered on all fronts — the food, the jazz, and Nahid looking after you both. We will make sure he sees this. Hope to see you back on the Upper West Side very soon. Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet:
Rating this a 1 specifically to help bring down the average: really rating should be a 3.5-4 imo

I’d say stay away from any meat: been here only once, but the short rib was barely tender (cooked way too quickly) and the medium rare filet my friend got was 100% over cooked.

Seasoning and flavoring was on point. My table seemed to enjoy the seafood dishes. I also got the duck bao buns and they tasted great, but duck was a bit dry for something cooked “confit”.

Overall seems like the cooks are taking shortcuts to get food out quicker and cheaper. Meat dishes 100% need more attention to detail

The Ellington does a wonderful job with brunch. The menu offers something for everyone and the service today was excellent. Our waiter, Nahid, was very attentive and responsive. He also made the most beautiful cappuccino for us I have ever seen! It had a very intricate flower pattern. The food was really good and sitting outside on the patio on a warm spring day made for a perfect brunch experience. Thank you!

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for this 5 star review Katie! It sounds like a perfect morning. We will make sure Nahid knows his cappuccino made an impression, that flower pattern takes some practice! We are glad the patio delivered on a day like that. Hope to see you back out there soon.
Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet:
Had a pretty awful experience here for dinner starting with the host greeting our party. The older gentleman talked down to our group before seating us. That should have been our red flag to walk away but we were so hungry we stayed.

The restaurant seemed to be understaffed because our the waiter was covering many tables service was slow and we were able to get more water or drinks. Our water carafe was also dirty which was gross

The food was just alright, the pizza ordered was burnt on the corners and the burgers were good. The fries were subpar

We love coming here, it’s one of our favorite places in the neighborhood. The food is consistently excellent, the vibe is cool without being stuffy, and they are always so sweet and welcoming to families. Many times we’ve had Nahid as our server and he goes above and beyond to make our experience A++. The Ellington is a staple and we hope others can discover this incredible gem !

response.snippet: Thank you so much, Irene! Reviews like this one mean the world to us. Knowing that The Ellington has become a neighbourhood staple for your family and that the experience is consistent every time is exactly what we are here for. Nahid is a wonderful part of our team and we will make sure he sees this. We hope to keep welcoming you back to Broadway for a long time to come. Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

reviews.snippet: I came in to The Ellington for dinner with a friend on Sunday night. We had a great time — the food was terrific and the service from Nahid was first-rate. I love the spacious dining room and the casual, comfortable vibe at The Ellington.

response.snippet:
F. Paul, we are chuffed a Sunday dinner with a friend came together so well, and that Nahid took such good care of the table. The spacious dining room and easy pace are exactly the vibe we aim for. Come back and see us again soon on Broadway.
Cheers, The Ellington

reviews.snippet: We had a wonderful brunch at Ellington today. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was very welcoming. We were particularly happy to meet our waiter Nahid who took great care of us. He was super helpful and attentive but also warm and friendly. We would be happy to return. Many thanks Nahid!

response.snippet: Thank you, Makram! Really glad brunch at The Ellington hit the mark. Nahid has a way of making every table feel looked after and your kind words will absolutely be passed along to him. We hope to see you back on the Upper West Side soon. Cheers, The Ellington on Broadway

raw_place.title: The Ellington | NYC
raw_place.description: Elegant, rustic-chic tavern presenting seasonally inspired takes on bar fare & cocktails.

reviews.snippet:
Fresh and healthy smoothie in upper west! My friend recommended here and glad to find a place like this. Much better than starbucks. However, I ordered multiple times but they were usually not cold(kinda warm). I think it can be really good if they blend the iced fruits. It's really creamy, so I just keep ordering tho.

Tip: Juice is just juice, but Juice Pharmacy is more of smoothie texture(but not cold).

Pros: Healthy, fresh, affordable
Cons: Kinda warm smoothies and juices

Best smoothie in town! Unique flavors, fair prices, kind staff, something for everyone here. I love how they even offer free samples of the flavor the person before you just got, so you can discover your next new favorite flavor.
Great prices, lovely staff, I went there with my ex, we recommend the Times Square Smoothie!

My favorite drink spot in Harlem! Fresh ingredients, kind staff and great location off the 1 train and near the water. I love all the smoothies - and esp love coming in to find samples on the counter ☺️

Wood interior, bills on the wall from all over the world. Almost walked by but glad i didn't. Very warm service. Tasty samples of the UPS (tefreshing) and more. Ordered the Blake King. Delicious and little pick me up with the coffee addition.

Visited this gem with my wife and son who just moved to the area and the food and service was 5+ stars. They offer a number of free samples to help you decide which smoothie to get, and they were all delicious. We ordered the Tano fruit blend smoothie - strawberry, blueberry, banana, mango and peach - and the Hummus wrap - kale, avocado, hummus, hot pepper, onion and tomato. The smoothie was delicious and the wrap was out of this world awesome, bursting with flavor and freshness. Highly recommend Oasis Jimma!

One of my labmates introduced me to this smoothie spot near Columbia and it’s now become my go-to. It seems really popular amongst other locals too. The smoothies are super affordable & yummy, and not over-iced. My favorite smoothie so far is The Gift. If you’re looking for a little snack to supplement your smoothie, the sambusas are pretty good.

The smoothie here was great, all satisfying especially the service. All great. The smoothie was so good and I'd recommend everyone to go and try it out because on the inside it's really nice and looks super cool!!
The place is small and cramped, but it’s literally a juice bar—so who wants to dine inside lol. Juice selection and service are outstanding. Highly recommend!

Was put on to this place a couple weeks back after a great Saturday morning workout. It's a small place so seating is very limited. I believe most people get their stuff to go.. Which I would advice. But the decor is pretty dope. They have a wall where they have currencies from around the world framed. You just feel happy once you walk in and you're greeted by the workers there and on some days the owner of the place. A pleasant woman she is.
Amazing Fresh Juice and friendly service.
Amazing smoothie bar! And the owner is the sweetest!

media.caption: Layered fruit smoothie with city view
Layered fruit smoothie with bridge view

reviews.snippet: Such a cosy neighbourhood gem!
They have a great selection of natural juices and smoothies and they are super nice and accommodating. 10/10 😁
Used to be decent. Zero quality control nowadays. I’ve gotten really sick multiple times now right after their smoothies.

I love the fact that you can create your own blends here and the prices are very low. They have a wide selection of options.

The only thing that I don't like is that both their almond and soy milks are sweetened - not a good option if you want to avoid added sugars.
Good price for a delicious smoothie. Fresh cut ingredients and made pretty fast. Friendly service, too she have us a sample. Got the UPS and was not disappointed!
1 star for not being open - walked 20 min in heat wave only to find they were closed. Update your hours!!!

THIS PLACE WILL RECEIVE YOUR PRESENCE MAGNIFICENTLY... THE BEINGS HERE KNOW HOW TO GREAT & SERVE *Ü* POWER~FULL FOOD THAT WILL DEFINITELY KEEP WATER~BODY HEALTHY... THIS IS MY FIRST TIME... (Ï) GOT A TIME SQUARE JUICE & A SAMBUSA... MY FRIEND CHUIKE LET ME TEST HER HUMMUS WRAP & WITH ALL (Ï)~AM HAVE A MOUTH ORGASM... THANK *Ü* ABDI ABAJABAL & STAFF TO MAKE ME FEEL SO GOOD INSIDE OUT... HUGE SMILE ON MY FACE...
Very nice smoothies and overall a great vibe. The person says he is living his dream! Always gives me some free samples.

I really loved going here for a limited event “Harry Potter Potions Class”. I was concerned about the size of the venue with regard to what we were up to - but the event planners made it all work. The upstairs area is surprisingly sizable.

Cafe Victoria is the idyllic space for a quaint party or event. The space is is beautiful, with hardwood floors, huge windows overlooking a lovely tree covered block and a community garden, and tons of natural lighting. The decor and furniture are elegant and charming, and there are many small details to admire, like the handcrafted candle holders. I helped host a baby shower at the venue and we needed to do very little set up or decoration to make the space feel warm, inviting, and festive. The owners were attentive and responsive and made sure we had everything we needed to make the shower a success.

I needed to film a scene at a cafe for my student film and this was perfect! Great set up, great lighting, and very quiet! Olga was always quick with communication and was flexible with scheduling. Once the doors are open, she lets you do your thing and never intrudes but is available should you need her. Highly recommend.

World Association for Children held an adoption event here recently and I attended as their adoption consultant. Having never been to the venue I got there early. It was there that I met Olga and Fr. Yakov who were extremely gracious hosts throughout our entire time there. The space is extremely comfortable and the atmosphere is very congenial. Every effort was made to ensure that guests were comfortable and that our stay was eventful. The families that attended found the location to be very convenient. Needless to say Olga went above and beyond the call of duty for our group and I would absolutely hold our next event here.

The light and airy 2nd floor room provided a congenial space for hosting the first birthday party for my godson, his parents, and family and friends. A nice niche for buffet food service, and a banquette with tables and chairs provided plenty of seating, with open space for moving and mingling.

I am an event planner , and I had a viewing today. Got to say the worse experience I've had in my planner experience. The tour guide or whatever he was had no shoes on , the place was a mess not viewing acceptable. Then when I viewed it with the client , and try to book with the original plan of the date being available , the date became unavailable. The place smells like onions and not trying to be funny. So unprofessional, never again. I advised to take it off the market for future events!!!

located within a short walk from the B,C and the1 trains cafe Victoria offers a ground floor, a fully equipped kitchen and a bright second floor area. it's a pleasant spot suitable for various occasions. recommend highly.
Cafe Victoria is a very nice place full of light. Olga was very responsive and helpful, we had a great experience. Our guests were extremely impressed with the space

Olga was very helpful since my first inquiry about the place. She accommodated requests and answered all the questions I had; on the day of the shooting everything went smoothly from start to finish. I highly recommend this place!
I attended a memorial here in the 2nd floor area. Nice cozy spot for a small/medium-sized gathering. Also, there's a piano.
Really nice place cozy

Came here almost every day of my week long solo trip to New York two years ago and mentioned to the owner the first day that this was the best cold brew I have every tried (still true), and from then on he always made conversation with me and was super super friendly and curious every time, it made me feel so welcome and made me want to go back after. The food and vibe is also amazing, would highly recommend to everyone!! Hope I get to go back as I never got to say goodbye to the owner:)
I wasn’t allowed to use my laptop, I thought that’s what you do in cafes, get work done and enjoy your coffee. Besides that my French toasts was soggy, tasted like raw eggs. Wouldn’t recommend.

response.snippet: Thank you for your feedback Madiha, I'm really sorry we couldn't please your palate. You get work done at an office or home office, yes there are plenty of cafes that allow the usage of computer but not us.

reviews.snippet: Cute little coffee and tea place not far from central park. Coffee is great and l loved the matcha. They have a nice outdoor seating area, although I think it could be cleaned a bit more because I saw some cigar butts on the shelf. I really like that they use compostable materials and I like the vibe/artwork.

response.snippet: Thank you Casey for your feedback, I am happy to know you enjoyed our product and vibe. I apologize for the cigar incident, we shared the out door seating with our neighbors next door and at night after we are closed they have costumers that do that. Will keep an eye on it from now on.

reviews.snippet: This is my favorite weekend breakfast/brunch place. My boyfriend and I come here at least once, if not twice, every weekend. It’s a charming local spot that’s small but mighty. There are only a handful of tables, so you may need to wait sometimes to sit but it’s worth it! My boyfriend is gluten free and always craves the GF pancakes with bacon. I try to mix it up but find myself always gravitating towards their biscuit sandwich — so good!! I would also recommend their breakfast burrito or salmon benedict.

response.snippet: Thank you guys for the kind and motivating words. You patronage is greatly appreciated.

reviews.snippet: Demitasse Coffee & Tea is SO good! I came here a few years ago for breakfast while I was staying on the Upper West Side and my experience was excellent. I definitely plan to return at some point, their coffee is delicious and they have a great menu!

response.snippet: Thank you Kristen, we look forward to seeing you again, soon.

reviews.snippet: This shop is so cute and the service/food is amazing! Highly recommend stopping by for a quick meal if you’re able to. The pastries and drinks are also very delicious.

response.snippet: Thank you for your motivating feedback. This kind of review is the caffeine we need when we wake up 4:30 am to be ready to work at 8am.

reviews.snippet: Great little spot near Columbia and Central Park. Excellent coffees, good food (breakfast burritos, fruit and yogurt, avocado toast…) The service is really nice. It’s small but there’s a decent amount of seating.

response.snippet: Thank you Michele for your feedback. We are happy to know you enjoyed your visit.

reviews.snippet: Excellent coffee! Food is great too. We had the breakfast burritos and I have no idea how they take a few simple ingredients and make them taste so delicious. Will look this place up every time I visit the city.

Really good coffee! Nice dude at the register making the coffee. I couldn't figure out how to tip but I'll just ask next time. Croissant was solid. Interior is nice. Looks like laptops are not allowed because its a small space. Looking forward to trying other things.

response.snippet: Thank you Pragya, it really means a lot to all of us. We look forward for your next visit.

reviews.snippet:
*May2025 update*
Now moved 1 block down and known as CALAVERAS CAFÉ, same offerings as Demitasse and taco shop downstairs by night. Very little seating upstairs in coffee area but great staff and pastries and coffee!

*July 2020 update* Demitasse is still open for takeout during Phase 2 and I am thankful! They don’t have outdoor seating but you can order online or at the counter and then take your breakfast burrito to go. Highly recommend!

*2017*
Finally got to check out this little neighborhood spot (opened around summer 2017 I think), met Angel, and had one of the best breakfast burritos I’ve found in New York. Opens at 8am on weekdays for breakfast and I highly recommend it for pre-work breakfast and coffee- you can get an omelette breakfast or breakfast burrito with hash browns or a Colombian breakfast plate or other similar sized items for about $12-13, or smaller sized pastry type items. Also had a drip coffee and it was fantastic, but there are plenty more coffee/espresso options.

There are probably 5-6 small high top tables for 2 and a small bar you can eat at, so I’d recommend it for solo eating or meeting up with one other person. Not super crowded on weekday mornings before 10am.

Go try this spot and get a loyalty punch card because you’ll want to come back!

response.snippet: Full of joy reading such an amazing review. Totally worthy to get up at 5am every day. Thanks and come back soon and often.

reviews.snippet: Nice place, the food is pretty good, cool outside seating arrangement for covid, however they don’t have any eco-friendly options..
I love this place! They have some of the best chai in the city. The food is delicious as well. The burrito and biscuit sandwich are my favorite! Excellent service!

response.snippet: Thank you, Emily. It's really nice too wake up this early and see the notification of such a positive review. We are very happy that you enjoyed your visit at Demitasse and we look forward to serving you again, soon.

reviews.snippet: Stopped by for a quick coffee and was amazed by the quality of their lattes. Probably the best vanilla latte I’ve had in months. Stop by if you want a quick coffee. I’ll be coming back!

response.snippet: AK, thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience with us. This kind of review is our motivation to always provide the best quality products and services. We look forward to seeing you again soon.

reviews.snippet: Great place to order take out from! Food is fresh and well seasoned! I had the breakfast arepa which was delicious. Can’t wait to be able to stop by in person soon!

response.snippet: Hi Gaby, thank you for such a wonderful feedback. In these rough times it means a world to know we are doing things right. Looking forward to seeing you soon at Demitasse, we have great food as now know and the best vibe.

reviews.snippet: Amazing coffee and espresso. The pastries are perfect for a morning start. Service is on point and very helpful. I will re visit any time I hit the city.

The coffee is ok, not very special. However, people are not allowed to use laptop for work or even having class and study there. No WiFi.
And I visit two cafe per day during the week my stay in Manhattan. All of the local coffee shop have the internet access EXCEPT this one, and they have the unlimited laptop using time and unlimited WiFi as well. So that’s unreasonable people can’t enjoy their coffee time and their business at the same time, anyway, here is New York, people all know how it feels like to work in a CAFE.

response.snippet: Hi Sharon, thank you for your kind feedback. Please have in mind that since March 2020 all places like Demitasse Coffee & Tea are working under extreme regulations. So we do our best to offer our "OK" coffee to as many patrons as possible still keeping our team and patrons as safe as possible. We provide as for our understanding great coffee, pastries, and breakfast items. Probably you were looking and needing an office space rather than a coffee shop, if I'm not wrong there is a big coffee shop chain named Starbucks which provides OK coffee with unlimited Wi-Fi.

reviews.snippet: Simply amazing. A boost of energy in every bite of this tasty Colombian food, it’s like I was traveling to the coasts off Cartagena after a brisk morning walk. I highly recommend going here with a group of friends and enjoying a sunny day afterwards!

response.snippet: Thank you Yannick for your encouraging review. We are very happy you enjoyed your time at Demitasse. We look forward to seeing you soon.

reviews.snippet: If you care about good roast selection matched with excellent barista work, here's your place. Matcha Latte with oat milk was also great.

This is one of my favorite coffee shops in all the city 100% (favorite order there for drinks is the decaf iced latte with oat milk is so creamy with freshly ground coffee that is delicious. Food bonus is prime (hard worker breakfast and the biscuit sandwich with chorizo is 👌🙌) + WiFi for my work and study days!

response.snippet: Thanks Kiki. You are one of our favorite, too.

reviews.snippet: It’s a wonderful place! Cool atmosphere and the staff was super friendly. If I am near north Central Park again, I will definitely visit Demitasse again!

response.snippet: Thank you Philip, for taking the time of sharing your experience in your visit and thank you for your encouraging words.

reviews.snippet:
Sincerely one of the best experiences I have had in a while. I had called ahead to kindly ask for a table seat instead of bar seating and to notify the restaurant I may arrive a little early to which they were super understanding and were able to work with us.

Villa, our server was accommodating, polite, attentive, and made us feel so special.

The food was delightful. We had the braised beef soup, scallion pancake, zhong dumplings, soup dumplings, cucumbers, and the chicken lo mein. Everything was very, very delicious.

The place was super clean and they had very relaxing music playing.

This place was the only place saved that up north in Manhattan (I am more of a downtown girly). However, I think it’s good for what it is! They have an open kitchen and the vibe is very lowkey, moody and actually, could be romantic. The service is attentive and very sweet.

The food! The food is great! Chonqqing spicy chicken is quite amazing! I really enjoyed the spice and the chicken. Soup dumplings were great - I think it has a perfect amount of soup and meat! Kungpao chicken is great as well - not as spicy as I wished for but chonqqing chicken was for that!

Must try noodles next time!!!

I’m a Columbia student and come here all the time. The prices are super reasonable, and one bowl of noodles is more than enough to fill you up. It’s also a great spot to come with friends and order a few stir-fried dishes to share. Highly recommend the beef noodles with mashed potatoes and the crispy salted chicken — huge portions!

media.caption: Braised pork rice with bok choy
Crispy fried popcorn chicken with seasoning

reviews.snippet: On a cold day after snowstorm, the group just wanted a hot noodle soups. The soup was lukewarm for all of us, thus disappointing. My trotter soup was too salty, so were the ribs. The salted egg shrimps were good (10 pieces). Server was nice, but service was slow because it seemed only one guy was around, warranting the 4 stars.

media.caption: Dinner menu, appetizer and noodle listings

reviews.snippet: Who doesn’t love fresh noodles? This place is amazing. The spicy cucumber salad was so saucy and punchy. Sizzling noodles have a bite and are a bowl of comfort. Freshest ingredients. The open kitchen creates a wonderful atmosphere. The service is uniquely sensitive and attentive. Highly recommend!

An incredible restaurant! I love Chinese food, in particular Shanghainese food. This place delivers!

I ordered the Dan Dan Noodles and the Zhong Dumplings. Both were incredible and tasted exactly as they should.

The staff were extremely polite and attentive, and I saw many people come in after I was seated, enjoy their food, and have a great time.

I prefer eating solo sometimes, and felt very comfortable eating here by myself, but I also knew that I’d feel welcome eating here with a group.

Keep up the great work, and to anyone reading this, please go check them out!

Food was delicious. We had the shrimp rolls, popcorn chicken and savory pancake scallions and they were delicious, especially the chicken. I had the beef noodle soup and it was so hearty, delicious and filling. Our waiter Galvin was great and guided us with recommendations. Will definitely be back!

The Tang on Amsterdam is an Absolute Gem!!

I just had one of the best meals I’ve had in New York in a long time at The Tang on Amsterdam, and I’m still thinking about it the next day. This place is a total hidden treasure in the neighborhood—cozy, vibrant, and packed with flavor in every sense of the word.

The vibe is perfect: warm lighting, beautiful décor with subtle Thai touches, and that lively energy without being overwhelming. It feels like a special spot whether you’re on a date night or just treating yourself after a long week. The service was genuinely warm and attentive—our server knew the menu inside out and was excited to help us pick dishes.

But let’s talk about the food, because wow. Everything we ordered was excellent, but the Stir Fried Beef with Fresh Mint Breeze? It was straight-up show-stopping. Tender, perfectly seared slices of beef in a savory, slightly sweet sauce that sings with garlic, chili, and that incredible pop of fresh mint. The mint isn’t just a garnish here—it’s the star that cuts through the richness and leaves you with the most refreshing, addictive finish. Every bite felt bright, bold, and balanced. I’m not exaggerating when I say it might be the best stir-fried beef dish I’ve ever had in the city. I literally cleaned the plate and was tempted to order another round.

If you’re anywhere near Amsterdam Ave, do yourself a favor and go to The Tang right now. Incredible flavors, generous portions, fair prices, and that rare feeling of leaving happier than when you walked in. Easily one of the best Thai spots in Manhattan. I’m already planning my next visit—probably tomorrow.
Highly, highly recommend. 10/10.

Go hungry and bring friends so you can share (or don’t… that beef might not make it to the table if you’re selfish like me 😉).

The Tang on Amsterdam – you’ve earned a new regular!

The Tang is a casual Chinese noodle restaurant on the Upper West Side in New York. The main focus is noodles and soups, which are flavorful, hearty, and come in big portions. The food is generally good, especially the beef noodle soup and dumplings, which are the most popular items.

The place itself is modern and simple inside, with a slightly dark but clean and relaxed atmosphere. It feels more like a quick casual dinner spot than a fancy restaurant. Service is usually friendly and efficient.

Location is convenient on Amsterdam Ave near Columbia/Upper West Side, with a lot of other restaurants and cafes around.
Food was excellent. Great portions and flavor. Great vibes. They were also so accommodating of my family and handicap needs. Highly recommend

Had a great time at The Tang NYC! The mango cocktail was super refreshing, and both the spicy chicken fry and kung pao chicken were packed with flavor and perfectly cooked. The crunchy potato wedges were dynamic and full of spicy flavor. Great food, fun vibe — definitely worth a visit!

Great Sichuan spot just steps from Columbia! 🏫
The Pea Pasted Noodles were rich, spicy, and super comforting — perfect on a cold day. The Tang’s Fried Rice (with minced pork and preserved veggies) totally blew me away — must-try! 🔥
Affordable, flavorful, and super student-friendly. Definitely coming back for more!

The Tang is a cozy, contemporary eatery serving creative Chinese noodles and other classic plates on the Upper West Side. It’s nice for a date or dinner with a friend. We had such a great meal from the Braised Beef Noodle Soup to the Zhong Dumplings and Tang’s Bliss Chicken Wings… So delicious!!

Decent place. Our waiter was very attentive and wonderful. The food was just okay. We ordered from the vegetarian selection and at the bottom of the cabbage bowl were bits of shredded beef. We’re not strict, but that was strange. The vegetable fried rice was just okay. The add on noddles was plain we asked for soy sauce and use the duck sauce from our spring rolls to give it some flavor. I left full, but the food didn’t really wow either of us.

But again, the service was great!

We visited The Tang located in upper west side which the decor is modern with cozy ambiance. It’s good for a workday quick lunch but also perfect for dating.

We love their Pork Dumplings in Chili Oil which was flavorful with great size of dumplings. The Salt & Pepper Ribs was decent but not as soft as expected.

We shared Beef Noodles Soup, Cold Noodles and Spicy Diced Chicken with a group of five people. Both noodles were delicious with good portion and their braised eggs were impressively satisfying.

My husband and I tried this place randomly on a Saturday night after a day of hanging out in the city. The place is quite small with not a lot of seating, but we didn't feel cramped. We ordered the Zhong Dumplings (Pork Dumplings w/Chili Oil & Garlic), Crispy Shrimp Spring Roll, Braised Beef Noodle Soup, Chongqing Spicy Chicken (Chicken bites w/dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns), Sho Chiku Bai Nigori, and Tsingtao. Everything was absolutely delicious!! The waiters were all very friendly and attentive. We would definitely eat here again.

It was a pleasant experience overall. Our appetizers (pork buns and shrimp spring rolls) where very tasty. The shared sake was also very good. Our main dishes were good but not extraordinary. One dish, a cold noodle dish, was very bland, and the other, the garlic ribs, was served with an overwhelming amount of crispy fried garlic (like overwhelming) and since the ribs were fried also, they were very dry with not much meat.

Even though there was only one server for the whole restaurant (who also worked the front door, sat people, and fetched to-go orders) we didn’t experience any bad or terribly delayed service…so kudos to that guy! But seriously the man may need some help.

Atmosphere was pleasant and not too loud.

response.snippet:
We apologize for the delayed response, and thank you for your thoughtful and detailed feedback. Two of our front-of-house team members were unexpectedly unable to work that evening, and we’re very sorry that the staffing shortage affected your experience. We also truly appreciate your recognition of the server who handled everything that night.

Our team should have noticed that the cold noodles were too bland and worked with the kitchen to correct the dish. We’re also reviewing your feedback about the garlic ribs. Please call the restaurant or email us directly with your visit details so we can follow up and take the appropriate steps to improve.

reviews.snippet: It tastes so good! All the noodles are delicious and I like the cabbage and the shrimp. But need to wait for the food since it’s cooked in front of you. Totally worth it!

Absolutely incredible experience, exactly what authentic and flavorful Chinese food should taste like. The spicy beef is one of the best things I've ever eaten and is a must try. Service was friendly and attentive. Can't wait to come back here.

The Tang just reopened! Was missing my chicken soup 🥹

There are quite a few new dishes and the price was adjusted down. With so much meat and vegetables in their noodles this is such a bargain compared to the other $20+ shops. Flavors are good too. I liked the beef and the pig trotter noodles especially.

Tried some of their new cocktails - cucumber flavor is very unique and cool.

Will come back again.

response.snippet: Thank you Jiang for your kind words and welcome back!

raw_place.title: The Tang
raw_place.description: Contemporary, cozy restaurant serving eclectic Chinese big & small plates, plus noodle bowls.

reviews.snippet: Good coffee and good snacks. The atmosphere is for sure for reading, studying, and maybe post-hookup feeling out the partner. The beans are decent for the coffee, and go well with the sandwiches.

Plowshares Coffee Roasters is one of my favorite coffee shops in Harlem. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the coffee is excellent. It is the kind of place where you can bring a book, a laptop, or simply sit and enjoy your coffee while watching the neighborhood go by. It is also a good place to meet a friend and have a conversation without feeling rushed.

One thing I especially appreciate is their Sunday afternoon jazz sessions. With so many small venues and community spaces in Harlem closing over the years, it is great to see a local business supporting live music and creating a place where people can gather and enjoy it.

Overall, a great neighborhood coffee shop with good coffee, a friendly atmosphere, and a strong sense of community. I always enjoy spending time here and will definitely be back.
Live jazz Sundays 2pm is great. Good coffee, limited food options sometimes. Last time I came they had a tasty focaccia sandwich, maybe it's new

Ts so buns. Lox bagel with cream cheese $11. Handed us a bagel with a radius of 2 inches and you had to put on the cream cheese and salmon yourself. Then no oat milk either after charging $0.75 for it on top of a sour cold brew for $5.25 that I couldn't finish. They said this bottle contained oat milk at the station but it was just soy milk after I took a sip and realized it didn't taste like oat milk. I'm writing this with my tongue spasming in pain from the sourness of the cold brew.
Plowshares has a very cool space where they serve some great drip coffee. The inside is really much larger than you’d suspect from the street

Amazing coffee, beautiful space, and genuinely kind people. You can taste the care in every cup. Plowshares Coffee Roasters is the kind of place that makes you slow down and enjoy the moment. One of my favorite coffee spots—highly recommend!!

Good chill music. Ideal atmosphere for those who want to focus and get things done. WiFi, accessible plugs and many tables. There’s a piano and a chessboard. Yummy pretzel and very good pain au chocolate. The coffee was small, but the flavor was great.
Saw Will Lyle Trio ft. John Webber and Rodney Green- for free! It does not get better than this! Ate a Caprese sandwich with a Cortado- Killer! Geeat vibe in here. Some people working, some hanging.
The coffee is great, the service is top-notch, love the design and the jazz sessions on Sundays. They even have a chess set. Feels like heaven to me. 10/10!

I LOVE Plowshares. Truly my favorite cafe by Columbia. It is large and spacious with many places to sit and great drinks and food to keep you sustained. I have been going here for over three years, and it is my go to place. I really love their soups which are fresh and rotated. There was a period of maybe two months when I came twice a week to work. Not too loud not too busy but still dynamic. my ONLY! wish is that they would carry matcha, but they also have many other non-coffee options (hot tea, hot chocolate, chai latte)
Just tried this coffee for the first time, very good! Awesome and such wonderful coffe spot

Great atmosphere, nice staff, but the coffee is hit or miss (occasionally tasting burnt) depending on the barista.

They also have live jazz between 2-4 pm which is great.

Beautiful coffee shop in Harlem. 😍 - perhaps one of my favorite coffee shops in NYC. I’ve been here twice but always satisfied with my cappuccino or latte.

I went here last Saturday (images) and it was a rainy day. I was a bit disappointed that I wasn’t asked if I would have my coffee inside or to go, so my beverage was served on a carton cup. But other than that, as an avid coffee drinker, I’m a fan.

This is a go-to place for coffee and a cozy space to work on whatever you are doing. I like the space a lot and they serve pastries from a super delicious bakery which is one of my favorites in lower east side.

Cappuccino was decent, although not super creamy. The beans they used were on the mid-dark roasted side, slightly bitter.

The coffee is fantastic, setting is awesome and they do cool things like the weekly jazz. However some of the servers are just ever so slightly passive aggressive and condescending. Has happened now 4-5 times. I say this with the hope that it becomes better - service is the only thing holding this place back!

Pumpkin pastry perfectly executed; excellent and flavorful lamination, perfect pumpkin filling—not too dense, and sweet just enough for a breakfast pastry. Flat white well done—no nonsense but still kind staff. Amazing space. There’s care.

I’m sad to say the service experience today was not as I’d hope. I decided to try the chai but found it very sweet and asked if it could be made less so. He said, basically no it’s the syrup. Which I got but said, I can’t drink it. So I asked for a simple tea/bag instead. He then said ok here, you pay here. I was confused as I had already paid for the other drink and clarified, no this is replacing the drink I can’t drink. He then began to tell me that he can’t return food and then compared it to returning a croissant. I then felt he missed the nuance and explained this drink isn’t made the same everywhere and I never had it here. He didn’t seem to interested to acknowledge the difference. By the time I got the tea, I sadly didn’t want to stay to enjoy it. Total buzzkill and sad because we like place and owner … I hope there’s more emphasis on offering a little bit of grace especially to a local and regular trying a new drink.

A beautiful place to work, with many outlets, seat cushions, various seating arrangements, self-serve water, TWO restrooms, that has an amazing free monthly Open mic too! (Definitely sign up for their newsletter — it was the first good thing that ever came out of my spam inbox!)

Drink prices are very reasonable to me. I think they serve some soups and pretzels for food; have not had myself yet. My iced chai latte served in a real glass was life-giving on a horribly humid day.

They have some beer/ales and one on tap.

Day pictures are from a grateful Sunday afternoon where many people were working alongside me with laptops, and it was very quiet, spacious, and filled with natural light. Including one picture of the Open Mic where my partner and I stayed for an amazing show until 10pm on a summer Fri night.

With prices so reasonable, I would really love for this cafe to thrive. Please come here. Note: Hours differ depending on the weekday!

media.caption: Iced chai latte served in a real glass on a horribly humid day was amazing~
BOMB after-hours Open Mic with local music

reviews.snippet: Cafe culture is alive and well here! You can get a lot of work done here. The light is as good as the vibe. I have not been to the live music night yet—but if the grand piano is any indication they take it as seriously as their coffee.

We always come here when we visit New York City! Plowshares has outstanding coffee and excellent service. The Harlem store is spacious for a sit-me-down, and the Broadway location is the quintessential hole-in-the-wall. Both highly recommended!!
The slices are bigger than other pizza places, the sauce is not impressive but good. More counter space for eating and sitting.

Travelled across an ocean to experience how the great city of New York makes it's wonderful pizzas. We chose this place as it was a proper old style hole in the wall pizzeria, and believe me we were not disappointed. The pizza was cooked to perfection, deliciously crispy and great flavoured cheese. Made even better with the option of free chili flakes and parmesan. The pizza was a great price too, easy to feed 2 people for under $10. Anyone else in the area should definitely stop by.

By definition, this is a New York Pizza slice not gonna lie. It is the best NYC pizza slice? No, but it does the job, of a typical new york slice you eat on the go when you are rushing and you need the quick bite to eat. The garlic knots are pretty good too! The place is well needed on 125th because to be honest 125th street is lacking pizza places. So thank you for being there.
2 slices with a free can of soda?? I'm just happy it's 1 of the best tasting pizza around!
I’ve only tried the cheese slice here, but I love it — and as a true pizza girly, trust me on this one! There’s no seating area, so plan to stand and eat orrr just take out lol.

Officially my 1st Pizza slice in NYC and what an amazing taste,thin crust,great toppings(i had a margarita🥰)fresh & not too oily!small interior with stand up shelf area but service was polite & professional.
Pizza was fantastic. Quick slice at a fair price. 100% recommend
Great NY pizza. Service was timely. A few spots to eat around the perimeter of the venue. No actual tables or chairs were present. Two slices and a can of soda $8.

Place is nice and clean but worker had a disgusting attitude . He acted as if I wasted his time being in there and had a smug look on his face the entire time .
Pizza is average .. taste old … truthfully it just tastes like a dollar slice with extra cheese if you ask me .
Won’t be back ! Nothing about that slice was “ super “

Overly salty and low quality for a slice of $4.90 buffalo chicken pizza. They don’t even show you the price with tax, which means paying with cash sucks.
Somehow you could notice the quality of service in a slice of pizza transaction. And it’s not quite friendly

My previous review was deleted, and a year later I’m still mad about my experience here.

Long story short, I paid for a pizza here online. I had a receipt to show proof of purchase. I had an order number. They said they didn’t get it on their end literally told me to “F*** off and get the F*** out” when I tried to show them my order number and receipt. 30 dollars I never got back. I was very kind and civil the entire exchange so I don’t know why they were freaking out at me.

I again add that all people should just go eat at the pizza place a block away called Dado’s. They are awesome and kind people who will give you a good slice.

❤️pizza …I've ordered from this establishment five times now and every single time, they have NOT disappointed me!! Their food is on point, it arrives hot and freshly made. Their delivery men are courteous and observes the hands-free order drop-off rules. I will continue to order from them as a faithful customer!

I wish I could give less than one star. The pizza was great, the customer service was atrocious. As soon as I arrived I gave my order at which point a price was quoted, I didn't ask how much I knew the cost and I knew what I wanted. I was accompanied by two of my colleagues who also gave their orders at which point we were asked who was paying. We were all paying for our own food it was just slices of pizza. When the pizza was done heating they asked did we want it all box, we didn't order together, we didn't pay together why would I want 6 slices of pizza smashed together in a box. I will be looking for a new pizza venue because this experience was frustrating and insulting. This wasn't a gourmet meal or venue it was pizza. Never again!

Paid $15 for a large pizza, it was ok. The cheese congealed into one large mass with no pull even while warm, but the flavor was alright and we ate the whole thing. We probably would only come back because its conveniently close by.

I’m m a regular pepperoni pizza lover and I’ve been eating that everywhere in NYC. Nowadays I have a list of many places that I love the pizza they make. This restaurant has the best pepperoni pizza in Harlem, the flavor of the sauce is so good, the crust is great and the cheese is delicious. They could piping indoor dinning, that’d be a plus but at this time I’m happy to have my hot pepperoni slice of pizza when I want it in Harlem. Just try it….
Pizza it’s okay. Just make sure you count your change. I made the mistake of not counting before leaving. Order was $4.50 gave $20.00 got back $5:50 enjoy my $10.00.

The pizza looks great. But as we all know looks can be deceiving. The sauce is the definition of bland. Cheese is abnormally oily and crust is acceptable.
I've had better dollar slices.
Refuse to pay 2.50 for this lack of flavor
The regular slices and beef patties were good but a little pricey because of the inflation that most folks still understand. They want to make a seen at the shop.
This place is just for take out. The Margarita pizza was okay.

For is Dee t but the service an attitude of the employees well actually one in particular is ridiculous. He seems like a miserable person who has no respect for others and never heard of “The customer is always right “. He literally huffed and puffed like a five year old little girl and went UGHHHHH, whattt. Now?! I am busyyy!”

I ordered a grocery delivery on Friday January 30th. It never arrived, despite multiple notifications that my order had been sent. It's Saturday January 31st and still no order. Totally unacceptable. In addition, they totally misrepresent the length of time for the order to arrive. I was given a 25 minute window for delivery. More than 90 minutes later it still hadn't arrived. Again, Totally unacceptable. False advertising. Undelivered food. Not happy at all.

I ordered two cases or 40 bottle water and your guys sent me two cases or 12 bottle in replacement after I leave a 1 star review never again…….i will never order from these unprofessional business again he text me number today trying to go back and forth who they clearly did not complete my order. I should of check all these reviews before even placing an order so many people can not be lying on your business.

response.snippet:
Hi Stephanie, we’re truly sorry for the inconvenience caused by the blizzard-related delivery disruption. Unfortunately, the original third-party driver picked up your order but was unable to complete the delivery due to severe weather conditions.
To make things right, we resent your full original order as a courtesy under Uber Eats Order #FA683, at no additional cost to you. According to your order receipt, this included 2 × Poland Spring 1.5L (12-pack) cases, totaling 24 bottles. We kindly ask that you review your order history in the Uber Eats app to confirm the item and quantity selected.
We always aim to provide accurate orders and excellent service, and we appreciate your understanding in this situation. If you still feel there is an issue, please contact us directly so we can assist further.

reviews.snippet: Really was excited for their vegan sandwich, but kind of sad when I got it, it was not a panini but more like toasted bread (the inside was not pressed or warm), and it was pretty soggy and fell apart. My husband’s non-vegan sandwich looked better and was much bigger too (see the pics) which was kind of weird. I would say it was a little disappointing but considering it is a bodega, not super surprising.

response.snippet: ,Julia, We pride ourselves on fresh and high-quality food with efficient service to match, and it sounds like we really dropped the ball here. I apologize. I can assure you, however, that this incident was an unusual one. Thank you for your business.

reviews.snippet: I will never shop here again I ordered two cases of water which the never delivered and lied and said it was delivered when I call to inquire about my order the guy said it was delivered I told him to ask the delivery guy who they delivered it to he said he would call me back and never did. It’s a snow storm outside if you wasn’t doing deliveries why charge me $57 to lie and say it was delivered knowing it’s a lie bad business never again.

response.snippet:
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and frustration this caused you. Yesterday’s blizzard created severe delivery disruptions across NYC, and unfortunately, the third-party delivery driver assigned to your order picked it up but failed to complete the delivery. While the delivery service was handled by a third party, we fully accept responsibility for ensuring our customers receive their orders.

As promised, we have resent your order at no additional charge, and we truly appreciate your patience and understanding during this situation. We value your business and hope you’ll give us another opportunity to serve you better in the future.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and we appreciate your consideration in updating your review.

reviews.snippet: THE BEST DELI THE CUSTOMER SERVICE IS ABOVE AND BEYOND FOR MY ORDER I AM SO IMPRESSED THANK YOU SO MUCH 5 STARS ALL OF THE ABOVE HIGHLY RECCOMEND DELICIOUS SMOOTHIE AND MUSHROOM BOWL THANK YOU SO MUCH

reviews.snippet: FALSE PRICING - beware if you buy anything from here and be sure to check the prices of the items as they're scanned. Most recently, I grabbed a bottle of dishwasher detergent that was clearly labeled at $7.49 and took to the cash register, where it was priced at $9.99! It took a lengthy argument with the store clerk and me pointing to the price tag at the shelf to convince him that they are trying to overcharge me by 33%. They told me that the shelf showed the "old price," which had not yet been updated. I had to remind them multiple times that a posted price must be honored, period. They finally gave up and "generously" gave it to me at the "old price". Considering that this happened to me twice, this is clearly a scheme to defraud customers. Do not shop here! It is not worth the hassle.

I had a very disappointing and unprofessional experience here. While checking out with my partner, the cashier began speaking in Hindi, assuming I wouldn’t understand. When I confronted him, he looked shocked and only asked if I understood—no apology, no accountability. This behavior felt discriminatory and completely inappropriate. Be cautious—if you don’t understand Hindi, there’s a good chance they’re saying disrespectful things right in front of you. That’s unacceptable for any business.

response.snippet:
Dear Ali,
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We’re truly sorry to hear that your visit was disappointing and that you felt disrespected. Please know that this is not reflective of the standard we aim to uphold.



We take your concerns very seriously. Every customer deserves to be treated with professionalism and respect, regardless of language or background. We are currently looking into this matter internally and will ensure appropriate steps are taken to address and correct the situation.



We’d appreciate the opportunity to speak with you directly so we can better understand what happened and make things right. Please feel free to contact us at 212-666-0109.



Thank you again for your feedback — it helps us improve.
Prakash

reviews.snippet: The cashier said something very rude in Hindi, assuming my partner wouldn’t understand. When my partner responded in Hindi to show he understood, the cashier didn’t apologize or have any shame. It was uncomfortable and completely uncalled for. I used to enjoy coming here, but now I’ll be avoiding this place. You lost a loyal customer.

This Deli a wonderful! The food is never bad! Try the blue berry pancakes!! The sandwiches are always delicious and perfect! The store is clean all the time. I have shopped at this store since it opened! The owner is wonderful and the staff is kind and helpful! They offer vegan food as well and Indian food! You can’t go wrong shopping here!

reviews.snippet:
Beware of the credit card premium they charge on purchases. Was 3.76% for me.

There is a tiny, barely noticeable, sign that says prices are differrent for cash vs credit card purchases. They pointed to this after I had to ask for my itemized receipt. When I pointed out the difference in my credit card charge and my itemized receipt they wagged a finger at their unclear sign.

Their unethical process involves checking someone out in the following order:
1. Ring up items
2. Tell you to approve amount on keypad (but giving no point of reference). Customer then taps to pay.
3. Asking if you want a receipt - if you say yes, they give you your non-itemized credit card receipt.
4. If you then ask for an itemized receipt you will finally see the price charged included a hefty 3.76% premium above the price they rung up my order at.

The credit card premium should be clearly listed. Prices on items throughout the store only reflect cash prices.

response.snippet: Sir, Before you swipe your card, machine ask you to confirm your transaction with the surcharge from the processor. Once you confirm then only your transaction processing. So there is no point to complain. Thanks for your business.

reviews.snippet: I absolutely love Freshy's Deli & Grocery! The deli food is a true delight, offering a diverse range of delicious choices that cater to every palate. The quality and freshness of their ingredients shine through in every bite. The abundance of options ensures there's something for everyone, making it my go-to spot for a satisfying and flavorful meal. The friendly staff and welcoming atmosphere only add to the overall fantastic experience. Five stars well-deserved!
