raw_place.title: Freshy's Deli & Grocery
raw_place.description: Around-the-clock store with standard grocery items & a deli counter making sandwiches & other eats.

reviews.snippet: I’ve been going to this deli for years and have never had a problem until now. A couple of weeks ago I ordered a bacon egg and cheese with turkey bacon and they forgot the cheese. Today I ordered a bacon egg and cheese with turkey bacon again and they put turkey slices instead of bacon.

This was my go-to deli for almost two years. No one made a better sandwich in Harlem. However, recently they increased their prices 50% and decreased the quality of their sandwiches significantly. I pass 3 other bodegas to walk to this place. Unfortunately today will be my last time. Too many repeat disappointments here to justify going back. Such a shame.
Average neighborhood deli. They make a decent burger.

This place served as a staple and "home away from home" for us during our visit here. It was right around the corner and open 24/7 and pretty much had everything we needed and was fairly priced for New York. However, the star is Alfred/Alford- he was a lot of fun and extremely enjoyable to converse with and made us the best sandwiches we've ever had, hands down. We were able to customize and order whatever we wanted on it, and he had his own great suggestions. Food was ready very quickly and it was obvious he tries to put a lot of heart into what he does, which can be very hard during those slow, early AM/late night hours. Seriously, I'm still dreaming about those sandwiches- could eat them every day!

Went in to order a simple, grilled chicken on a hero w/mozzarella cheese everything on it. Got home and there was no grilled chicken on the hero smh. Lack of communication between the deli man and the cashier they were ignoring each other. Also a lack of attention to detail and customer service. I definitely won’t come back and wouldn’t recommend any of my friends to either.
Hail from Queens, been stopping here for years when I do work in the neighborhood. Service is swift enough, and I never had a complaint regarding their food. Good drink selection as well.
Good sandwiches Good Foot overall excellent breakfast they have cigarettes beer and groceries however they no longer accept EBT clean and friendly
Good food at a good price, service was friendlier than most deli's I've been to in NY, fair selection of groceries too. I'll be back for sure!
Love shopping here customer service its great! I Like the food, and most of my store needs I find them here, including plants outside the store!
Went this supermarket to get sandwich since they had a deli bought a already made cause no one was behind the counter. Very clean.

Cashier and the sandwich maker are awesome. Thank you guys.
Prices are good too.
Amazing food and wonderful service. Our favorite eatery during our stay in Harlem.
Open 24/7 convenient good for grilled sandwiches and late night munchies!!
Good 👍
In this deli, leave men’s drink beer inside the location like if there bar ,I was passing by with my kid and those men’s are so nasty
I got a sandwich and asked for a few toppings and the guy making it didn't put any of the toppings I wanted in my sandwich.
Good bagels, diverse selection of Little Debbie products
Great guys. Awesome cook!!! Great fresh food!!!
Great options when it comes to candy bars and things of that nature.
Good food service is fast
Great neighborhood Bodega with fresh food and they deliver
Excellent staff, excellent service and excellent prices! Went there every morning and night for a fresh juice $7-$8 . Thank you for everything!

Horrible horrible customer service, they make me wait at least 15 minutes everytime I order a sandwich because I’m vegetarian. And when I get upset they try to make me out to be the rude person every time. And to make matters worse they charge me a difference price for the same sandwich that I get the same ingredients for every time I come. They even made me cry before how mean they were being to me.

Overly priced.... I go here cuz my job is on the block but they continuously tried to sell broken capped bottles of glass drinks... and when you leave they put it back for someone to buy.... rude and unprofessional

Clean place, fresh foods, fast & friendly staff, and service & very professional.
Tip the delivery guy well. They do an amazing job at delivering your food, fast.
The chopped cheese was so good I had it twice in one day. Perfect iced coffee as well.
Love calling ahead to get my food ready. Especially in the morning rush.

Buzzed my delivery person in but was finishing up getting ready for bed in the bathroom. Delivery instructions were to leave at door. When he arrived I yelled to just leave it. Wasn’t wearing pants and he kept knocking and then pounded on my door while asking him to just leave the food. Woke up half my floor and when I put on pants to open door he threw my food at me. Bag of food was half ruined. Called store and they said they would look into it and get back to me. Never heard back. Tried to reach them because employ their own drivers and tried to follow up to no avail.

Food is good but they employ the worst delivery staff
Order not made correctly. The meat is sooooo salty it’s not edible. They messed up but the person that answered the phone tried to blame me and my card was charged twice.
BEWARE!! they are charging extra for use of debt cards which isn’t legal in NYC. These people are well aware and have more than likely been getting away with this for some time.

Delivery service Really not great at night time because I order from grubhub app and before the delivery guy that works at there store show up he clicked delivered food 😐😑 If I did not contact grubhub for all I know they would never had deliver my food and then lie and say I had pets in my house and to clear the path for delivery guy 😑🤔I'm allergic to dogs and cats so why lie to grubhub customer service about this 🙄😑food is good but night delivery service suck
Best bodega on the block! Food is always on point and the service is always friendly. Also, it’s always clean and neat. 10/10 recommend 😉

Sure this place is always clean and well stocked but the pricing is alllll over the place. I get charged differently for the same items every visit depending on who’s at the counter. Joe’s Deli down the block never does that and their breakfast sandwiches are way better.

They will steal from you. I've seen it many times. I've lived in the neighborhood for years. If you come in late night-even sober, and you have the slightest alteration on the order, they will ring up 'special order' for $50 or more.
The daytime staff is reasonable and consistent and pleasant.
The nighttime staff are absolutely stealing from the customers and probably from the owner.
UPDATE
The night staff committed a hate-crime in front of my eyes against a trans person.
What a cherry on top.
Custom salad made fresh everything was good and filling...🤤🤤

Honestly the best place to get deliveries. The food is good and cheap. They don't get an attitude when you call back if there was a mistake nor does the delivery guy gives you an attitude. Ordered from this place 6 times already and I'm set. The reason for 4 stars instead of 5, they didn't cook my fries well done... I've ordered well done/crunchy fries 3 times and... meh. However their customer service is very good. And this is why I continue to order from there. Thank you for being kind and genuine with your clients. Not many delis are like that around here.

I’ve been coming here for 8 years. Food was your typical deli food, nothing special. Just close to my house. Philly deluxe was $9 before the pandemic. Its $18, sometimes $16, they charge a different price every time. I understand inflation happened, a lot had changed but how is it that they charge more than any other deli. All other delis charge $13. Food isn’t that good for those prices. I walk down the next corner and pay $13. $18 is just ridiculous for fries and a sub. And the people working here are a bunch of thieves. They charge what they want. How they feel like charging. I’m done with this place.

Duke Ellington is truly a large, well-stocked deli, certainly a step above the typical bodega-class spot. A wide variety of cooked food, salad bar, obviously cold cuts and salads like chicken and shrimp for sandwiches or bulk purchase. The salad bar is fresh and good. There are literally every possible type of soft drinks even Stewart's and organic brands and beer and suchlike. Paper products, cereal, cookies and ice cream, too. Fast delivery is also available.
Here's the rub, as Hamlet said: this spot is very very expensive. It's super convenient and stocked with everything and you def pay for it!
Check your prices before you check out, too. They've been known to 'round up to the next dollar'. Watch it. Otherwise, no complaints and no surprises.

Listen, man... Came back to NY, from FL, for the holidays... EVERYTHING went up! I come here right before I'm leaving the city - wish I knew about this place during my whole stay. No minimum card fee, PLUS, good, fast service, on, GOOD FOOD!!

I'm their hrs, but, come here for ALL your deli cooked offering and snack food needs. They kept it real where all others that I've dealt with DIDN'T. Plus, a nice clean store, with, ALL the offerings!

Used to be solid. Now they’re overpricing everything and giving different prices for different colored people just to see who they can get over on. I literally paid $2.50 for an avocado here a couple weeks ago and today they told my pale skinned partner it’s $4 even after they argued the price gauging. They have no shame. Ordering online is even worse. It seems like they simply let the person at the register run their pricing. To say nothing of the fact that they let their deli ingredients sit there for 2-3 days before they change them out. Go up the same block to 105 and Columbus for a much fairly priced and sanitation run deli.

name: Sugar Monk
address: 2292 Frederick Douglass Blvd, New York, NY 10027

reviews.snippet: Phenomenal cocktails, service, and atmosphere. Came for happy hour but also had regular priced cocktails which were well worth it, and loved the black truffle popcorn. Very very good service.

Great place! Happy hour till 7pm and great choices there! There regular menu is so creative. Classic vibe but with their own twist.
The old fashioned was great, very balanced and the burnt bay leaf was awesome. The Marie Laveu was amazing, the presentation, the flavor, everything was great!
Highly recommend!

Mel and I have been coming here for years. In fact it is our second home. Ektoras and Simon are the sweetest, Lee always takes care of us, and lately quiet the new brunch hours, TJ makes resplendent art out of being an incredible mixologist. Truly divine.

I will forever recommend this place. I have been here several times with friends. One thing I can say is that they are consistent and the bar is high. The ambiance the aesthetic and service are always top notch. It's good for a night cap or just meeting someone for the first time.

When I tell you, this place has a wonderful atmosphere. The service was five star. The cocktails were made with such love and attention and even if you wanted something a little off menu, they went the extra mile to try and make it for you and trust me the results were delicious. Sometimes you need to know the password at the door, but let’s just say this if you know you know..

I had such an amazing time and experience. Each cocktail was unique and tasted amazing. I'm extremely into herbalism and to see such a well crafted intentional menu was beautiful. This place is definitely a one of a kind experience
TJ was my bartender and he was soo Amazing! He explained Everything made and I love mixologist like that. Atmosphere is great! Will be visiting here everytime I visit Harlem.

Beautiful ambience! The music selection was to perfection. The bartender Lee was great checked in consistently cleared our drinks consistently! This place is definitely a gem. The only reason I gave it 4 stars opposed to 5 is because the drinks were not strong but very crafty and pretty!
For bartending please ask for Jesus makes the best drinks hands down!! The staff is very friendly and welcoming. Super relaxed vibes where you can go and enjoy yourself tremendously after work.
The vibe is intimate and music Playlist is top tier. The drinks are very well balanced. Only tried desserts and they were delicious!

Sugar Monk is beloved. The cocktails are crafted with much love and care and attention to detail. The liquors are created in their own distillery. I am Aegean and their liquors and amaros make me think of home. Watching the bartenders is like watching a performance art piece in this beautifully designed and lit environment. I visit Sugar Monk pretty much every two weeks and I feel home, I feel safe and truly at peace when I sit at the bar, have a cocktail, read my book and watch the whole precess of making these drinks. I comfortably say and I really mean that this my favorite cocktail bar in NYC and it is in the heart of beloved Harlem. Plus: Lee, you are a rockstar!
Great cocktail spot with weekly live jazz! Definitely recommended stopping by for a nice drink when Max Bessesen or Tim Johnson are playing! 👌

This is the perfect place for date night, celebration, quick drink, nightcap. You name it and I promise it would exceed your expectations. Honorable mention is THEE one and only bartender Lee. She sets the standard every time and she is just a breath of fresh air and her drinks are top notch. Anyways make sure when you go you get the popcorn and sit at the bar for the BEST experience.

Didn't have any food but between my spouse and I we tried nine cocktails over two visits while staying in the area from out of town. The atmosphere was relaxed on our weekday visits and the staff were very attentive. The recommended reservations on their website didn't seem necessary. They mix drinks with their local parent producer Atheras Spirits's bitters and liqueurs. We inquired about their products for sale and they offered us tastings. We really liked the cardamom bitters. Our second night we only came for a night cap and they brought us a complimentary glass of a new bergamot liqueur they were testing. If Atheras Spirits is reading this, definitely produce the bergamot spirits. That and/or the cardamom would make an incredible hot toddy.

This bar is super cozy, dimly lit, music playing low. Love that everyone can conversate without it being too loud. Drinks were great, I had the "over the volcano", the truffle popcorn was so yummy, and we had amazing service, the bartender even gave us shots on the house. We had an amazing time and would definitely come back!

First of all the drinks were amazing! I have to give this bar that credit. The hostess/waitress was the weirdest person. It took our experience down so much. She got pissed that my friend opened the door and disciplined us not to ever do it again. We were like umm okay??? Then she sits us at a table that says we got until 8:30pm to be at. Very weird to be timed and told that. If another party reserved a table, you could tell us that and tell us they may need to move us to sit that party. That would be totally fine. But she didn’t. When taking our order, she looked very impatient. She had a face full of attitude. We asked to sit at the bar. She seemed stressed and was like which seats so I can move yall. And that she had to transfer the food/drinks to that table. It was an awkward talk.z So after that weird situation we sit at the bar and everything is amazing. Bartender was very friendly and the drinks were amazing. We then ask her for the check and she said okay. She disappears. We wait. My friend goes to use the bathroom. We keep waiting. Then the bartender asks if we want more drinks and we tell him that we are waiting for our check. He goes to help check us out. Then the hostess/waitress yells at him to transfer our old table to our new bar table. Why wasn’t that done when we switched a while ago and where were you to check us out in the first place. I would come back for the drinks and vibe but would not when she is working.

I stumbled upon this little gem in the heart of Harlem, right near the Apollo Theater. It’s a small boutique cocktail bar where every corner has been meticulously designed down to the finest detail; not only are the cocktails top-notch, but many of the spirits are actually made in-house right here in New York—it truly is a gem. They seated us in a lovely corner, and we spent a magical evening there, feeling completely unhurried. The service was excellent, and the bartenders looked like they had stepped straight out of a movie. I think I’ll be coming up to Harlem often just to stop by this place.

One of my favorite bars in the city. The drinks are insane—many have ~a dozen ingredients and all sorts of herbs and spices and ingredients I had to look up. They make their own Amari!! The drink list is inventive and creative and extensive. We consulted the server for help and she gave us great recommendations and accompanying stories behind the drinks. The vibes inside are also great. This place is a treasure

I stopped by here before my movie on a Friday night and I’m so glad that I did. What a sexy, chill vibe! I had the Over The Volcano, and as I told the best bartender ever Ryan, it’s truly a perfect drink. No notes. The bar itself is intimate, with some outside seating available too. The music is low, allowing for audible conversation. I had a great time and can’t wait to come back! Note, they do add 20% gratuity to the bill, but for the service, it’s definitely worth it

phenomenally crafted cocktails with a captivating menu. cozy space, aesthetically pleasing bar, soft lighting and seductive vibe. Classic type jazz band on Tuesdays from 8-10pm. try the popcorn :) reservations recommended.

raw_place.title: Sugar Monk
raw_place.address: 2292 Frederick Douglass Blvd, New York, NY 10027
raw_place.description: Cocktail lounge with a chill vibe presenting creative concoctions in an art-filled atmosphere.

reviews.snippet: First time diner but definitely will not be my last. We arrived on Saturday right before the afternoon rush. We ordered a few appetizers and Ramen bowls. Their Yuzu green lemonade is such a palette cleanse. My favorite appetizers were the Purple yam fries with this banging sauce in the side. The fried shumai were big and full of flavor. The Tuna ceviche I had as my entree with two sides of wonton chips sooooo tasty. Katsu was my least favorite no flavor profile at all. My partner had the chicharron ramen didn’t get a picture because someone didn’t wait lol. Ambiance is very authentic to the culture which I can appreciate.

media.caption: Fried round shumai with soy dipping sauce
Crispy fried japanese sweet potato strips
Crispy fried cutlet and side salad
Crispy tempura flakes over kani salad
Pork chashu ramen in rich broth
Interior wooden plank walls with dining tables
Interior seating with japanese lanterns and kaiju poster
Wooden wall gallery with framed photos
Black framed photo collage wood floor
Wooden slat wall and framed anime art

response.snippet:
Thank you so much, Chrystal! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share such a detailed review 😊 We’re so happy you enjoyed the Yuzu Green Lemonade, Purple Yam Fries, fried shumai, and Tuna Ceviche. And yes… the Chicharron ramen disappears fast for a reason 😂

We also appreciate the honest feedback on the katsu and will share it with our kitchen team. Looking forward to welcoming you and your partner back again soon to explore more of the menu 🍜✨

reviews.snippet:
This was my first time visiting this restaurant and I had an amazing experience. There wasn’t much of a wait to be seated, and our waiter, Ricky, was absolutely incredible and very attentive. He helped guide us through the menu with great suggestions from the main dishes to the desserts and every recommendation was spot on.

The chicharrón ramen was absolutely delicious, and I’d definitely recommend adding a boiled egg if you enjoy them. I also tried the matcha tiramisu, which was surprisingly flavorful and much more enjoyable than I expected, especially since I’m not usually someone who eats matcha.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this place and I’m already looking forward to my next visit.

My first time! Staff was great and Monsur took care of me with the menu and helping me decide on what to have. The Tori Ramen lunch set was great and a good value. I added the hot sake too and was full! Definitely a must and do over!

response.snippet: Thank you so much, Al-ex! We’re so happy your first visit was a great experience 😊 Monsur will be thrilled to hear your kind words. Glad you enjoyed the Tori Ramen lunch set and hot sake combo, definitely a solid meal 🍜🍶 Looking forward to welcoming you back again soon!

reviews.snippet: I have always loved Jin Ramen! Excellent food, great staff and good choice of sake. But the reason I have to give only 4 stars is because I find it insulting to be charged $2.50 for extra side of corn which really only amounts to a small handful. That’s just ridiculous. Why?

media.caption: Spicy tonkotsu ramen with corn and pork

reviews.snippet: The pork bun appetizer was so good that i ate them both before i remembered i wanted to take a picture. I love the ramen here its always delicious. Great broth very tasty ramen. However, i have continued to not love the service. They simply are not that attentive but if you are not super fragile the food makes up for any indiscretions with service. Will definitely be going back to try their flight of sakis.
Omggggggg I had the Japanese Curry Ramen! 10/10 I absolutely recommend. I love Jin Ramen! Atmosphere, Staff, and Service is outstanding!! Love it!

response.snippet: Thank you

reviews.snippet: I only gave the food to four star. This is probably my problem but they add a little bit too much broth and I don’t like that so that’s why I’m gonna give it a 4 star but other than that this is a really good authentic ramen shop. I loved it I would come back again.

response.snippet: Thank you, always feel free to tell us your preferences when ordering.

reviews.snippet: Been coming here for years. Jin is a hole in the wall with a real cozy atmosphere, quick service and solid ramen, soba, and donburi bowls that always hit the spot.

response.snippet: Thank you so much, Matt! It truly means a lot to have your support over the years 😊 We’re glad our ramen, soba, and donburi continue to hit the spot and that the cozy atmosphere keeps bringing you back. Looking forward to serving you again soon 🍜✨

reviews.snippet: The best Japanese food I’ve ever had and our server Jason was the best!! Don’t second guess this place. Just go!

response.snippet: Thank you so much!!!!

reviews.snippet: Can’t even explain how amazing my experience was here, the service was incredible,our server was always checking on us and willing to give recommendations. They have two different areas for dining,I thought it was only one area for dining,but they have more tables on the other side,portions were pretty good,they also have a lunch special menu,definitely coming back here!

response.snippet: Thank you

reviews.snippet: Service and food is great. The Chef Jefferson in the red hat is always very friendly and awesome in cooking. Monsur is very good in customer service and quick to server. Must come if you want to travel to Japan just for authentic ramen

Loved both ramen and fried rice. Fried rice seemed to be based on butter + soy sauce, and that’s my fav flavor base for fried rice so can’t complain at all.

Ramen had very good broth that was flavorful and thick enough, but not too salty and not too thick. I really liked its balance. Noodle was slightly softer than my preference and chasu was bit drier than I hoped, but the broth was really spot on for me and I would love to get the ramen here again if next chance.

response.snippet: Thank you so much

reviews.snippet: This is a very popular spot among students at Columbia so we decided to go. I had already heard a lot about this place, and was not disappointed. We were able to get a table easily. They had a huge menu with a lot of options, including vegetarian options. We really enjoyed the chicken gyoza, the chicken bao buns and the chicken ramen. The servers were very sweet and it’s reasonably priced. Would recommend coming here for sure.

response.snippet: Thank you so much

reviews.snippet: Monsur was a great server for us tonight! I got the Miso Ramen and the Nanban Chicken Appetizer, both were delicious!! My family got ramen and a ton of the appetizers which all tasted fresh and distinguished from other places I have been to. Great food all around! Thank you!

response.snippet: Thank you

reviews.snippet: Delicious spot, especially convenient for folks in West or Central Harlem, and right by the 125th St 1 train stop. I had the spicy tonkotsu ramen and a side of karaage, both of which were excellent. The ramen serving was generous in a rather large bowl. The chashu slices were very tender and a good thickness, and had a delicious sweet glaze on them. The broth was rich and the meal was filling without needing to order more noodles. Not cheap but not too expensive either, especially considering the high quality. I’m definitely planning to go back and try some other options. My food was served quickly after ordering, but I felt like the service after that wasn’t particularly attentive - no waiter checked in after I got my food, and I had to wait around for a while after finishing before I could get the check. Not a huge deal though, and the servers were still polite and the food was excellent.

response.snippet: Thank you so much

reviews.snippet: Monsur is always an amazing server. He consistently makes efforts towards ensuring my every visit to Jin Ramen is one I walk away from with glee. The chicken katsu curry don is my go to it’s always prepared with appropriate care and attention!

response.snippet: Thank you so much

reviews.snippet: Came here with my friend for our annual ramen date-- a little tradition we unintentionally started a few years ago. The space is small but can has many small tables and the ambiance is cool with dim lighting and different photos and even action figure pieces on the walls. We got the veggie gyozas and karaage to start which left a lot to be desired, to put it simply the food lacked flavor :/ as our time there went on and we waited for our main dish, ramen, our waiter barely attended us and we had to flag him down several times to ask for more water, napkins and drinks. Even when my friend returned her drink bc she didn't like it after just one sip, the waiter rolled his eyes and gave us such a deep sigh, we found the interaction very rude as if we had insulted him directly. Finally our ramen came out. I got the shrimp ramen and my friend the chicharron ramen. It was much more flavorful than the appetizers but nothing very special. The consensus: we've had better elsewhere. I wouldn't highly recommend this place considering the service was significantly lacking and the food was mid at best....

Always come to this location. Most of the time I have the same Server. Ricky is always in a great mood and knows how to speak to the people. Always makes me feel at home. He recommended a new bowl Ramen which was very delicious. I usually get the Tonkotsu ramen but this time I tried the NEW Chicken encebollado Ramen. Great taste and reminds me of a homemade dish my grandmother makes. This place never disappoints.
Chicken encebollado ramen and Tonkotsu ramen.

This is easily one of my favorite places in Harlem. The food is spectacular, and the service is incredible! Our waiter, Carlos, was so kind. He took time to speak with the table and really showcase the love he has for this establishment and their cuisine.

Our server, Ricky, was wonderful! Super attentive, and fast service.
Ramen itself was decent. Noodles cooked well. Taste was ok. Not much chicken flavor in my broth. But overall, satisfactory

raw_place.title: Jin Ramen West Harlem
raw_place.description: Busy Japanese joint specializing in rice bowls & ramen noodle dishes in a casual atmosphere.

name: Aloft Harlem Hotel WXYZ Bar
address: 2296 Frederick Douglass Blvd, New York, NY 10027

reviews.snippet: My new favorite place in Harlem! It’s almost a hidden gem —I could barely see the sign, there is a sign to the hotel bar (abc…or some letters!) and the bar happens to be attached to this GREAT hotel! Modern, very thoughtful room design, spotless, cheerful and helpful staff, great bar (did I already mention that? I actually had a wonderful meal while watching the NBA playoff games during my last visit.), great food / snacks, water, soda, available anytime just by the front desk ….location convenient to transportation and stores …I love this place!

Enjoyed our meet up at the hotel, Kool vibe, clean and welcoming. Only issue was the air conditioning or lack there of. Spent two hours in the event space and had a great time despite ot being a bit warm..
The staff was amazing, drinks were on point, but we didn't try any food. Definitely stay here the next time you are visiting Harlem.

After an already awful experience at the connected Aloft hotel, and while sitting down at he bar I was snubbed by the bar man - "what do you want?". Well, I wanted to have a quick bite. The selection on the menu was already pretty poor, but I actually starting laughing when I got my order of chicken egg rolls (which took >30 minutes to make, with hardly anyone around). Listed under "big dishes" for $11 you get 6 tiny pieces - served on cardboard, and (no joke) parts of it were raw where other parts were burning hot - a sign of having been cooked at way too high temperature.

The drinks menu is no better. Very little choice, and nothing below $10 - and this in Harlem. What a joke.

You might think that as you are in NYC you don't care about all this because it's all about the location. Well, think again. This neighborhood is dark, unfriendly, smelling of marijuana, and as someone who has seen a lot of the world, trust me: stay away. People stare at you on the street after dark, and there are beggars everywhere.

My first visit to NYC (2014), stayed here for business and pleasure trip. Easy walking distance to subway, Apollo, and Harlem shops. Friendly staff, very clean, quiet building. I enjoyed my trip. Would stay here again.
Great Ambiance, and Niama was very friendly and assertive. Great vibes!!!
Truthfully awesome place to vibe at,will come again
Bar tender too busy on her phone to offer anything. Not friendly at all. Couldn’t help us and had no interest in doing so. Just not at all worth stopping here.
Courteous service, not far the subway system, AMC across the street.
Nice ambience, friendly staff. Small bar inside hotel.
The staff I met in the lobby was respectful & pleasant
Room was nice. Lobby bar was convenient.
Beautiful venue
Nice place.
Really nice.
Poor cleaning
The vendors were all courteous and had items displayed for show and purchasing. The food was delicious.
Yeterli bir tesistir.

reviews.snippet:
A1 experience! I was originally going to somewhere up the street and they were closed! I was so hungry I literally walked into the next cafe I passed and it happened to be here. What a gem! The girls at the front were really nice. They serve breakfast all day which was great because I was craving pancakes. After 1pm, the breakfast menu goes up by $2. I was there a little after that and as the owner was walking out, he told them not to charge me for it!

The vibe is unmatched. Upstairs and downstairs seating with both floors having cozy couch/chair options. I sat upstairs which felt like I was in a friend’s living room. There were bean bags,comfy seats small tables, a tv, board games and an electric fireplace. What a vibe! I had the longest morning navigating the subway with my luggage and waiting to check into my hotel. I could have slept in there I swear. There were a few people doing work on their laptops and reading books but it wasn’t at all packed.

The food was amazing! I consider myself a pancake snob and these were some of the fluffiest pancakes I’ve ever had! They were amazing! The bacon was crisp to perfection! I’ll be here in the city for a few days and I will DEFINITELY be back!

media.caption: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes with omelet and bacon

reviews.snippet:
went there for 2 croissant, guy took 6min “put in my order and charge me “, no taxes details on receipts( faking it out) .

19$ flat for two croissants?!!! average ones.

I definitely got scammed and he definitely invented the price. (been a costumer for 7 months)

response.snippet:
We’re very sorry for your experience and the frustration this caused.
As a customer of ours for the past 7 months who has enjoyed the food and atmosphere we’ve built, you know that what happened yesterday was a one time mistake on our side . After 4pm we switch to our wine bar service and don’t normally sell pastries. As a courtesy, we sold the croissants, and unfortunately an error occurred.
We the owners are here daily, and this could have been resolved immediately if it had been brought to our attention. We have now issued a full refund, which you should see within the next 24–48 hours.
Our apologies again, and we hope to see you again.

reviews.snippet:
The place and view are nice, but I didn’t like the food. I ordered scrambled eggs that were not scrambled at all they were cold and tasteless. The pancakes looked better, but flavor wise they were just okay. The food is served on disposable paper plates that have a horrible smell, which ruins the experience and affects the smell of the food. The music is way too loud for breakfast.

The girl who served us, who seemed to be new (and was very kind, by the way), was constantly being supervised and scolded by another girl from the kitchen, who even threatened to tell the manager about her.

Overall, I went during my days in Columbia looking for a quiet brunch, and I wouldn’t go back.

This place is an absolute gem! The service was incredibly friendly and attentive, making the whole experience a delight. You seriously can't beat the prices for the quality you get here. And the food? Absolutely delicious – every bite was a flavor explosion. I'll definitely be back for more!

Such an amazing place! The pancakes were super fluffy and delicious, and the salad was fresh and incredible. The cozy vibe with board games makes it a really fun spot to hang out. Cute place, great food, and overall highly recommend!

response.snippet:
Hi Neta,
Thank you for the amazing 5-star review of Claire’s Kitchen Cafe – Upper West Side! 🥞🥗 We’re so glad you loved the fluffy pancakes, fresh salad, and the cozy vibe—it makes us happy to know the board games added to the fun atmosphere too. 🌸 We truly appreciate your kind words and recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you back soon for another delicious and relaxing brunch!

reviews.snippet: Fabulous. Best shawarma I’ve had since leaving Detroit. Incredible pancakes. And A++ service by the nicest guy. Brought our kids extra plates of veggies and deconstructed everything for them.

Great Coffee and Delicious Food!
The coffee is well-made, and the food is excellent. I had the Tunisian sandwich and the Greek salad which was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared!
The atmosphere is welcoming, and the staff is very friendly. They also host comedy shows every other Tuesday which is a lot of fun! Highly recommended!

response.snippet: Thank you, Adar, for the detailed and valuable feedback. We are committed to maintaining our high standards of service.

reviews.snippet:
Another little gem in this area. Beautiful atmosphere, friendly staff, good coffee (I only had an iced latte; thus, cannot judge for proper hot coffee) and delicious meal; I had a very good Greek-style omelette. It’s a beautiful corner spot, with lots of sitting options inside (a bench facing the large vitrine, tables and chairs, or another area upstairs) and outside. Great spot for somebody who wants to combine work and… appetite pleasure, as it offers free and fast internet. :-)
The day I visited, an early weekend morning, somebody was playing music too loud for that time (the music was enjoyable, the volume was too loud!) and talking loud and non-stop, but any other time I cross, it seems like a quiet and comfortable spot to enjoy a meal and coffee, and always nicely busy.
I love that they always have water for doggies outside and the place looks very clean inside and out.

media.caption: Mediterranean omelet with feta and iced coffee

response.snippet:
Hi Stella,
Thank you for the thoughtful and detailed 5-star review of Claire’s Kitchen Cafe – Upper West Side! 🥞☕ We’re so glad you enjoyed the Greek-style omelette, the cozy corner atmosphere, and your iced latte. 🌸 It’s wonderful to hear you appreciated the variety of seating, the free Wi-Fi, and even the little touches like water for dogs outside. We’re sorry the music volume felt a bit too loud during your visit, and we’ll keep that in mind moving forward. Your kind words about our staff, cleanliness, and overall vibe mean a lot—we look forward to welcoming you back soon for another delicious and relaxing breakfast or brunch!

reviews.snippet:
Perhaps it was an off day, but unfortunately, we ordered flavored iced lattes that were accidentally made hot instead. When I asked for them to be corrected, it seemed they just poured the hot latte over ice, which created a watery latte with a warm, separated foam on top that was not appetizing. The staff was not unkind when I asked for the lattes to be fixed, however!

We ordered avocado toast as well, which was portioned fairly large and tasted good.

Overall, the cafe was very cute and quiet! I'd visit again for the food, but will likely pass on the coffee next time around.

Great menu options in cute space, we loved our breakfast here last week!

I have never had a bad meal at Claire’s — everything is super fresh and flavorful with options for everyone. You Gotta try their Roast Beef Sandwich and Avocado toast

It’s going to be a great space for events and parties, along with breakfast and coffee during the day

response.snippet:
Hi Adam,
Thank you for the amazing 5-star review of Claire’s Kitchen Cafe – Upper West Side! 🌸🥑🥪 We’re so glad you loved your breakfast and that you’ve consistently enjoyed fresh, flavorful meals with us. The roast beef sandwich and avocado toast are definitely guest favorites, and it’s wonderful to hear they stood out for you too. We’re also excited that you see the café as a great space for events and gatherings—that’s exactly the kind of welcoming atmosphere we hope to create. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews.snippet: Genuinely the worst place on the UWS. They have decided to increase the prices in their system without updating the menu prices, without informing their customers about this. Terrible food, terrible service, no AC in 100+ degree weather. Location convenience is not worth the horrible experience.
very cozy, loved my breakfast items (mex bowl and pancakes), iced mocha w oatmilk was delicious. the staff was very kind and i went back for wine bar hours. definitely a new regular spot for me

The owners are sweethearts! Very nice people. The food is good.. customer service is okay depending in who’s there. Some of the staff aren’t exposed to different cultures though and give you weird stare if you’re black…. But, the bosses seem great! So it’s worth it, just ignore the help with weird energy

Overall a good experience. The Avo Toast was great.

Unfortunately they seem to serve nearly everything on paper plates, which degrades the culinary experience quite a bit if you’re staying in.

This is by far the best place around! Food is so delicious and well prepared, and the service is incredibly welcoming. On top of that the prices are really honest. That’s my go-to spot around either for a brunch, lunch or for wine in the evening. I recently celebrated my birthday there also, and it was the best and perfect option.

response.snippet: Thank you, Jussi, for celebrating your birthday with us. We thoroughly enjoyed hosting you and your friend, and we look forward to welcoming you and your friends back again soon.

reviews.snippet:
It was disappointed experience. I came here before and had great sandwich and hot chocolate. Therefore I came back to try something new. I ordered American breakfast and hot chocolate this time. Unfortunately the experience went to very poor. The beacon wasn’t fully cooked. The bread has a black spot on it, it does look like a mold but I’m not sure therefore I didn’t touch it and throw it away. Hot chocolate didn’t tasty like before.
I waited for almost 30mins for American breakfast. Maybe kitchen was very slow on that day. I asked the lady who took my order she was “nice” but not sure what she is doing, no apology to me when the food came out. She did apologize to everyone else says the food came out late. I have no idea why. The food wasn’t hot meal anymore. Looks like sit there for while. When I go out from the place, she was stand front of me and saw me but didn’t say anything again.

Well today was pretty disappointing to be honest.
I came in this morning after I had ordered a bogo sandwich on postmates for me and my friend.
Well we had placed the order about 25 minutes before we got to the location, waited another 10 minutes only to have the cashier cancel our order right then because the store didn’t have turkey. I DO appreciate my money being returned to me.

Our coffees were pretty bad as well.
And honestly our cashier was pretty overwhelmed but tbh I don’t think it is his fault. It seems that this location is not being managed or staffed well to the point that the cashier was probably overstimulated, annoyed and anxious.
I really used to like this place but I won’t be coming back. Please make sure you are supporting your cashier because I felt like he was not receiving support. If the cashier is reading this I know it is probably not your fault.

A few questions I have for the management,
Why would it take almost thirty minutes for it to be communicated that there was no more turkey?
Why is your cashier overwhelmed?
Why was he all alone in the middle of a pretty heavy rush?

I hope that your instinct is to reflect on your management rather than your employee

tbh this gets 5 stars purely based on how good the vibes are!! the food is perfectly serviceable, some things really tasty, some not. but I LOVE the upstairs setting, i love the collection of chairs, i love how it's always popping but never too crowded. my favorite place in the UWS to relax and unwind and work.

response.snippet:
Hi Sandra, thank you for the detailed feedback. Please feel free to contact the owners at the store. We would glad to know where we need to do better!
Ori

reviews.snippet: So happy to have discovered this cozy gem in the neighborhood! The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the owners are incredibly kind. It’s a perfect spot to relax or get some work done on your laptop. The menu is surprisingly wide, but the real star is the Burekas- absolutely delicious. Can’t wait to come back and try more stuff!

response.snippet:
Hi H A L,
Thank you for the amazing 5-star review of Claire’s Kitchen Cafe – Upper West Side! 🥐☕ We’re so glad you discovered our cozy spot and that the warm atmosphere, kind service, and wide menu made such a great impression. 🌸 We’re especially thrilled you loved the burekas—they’re a favorite here too! It’s wonderful to know the cafe felt like the perfect place to relax or get some work done. We can’t wait to welcome you back to try even more from the menu!

reviews.snippet: Three or four times there. Is an amazing place. 6 stars in everything. I hope to return another day. Highly recommended. Cortado is 👌

We hosted a ~40-person tech community meetup here and had a fantastic experience.

The space worked really well for the format of our event. We used both floors: the first floor for mingling and networking, and the second floor for the presentation part of the evening. On the second floor we were able to seat around 40 people comfortably for talks, with everyone facing the presentation area. It worked great for a small conference-style setup.

The layout is cozy but flexible, and the owners helped us rearrange chairs and furniture to create a setup that worked for talks followed by networking.

For anyone planning an event: the space already has a TV screen, sound system, and microphones, which made it easy to run presentations and a panel discussion. Everything worked smoothly.

The atmosphere is great—warm, lively, and welcoming. It feels intimate and social, which is perfect for meetups or community gatherings.

The food was excellent, especially if you enjoy Israeli-style flavors. The nostalgic shared plates were generous and perfect for a networking-style event. The catering was very reasonably priced, and the portions were abundant.

The hospitality of the owners really stood out. They were incredibly accommodating, helped us adjust the room layout, and were genuinely easy to work with while organizing the event.

Location-wise it worked really well for our group. The Upper West Side location on 106th Street was convenient both for people coming from around the city and for those traveling in from North Jersey / Bergen County, making it a great spot for an after-work community meetup.

If you're looking for a place to host a meetup, community event, or small gathering of around 30–40 people, this setup works really well. We’d absolutely host here again.

media.caption: Cozy event space with presentation screen and microphones
Event space with screen and seating for 40 people
First floor bar area where we did networking and snacks during our meetup

reviews.snippet: We had such a great experience at Claire’s After Dark on the UWS! Such a cute and cozy little spot with delicious food and a really welcoming atmosphere. Ori was awesome and gave us great recommendations, the pancakes were absolutely delicious and definitely worth trying. Will definitely be coming back!

On a lark, I searched for "wine bars near me" and this popped up. Opened maybe a year ago so that's why I didn't know about of it. I viewed the wine list online...impressively well curated selection of high value, quality wines, IMH[but knowledgeable]O, and an interesting menu that made me walk right over for dinner. Excellent food, friendly owner, friendly service, and comfortable seating at the cozy bar, and at tables on the ground level as well upstairs, with furniture cleverly making it feel like a combo living room/family room/dining room for events. There's some outside seating, too. Will be back soon. Lucky is the person who knows about this charming establishment :)
I ordered a dish based on Daniel’s (server) recommendation of the Mediterranean salad and add shredded chicken (Israeli style). It’s not on the menu, but absolutely delish! Great service as well.
Great ambiance and location. Simple but very well executed food and dishes that resonated with me and my friends. Great wine selection and very attentive service. This is a neighborhood gem!
Eli is lovely - first time here and he took incredible care of us. Very cute cafe and fun low-key date spot as well!
Be specific when you order the charcuterie. I gave them carte blanche and got 3 cheese, 1 meat, and 1 toast.
This place is hidden gem on the upper west side. A whole vibe. Indoor outdoor and upstairs dining, pac man machine, coffee, wine, and food. It’s Not your average Cafe/winebar
Great new wine bar! Very affordable pricing and excellent atmosphere to work or catch up with friends. Staff is friendly and recommends great drinks. Look forward to coming back

Best wine bar around! Amazing staff, excelente food, great options of wine and even beers. Price is the best you could find in this city! Don’t miss their happy hour. My favorite spot without a doubt.
Loved this bar! Amazing experience! Highly recommend!!!
Claire’s is the perfect place for an intimate light dinner with tasteful wines or a later night celebratory glass of Prosecco! Service is great & atmosphere is relaxing & fun!
Great place in our neighborhood! Staff was super nice, food was great and atmosphere really chilled and good. They had a comedy night when we went, they are going to need more seats!!!!
I love Claire’s- so glad to have it in the neighborhood! We loved the mezze platter and frena bread!
Delicious empanadas and Greek salad. Friendly service. Great neighborhood location. Highly recommended.
Very cozy, drinks were really good!
Very cute cafe in Manhattan! Quick and pleasant service! Would come again:)
My first time at Claire's, having delicious coffee & chatting with Oren, the owner
Warm staff, cozy atmosphere. Feels so welcoming! Thank you.
Service is not very good
