reviews.snippet: The name doesn’t do it enough justice, it truly was an experience of local community just sitting in its natural communal ambiance. This is a village that takes care of its people and it shows in this establishment.

I stayed at the hostel close by and I regret going to the other cafes in that area for breakfast. Should have been going here since day 1. The breakfast is really good, well priced, and the workers are super friendly and treat you like family.
So good! If you are in the area and want great food from great people, this place is for you!

Absolutely amazing place to eat food and have some drinks and vibe out. The owner wauscar is so loving and welcoming. Anything you order is made with love and freshly made, all is made to order. Absolutely love this place and recommend everyone to come and enjoy this great atmosphere!!! Come try it out at least once you will not regret it!!! 1/23/26 came back and the cook created an amazing dish for me. Everyone should at least come and experience this place at least once you won’t regret it!!! @Maccdeli Ty for the amazing food !!

MACC, which stands for Manhattan Avenue Community Cafe, is more than just a deli; it’s a neighborhood gathering spot, in which Wascar, the owner, makes you feel like family. The food is next to none — always fresh and homemade — and reasonably priced. From the cubano to various custom sandwiches, the breakfast with pancakes to the homemade lunch specials and wings for sports events, MACC consistently serves the freshest and tastiest food in the area. Stop by and grab a cold Presidente, order your custom sandwich, and stay for a while.

Got an egg whites and avocado on a super fresh bun. No big deal, right? Not here. Here, it's prepared to perfection. This place stands out. Even the black pepper they use has flavor! I get this sandwich all the time at delis and diners but here it's really 100% an outstanding experience each time I've come (work brings me to the area from time to time). The staff here really cares and is so pleasant and professional. I mean, why write a review for an egg/avo sandwich? I'll tell you why. This place stands out! The reviews are real. Delicious!
This place is a cool vibe and the staff are super friendly. Makes you wanna come back. They got so many options for beer and the hot chocolate is amazing!!
amazing local spot with the sweetest owners and really good food for a good price! amazing vibes, in house Wi-fi, cold beer, and tasty sangria. they have it all! check them out
Wascar I’ve been here for three years cool spot.
Chill place to eat and have a brew.cool staff and cool patrons, as well as an outside enclosed area with fresh air make this a very comfortable place to look forward to stop in on your way home.

the guy who made my coffee was so lovely and friendly, this place was such a great find and just across the street from my hostel, came back twice for an off the menu iced cappuccino and it was the best i’ve ever had and decided on the french toast for breakfast on my last day in new york :))) definitely recommend xx
The best deli right off central park highly recommend for drinks and sandwiches
Pesto sandwich is delicious. Owner and his friends are super nice and friendly, I’ll definitely come again!! It’s hard to find good deli sandwiches at such a decent price
Good vibe, friendly staff, and great eats for a reasonable price (pernil sandwich was 10/10)

Stumbled on MACC’s on my way to Central Park and it was delightful. The guys behind the counter in the MACC hat was awesome and super friendly and accommodating. The food was great and reasonably priced. There was a broad selection of things to eat and drink, the coffee was great too!! Will come again!
Great atmosphere, cold beer and delicious sandwiches. What more could you want? They’ve got that too

Amazing place. One of my favorites in NYC. The food is incredible. I regularly get the sausage egg and cheese with a hashbrown and chipotle sauce for breakfast. They also have a great selection of beers. The atmosphere is super welcoming, and changes throughout the day with many people enjoying a drink at night. Don't miss this one if you are in the area.

media.caption: Sesame bagel with avocado and spinach

reviews.snippet: vibes were 10/10, chicken pesto sandwich was deeeeeelicious 😍🤤 and the coffee was pretty good too. Definitely going back when I get the chance ☺️
Very good food and friendly people

name: Pie Pie Pizza
address: 924 Columbus Ave, New York, NY 10025, United States

reviews.snippet:
A small pizza joint w/a couple of tables for indoor seating, and an open storefront window at a bar-stool for fresh air.

Chees slice tasty. Not too oily. Good flavor. Kinda small though. Friend had Grandma's pizza (w/pepperoni) and said it was delicious. The day we visited was cash only. Staff wore masks.

I didn't feel welcomed to stay and eat my slice indoors, although I'm fully vaccinated, so won't revisit.

It’s my favorite pizza in New York, super yummy and not too fattening. I always order the Pie pie original pizza pie and never disappoints. This time I wanted to try the cheesecake and it’s really good too. Thank you!

response.snippet: Thank you very much for your support!

reviews.snippet: Ordered to pick up a 12” (personal) chicken bacon ranch. It was pretty decent. Definitely had better. For a quick and cheap bite to go, it’s good. Haven’t tried anything else from around the area to compare to. But it is decent enough if you’re close by.
Pizza was top 10 I've ever had. When I asked the guy who works the register "is this the best pizza in New York?" He said "it's Ight" haha at least he was honest 😂
Here right now to get their original wings! My absolute favorite! I burned calories just to eat it 😅 They decorated for the holiday! Great eats!
Just not a very good pizza. Low quality ingredients. Half the dollar slice places in the city are better than this.
Slices start at $2; can soda $1. Crust and sauce was tasty, overall good pizza place, service was good compared to many other NY slice corners; very good for the price!
I got this order from Grubhub, but they didn't respond to my request and blamed the driver. Terrible service
Fast delivery, everything came hot and fresh. Slice was larger than my hand. Real NY pizza! A+ quality 👍

It's cheap and that's all. Dirty and tasteless slices with no soul and not even a trace of history of a soul. The name is cool and that's probably why some scammers bothered to give a non-sense 5 stars. SKIP.

Pie Pie Pizza makes a pretty decent pizza but I wouldn't tell visitors to go out of their way to try it. For those that live in the neighborhood, it's not a bad option to have but I don't feel like it offers enough to make it truly standout.

The slices are fairly thin, which I do prefer, but the pizza is also really oily. The cheese and sauce both don't really have a standout flavor so everything just kind of tastes like one thing instead of a bunch of complimentary ingredients.

Will I go back? Sure. Will it be my go-to pizza place? No.

The calzones are delicious, and then strangely the pizza is not very good. My husband and I used to order their calzones all the time though when we lived in the neighborhood we loved them so much. Delicious ricotta cheese filling. Just pass on the pizza.

THE WORST PIZZA I HAVE EVER HAD SINCE I HAVE LIVED IN NYC.

I have lived in New York City for more than 25 years and I have never in my life had garbage pizza like this.

This pizza shop should not even be open and or they should have different people working in this pizza shop.

Today my son went to this Pizzeria and order two slices of pizza. The first slice of Pizza had sausage, pepperoni and cheese on it. So I also wanted onions, mushrooms and peppers added to this slice.

However, the person that’s working in this Pizzeria took the slice of pizza that had cheese, sausage and pepperoni and just added raw onions and raw mushrooms on the top and he didn’t even bother to cook it.

This was the garbage slice of pizza that was given to my son.

Incompetent people, they shouldn’t even own a pizza shop if this is how you’re going to treat the customers totally disgusting
My favorite slice the pie pie original with three cheeses, mozzarella, fresh mozzarella and Parmesan. I absolutely love this place it is my favorite uptown.

Ordered from Uber eats and got what looked like 4 of the stalest, driest pizzas I have ever seen in my life. Literally had one slice had the worse case of food poisoning almost instantly. Never never ever ordering from them again. Alll 4 pizzas went to the trash!

Ordered here for the first time yesterday-10/27/18...& loved it!

This is now on my speed dial for go-to neighborhood pizza delivery spot. Had the sausage/mushroom + pepperoni/xtra cheese + calzone + garlic knots. All of it was super delicious. And Nick - his customer service was absolutely superb. I'd recommend this place for sure.

"I could eat this until I die" -- My wife about this pizza. Good prices, fast delivery, and a magically "just works" combination of flavors makes you think the pies are just MSG and cocaine. Crust is of the medium thickness, soft and slightly chewy variety. Tips: 1.) Order bacon as one of the toppings 2.) Order garlic knots and use them to sop up some of the initial grease on the pie. 3.) Be nice as their shop is very, very hot inside and they have a rough job. Also, $1 cheese slices with valid student ID.
Recommended! Good food! Pepperoni bites were tasty albeit a bit dry. Meatball pizza - crust, sauce, cheese & meat - had really good flavor and was served very hot. Meatballs a bit overdone (dry).

Ordered 3 slices , two plain extra cheese and one pepperoni and bacon , the pizza tasted old and dried up, cheese were like rubber and no seasoning barely had sauce. They didn’t seem friendly either looks like they judge people who come in there.

Pie Pie is a small shop with a large variety of v. good pizza. Standard cheese and pepperoni along with the current combo styles like 'salad pizza' ( c' mon, seriously? Salad pizza?) Call a head for pickup and it'll be ready by the time you get there. Or delivery, which is good too, but you should really get out in the fresh air for a few minutes, dontcha think? Anyway great pie, moderate price for the area.

raw_place.title: Pie Pie Pizza
raw_place.address: 924 Columbus Ave, New York, NY 10025, United States

reviews.snippet: I have been coming to this iconic, lovely, lively, warm restaurant for more than a decade — I bring everyone I love here. There is no better spot in NYC — the food is delicious, the staff are delicious ❤️, the mood is always uplifting. Do yourself a favor and come to one of the most authentic spots in the city.

response.snippet: Thank you for being part of our story for all these years and for bringing the people you love through our doors. That’s the greatest compliment we could ask for Alexis.

reviews.snippet: The best cosmopolitan's I've ever had. Max is truly a gem and so is his staff. Very welcoming atmosphere with inviting smells of garlic,shallots and wine. Best garlic frites.

response.snippet: Thank you for such an amazing review! We are thrilled you enjoyed the cosmopolitans, the garlic frites, and the warm atmosphere at Café du Soleil. Max and the entire team truly appreciate your kind words!

reviews.snippet:
Cute, quaint spot. The customer service was great.
What we initially came in to try wasn’t available but I was not disappointed with my visit. The food was absolutely delicious. My sister who dislikes ham thoroughly enjoyed her quiche Lorraine. I enjoyed the croque madame. I do wish the side salads had dressing. The caramel macchiatos were some of the best coffee I’ve had in a long time. The crepe was perfect balance of tart and sweet.

response.snippet: Hi Shirley, I think you are missing 2 stars lol. You wrote: Food: 5/5 Service: 5/5 Atmosphere: 5/5. Thanks for letting us know you loved the food and service.

reviews.snippet: I really enjoyed the atmosphere of the restaurant. The staff was also very attentive, with reasonable prices. However, we had 4 different steaks and unfortunately while they were all cooked perfectly the actual quality of the meat was quite low and none of us enjoyed it. This could have been a one time thing however I have to mention it. That being said our appetizers were delicious.

response.snippet: Thank you for your review Deniz.

reviews.snippet:
What an amazing discovery. Great atmosphere, wide menu selection, welcoming and professional service.
Every dish we tried left us curving to return for more. My personal surprise was a blood sausage. I tried plenty of them cooked Slavic style, but one we had in Cafe du Soleil - best of the best!!!

response.snippet: If you want authentic French bistro food, you will definitely find it at Cafe du Soleil! Please come back soon Vladislava.

reviews.snippet:
Saturday brunch walk-in with the place filled to 40% capacity. Very chill vibes and French/Paris eatery setup with nice bright interiors.

I wish their draught selection was wider, but the Kronenbourg pint they had on tap was chilled and went down pretty easy!

For food, we got linguine with butter for out little butter cakes, Moroccan Sandwich ($19) with Spicy Lamb Sausage. The French Baguette was pretty hard to eat but the sausage was good.

The winner of the table though was an excellent Vegetarian Avocado Toast ($19). The Yellow and Red Cherry tomatoes and onions just elevated the taste to the next level for me!

Service was slightly slow in terms of our drinks. Food however arrived within 20 mins of ordering.

I can see Cafe Du Soleil become our regular brunch spot, especially whenever I am craving their amazing Avocado Toast!

response.snippet: Thanks Ameya! So happy you loved our vegetarian avocado toast. Looking forward to having you as a regular customer at Cafe du Soleil.

reviews.snippet:
I was looking for a quiet place to have a nice glass of wine and a bite to eat. After a beautiful concert at the Cathedral of St. John the Divine. After trying a few different places that were way too loud, I found Cafe du Soleil.
The host tonight was Miguel. He was so gracious and welcoming. Even though I just wanted a little something, he showed me to a beautiful little table outside that is inside a plastic bubble! Very cozy and private. It was the perfect quiet experience to have a glass of wine and some delicious escargot on Broadway in New York City! I will be back, for sure. Very grateful to Miguel for the welcome.

response.snippet: Miguel is lovely and makes everyone comfortable and welcome. I will show him your review. Come back anytime.

reviews.snippet:
We had the best time here! Everything was so tasty and well-prepared.

We started with peach bourbon and raspberry ginger cocktails—both super fresh, flavorful, and a great size. For food, we had the French onion soup, butternut squash soup, Hachis Parmentier Au Four (a French take on shepherd’s pie), and a croque madame. Every dish was perfectly seasoned—not too salty or sweet, just really good, comforting food.

For dessert, we split an apple tart, and it was the perfect way to end the meal—flaky, warm, and so delicious.

The staff was really friendly, and the prices were surprisingly reasonable for the quality and portion sizes. We’ll definitely be back!

response.snippet: Thanks for posting the pictures you took at Cafe du Soleil, they are really nice. And yes, we agree, we make super comforting French food! A bientot Ayaka.

reviews.snippet: Great outdoor seating area, great staff, and amazing food. First time trying escargot and I was really impressed. I wanted to drink the broth that the mussells came in. Delicious meal. 10/10 would recommend. The manager was even nice enough to buy us a second round of drinks!

response.snippet: Thanks for the great pictures and review Alexander!

reviews.snippet: Ordered on uber eats October 4 around 4 in the afternoon. Missing a drink, fries were old and cold, bottom of bag fell out as soon as l lifted it from the counter. Burger bacon was raw. No toppings as described (Lettuce tomato pickles etc). Mousse was warm. Onion Soup was tasteless.

response.snippet: We are so sorry to hear about your disappointing experience with your recent Uber Eats order. We would appreciate it if you could provide a bit more detail about the specific time you placed your order so we can look into what happened.

reviews.snippet:
Absolutely wonderful!!! Tried snails for the first time and I have to be honest I was skeptical..but they were absolutely delicious!! Especially when paired up with the delicious bread they give you! Had steak and eggs with fries, omg!! The best steak and eggs I’ve ever had in my life! The bartenders were amazing and very communicative and comforting. Definitely coming here again!! 10/5!!!

Sorry I didn’t take pictures of the steak and eggs, I very much inhaled that food lol oh and the fries were spectacular too! Perfect amount of crunchy, crispy and flavorful!

response.snippet:
It sounds like you enjoyed every dish of your brunch, this is wonderful. Thanks for the great photos. Best brunch for sure!
And I am happy you loved the snails, you have to try them once in your life.

reviews.snippet:
BEWARE!!!!

I really loved this place, the food is decent and the vibes are great.

They have a great pre fixe too.

That said, one of the servers is an incompetent thief. The most recent time we went was on a Thursday night and we got the pre fixe, tried to split it between two cards, and the server came to charge us. He told us he could split it, took both cards, then ended up charging only one card twice (one charge was $94, the other charge was randomly $2).

When the server returned with the cards and we noticed mishap, my boyfriend and I decided to just fix it between ourselves on Venmo as my card was the only one charged. I tipped 22% of the entire bill and put the whole tip on one receipt, leaving the $2 receipt with zero tip.

2 days later I get a notification from my bank that my credit card had an alert for overtipping, and am SHOCKED to see the server illegally added an additional 500% tip on that $2 charge.

There’s simply no way that can be written off as an innocent mistake. I’ve worked as a server with multiple POS systems, and the server would have had to add the tip to the receipt in the system upon closing the bill.

I called the restaurant Sunday to speak to a manager and the same thief of a server answered, and upon realizing that I was calling to report the issue to the manager claimed the manager wasn’t there and that I’d have to call back another time during the week.

Just a completely off putting experience that ruined what would otherwise have been a great night at a place I loved to visit beforehand.

response.snippet: Can you please describe the server, I would like to investigate. This is not what we are about. Thanks.

reviews.snippet: Café du Soleil on the Upper West Side is such a charming neighborhood spot with a warm, welcoming atmosphere and a classic French bistro feel. The food is delicious, the service is friendly, and the whole experience feels relaxed, comfortable, and special without being too formal. It’s the kind of place that makes you want to settle in, enjoy a great meal, and come back again soon.

response.snippet: Hi Jayson. Thank you so much for your wonderful review! It means so much to know Café du Soleil feels like a place where you can relax, enjoy a meal and feel at home. We truly appreciate your kind words and can't wait to welcome you back again soon. Merci!

reviews.snippet: I have been to this place occasionally since we live in the neighborhood. On our most recent visit, the service was unusually poor. After being seated, it took a good 20-25 minutes for a waiter to come take our order. We never saw that waiter again. It took another 20-25 mins for the appetizer to arrive, which was brought by another waiter we had not interacted with. While we were waiting for our food, a third waiter tended the tables around us, chatting with some of the other patrons but completely ignoring us. After our appetizer was finished, another very long wait (a good 25 mins). We could see food coming out of the kitchen and being served to the tables around us, but nothing came our way. We tried to get the attention of the waiter who had been waiting on the tables near us, but he seemed to be avoiding us. We had to ask a busboy to try to find another waiter for us to check on our food. A few minutes later, our main courses were finally brought to us by a fourth person, the woman who had brought us to the table at the very beginning. We had been sitting there well over an hour. Some of the food was no longer very warm, suggesting it had been sitting in the kitchen for a while. Finally, the waiter who had been waiting on the nearby tables came to our table, asking a perfunctory “how’s everything?” When I expressed (calmly) that the service had been very slow, he became defensive and replied, unapologetically, that it wasn’t the service that was slow, it was the kitchen. “There’s nothing we can do about this,” he said curtly, walking away, seemingly upset. His defensive attitude was even more of a turn-off. We just finished our now lukewarm food, discussing among ourselves how the restaurant, and this waiter in particular, could have handled the situation better. When we were almost done, seemingly realizing that he had been rather rude, he came to our table and abruptly asked “do you want dessert X or Y since you have been waiting long ?” (presumably on the house). The way he said it again felt more condescending than apologetic and sincere. We just declined politely. Too late and not sincere enough. We don’t need free food, just attentive and polite service. We asked for our check and walked away, concluding that we don’t need to return to this place.

response.snippet: We’re truly sorry this visit left you feeling so disappointed. We understand your frustration, not only with the delays, but with the lack of communication and the way the situation was handled. That’s not the experience we want anyone to have at our restaurant. We found out who the waiter is and will address the issue with him.

reviews.snippet: My review is based on take out. I ordered the pistachio cheesecake based on the photo on Cafe du Soleil's website. What I received didn't even look close to what was online (see photo). I was looking forward to what I saw online and not what I actually received. I checked when I got home and was too far to go back and return it. Someone needs to update the site or don't post photos of items you don't actually have. So disappointed!

response.snippet: We updated the photo, so sorry. I hope it tasted great though.

reviews.snippet: Had a fabulous brunch here last weekend with a friend, love this place, the decor, the food, the light it’s just a solid spot! Staff is super helpful and sweet. Food is top, I had the French burger and it was spectacular, I plan on becoming a regular here! Bravo!

response.snippet: The French Burger is such a hit! Thanks Stewart, we are known for our Brunch and we are happy to have you as a customer. It's funny you said Solid, we had an article that quoted Cafe du Soleil as "a solid French bistro on the Upper West side".

reviews.snippet: I am a longstanding fan of Cafe du Soleil. They have an extensive menu, and the food is good and well priced for the quality. No one should expect Michelin-star gastronomy, this is solid bistro cuisine, and they do that well. The happy hour is an exceptional value, and I don't know how they make money, but having to be at the (tight) bar does a pretty good job of rationing service, so either come early or be willing to stand. I particularly relish the fact that the staff here are willing to tolerate my terrible French. This is a place I bring my friends and family, and look forward to doing so for a long time to come!

response.snippet: We love having you as a regular and please keep practicing your French, where else are you going to do it!

reviews.snippet:
I’m French, and for a few months I had been hesitating to try a French restaurant because I was afraid of being disappointed.
Well, I was incredibly pleasantly surprised! The food was excellent, from the starters with le pâté de campagne and les escargots, to the main courses with le coq au vin and le bœuf bourguignon, and finally the dessert with la crème brûlée.
My American girlfriend loved it. I highly recommend it.

response.snippet:
Thank you so much for this thoughtful review. Coming from someone French, it truly means a lot to us. We’re very happy you decided to give us a try and that you enjoyed the experience from beginning to end.

We’re especially glad both you and your girlfriend loved the pâté de campagne, escargots, coq au vin, bœuf bourguignon, and crème brûlée. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another little taste of France in New York!

reviews.snippet: We enjoyed sitting here for brunch, the atmosphere and the service were great although the food was just OK.

response.snippet: Thank you for taking the time to share your brunch experience with us. We're glad you enjoyed the atmosphere and found our service to be great. We appreciate your honest feedback regarding the food and will take this into consideration as we continuously look for ways to improve.

reviews.snippet: I like the atmosphere at this French bistro and the food is surprisingly good. Note there is a French attitude towards service here even though we're on the UWS. They don't respond well to any modifications or special requests - forget about any issues you have with your order. If you stick to French classics and don't ask for anything special you should be good 👌 and it's an enjoyable meal.

response.snippet: Our French Onion Soup is indeed the best on the upper west side. Good time of year to enjoy it. Happy holidays

raw_place.title: Cafe du Soleil
raw_place.description: Simple French fare, old-time bistro decor & sidewalk seating make this a popular neighborhood spot.

reviews.snippet: My favorite bar near home! The staff is great, they have board games and shuffleboard, and their beers are top notch! I love going there at least once a week to see the different beers on tap. I brought my sister once here and she loved the Snow White cocktail. We came in during happy hour on Tuesday a while ago and the bartender was super sweet! Made her a cool custom cocktail that she enjoyed. It’s also bring your own food, which is great! Can bring it in or have it delivered. Bob’s will always be my comfort spot for a beer. Also spent new years there, great vibe! My boyfriend also did mention that they once played Akira on the projector. Incredible!

response.snippet: Thank you, Rasheeda, for the kind words! We'd love to have you back at Bob's anytime :)

reviews.snippet: Great vibe and drinks. However, when I paid for the first round of drinks, they presented the bill in a way that covered the line for 20% gratuity that was automatically added due to the large party I had just joined. Guess that’s on me for not triple checking, but I double tipped.

response.snippet: Thank you for the review, Nicki! I appreciate you sharing your experience.

reviews.snippet: Great bar. Love the bartenders and atmosphere. I love the shuffleboard table, and the fact that they give you free jello shots if you make the mini basketball shot behind the bar.

response.snippet: Thank you, Chase! Looking forward to serving you again. Come back soon!

reviews.snippet:
Cool aesthetic and crowd
Unfortunately one of the bartenders - Irish guy with leprechaun like costume - couldn’t be bothered to serve me as he was chatting up a customer. We made eye contact 2x but he chose to continue his convo.

response.snippet: Hi Bryan - thank you for your feedback and honest review. I hope you'll give us another chance to serve you better! Give us a shout at Drinkmore@bobsyouruncle.nyc if you want to and we'll make it right.

reviews.snippet:
Bob's is a bit of a legend in my friend group. It's a proper neighborhood bar. Good tap selection, standard liquor options, dim lighting, cozy seating, sports on the projector... It fits the bill of the "third place" that is often hard to find elsewhere in the neighborhood.
Bob's is just far enough away from Columbia that it doesn't get slammed with undergrad students. Patrons tend to be locals and older Columbia graduate students or veterans.
A comfortable spot that I frequented while in school and now a place I get to visit when I'm back in town.

response.snippet: We know it's very delayed, but thank you Mark for the thoughtful 5-star review. We'd love to serve you again next time you are in town!

reviews.snippet: They dont do food, so you can bring your own. Just order a drink or two and youre good. They have good options for drinks and the workers are very kind.

response.snippet: Thanks Julius! Looking forward to serving you again :)

reviews.snippet: The bartender was extremely rude to us when we arrived. We got there way before closing time and he sent us away in a very unaccetable manner. I don’t recommend this place.

response.snippet: Hi and thanks for sharing your experience here. I’m so sorry this happened and you were treated like that. Please send us an email and we’ll do our best to make it right: Drinkmore@bobsyouruncle.nyc

reviews.snippet: Great place to visit! We were so much welcomed by the regulars and the owners during our only (consecutive) three nights visiting. Hope to see you all again! Love, your “German” friends 💖

response.snippet: Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We’d love to have you back soon :)

reviews.snippet: Neighborhood spot with nitro left hand milk stout on tap. One of my absolute favorite beers that has been harder to find the last few years. Projector for sports ball and shuffleboard are also a huge plus.

response.snippet: Thanks K E for the 5-stars! We'd love to serve you again!

reviews.snippet: Old bar. Used to be a butchers. Building goes back to the 1860s. Inexpensive place with a few choices of wine and beer. Lovely service. And a great movie based card game.

response.snippet: Thanks, Andi!

reviews.snippet: Was disappointed about the very mean bartender being rude to us before we even walked into the building (over an hour before closing time) he yelled “go away” to us very aggressively

response.snippet: Hi Annabella - This is definitely not okay and not the experience we'd want you to have. Please send us an email at Drinkmore@bobsyouruncle.nyc and we'll do our best to make it right.

reviews.snippet: I love this place!!!! I live across the street and have visited on and off since moving to NY. Then I saw a sign saying they were having a trivia night!!! I was soooo excited! I used to do trivia nights in college with my friends (team name the Brainiacs), and I missed that! I started going to Josef’s trivia nights and had so much fun! I loved the atmosphere, and the bartenders, Alex and Chelsea, made me feel safe and at home! Even when men come up to you and ask if “you come here often,” when you’re just focused on trivia questions. I am here for the fun of trivia nights and the safety of being close to home! Treated like family is a very accurate calling card for this place! 10/10 Recommend!

response.snippet: Thank you so much, Suleyma, for the kind words! We have trivia night every Monday and look forward to seeing you again :)

reviews.snippet: Bob’s is hands down my favorite local bar—it never disappoints! The staff is amazing, and they have board games and shuffleboard to keep things fun, not to mention an excellent selection of beers. I make it a point to drop by every week to try the newest brews on tap. Once, I brought my sister along, and she absolutely loved the Snow White cocktail. We happened to be there during a happy hour on a Tuesday some time ago, and the bartender went the extra mile by creating a custom cocktail just for her. Another fantastic feature is that you're welcome to bring your own food or even order in. Bob’s is always my go-to spot for a beer. I even celebrated New Year's there, and the atmosphere was amazing! My boyfriend also noted that they once showed Akira on the projector. How awesome is that?

response.snippet: Thank you so much for this review, Ryder! I know it's been a while since you posted but we are catching up on old reviews so wanted to just express our thanks. We hope to see you again soon!

reviews.snippet: Loved the vibe of this place. The warm atmosphere and cozy setting made it feel like home, especially by my second visit. The ‘bring your own food’ policy was a surprise, but it added to the experience, making for a fun and laid-back time. No frills, just pure enjoyment of what really matters.

reviews.snippet:
Manna's is the real deal — and I don't just mean the food.

I came in and the plate was $12. I only had $11 and a hundred dollar bill, so I asked if it was okay to pay with the hundred. Without hesitation, the man behind the counter said to just give him the $11 — "we don't worship money." I honestly wasn't expecting that. It stopped me in my tracks. That kind of warmth and generosity is rare anywhere, let alone in New York City.

The food matched the energy completely. Rice and beans cooked deep and flavorful, a perfectly fried protein with a sticky glaze, and braised greens on the side — all generous, all delicious, all incredibly affordable. This is soul food done with actual soul.

Manna's isn't just a restaurant. It's a reminder that some places still run on genuine love for people. I'll be back — with exact change and then some.

After a morning of strolling on 125th Street in the heart of Harlem, it is easy to become hungrey (if you know what I mean). So of course, I needed to stop by Manna’s for something to eat. And of course, Marylin and her staff did not disappoint. Everything from her homemade ginger juice and array of hot and cold dishes to choose from, buffet style you just need to have portion control bc once your dish gets the weight in, you may realized the truly your eyes are bigger than your wallet and stomach. So be mindful, walk around the buffet before taking your plate, the choices are incredible. They also have a catering menu so whatever you see can be created for a special occasion. I believe the pictures will speak for themselves. Enjoy

reviews.snippet: The owner of this place, Ms. Betty Park, is well-known even in Korea. I was genuinely surprised to hear that she’s involved in community service, makes donations, and even runs a scholarship foundation in Harlem. The restaurant itself is a bit smaller than I expected, but the variety of food is impressive. The Korean-style seasoned fried chicken left the biggest impression on me—it could easily compete with some of the most famous chicken dishes in New York. The cornbread was absolutely delicious, and even the spaghetti was great. It’s the kind of place I already want to go back to tomorrow. The food tasted incredibly fresh, and the cleanliness around the food area was top-notch. While it follows more of a deli-style hot food format, there’s no doubt this is one of Harlem’s must-try spots.

The rice had sautéed peppers, spices, and sausage. It was really soft and super flavorful.

Do not pass up on their green beans. I thought I would not like it as I usually don’t care for the standard green beans. I get at American restaurants. I was pleasantly surprised to see that these were really sweet and juicy! Highly recommend.

And as I mentioned at the beginning, their chicken was very tough and dry, but the flavor was there. I will give them a pass as it was pretty late at night, and that chicken probably was cooked earlier in the day.
